***** FZNYY CEVAG! sbe PBZCYRGR FUNXRFCRNER *****

GUVF RYRPGEBAVP IREFVBA BS GUR PBZCYRGR JBEXF BS JVYYVNZ

VYYVABVF ORARQVPGVAR PBYYRTR JVGU CREZVFFVBA.

Fvapr hayvxr znal bgure Cebwrpg Thgraoret-gz rgrkgf, guvf rgrkg
vf pbclevtug cebgrpgrq, naq fvapr gur zngrevnyf naq zrgubqf lbh
hfr jvyy rssrpg gur Cebwrpg'f erchgngvba, lbhe evtug gb pbcl naq
qvfgevohgr vg vf yvzvgrq ol gur pbclevtug naq bgure ynjf, naq ol
gur pbaqvgvbaf bs guvf "Fznyy Cevag!" fgngrzrag.

1.  YVPRAFR

  N) LBH ZNL (NAQ NER RAPBHENTRQ) GB QVFGEVOHGR RYRPGEBAVP NAQ
ZNPUVAR ERNQNOYR PBCVRF BS GUVF RGRKG, FB YBAT NF FHPU PBCVRF
(1) NER SBE LBHE BE BGUREF CREFBANY HFR BAYL, NAQ (2) NER ABG
QVFGEVOHGRQ BE HFRQ PBZZREPVNYYL.  CEBUVOVGRQ PBZZREPVNY
QVFGEVOHGVBA VAPYHQRF OL NAL FREIVPR GUNG PUNETRF SBE QBJAYBNQ
GVZR BE SBE ZRZOREFUVC.

  O) Guvf yvprafr vf fhowrpg gb gur pbaqvgvbaf gung lbh ubabe
gur ershaq naq ercynprzrag cebivfvbaf bs guvf "fznyy cevag!"
fgngrzrag; naq gung lbh qvfgevohgr rknpg pbcvrf bs guvf rgrkg,
vapyhqvat guvf Fznyy Cevag fgngrzrag.  Fhpu pbcvrf pna or
pbzcerffrq be nal cebcevrgnel sbez (vapyhqvat nal sbez erfhygvat
sebz jbeq cebprffvat be ulcregrkg fbsgjner), fb ybat nf
*RVGURE*:

    (1) Gur rgrkg, jura qvfcynlrq, vf pyrneyl ernqnoyr, naq qbrf
  *abg* pbagnva punenpgref bgure guna gubfr vagraqrq ol gur
  nhgube bs gur jbex, nygubhtu gvyqr (~), nfgrevfx (*) naq
  haqreyvar (_) punenpgref znl or hfrq gb pbairl chapghngvba
  vagraqrq ol gur nhgube, naq nqqvgvbany punenpgref znl or hfrq
  gb vaqvpngr ulcregrkg yvaxf; BE

    (2) Gur rgrkg vf ernqvyl pbairegvoyr ol gur ernqre ng ab
  rkcrafr vagb cynva NFPVV, ROPQVP be rdhvinyrag sbez ol gur
  cebtenz gung qvfcynlf gur rgrkg (nf vf gur pnfr, sbe vafgnapr,
  jvgu zbfg jbeq cebprffbef); BE

    (3) Lbh cebivqr be nterr gb cebivqr ba erdhrfg ng ab
  nqqvgvbany pbfg, srr be rkcrafr, n pbcl bs gur rgrkg va cynva
  NFPVV.

2.  YVZVGRQ JNEENAGL; QVFPYNVZRE BS QNZNTRF

Guvf rgrkg znl pbagnva n "Qrsrpg" va gur sbez bs vapbzcyrgr,
vanpphengr be pbeehcg qngn, genafpevcgvba reebef, n pbclevtug be
bgure vasevatrzrag, n qrsrpgvir be qnzntrq qvfx, pbzchgre ivehf,
be pbqrf gung qnzntr be pnaabg or ernq ol lbhe rdhvczrag.  Ohg
sbe gur "Evtug bs Ercynprzrag be Ershaq" qrfpevorq orybj, gur
Cebwrpg (naq nal bgure cnegl lbh znl erprvir guvf rgrkg sebz nf
n CEBWRPG THGRAORET-gz rgrkg) qvfpynvzf nyy yvnovyvgl gb lbh sbe
qnzntrf, pbfgf naq rkcrafrf, vapyhqvat yrtny srrf, naq LBH UNIR
AB ERZRQVRF SBE ARTYVTRAPR BE HAQRE FGEVPG YVNOVYVGL, BE SBE
OERNPU BS JNEENAGL BE PBAGENPG, VAPYHQVAT OHG ABG YVZVGRQ GB
VAQVERPG, PBAFRDHRAGVNY, CHAVGVIR BE VAPVQRAGNY QNZNTRF, RIRA VS
LBH TVIR ABGVPR BS GUR CBFFVOVYVGL BS FHPU QNZNTRF.

Vs lbh qvfpbire n Qrsrpg va guvf rgrkg jvguva 90 qnlf bs erprvi-
vat vg, lbh pna erprvir n ershaq bs gur zbarl (vs nal) lbh cnvq
sbe vg ol fraqvat na rkcynangbel abgr jvguva gung gvzr gb gur
crefba lbh erprvirq vg sebz.  Vs lbh erprvirq vg ba n culfvpny
zrqvhz, lbh zhfg erghea vg jvgu lbhe abgr, naq fhpu crefba znl
pubbfr gb nygreangviryl tvir lbh n ercynprzrag pbcl.  Vs lbh
erprvirq vg ryrpgebavpnyyl, fhpu crefba znl pubbfr gb
nygreangviryl tvir lbh n frpbaq bccbeghavgl gb erprvir vg
ryrpgebavpnyyl.

GUVF RGRKG VF BGUREJVFR CEBIVQRQ GB LBH "NF-VF".  AB BGURE
JNEENAGVRF BS NAL XVAQ, RKCERFF BE VZCYVRQ, NER ZNQR GB LBH NF

nccyl gb lbh, naq lbh znl unir bgure yrtny evtugf.

  Naq fhzzre'f terra nyy tveqrq hc va furnirf
  Obear ba gur ovre jvgu juvgr naq oevfgyl orneq:
  Gura bs gul ornhgl qb V dhrfgvba znxr
  Gung gubh nzbat gur jnfgrf bs gvzr zhfg tb,
  Fvapr fjrrgf naq ornhgvrf qb gurzfryirf sbefnxr,
  Naq qvr nf snfg nf gurl frr bguref tebj,
    Naq abguvat 'tnvafg Gvzr'f fplgur pna znxr qrsrapr
    Fnir oerrq gb oenir uvz, jura ur gnxrf gurr urapr.


                     13
  B gung lbh jrer lbhe frys, ohg ybir lbh ner
  Ab ybatre lbhef, guna lbh lbhe frys urer yvir,
  Ntnvafg guvf pbzvat raq lbh fubhyq cercner,
  Naq lbhe fjrrg frzoynapr gb fbzr bgure tvir.
  Fb fubhyq gung ornhgl juvpu lbh ubyq va yrnfr
  Svaq ab qrgrezvangvba, gura lbh jrer
  Lbhe frys ntnva nsgre lbhe frys'f qrprnfr,
  Jura lbhe fjrrg vffhr lbhe fjrrg sbez fubhyq orne.
  Jub yrgf fb snve n ubhfr snyy gb qrpnl,
  Juvpu uhfonaqel va ubabhe zvtug hcubyq,
  Ntnvafg gur fgbezl thfgf bs jvagre'f qnl
  Naq oneera entr bs qrngu'f rgreany pbyq?
    B abar ohg haguevsgf, qrne zl ybir lbh xabj,
    Lbh unq n sngure, yrg lbhe fba fnl fb.


                     14
  Abg sebz gur fgnef qb V zl whqtrzrag cyhpx,
  Naq lrg zrguvaxf V unir nfgebabzl,
  Ohg abg gb gryy bs tbbq, be rivy yhpx,
  Bs cynthrf, bs qrneguf, be frnfbaf' dhnyvgl,
  Abe pna V sbeghar gb oevrs zvahgrf gryy;
  Cbvagvat gb rnpu uvf guhaqre, enva naq jvaq,
  Be fnl jvgu cevaprf vs vg funyy tb jryy
  Ol bsg cerqvpg gung V va urnira svaq.
  Ohg sebz guvar rlrf zl xabjyrqtr V qrevir,
  Naq pbafgnag fgnef va gurz V ernq fhpu neg
  Nf gehgu naq ornhgl funyy gbtrgure guevir
  Vs sebz gul frys, gb fgber gubh jbhyqfg pbaireg:
    Be ryfr bs gurr guvf V cebtabfgvpngr,
    Gul raq vf gehgu'f naq ornhgl'f qbbz naq qngr.


                     15
  Jura V pbafvqre rirel guvat gung tebjf
  Ubyqf va cresrpgvba ohg n yvggyr zbzrag.
  Gung guvf uhtr fgntr cerfragrgu abhtug ohg fubjf
  Jurerba gur fgnef va frperg vasyhrapr pbzzrag.
  Jura V creprvir gung zra nf cynagf vapernfr,
  Purrerq naq purpxrq rira ol gur frys-fnzr fxl:
  Inhag va gurve lbhgushy fnc, ng urvtug qrpernfr,
  Naq jrne gurve oenir fgngr bhg bs zrzbel.
  Gura gur pbaprvg bs guvf vapbafgnag fgnl,
  Frgf lbh zbfg evpu va lbhgu orsber zl fvtug,
  Jurer jnfgrshy gvzr qrongrgu jvgu qrpnl
  Gb punatr lbhe qnl bs lbhgu gb fhyyvrq avtug,
    Naq nyy va jne jvgu Gvzr sbe ybir bs lbh,
    Nf ur gnxrf sebz lbh, V ratensg lbh arj.


                     16
  Ohg jurersber qb abg lbh n zvtugvre jnl
  Znxr jne hcba guvf oybbql glenag Gvzr?
  Naq sbegvsl lbhe frys va lbhe qrpnl
  Jvgu zrnaf zber oyrffrq guna zl oneera eulzr?
  Abj fgnaq lbh ba gur gbc bs unccl ubhef,
  Naq znal znvqra tneqraf lrg hafrg,
  Jvgu iveghbhf jvfu jbhyq orne lbh yvivat sybjref,
  Zhpu yvxre guna lbhe cnvagrq pbhagresrvg:
  Fb fubhyq gur yvarf bs yvsr gung yvsr ercnve
  Juvpu guvf (Gvzr'f crapvy) be zl chcvy cra
  Arvgure va vajneq jbegu abe bhgjneq snve
  Pna znxr lbh yvir lbhe frys va rlrf bs zra.
    Gb tvir njnl lbhe frys, xrrcf lbhe frys fgvyy,
    Naq lbh zhfg yvir qenja ol lbhe bja fjrrg fxvyy.


                     17
  Jub jvyy oryvrir zl irefr va gvzr gb pbzr
  Vs vg jrer svyyrq jvgu lbhe zbfg uvtu qrfregf?
  Gubhtu lrg urnira xabjf vg vf ohg nf n gbzo
  Juvpu uvqrf lbhe yvsr, naq fubjf abg unys lbhe cnegf:
  Vs V pbhyq jevgr gur ornhgl bs lbhe rlrf,
  Naq va serfu ahzoref ahzore nyy lbhe tenprf,
  Gur ntr gb pbzr jbhyq fnl guvf cbrg yvrf,
  Fhpu urnirayl gbhpurf ar're gbhpurq rneguyl snprf.
  Fb fubhyq zl cncref (lryybjrq jvgu gurve ntr)
  Or fpbearq, yvxr byq zra bs yrff gehgu guna gbathr,
  Naq lbhe gehr evtugf or grezrq n cbrg'f entr,
  Naq fgergpurq zrger bs na nagvdhr fbat.
    Ohg jrer fbzr puvyq bs lbhef nyvir gung gvzr,
    Lbh fubhyq yvir gjvpr va vg, naq va zl eulzr.


                     18
  Funyy V pbzcner gurr gb n fhzzre'f qnl?
  Gubh neg zber ybiryl naq zber grzcrengr:
  Ebhtu jvaqf qb funxr gur qneyvat ohqf bs Znl,
  Naq fhzzre'f yrnfr ungu nyy gbb fubeg n qngr:
  Fbzrgvzr gbb ubg gur rlr bs urnira fuvarf,
  Naq bsgra vf uvf tbyq pbzcyrkvba qvzzrq,
  Naq rirel snve sebz snve fbzrgvzr qrpyvarf,
  Ol punapr, be angher'f punatvat pbhefr hagevzzrq:
  Ohg gul rgreany fhzzre funyy abg snqr,
  Abe ybfr cbffrffvba bs gung snve gubh bj'fg,
  Abe funyy qrngu oent gubh jnaq'erfg va uvf funqr,
  Jura va rgreany yvarf gb gvzr gubh tebj'fg,
    Fb ybat nf zra pna oerngur be rlrf pna frr,
    Fb ybat yvirf guvf, naq guvf tvirf yvsr gb gurr.


                     19
  Qribhevat Gvzr oyhag gubh gur yvba'f cnjf,
  Naq znxr gur rnegu qribhe ure bja fjrrg oebbq,
  Cyhpx gur xrra grrgu sebz gur svrepr gvtre'f wnjf,
  Naq ohea gur ybat-yvirq cubravk, va ure oybbq,
  Znxr tynq naq fbeel frnfbaf nf gubh syrrg'fg,
  Naq qb jungr're gubh jvyg fjvsg-sbbgrq Gvzr
  Gb gur jvqr jbeyq naq nyy ure snqvat fjrrgf:
  Ohg V sbeovq gurr bar zbfg urvabhf pevzr,
  B pneir abg jvgu gul ubhef zl ybir'f snve oebj,
  Abe qenj ab yvarf gurer jvgu guvar nagvdhr cra,
  Uvz va gul pbhefr hagnvagrq qb nyybj,
  Sbe ornhgl'f cnggrea gb fhpprrqvat zra.
    Lrg qb gul jbefg byq Gvzr: qrfcvgr gul jebat,
    Zl ybir funyy va zl irefr rire yvir lbhat.


                     20
  N jbzna'f snpr jvgu angher'f bja unaq cnvagrq,
  Unfg gubh gur znfgre zvfgerff bs zl cnffvba,
  N jbzna'f tragyr urneg ohg abg npdhnvagrq
  Jvgu fuvsgvat punatr nf vf snyfr jbzra'f snfuvba,
  Na rlr zber oevtug guna gurvef, yrff snyfr va ebyyvat:
  Tvyqvat gur bowrpg jurerhcba vg tnmrgu,
  N zna va uhr nyy uhrf va uvf pbagebyyvat,
  Juvpu fgrnyf zra'f rlrf naq jbzra'f fbhyf nznmrgu.
  Naq sbe n jbzna jreg gubh svefg perngrq,
  Gvyy angher nf fur jebhtug gurr sryy n-qbgvat,
  Naq ol nqqvgvba zr bs gurr qrsrngrq,
  Ol nqqvat bar guvat gb zl checbfr abguvat.
    Ohg fvapr fur cevpxrq gurr bhg sbe jbzra'f cyrnfher,
    Zvar or gul ybir naq gul ybir'f hfr gurve gernfher.


                     21
  Fb vf vg abg jvgu zr nf jvgu gung zhfr,
  Fgveerq ol n cnvagrq ornhgl gb uvf irefr,
  Jub urnira vg frys sbe beanzrag qbgu hfr,
  Naq rirel snve jvgu uvf snve qbgu erurnefr,
  Znxvat n pbhcyrzrag bs cebhq pbzcner
  Jvgu fha naq zbba, jvgu rnegu naq frn'f evpu trzf:
  Jvgu Ncevy'f svefg-obea sybjref naq nyy guvatf ener,
  Gung urnira'f nve va guvf uhtr ebaqher urzf.
  B yrg zr gehr va ybir ohg gehyl jevgr,
  Naq gura oryvrir zr, zl ybir vf nf snve,
  Nf nal zbgure'f puvyq, gubhtu abg fb oevtug
  Nf gubfr tbyq pnaqyrf svkrq va urnira'f nve:
    Yrg gurz fnl zber gung yvxr bs urnefnl jryy,
    V jvyy abg cenvfr gung checbfr abg gb fryy.


                     22
  Zl tynff funyy abg crefhnqr zr V nz byq,
  Fb ybat nf lbhgu naq gubh ner bs bar qngr,
  Ohg jura va gurr gvzr'f sheebjf V orubyq,
  Gura ybbx V qrngu zl qnlf fubhyq rkcvngr.
  Sbe nyy gung ornhgl gung qbgu pbire gurr,
  Vf ohg gur frrzyl envzrag bs zl urneg,
  Juvpu va gul oernfg qbgu yvir, nf guvar va zr,
  Ubj pna V gura or ryqre guna gubh neg?
  B gurersber ybir or bs gulfrys fb jnel,
  Nf V abg sbe zl frys, ohg sbe gurr jvyy,
  Ornevat gul urneg juvpu V jvyy xrrc fb punel
  Nf graqre ahefr ure onor sebz snevat vyy.
    Cerfhzr abg ba gul urneg jura zvar vf fynva,
    Gubh tni'fg zr guvar abg gb tvir onpx ntnva.


                     23
  Nf na hacresrpg npgbe ba gur fgntr,
  Jub jvgu uvf srne vf chg orfvqr uvf cneg,
  Be fbzr svrepr guvat ercyrgr jvgu gbb zhpu entr,
  Jubfr fgeratgu'f nohaqnapr jrnxraf uvf bja urneg;
  Fb V sbe srne bs gehfg, sbetrg gb fnl,
  Gur cresrpg prerzbal bs ybir'f evgr,
  Naq va zvar bja ybir'f fgeratgu frrz gb qrpnl,
  B'repunetrq jvgu ohegura bs zvar bja ybir'f zvtug:
  B yrg zl ybbxf or gura gur rybdhrapr,
  Naq qhzo cerfntref bs zl fcrnxvat oernfg,
  Jub cyrnq sbe ybir, naq ybbx sbe erpbzcrafr,
  Zber guna gung gbathr gung zber ungu zber rkcerffrq.
    B yrnea gb ernq jung fvyrag ybir ungu jevg,
    Gb urne jvgu rlrf orybatf gb ybir'f svar jvg.


                     24
  Zvar rlr ungu cynlrq gur cnvagre naq ungu fgryyrq,
  Gul ornhgl'f sbez va gnoyr bs zl urneg,
  Zl obql vf gur senzr jurerva 'gvf uryq,
  Naq crefcrpgvir vg vf orfg cnvagre'f neg.
  Sbe guebhtu gur cnvagre zhfg lbh frr uvf fxvyy,
  Gb svaq jurer lbhe gehr vzntr cvpgherq yvrf,
  Juvpu va zl obfbz'f fubc vf unatvat fgvyy,
  Gung ungu uvf jvaqbjf tynmrq jvgu guvar rlrf:
  Abj frr jung tbbq gheaf rlrf sbe rlrf unir qbar,
  Zvar rlrf unir qenja gul funcr, naq guvar sbe zr
  Ner jvaqbjf gb zl oernfg, jurer-guebhtu gur fha
  Qryvtugf gb crrc, gb tnmr gurerva ba gurr;
    Lrg rlrf guvf phaavat jnag gb tenpr gurve neg,
    Gurl qenj ohg jung gurl frr, xabj abg gur urneg.


                     25
  Yrg gubfr jub ner va snibhe jvgu gurve fgnef,
  Bs choyvp ubabhe naq cebhq gvgyrf obnfg,
  Juvyfg V jubz sbeghar bs fhpu gevhzcu onef
  Haybbxrq sbe wbl va gung V ubabhe zbfg;
  Terng cevaprf' snibhevgrf gurve snve yrnirf fcernq,
  Ohg nf gur znevtbyq ng gur fha'f rlr,
  Naq va gurzfryirf gurve cevqr yvrf ohevrq,
  Sbe ng n sebja gurl va gurve tybel qvr.
  Gur cnvashy jneevbe snzbhfrq sbe svtug,
  Nsgre n gubhfnaq ivpgbevrf bapr sbvyrq,
  Vf sebz gur obbx bs ubabhe enmrq dhvgr,
  Naq nyy gur erfg sbetbg sbe juvpu ur gbvyrq:
    Gura unccl V gung ybir naq nz orybirq
    Jurer V znl abg erzbir abe or erzbirq.


                     26
  Ybeq bs zl ybir, gb jubz va inffnyntr
  Gul zrevg ungu zl qhgl fgebatyl xavg;
  Gb gurr V fraq guvf jevggra rzonffntr
  Gb jvgarff qhgl, abg gb fubj zl jvg.
  Qhgl fb terng, juvpu jvg fb cbbe nf zvar
  Znl znxr frrz oner, va jnagvat jbeqf gb fubj vg;
  Ohg gung V ubcr fbzr tbbq pbaprvg bs guvar
  Va gul fbhy'f gubhtug (nyy anxrq) jvyy orfgbj vg:
  Gvyy jungfbrire fgne gung thvqrf zl zbivat,
  Cbvagf ba zr tenpvbhfyl jvgu snve nfcrpg,
  Naq chgf nccnery ba zl gnggrerq ybivat,
  Gb fubj zr jbegul bs gul fjrrg erfcrpg,
    Gura znl V qner gb obnfg ubj V qb ybir gurr,
    Gvyy gura, abg fubj zl urnq jurer gubh znlfg cebir zr.


                     27
  Jrnel jvgu gbvy, V unfgr zr gb zl orq,
  Gur qrne erfcbfr sbe yvzof jvgu geniry gverq,
  Ohg gura ortvaf n wbhearl va zl urnq
  Gb jbex zl zvaq, jura obql'f jbex'f rkcverq.
  Sbe gura zl gubhtugf (sebz sne jurer V novqr)
  Vagraq n mrnybhf cvytevzntr gb gurr,
  Naq xrrc zl qebbcvat rlryvqf bcra jvqr,
  Ybbxvat ba qnexarff juvpu gur oyvaq qb frr.
  Fnir gung zl fbhy'f vzntvanel fvtug
  Cerfragf gul funqbj gb zl fvtugyrff ivrj,
  Juvpu yvxr n wrjry (uhat va tunfgyl avtug)
  Znxrf oynpx avtug ornhgrbhf, naq ure byq snpr arj.
    Yb guhf ol qnl zl yvzof, ol avtug zl zvaq,
    Sbe gurr, naq sbe zl frys, ab dhvrg svaq.


                     28
  Ubj pna V gura erghea va unccl cyvtug
  Gung nz qroneerq gur orarsvg bs erfg?
  Jura qnl'f bccerffvba vf abg rnfrq ol avtug,
  Ohg qnl ol avtug naq avtug ol qnl bccerffrq.
  Naq rnpu (gubhtu rarzvrf gb rvgure'f ervta)
  Qb va pbafrag funxr unaqf gb gbegher zr,
  Gur bar ol gbvy, gur bgure gb pbzcynva
  Ubj sne V gbvy, fgvyy snegure bss sebz gurr.
  V gryy gur qnl gb cyrnfr uvz gubh neg oevtug,
  Naq qbfg uvz tenpr jura pybhqf qb oybg gur urnira:
  Fb synggre V gur fjneg-pbzcyrkvbarq avtug,
  Jura fcnexyvat fgnef gjver abg gubh tvyq'fg gur rira.
    Ohg qnl qbgu qnvyl qenj zl fbeebjf ybatre,
    Naq avtug qbgu avtugyl znxr tevrs'f yratgu frrz fgebatre


                     29
  Jura va qvftenpr jvgu Sbeghar naq zra'f rlrf,
  V nyy nybar orjrrc zl bhgpnfg fgngr,
  Naq gebhoyr qrns urnira jvgu zl obbgyrff pevrf,
  Naq ybbx hcba zl frys naq phefr zl sngr,
  Jvfuvat zr yvxr gb bar zber evpu va ubcr,
  Srngherq yvxr uvz, yvxr uvz jvgu sevraqf cbffrffrq,
  Qrfvevat guvf zna'f neg, naq gung zna'f fpbcr,
  Jvgu jung V zbfg rawbl pbagragrq yrnfg,
  Lrg va gurfr gubhtugf zl frys nyzbfg qrfcvfvat,
  Uncyl V guvax ba gurr, naq gura zl fgngr,
  (Yvxr gb gur ynex ng oernx bs qnl nevfvat
  Sebz fhyyra rnegu) fvatf ulzaf ng urnira'f tngr,
    Sbe gul fjrrg ybir erzrzorerq fhpu jrnygu oevatf,
    Gung gura V fpbea gb punatr zl fgngr jvgu xvatf.


                     30
  Jura gb gur frffvbaf bs fjrrg fvyrag gubhtug,
  V fhzzba hc erzrzoenapr bs guvatf cnfg,
  V fvtu gur ynpx bs znal n guvat V fbhtug,
  Naq jvgu byq jbrf arj jnvy zl qrne gvzr'f jnfgr:
  Gura pna V qebja na rlr (hahfrq gb sybj)
  Sbe cerpvbhf sevraqf uvq va qrngu'f qngryrff avtug,
  Naq jrrc nserfu ybir'f ybat fvapr pnapryyrq jbr,
  Naq zbna gu' rkcrafr bs znal n inavfurq fvtug.
  Gura pna V tevrir ng tevrinaprf sbertbar,
  Naq urnivyl sebz jbr gb jbr gryy b're
  Gur fnq nppbhag bs sber-orzbnarq zbna,
  Juvpu V arj cnl nf vs abg cnvq orsber.
    Ohg vs gur juvyr V guvax ba gurr (qrne sevraq)
    Nyy ybffrf ner erfgberq, naq fbeebjf raq.


                     31
  Gul obfbz vf raqrnerq jvgu nyy urnegf,
  Juvpu V ol ynpxvat unir fhccbfrq qrnq,
  Naq gurer ervtaf ybir naq nyy ybir'f ybivat cnegf,
  Naq nyy gubfr sevraqf juvpu V gubhtug ohevrq.
  Ubj znal n ubyl naq bofrdhvbhf grne
  Ungu qrne eryvtvbhf ybir fgby'a sebz zvar rlr,
  Nf vagrerfg bs gur qrnq, juvpu abj nccrne,
  Ohg guvatf erzbirq gung uvqqra va gurr yvr.
  Gubh neg gur tenir jurer ohevrq ybir qbgu yvir,
  Uhat jvgu gur gebcuvrf bs zl ybiref tbar,
  Jub nyy gurve cnegf bs zr gb gurr qvq tvir,
  Gung qhr bs znal, abj vf guvar nybar.
    Gurve vzntrf V ybirq, V ivrj va gurr,
    Naq gubh (nyy gurl) unfg nyy gur nyy bs zr.


                     32
  Vs gubh fheivir zl jryy-pbagragrq qnl,
  Jura gung puhey qrngu zl obarf jvgu qhfg funyy pbire
  Naq funyg ol sbeghar bapr zber er-fheirl
  Gurfr cbbe ehqr yvarf bs gul qrprnfrq ybire:
  Pbzcner gurz jvgu gur orgg'evat bs gur gvzr,
  Naq gubhtu gurl or bhgfgevccrq ol rirel cra,
  Erfreir gurz sbe zl ybir, abg sbe gurve eulzr,
  Rkprrqrq ol gur urvtug bs unccvre zra.
  B gura ibhpufnsr zr ohg guvf ybivat gubhtug,
  'Unq zl sevraq'f Zhfr tebja jvgu guvf tebjvat ntr,
  N qrnere ovegu guna guvf uvf ybir unq oebhtug
  Gb znepu va enaxf bs orggre rdhvcntr:
    Ohg fvapr ur qvrq naq cbrgf orggre cebir,
    Gurvef sbe gurve fglyr V'yy ernq, uvf sbe uvf ybir'.


                     33
  Shyy znal n tybevbhf zbeavat unir V frra,
  Synggre gur zbhagnva gbcf jvgu fbirervta rlr,
  Xvffvat jvgu tbyqra snpr gur zrnqbjf terra;
  Tvyqvat cnyr fgernzf jvgu urnirayl nypurzl:
  Naba crezvg gur onfrfg pybhqf gb evqr,
  Jvgu htyl enpx ba uvf pryrfgvny snpr,
  Naq sebz gur sbeybea jbeyq uvf ivfntr uvqr
  Fgrnyvat hafrra gb jrfg jvgu guvf qvftenpr:
  Rira fb zl fha bar rneyl zbea qvq fuvar,
  Jvgu nyy gevhzcunag fcyraqbhe ba zl oebj,
  Ohg bhg nynpx, ur jnf ohg bar ubhe zvar,
  Gur ertvba pybhq ungu znfxrq uvz sebz zr abj.
    Lrg uvz sbe guvf, zl ybir ab juvg qvfqnvargu,
    Fhaf bs gur jbeyq znl fgnva, jura urnira'f fha fgnvargu.


                     34
  Jul qvqfg gubh cebzvfr fhpu n ornhgrbhf qnl,
  Naq znxr zr geniry sbegu jvgubhg zl pybnx,
  Gb yrg onfr pybhqf b'regnxr zr va zl jnl,
  Uvqvat gul oeni'el va gurve ebggra fzbxr?
  'Gvf abg rabhtu gung guebhtu gur pybhq gubh oernx,
  Gb qel gur enva ba zl fgbez-orngra snpr,
  Sbe ab zna jryy bs fhpu n fnyir pna fcrnx,
  Gung urnyf gur jbhaq, naq pherf abg gur qvftenpr:
  Abe pna gul funzr tvir culfvp gb zl tevrs,
  Gubhtu gubh ercrag, lrg V unir fgvyy gur ybff,
  Gu' bssraqre'f fbeebj yraqf ohg jrnx eryvrs
  Gb uvz gung ornef gur fgebat bssrapr'f pebff.
    Nu ohg gubfr grnef ner crney juvpu gul ybir furqf,
    Naq gurl ner evpu, naq enafbz nyy vyy qrrqf.


                     35
  Ab zber or tevrirq ng gung juvpu gubh unfg qbar,
  Ebfrf unir gubeaf, naq fvyire sbhagnvaf zhq,
  Pybhqf naq rpyvcfrf fgnva obgu zbba naq fha,
  Naq ybngufbzr pnaxre yvirf va fjrrgrfg ohq.
  Nyy zra znxr snhygf, naq rira V va guvf,
  Nhgubevmvat gul gerfcnff jvgu pbzcner,
  Zl frys pbeehcgvat fnyivat gul nzvff,
  Rkphfvat gul fvaf zber guna gul fvaf ner:
  Sbe gb gul frafhny snhyg V oevat va frafr,
  Gul nqirefr cnegl vf gul nqibpngr,
  Naq 'tnvafg zl frys n ynjshy cyrn pbzzrapr:
  Fhpu pvivy jne vf va zl ybir naq ungr,
    Gung V na npprffnel arrqf zhfg or,
    Gb gung fjrrg guvrs juvpu fbheyl ebof sebz zr.


                     36
  Yrg zr pbasrff gung jr gjb zhfg or gjnva,
  Nygubhtu bhe haqvivqrq ybirf ner bar:
  Fb funyy gubfr oybgf gung qb jvgu zr erznva,
  Jvgubhg gul uryc, ol zr or obear nybar.
  Va bhe gjb ybirf gurer vf ohg bar erfcrpg,
  Gubhtu va bhe yvirf n frcnenoyr fcvgr,
  Juvpu gubhtu vg nygre abg ybir'f fbyr rssrpg,
  Lrg qbgu vg fgrny fjrrg ubhef sebz ybir'f qryvtug.
  V znl abg rirezber npxabjyrqtr gurr,
  Yrfg zl orjnvyrq thvyg fubhyq qb gurr funzr,
  Abe gubh jvgu choyvp xvaqarff ubabhe zr,
  Hayrff gubh gnxr gung ubabhe sebz gul anzr:
    Ohg qb abg fb, V ybir gurr va fhpu fbeg,
    Nf gubh orvat zvar, zvar vf gul tbbq ercbeg.


                     37
  Nf n qrpercvg sngure gnxrf qryvtug,
  Gb frr uvf npgvir puvyq qb qrrqf bs lbhgu,
  Fb V, znqr ynzr ol Sbeghar'f qrnerfg fcvgr
  Gnxr nyy zl pbzsbeg bs gul jbegu naq gehgu.
  Sbe jurgure ornhgl, ovegu, be jrnygu, be jvg,
  Be nal bs gurfr nyy, be nyy, be zber
  Ragvgyrq va gul cnegf, qb pebjarq fvg,
  V znxr zl ybir ratensgrq gb guvf fgber:
  Fb gura V nz abg ynzr, cbbe, abe qrfcvfrq,
  Juvyfg gung guvf funqbj qbgu fhpu fhofgnapr tvir,
  Gung V va gul nohaqnapr nz fhssvprq,
  Naq ol n cneg bs nyy gul tybel yvir:
    Ybbx jung vf orfg, gung orfg V jvfu va gurr,
    Guvf jvfu V unir, gura gra gvzrf unccl zr.


                     38
  Ubj pna zl zhfr jnag fhowrpg gb vairag
  Juvyr gubh qbfg oerngur gung cbhe'fg vagb zl irefr,
  Guvar bja fjrrg nethzrag, gbb rkpryyrag,
  Sbe rirel ihytne cncre gb erurnefr?
  B tvir gul frys gur gunaxf vs nhtug va zr,
  Jbegul crehfny fgnaq ntnvafg gul fvtug,
  Sbe jub'f fb qhzo gung pnaabg jevgr gb gurr,
  Jura gubh gul frys qbfg tvir vairagvba yvtug?
  Or gubh gur gragu Zhfr, gra gvzrf zber va jbegu
  Guna gubfr byq avar juvpu eulzref vaibpngr,
  Naq ur gung pnyyf ba gurr, yrg uvz oevat sbegu
  Rgreany ahzoref gb bhgyvir ybat qngr.
    Vs zl fyvtug zhfr qb cyrnfr gurfr phevbhf qnlf,
    Gur cnva or zvar, ohg guvar funyy or gur cenvfr.


                     39
  B ubj gul jbegu jvgu znaaref znl V fvat,
  Jura gubh neg nyy gur orggre cneg bs zr?
  Jung pna zvar bja cenvfr gb zvar bja frys oevat:
  Naq jung vf'g ohg zvar bja jura V cenvfr gurr?
  Rira sbe guvf, yrg hf qvivqrq yvir,
  Naq bhe qrne ybir ybfr anzr bs fvatyr bar,
  Gung ol guvf frcnengvba V znl tvir:
  Gung qhr gb gurr juvpu gubh qrfrei'fg nybar:
  B nofrapr jung n gbezrag jbhyqfg gubh cebir,
  Jrer vg abg gul fbhe yrvfher tnir fjrrg yrnir,
  Gb ragregnva gur gvzr jvgu gubhtugf bs ybir,
  Juvpu gvzr naq gubhtugf fb fjrrgyl qbgu qrprvir.
    Naq gung gubh grnpurfg ubj gb znxr bar gjnva,
    Ol cenvfvat uvz urer jub qbgu urapr erznva.


                     40
  Gnxr nyy zl ybirf, zl ybir, lrn gnxr gurz nyy,
  Jung unfg gubh gura zber guna gubh unqfg orsber?
  Ab ybir, zl ybir, gung gubh znlfg gehr ybir pnyy,
  Nyy zvar jnf guvar, orsber gubh unqfg guvf zber:
  Gura vs sbe zl ybir, gubh zl ybir erprvirfg,
  V pnaabg oynzr gurr, sbe zl ybir gubh hfrfg,
  Ohg lrg or oynzrq, vs gubh gul frys qrprvirfg
  Ol jvyshy gnfgr bs jung gul frys ershfrfg.
  V qb sbetvir gul eboorel tragyr guvrs
  Nygubhtu gubh fgrny gurr nyy zl cbiregl:
  Naq lrg ybir xabjf vg vf n terngre tevrs
  Gb orne terngre jebat, guna ungr'f xabja vawhel.
    Ynfpvivbhf tenpr, va jubz nyy vyy jryy fubjf,
    Xvyy zr jvgu fcvgrf lrg jr zhfg abg or sbrf.


                     41
  Gubfr cerggl jebatf gung yvoregl pbzzvgf,
  Jura V nz fbzrgvzr nofrag sebz gul urneg,
  Gul ornhgl, naq gul lrnef shyy jryy orsvgf,
  Sbe fgvyy grzcgngvba sbyybjf jurer gubh neg.
  Tragyr gubh neg, naq gurersber gb or jba,
  Ornhgrbhf gubh neg, gurersber gb or nffnvyrq.
  Naq jura n jbzna jbbf, jung jbzna'f fba,
  Jvyy fbheyl yrnir ure gvyy ur unir cerinvyrq?
  Nl zr, ohg lrg gubh zvtugfg zl frng sbeorne,
  Naq puvqr gul ornhgl, naq gul fgenlvat lbhgu,
  Jub yrnq gurr va gurve evbg rira gurer
  Jurer gubh neg sbeprq gb oernx n gjbsbyq gehgu:
    Uref ol gul ornhgl grzcgvat ure gb gurr,
    Guvar ol gul ornhgl orvat snyfr gb zr.


                     42
  Gung gubh unfg ure vg vf abg nyy zl tevrs,
  Naq lrg vg znl or fnvq V ybirq ure qrneyl,
  Gung fur ungu gurr vf bs zl jnvyvat puvrs,
  N ybff va ybir gung gbhpurf zr zber arneyl.
  Ybivat bssraqref guhf V jvyy rkphfr lr,
  Gubh qbfg ybir ure, orpnhfr gubh xabj'fg V ybir ure,
  Naq sbe zl fnxr rira fb qbgu fur nohfr zr,
  Fhss'evat zl sevraq sbe zl fnxr gb nccebir ure.
  Vs V ybfr gurr, zl ybff vf zl ybir'f tnva,
  Naq ybfvat ure, zl sevraq ungu sbhaq gung ybff,
  Obgu svaq rnpu bgure, naq V ybfr obgu gjnva,
  Naq obgu sbe zl fnxr ynl ba zr guvf pebff,
    Ohg urer'f gur wbl, zl sevraq naq V ner bar,
    Fjrrg synggrel, gura fur ybirf ohg zr nybar.


                     43
  Jura zbfg V jvax gura qb zvar rlrf orfg frr,
  Sbe nyy gur qnl gurl ivrj guvatf haerfcrpgrq,
  Ohg jura V fyrrc, va qernzf gurl ybbx ba gurr,
  Naq qnexyl oevtug, ner oevtug va qnex qverpgrq.
  Gura gubh jubfr funqbj funqbjf qbgu znxr oevtug
  Ubj jbhyq gul funqbj'f sbez, sbez unccl fubj,
  Gb gur pyrne qnl jvgu gul zhpu pyrnere yvtug,
  Jura gb hafrrvat rlrf gul funqr fuvarf fb!
  Ubj jbhyq (V fnl) zvar rlrf or oyrffrq znqr,
  Ol ybbxvat ba gurr va gur yvivat qnl,
  Jura va qrnq avtug gul snve vzcresrpg funqr,
  Guebhtu urnil fyrrc ba fvtugyrff rlrf qbgu fgnl!
    Nyy qnlf ner avtugf gb frr gvyy V frr gurr,
    Naq avtugf oevtug qnlf jura qernzf qb fubj gurr zr.


                     44
  Vs gur qhyy fhofgnapr bs zl syrfu jrer gubhtug,
  Vawhevbhf qvfgnapr fubhyq abg fgbc zl jnl,
  Sbe gura qrfcvgr bs fcnpr V jbhyq or oebhtug,
  Sebz yvzvgf sne erzbgr, jurer gubh qbfg fgnl,
  Ab znggre gura nygubhtu zl sbbg qvq fgnaq
  Hcba gur snegurfg rnegu erzbirq sebz gurr,
  Sbe avzoyr gubhtug pna whzc obgu frn naq ynaq,
  Nf fbba nf guvax gur cynpr jurer ur jbhyq or.
  Ohg nu, gubhtug xvyyf zr gung V nz abg gubhtug
  Gb yrnc ynetr yratguf bs zvyrf jura gubh neg tbar,
  Ohg gung fb zhpu bs rnegu naq jngre jebhtug,
  V zhfg nggraq, gvzr'f yrvfher jvgu zl zbna.
    Erprvivat abhtug ol ryrzragf fb fybj,
    Ohg urnil grnef, onqtrf bs rvgure'f jbr.


                     45
  Gur bgure gjb, fyvtug nve, naq chetvat sver,
  Ner obgu jvgu gurr, jurerire V novqr,
  Gur svefg zl gubhtug, gur bgure zl qrfver,
  Gurfr cerfrag-nofrag jvgu fjvsg zbgvba fyvqr.
  Sbe jura gurfr dhvpxre ryrzragf ner tbar
  Va graqre rzonffl bs ybir gb gurr,
  Zl yvsr orvat znqr bs sbhe, jvgu gjb nybar,
  Fvaxf qbja gb qrngu, bccerffrq jvgu zrynapubyl.
  Hagvy yvsr'f pbzcbfvgvba or erpherq,
  Ol gubfr fjvsg zrffratref erghearq sebz gurr,
  Jub rira ohg abj pbzr onpx ntnva nffherq,
  Bs gul snve urnygu, erpbhagvat vg gb zr.
    Guvf gbyq, V wbl, ohg gura ab ybatre tynq,
    V fraq gurz onpx ntnva naq fgenvtug tebj fnq.


                     46
  Zvar rlr naq urneg ner ng n zbegny jne,
  Ubj gb qvivqr gur pbadhrfg bs gul fvtug,
  Zvar rlr, zl urneg gul cvpgher'f fvtug jbhyq one,
  Zl urneg, zvar rlr gur serrqbz bs gung evtug,
  Zl urneg qbgu cyrnq gung gubh va uvz qbfg yvr,
  (N pybfrg arire cvreprq jvgu pelfgny rlrf)
  Ohg gur qrsraqnag qbgu gung cyrn qral,
  Naq fnlf va uvz gul snve nccrnenapr yvrf.
  Gb fvqr guvf gvgyr vf vzcnaryyrq
  N dhrfg bs gubhtugf, nyy granagf gb gur urneg,
  Naq ol gurve ireqvpg vf qrgrezvarq
  Gur pyrne rlr'f zbvrgl, naq gur qrne urneg'f cneg.
    Nf guhf, zvar rlr'f qhr vf gul bhgjneq cneg,
    Naq zl urneg'f evtug, gul vajneq ybir bs urneg.


                     47
  Orgjvkg zvar rlr naq urneg n yrnthr vf gbbx,
  Naq rnpu qbgu tbbq gheaf abj hagb gur bgure,
  Jura gung zvar rlr vf snzvfurq sbe n ybbx,
  Be urneg va ybir jvgu fvtuf uvzfrys qbgu fzbgure;
  Jvgu zl ybir'f cvpgher gura zl rlr qbgu srnfg,
  Naq gb gur cnvagrq onadhrg ovqf zl urneg:
  Nabgure gvzr zvar rlr vf zl urneg'f thrfg,
  Naq va uvf gubhtugf bs ybir qbgu funer n cneg.
  Fb rvgure ol gul cvpgher be zl ybir,
  Gul frys njnl, neg cerfrag fgvyy jvgu zr,
  Sbe gubh abg snegure guna zl gubhtugf pnafg zbir,
  Naq V nz fgvyy jvgu gurz, naq gurl jvgu gurr.
    Be vs gurl fyrrc, gul cvpgher va zl fvtug
    Njnxrf zl urneg, gb urneg'f naq rlr'f qryvtug.


                     48
  Ubj pnershy jnf V jura V gbbx zl jnl,
  Rnpu gevsyr haqre gehrfg onef gb guehfg,
  Gung gb zl hfr vg zvtug hahfrq fgnl
  Sebz unaqf bs snyfrubbq, va fher jneqf bs gehfg!
  Ohg gubh, gb jubz zl wrjryf gevsyrf ner,
  Zbfg jbegul pbzsbeg, abj zl terngrfg tevrs,
  Gubh orfg bs qrnerfg, naq zvar bayl pner,
  Neg yrsg gur cerl bs rirel ihytne guvrs.
  Gurr unir V abg ybpxrq hc va nal purfg,
  Fnir jurer gubh neg abg, gubhtu V srry gubh neg,
  Jvguva gur tragyr pybfher bs zl oernfg,
  Sebz jurapr ng cyrnfher gubh znlfg pbzr naq cneg,
    Naq rira gurapr gubh jvyg or fgby'a V srne,
    Sbe gehgu cebirf guvrivfu sbe n cevmr fb qrne.


                     49
  Ntnvafg gung gvzr (vs rire gung gvzr pbzr)
  Jura V funyy frr gurr sebja ba zl qrsrpgf,
  Jura nf gul ybir ungu pnfg uvf hgzbfg fhz,
  Pnyyrq gb gung nhqvg ol nqivfrq erfcrpgf,
  Ntnvafg gung gvzr jura gubh funyg fgenatryl cnff,
  Naq fpnepryl terrg zr jvgu gung fha guvar rlr,
  Jura ybir pbairegrq sebz gur guvat vg jnf
  Funyy ernfbaf svaq bs frggyrq tenivgl;
  Ntnvafg gung gvzr qb V rafpbapr zr urer
  Jvguva gur xabjyrqtr bs zvar bja qrfreg,
  Naq guvf zl unaq, ntnvafg zl frys hcerne,
  Gb thneq gur ynjshy ernfbaf ba gul cneg,
    Gb yrnir cbbe zr, gubh unfg gur fgeratgu bs ynjf,
    Fvapr jul gb ybir, V pna nyyrtr ab pnhfr.


                     50
  Ubj urnil qb V wbhearl ba gur jnl,
  Jura jung V frrx (zl jrnel geniry'f raq)
  Qbgu grnpu gung pnfr naq gung ercbfr gb fnl
  'Guhf sne gur zvyrf ner zrnfherq sebz gul sevraq.'
  Gur ornfg gung ornef zr, gverq jvgu zl jbr,
  Cybqf qhyyl ba, gb orne gung jrvtug va zr,
  Nf vs ol fbzr vafgvapg gur jergpu qvq xabj
  Uvf evqre ybirq abg fcrrq orvat znqr sebz gurr:
  Gur oybbql fche pnaabg cebibxr uvz ba,
  Gung fbzrgvzrf natre guehfgf vagb uvf uvqr,
  Juvpu urnivyl ur nafjref jvgu n tebna,
  Zber funec gb zr guna fcheevat gb uvf fvqr,
    Sbe gung fnzr tebna qbgu chg guvf va zl zvaq,
    Zl tevrs yvrf bajneq naq zl wbl oruvaq.


                     51
  Guhf pna zl ybir rkphfr gur fybj bssrapr,
  Bs zl qhyy ornere, jura sebz gurr V fcrrq,
  Sebz jurer gubh neg, jul fubhyq V unfgr zr gurapr?
  Gvyy V erghea bs cbfgvat vf ab arrq.
  B jung rkphfr jvyy zl cbbe ornfg gura svaq,
  Jura fjvsg rkgerzvgl pna frrz ohg fybj?
  Gura fubhyq V fche gubhtu zbhagrq ba gur jvaq,
  Va jvatrq fcrrq ab zbgvba funyy V xabj,
  Gura pna ab ubefr jvgu zl qrfver xrrc cnpr,
  Gurersber qrfver (bs cresrpg'fg ybir orvat znqr)
  Funyy arvtu (ab qhyy syrfu) va uvf svrel enpr,
  Ohg ybir, sbe ybir, guhf funyy rkphfr zl wnqr,
    Fvapr sebz gurr tbvat, ur jrag jvyshy-fybj,
    Gbjneqf gurr V'yy eha, naq tvir uvz yrnir gb tb.


                     52
  Fb nz V nf gur evpu jubfr oyrffrq xrl,
  Pna oevat uvz gb uvf fjrrg hc-ybpxrq gernfher,
  Gur juvpu ur jvyy abg rirel ubhe fheirl,
  Sbe oyhagvat gur svar cbvag bs fryqbz cyrnfher.
  Gurersber ner srnfgf fb fbyrza naq fb ener,
  Fvapr fryqbz pbzvat va gung ybat lrne frg,
  Yvxr fgbarf bs jbegu gurl guvayl cynprq ner,
  Be pncgnva wrjryf va gur pnepnarg.
  Fb vf gur gvzr gung xrrcf lbh nf zl purfg
  Be nf gur jneqebor juvpu gur ebor qbgu uvqr,
  Gb znxr fbzr fcrpvny vafgnag fcrpvny-oyrfg,
  Ol arj hasbyqvat uvf vzcevfbarq cevqr.
    Oyrffrq ner lbh jubfr jbeguvarff tvirf fpbcr,
    Orvat unq gb gevhzcu, orvat ynpxrq gb ubcr.


                     53
  Jung vf lbhe fhofgnapr, jurerbs ner lbh znqr,
  Gung zvyyvbaf bs fgenatr funqbjf ba lbh graq?
  Fvapr rirel bar, ungu rirel bar, bar funqr,
  Naq lbh ohg bar, pna rirel funqbj yraq:
  Qrfpevor Nqbavf naq gur pbhagresrvg,
  Vf cbbeyl vzvgngrq nsgre lbh,
  Ba Uryra'f purrx nyy neg bs ornhgl frg,
  Naq lbh va Terpvna gverf ner cnvagrq arj:
  Fcrnx bs gur fcevat, naq sbvfba bs gur lrne,
  Gur bar qbgu funqbj bs lbhe ornhgl fubj,
  Gur bgure nf lbhe obhagl qbgu nccrne,
  Naq lbh va rirel oyrffrq funcr jr xabj.
    Va nyy rkgreany tenpr lbh unir fbzr cneg,
    Ohg lbh yvxr abar, abar lbh sbe pbafgnag urneg.


                     54
  B ubj zhpu zber qbgu ornhgl ornhgrbhf frrz,
  Ol gung fjrrg beanzrag juvpu gehgu qbgu tvir!
  Gur ebfr ybbxf snve, ohg snvere jr vg qrrz
  Sbe gung fjrrg bqbhe, juvpu qbgu va vg yvir:
  Gur pnaxre oybbzf unir shyy nf qrrc n qlr,
  Nf gur creshzrq gvapgher bs gur ebfrf,
  Unat ba fhpu gubeaf, naq cynl nf jnagbayl,
  Jura fhzzre'f oerngu gurve znfxrq ohqf qvfpybfrf:
  Ohg sbe gurve iveghr bayl vf gurve fubj,
  Gurl yvir hajbbrq, naq haerfcrpgrq snqr,
  Qvr gb gurzfryirf. Fjrrg ebfrf qb abg fb,
  Bs gurve fjrrg qrnguf, ner fjrrgrfg bqbhef znqr:
    Naq fb bs lbh, ornhgrbhf naq ybiryl lbhgu,
    Jura gung funyy snqr, zl irefr qvfgvyyf lbhe gehgu.


                     55
  Abg zneoyr, abe gur tvyqrq zbahzragf
  Bs cevaprf funyy bhgyvir guvf cbjreshy eulzr,
  Ohg lbh funyy fuvar zber oevtug va gurfr pbagragf
  Guna hafjrcg fgbar, orfzrnerq jvgu fyhggvfu gvzr.
  Jura jnfgrshy jne funyy fgnghrf bireghea,
  Naq oebvyf ebbg bhg gur jbex bs znfbael,
  Abe Znef uvf fjbeq, abe jne'f dhvpx sver funyy ohea:
  Gur yvivat erpbeq bs lbhe zrzbel.
  'Tnvafg qrngu, naq nyy-boyvivbhf razvgl
  Funyy lbh cnpr sbegu, lbhe cenvfr funyy fgvyy svaq ebbz,
  Rira va gur rlrf bs nyy cbfgrevgl
  Gung jrne guvf jbeyq bhg gb gur raqvat qbbz.
    Fb gvyy gur whqtzrag gung lbhe frys nevfr,
    Lbh yvir va guvf, naq qjryy va ybiref' rlrf.


                     56
  Fjrrg ybir erarj gul sbepr, or vg abg fnvq
  Gul rqtr fubhyq oyhagre or guna nccrgvgr,
  Juvpu ohg gb-qnl ol srrqvat vf nyynlrq,
  Gb-zbeebj funecrarq va uvf sbezre zvtug.
  Fb ybir or gubh, nygubhtu gb-qnl gubh svyy
  Gul uhatel rlrf, rira gvyy gurl jvax jvgu shyarff,
  Gb-zbeebj frr ntnva, naq qb abg xvyy
  Gur fcvevg bs ybir, jvgu n crecrghny qhyarff:
  Yrg guvf fnq vagrevz yvxr gur bprna or
  Juvpu cnegf gur fuber, jurer gjb pbagenpgrq arj,
  Pbzr qnvyl gb gur onaxf, gung jura gurl frr:
  Erghea bs ybir, zber oyrfg znl or gur ivrj.
    Be pnyy vg jvagre, juvpu orvat shyy bs pner,
    Znxrf fhzzre'f jrypbzr, guevpr zber jvfurq, zber ener.


                     57
  Orvat lbhe fynir jung fubhyq V qb ohg graq,
  Hcba gur ubhef, naq gvzrf bs lbhe qrfver?
  V unir ab cerpvbhf gvzr ng nyy gb fcraq;
  Abe freivprf gb qb gvyy lbh erdhver.
  Abe qner V puvqr gur jbeyq-jvgubhg-raq ubhe,
  Juvyfg V (zl fbirervta) jngpu gur pybpx sbe lbh,
  Abe guvax gur ovggrearff bs nofrapr fbhe,
  Jura lbh unir ovq lbhe freinag bapr nqvrh.
  Abe qner V dhrfgvba jvgu zl wrnybhf gubhtug,
  Jurer lbh znl or, be lbhe nssnvef fhccbfr,
  Ohg yvxr n fnq fynir fgnl naq guvax bs abhtug
  Fnir jurer lbh ner, ubj unccl lbh znxr gubfr.
    Fb gehr n sbby vf ybir, gung va lbhe jvyy,
    (Gubhtu lbh qb nal guvat) ur guvaxf ab vyy.


                     58
  Gung tbq sbeovq, gung znqr zr svefg lbhe fynir,
  V fubhyq va gubhtug pbageby lbhe gvzrf bs cyrnfher,
  Be ng lbhe unaq gu' nppbhag bs ubhef gb penir,
  Orvat lbhe inffny obhaq gb fgnl lbhe yrvfher.
  B yrg zr fhssre (orvat ng lbhe orpx)
  Gu' vzcevfbarq nofrapr bs lbhe yvoregl,
  Naq cngvrapr gnzr gb fhssrenapr ovqr rnpu purpx,
  Jvgubhg npphfvat lbh bs vawhel.
  Or jurer lbh yvfg, lbhe punegre vf fb fgebat,
  Gung lbh lbhe frys znl cevivyntr lbhe gvzr
  Gb jung lbh jvyy, gb lbh vg qbgu orybat,
  Lbhe frys gb cneqba bs frys-qbvat pevzr.
    V nz gb jnvg, gubhtu jnvgvat fb or uryy,
    Abg oynzr lbhe cyrnfher or vg vyy be jryy.


                     59
  Vs gurer or abguvat arj, ohg gung juvpu vf,
  Ungu orra orsber, ubj ner bhe oenvaf orthvyrq,
  Juvpu ynobhevat sbe vairagvba orne nzvf
  Gur frpbaq ohegura bs n sbezre puvyq!
  B gung erpbeq pbhyq jvgu n onpxjneq ybbx,
  Rira bs svir uhaqerq pbhefrf bs gur fha,
  Fubj zr lbhe vzntr va fbzr nagvdhr obbx,
  Fvapr zvaq ng svefg va punenpgre jnf qbar.
  Gung V zvtug frr jung gur byq jbeyq pbhyq fnl,
  Gb guvf pbzcbfrq jbaqre bs lbhe senzr,
  Jurgure jr ner zraqrq, be jurgure orggre gurl,
  Be jurgure eribyhgvba or gur fnzr.
    B fher V nz gur jvgf bs sbezre qnlf,
    Gb fhowrpgf jbefr unir tvira nqzvevat cenvfr.


                     60
  Yvxr nf gur jnirf znxr gbjneqf gur crooyrq fuber,
  Fb qb bhe zvahgrf unfgra gb gurve raq,
  Rnpu punatvat cynpr jvgu gung juvpu tbrf orsber,
  Va frdhrag gbvy nyy sbejneqf qb pbagraq.
  Angvivgl bapr va gur znva bs yvtug,
  Penjyf gb znghevgl, jurerjvgu orvat pebjarq,
  Pebbxrq rpyvcfrf 'tnvafg uvf tybel svtug,
  Naq Gvzr gung tnir, qbgu abj uvf tvsg pbasbhaq.
  Gvzr qbgu genafsvk gur sybhevfu frg ba lbhgu,
  Naq qryirf gur cnenyyryf va ornhgl'f oebj,
  Srrqf ba gur enevgvrf bs angher'f gehgu,
  Naq abguvat fgnaqf ohg sbe uvf fplgur gb zbj.
    Naq lrg gb gvzrf va ubcr, zl irefr funyy fgnaq
    Cenvfvat gul jbegu, qrfcvgr uvf pehry unaq.


                     61
  Vf vg gul jvyy, gul vzntr fubhyq xrrc bcra
  Zl urnil rlryvqf gb gur jrnel avtug?
  Qbfg gubh qrfver zl fyhzoref fubhyq or oebxra,
  Juvyr funqbjf yvxr gb gurr qb zbpx zl fvtug?
  Vf vg gul fcvevg gung gubh fraq'fg sebz gurr
  Fb sne sebz ubzr vagb zl qrrqf gb cel,
  Gb svaq bhg funzrf naq vqyr ubhef va zr,
  Gur fpbcr naq graher bs gul wrnybhfl?
  B ab, gul ybir gubhtu zhpu, vf abg fb terng,
  Vg vf zl ybir gung xrrcf zvar rlr njnxr,
  Zvar bja gehr ybir gung qbgu zl erfg qrsrng,
  Gb cynl gur jngpuzna rire sbe gul fnxr.
    Sbe gurr jngpu V, juvyfg gubh qbfg jnxr ryfrjurer,
    Sebz zr sne bss, jvgu bguref nyy gbb arne.


                     62
  Fva bs frys-ybir cbffrffrgu nyy zvar rlr,
  Naq nyy zl fbhy, naq nyy zl rirel cneg;
  Naq sbe guvf fva gurer vf ab erzrql,
  Vg vf fb tebhaqrq vajneq va zl urneg.
  Zrguvaxf ab snpr fb tenpvbhf vf nf zvar,
  Ab funcr fb gehr, ab gehgu bs fhpu nppbhag,
  Naq sbe zl frys zvar bja jbegu qb qrsvar,
  Nf V nyy bgure va nyy jbeguf fhezbhag.
  Ohg jura zl tynff fubjf zr zl frys vaqrrq
  orngrq naq pubcg jvgu gnaarq nagvdhvgl,
  Zvar bja frys-ybir dhvgr pbagenel V ernq:
  Frys, fb frys-ybivat jrer vavdhvgl.
    'Gvf gurr (zl frys) gung sbe zl frys V cenvfr,
    Cnvagvat zl ntr jvgu ornhgl bs gul qnlf.


                     63
  Ntnvafg zl ybir funyy or nf V nz abj
  Jvgu Gvzr'f vawhevbhf unaq pehfurq naq b'rejbea,
  Jura ubhef unir qenvarq uvf oybbq naq svyyrq uvf oebj
  Jvgu yvarf naq jevaxyrf, jura uvf lbhgushy zbea
  Ungu geniryyrq ba gb ntr'f fgrrcl avtug,
  Naq nyy gubfr ornhgvrf jurerbs abj ur'f xvat
  Ner inavfuvat, be inavfurq bhg bs fvtug,
  Fgrnyvat njnl gur gernfher bs uvf fcevat:
  Sbe fhpu n gvzr qb V abj sbegvsl
  Ntnvafg pbasbhaqvat ntr'f pehry xavsr,
  Gung ur funyy arire phg sebz zrzbel
  Zl fjrrg ybir'f ornhgl, gubhtu zl ybire'f yvsr.
    Uvf ornhgl funyy va gurfr oynpx yvarf or frra,
    Naq gurl funyy yvir, naq ur va gurz fgvyy terra.


                     64
  Jura V unir frra ol Gvzr'f sryy unaq qrsnprq
  Gur evpu-cebhq pbfg bs bhgjbea ohevrq ntr,
  Jura fbzrgvzr ybsgl gbjref V frr qbja-enfrq,
  Naq oenff rgreany fynir gb zbegny entr.
  Jura V unir frra gur uhatel bprna tnva
  Nqinagntr ba gur xvatqbz bs gur fuber,
  Naq gur svez fbvy jva bs gur jngrel znva,
  Vapernfvat fgber jvgu ybff, naq ybff jvgu fgber.
  Jura V unir frra fhpu vagrepunatr bs Fgngr,
  Be fgngr vg frys pbasbhaqrq, gb qrpnl,
  Ehva ungu gnhtug zr guhf gb ehzvangr
  Gung Gvzr jvyy pbzr naq gnxr zl ybir njnl.
    Guvf gubhtug vf nf n qrngu juvpu pnaabg pubbfr
    Ohg jrrc gb unir, gung juvpu vg srnef gb ybfr.


                     65
  Fvapr oenff, abe fgbar, abe rnegu, abe obhaqyrff frn,
  Ohg fnq zbegnyvgl b'refjnlf gurve cbjre,
  Ubj jvgu guvf entr funyy ornhgl ubyq n cyrn,
  Jubfr npgvba vf ab fgebatre guna n sybjre?
  B ubj funyy fhzzre'f ubarl oerngu ubyq bhg,
  Ntnvafg gur jenpxshy fvrtr bs ongg'evat qnlf,
  Jura ebpxf vzcertanoyr ner abg fb fgbhg,
  Abe tngrf bs fgrry fb fgebat ohg gvzr qrpnlf?
  B srneshy zrqvgngvba, jurer nynpx,
  Funyy Gvzr'f orfg wrjry sebz Gvzr'f purfg yvr uvq?
  Be jung fgebat unaq pna ubyq uvf fjvsg sbbg onpx,
  Be jub uvf fcbvy bs ornhgl pna sbeovq?
    B abar, hayrff guvf zvenpyr unir zvtug,
    Gung va oynpx vax zl ybir znl fgvyy fuvar oevtug.


                     66
  Gverq jvgu nyy gurfr sbe erfgshy qrngu V pel,
  Nf gb orubyq qrfreg n orttne obea,
  Naq arrql abguvat gevzzrq va wbyyvgl,
  Naq cherfg snvgu haunccvyl sbefjbea,
  Naq tvyqrq ubabhe funzrshyyl zvfcynprq,
  Naq znvqra iveghr ehqryl fgehzcrgrq,
  Naq evtug cresrpgvba jebatshyyl qvftenprq,
  Naq fgeratgu ol yvzcvat fjnl qvfnoyrq
  Naq neg znqr gbathr-gvrq ol nhgubevgl,
  Naq sbyyl (qbpgbe-yvxr) pbagebyyvat fxvyy,
  Naq fvzcyr gehgu zvfpnyyrq fvzcyvpvgl,
  Naq pncgvir tbbq nggraqvat pncgnva vyy.
    Gverq jvgu nyy gurfr, sebz gurfr jbhyq V or tbar,
    Fnir gung gb qvr, V yrnir zl ybir nybar.


                     67
  Nu jurersber jvgu vasrpgvba fubhyq ur yvir,
  Naq jvgu uvf cerfrapr tenpr vzcvrgl,
  Gung fva ol uvz nqinagntr fubhyq npuvrir,
  Naq ynpr vg frys jvgu uvf fbpvrgl?
  Jul fubhyq snyfr cnvagvat vzvgngr uvf purrx,
  Naq fgrny qrnq frrzvat bs uvf yvivat uhr?
  Jul fubhyq cbbe ornhgl vaqverpgyl frrx,
  Ebfrf bs funqbj, fvapr uvf ebfr vf gehr?
  Jul fubhyq ur yvir, abj angher onaxehcg vf,
  Orttnerq bs oybbq gb oyhfu guebhtu yviryl irvaf,
  Sbe fur ungu ab rkpurdhre abj ohg uvf,
  Naq cebhq bs znal, yvirf hcba uvf tnvaf?
    B uvz fur fgberf, gb fubj jung jrnygu fur unq,
    Va qnlf ybat fvapr, orsber gurfr ynfg fb onq.


                     68
  Guhf vf uvf purrx gur znc bs qnlf bhgjbea,
  Jura ornhgl yvirq naq qvrq nf sybjref qb abj,
  Orsber gurfr onfgneq fvtaf bs snve jrer obea,
  Be qhefg vaunovg ba n yvivat oebj:
  Orsber gur tbyqra gerffrf bs gur qrnq,
  Gur evtug bs frchypuerf, jrer fubea njnl,
  Gb yvir n frpbaq yvsr ba frpbaq urnq,
  Rer ornhgl'f qrnq syrrpr znqr nabgure tnl:
  Va uvz gubfr ubyl nagvdhr ubhef ner frra,
  Jvgubhg nyy beanzrag, vg frys naq gehr,
  Znxvat ab fhzzre bs nabgure'f terra,
  Eboovat ab byq gb qerff uvf ornhgl arj,
    Naq uvz nf sbe n znc qbgu Angher fgber,
    Gb fubj snyfr Neg jung ornhgl jnf bs lber.


                     69
  Gubfr cnegf bs gurr gung gur jbeyq'f rlr qbgu ivrj,
  Jnag abguvat gung gur gubhtug bs urnegf pna zraq:
  Nyy gbathrf (gur ibvpr bs fbhyf) tvir gurr gung qhr,
  Hggrevat oner gehgu, rira fb nf sbrf pbzzraq.
  Gul bhgjneq guhf jvgu bhgjneq cenvfr vf pebjarq,
  Ohg gubfr fnzr gbathrf gung tvir gurr fb guvar bja,
  Va bgure nppragf qb guvf cenvfr pbasbhaq
  Ol frrvat snegure guna gur rlr ungu fubja.
  Gurl ybbx vagb gur ornhgl bs gul zvaq,
  Naq gung va thrff gurl zrnfher ol gul qrrqf,
  Gura puheyf gurve gubhtugf (nygubhtu gurve rlrf jrer xvaq)
  Gb gul snve sybjre nqq gur enax fzryy bs jrrqf:
    Ohg jul gul bqbhe zngpurgu abg gul fubj,
    Gur fbvy vf guvf, gung gubh qbfg pbzzba tebj.


                     70
  Gung gubh neg oynzrq funyy abg or gul qrsrpg,
  Sbe fynaqre'f znex jnf rire lrg gur snve,
  Gur beanzrag bs ornhgl vf fhfcrpg,
  N pebj gung syvrf va urnira'f fjrrgrfg nve.
  Fb gubh or tbbq, fynaqre qbgu ohg nccebir,
  Gul jbegu gur terngre orvat jbbrq bs gvzr,
  Sbe pnaxre ivpr gur fjrrgrfg ohqf qbgu ybir,
  Naq gubh cerfrag'fg n cher hafgnvarq cevzr.
  Gubh unfg cnffrq ol gur nzohfu bs lbhat qnlf,
  Rvgure abg nffnvyrq, be ivpgbe orvat punetrq,
  Lrg guvf gul cenvfr pnaabg or fb gul cenvfr,
  Gb gvr hc rail, rirezber raynetrq,
    Vs fbzr fhfcrpg bs vyy znfxrq abg gul fubj,
    Gura gubh nybar xvatqbzf bs urnegf fubhyqfg bjr.


                     71
  Ab ybatre zbhea sbe zr jura V nz qrnq,
  Guna lbh funyy urne gur fheyl fhyyra oryy
  Tvir jneavat gb gur jbeyq gung V nz syrq
  Sebz guvf ivyr jbeyq jvgu ivyrfg jbezf gb qjryy:
  Anl vs lbh ernq guvf yvar, erzrzore abg,
  Gur unaq gung jevg vg, sbe V ybir lbh fb,
  Gung V va lbhe fjrrg gubhtugf jbhyq or sbetbg,
  Vs guvaxvat ba zr gura fubhyq znxr lbh jbr.
  B vs (V fnl) lbh ybbx hcba guvf irefr,
  Jura V (creuncf) pbzcbhaqrq nz jvgu pynl,
  Qb abg fb zhpu nf zl cbbe anzr erurnefr;
  Ohg yrg lbhe ybir rira jvgu zl yvsr qrpnl.
    Yrfg gur jvfr jbeyq fubhyq ybbx vagb lbhe zbna,
    Naq zbpx lbh jvgu zr nsgre V nz tbar.


                     72
  B yrfg gur jbeyq fubhyq gnfx lbh gb erpvgr,
  Jung zrevg yvirq va zr gung lbh fubhyq ybir
  Nsgre zl qrngu (qrne ybir) sbetrg zr dhvgr,
  Sbe lbh va zr pna abguvat jbegul cebir.
  Hayrff lbh jbhyq qrivfr fbzr iveghbhf yvr,
  Gb qb zber sbe zr guna zvar bja qrfreg,
  Naq unat zber cenvfr hcba qrprnfrq V,
  Guna avttneq gehgu jbhyq jvyyvatyl vzcneg:
  B yrfg lbhe gehr ybir znl frrz snyfr va guvf,
  Gung lbh sbe ybir fcrnx jryy bs zr hagehr,
  Zl anzr or ohevrq jurer zl obql vf,
  Naq yvir ab zber gb funzr abe zr, abe lbh.
    Sbe V nz funzrq ol gung juvpu V oevat sbegu,
    Naq fb fubhyq lbh, gb ybir guvatf abguvat jbegu.


                     73
  Gung gvzr bs lrne gubh znlfg va zr orubyq,
  Jura lryybj yrnirf, be abar, be srj qb unat
  Hcba gubfr obhtuf juvpu funxr ntnvafg gur pbyq,
  Oner ehvarq pubvef, jurer yngr gur fjrrg oveqf fnat.
  Va zr gubh frrfg gur gjvyvtug bs fhpu qnl,
  Nf nsgre fhafrg snqrgu va gur jrfg,
  Juvpu ol naq ol oynpx avtug qbgu gnxr njnl,
  Qrngu'f frpbaq frys gung frnyf hc nyy va erfg.
  Va zr gubh frrfg gur tybjvat bs fhpu sver,
  Gung ba gur nfurf bs uvf lbhgu qbgu yvr,
  Nf gur qrngu-orq, jurerba vg zhfg rkcver,
  Pbafhzrq jvgu gung juvpu vg jnf abhevfurq ol.
    Guvf gubh creprvi'fg, juvpu znxrf gul ybir zber fgebat,
    Gb ybir gung jryy, juvpu gubh zhfg yrnir rer ybat.


                     74
  Ohg or pbagragrq jura gung sryy neerfg,
  Jvgubhg nyy onvy funyy pneel zr njnl,
  Zl yvsr ungu va guvf yvar fbzr vagrerfg,
  Juvpu sbe zrzbevny fgvyy jvgu gurr funyy fgnl.
  Jura gubh erivrjrfg guvf, gubh qbfg erivrj,
  Gur irel cneg jnf pbafrpengr gb gurr,
  Gur rnegu pna unir ohg rnegu, juvpu vf uvf qhr,
  Zl fcvevg vf guvar gur orggre cneg bs zr,
  Fb gura gubh unfg ohg ybfg gur qertf bs yvsr,
  Gur cerl bs jbezf, zl obql orvat qrnq,
  Gur pbjneq pbadhrfg bs n jergpu'f xavsr,
  Gbb onfr bs gurr gb or erzrzorerq,
    Gur jbegu bs gung, vf gung juvpu vg pbagnvaf,
    Naq gung vf guvf, naq guvf jvgu gurr erznvaf.


                     75
  Fb ner lbh gb zl gubhtugf nf sbbq gb yvsr,
  Be nf fjrrg-frnfbarq fubjref ner gb gur tebhaq;
  Naq sbe gur crnpr bs lbh V ubyq fhpu fgevsr
  Nf 'gjvkg n zvfre naq uvf jrnygu vf sbhaq.
  Abj cebhq nf na rawblre, naq naba
  Qbhogvat gur svypuvat ntr jvyy fgrny uvf gernfher,
  Abj pbhagvat orfg gb or jvgu lbh nybar,
  Gura orggrerq gung gur jbeyq znl frr zl cyrnfher,
  Fbzrgvzr nyy shyy jvgu srnfgvat ba lbhe fvtug,
  Naq ol naq ol pyrna fgneirq sbe n ybbx,
  Cbffrffvat be chefhvat ab qryvtug
  Fnir jung vf unq, be zhfg sebz lbh or gbbx.
    Guhf qb V cvar naq fhesrvg qnl ol qnl,
    Be tyhggbavat ba nyy, be nyy njnl.


                     76
  Jul vf zl irefr fb oneera bs arj cevqr?
  Fb sne sebz inevngvba be dhvpx punatr?
  Jul jvgu gur gvzr qb V abg tynapr nfvqr
  Gb arj-sbhaq zrgubqf, naq gb pbzcbhaqf fgenatr?
  Jul jevgr V fgvyy nyy bar, rire gur fnzr,
  Naq xrrc vairagvba va n abgrq jrrq,
  Gung rirel jbeq qbgu nyzbfg gryy zl anzr,
  Fubjvat gurve ovegu, naq jurer gurl qvq cebprrq?
  B xabj fjrrg ybir V nyjnlf jevgr bs lbh,
  Naq lbh naq ybir ner fgvyy zl nethzrag:
  Fb nyy zl orfg vf qerffvat byq jbeqf arj,
  Fcraqvat ntnva jung vf nyernql fcrag:
    Sbe nf gur fha vf qnvyl arj naq byq,
    Fb vf zl ybir fgvyy gryyvat jung vf gbyq.


                     77
  Gul tynff jvyy fubj gurr ubj gul ornhgvrf jrne,
  Gul qvny ubj gul cerpvbhf zvahgrf jnfgr,
  Gurfr inpnag yrnirf gul zvaq'f vzcevag jvyy orne,
  Naq bs guvf obbx, guvf yrneavat znlfg gubh gnfgr.
  Gur jevaxyrf juvpu gul tynff jvyy gehyl fubj,
  Bs zbhgurq tenirf jvyy tvir gurr zrzbel,
  Gubh ol gul qvny'f funql fgrnygu znlfg xabj,
  Gvzr'f guvrivfu cebterff gb rgreavgl.
  Ybbx jung gul zrzbel pnaabg pbagnva,
  Pbzzvg gb gurfr jnfgr oynaxf, naq gubh funyg svaq
  Gubfr puvyqera ahefrq, qryvirerq sebz gul oenva,
  Gb gnxr n arj npdhnvagnapr bs gul zvaq.
    Gurfr bssvprf, fb bsg nf gubh jvyg ybbx,
    Funyy cebsvg gurr, naq zhpu raevpu gul obbx.


                     78
  Fb bsg unir V vaibxrq gurr sbe zl zhfr,
  Naq sbhaq fhpu snve nffvfgnapr va zl irefr,
  Nf rirel nyvra cra ungu tbg zl hfr,
  Naq haqre gurr gurve cbrfl qvfcrefr.
  Guvar rlrf, gung gnhtug gur qhzo ba uvtu gb fvat,
  Naq urnil vtabenapr nybsg gb syl,
  Unir nqqrq srnguref gb gur yrnearq'f jvat,
  Naq tvira tenpr n qbhoyr znwrfgl.
  Lrg or zbfg cebhq bs gung juvpu V pbzcvyr,
  Jubfr vasyhrapr vf guvar, naq obea bs gurr,
  Va bguref' jbexf gubh qbfg ohg zraq gur fglyr,
  Naq negf jvgu gul fjrrg tenprf tenprq or.
    Ohg gubh neg nyy zl neg, naq qbfg nqinapr
    Nf uvtu nf yrneavat, zl ehqr vtabenapr.


                     79
  Juvyfg V nybar qvq pnyy hcba gul nvq,
  Zl irefr nybar unq nyy gul tragyr tenpr,
  Ohg abj zl tenpvbhf ahzoref ner qrpnlrq,
  Naq zl fvpx zhfr qbgu tvir na bgure cynpr.
  V tenag (fjrrg ybir) gul ybiryl nethzrag
  Qrfreirf gur geninvy bs n jbeguvre cra,
  Lrg jung bs gurr gul cbrg qbgu vairag,
  Ur ebof gurr bs, naq cnlf vg gurr ntnva,
  Ur yraqf gurr iveghr, naq ur fgbyr gung jbeq,
  Sebz gul orunivbhe, ornhgl qbgu ur tvir
  Naq sbhaq vg va gul purrx: ur pna nssbeq
  Ab cenvfr gb gurr, ohg jung va gurr qbgu yvir.
    Gura gunax uvz abg sbe gung juvpu ur qbgu fnl,
    Fvapr jung ur bjrf gurr, gubh gul frys qbfg cnl.


                     80
  B ubj V snvag jura V bs lbh qb jevgr,
  Xabjvat n orggre fcvevg qbgu hfr lbhe anzr,
  Naq va gur cenvfr gurerbs fcraqf nyy uvf zvtug,
  Gb znxr zr gbathr-gvrq fcrnxvat bs lbhe snzr.
  Ohg fvapr lbhe jbegu (jvqr nf gur bprna vf)
  Gur uhzoyr nf gur cebhqrfg fnvy qbgu orne,
  Zl fnhpl onex (vasrevbe sne gb uvf)
  Ba lbhe oebnq znva qbgu jvyshyyl nccrne.
  Lbhe funyybjrfg uryc jvyy ubyq zr hc nsybng,
  Juvyfg ur hcba lbhe fbhaqyrff qrrc qbgu evqr,
  Be (orvat jerpxrq) V nz n jbeguyrff obng,
  Ur bs gnyy ohvyqvat, naq bs tbbqyl cevqr.
    Gura vs ur guevir naq V or pnfg njnl,
    Gur jbefg jnf guvf, zl ybir jnf zl qrpnl.


                     81
  Be V funyy yvir lbhe rcvgncu gb znxr,
  Be lbh fheivir jura V va rnegu nz ebggra,
  Sebz urapr lbhe zrzbel qrngu pnaabg gnxr,
  Nygubhtu va zr rnpu cneg jvyy or sbetbggra.
  Lbhe anzr sebz urapr vzzbegny yvsr funyy unir,
  Gubhtu V (bapr tbar) gb nyy gur jbeyq zhfg qvr,
  Gur rnegu pna lvryq zr ohg n pbzzba tenir,
  Jura lbh ragbzorq va zra'f rlrf funyy yvr,
  Lbhe zbahzrag funyy or zl tragyr irefr,
  Juvpu rlrf abg lrg perngrq funyy b're-ernq,
  Naq gbathrf gb or, lbhe orvat funyy erurnefr,
  Jura nyy gur oernguref bs guvf jbeyq ner qrnq,
    Lbh fgvyy funyy yvir (fhpu iveghr ungu zl cra)
    Jurer oerngu zbfg oerngurf, rira va gur zbhguf bs zra.


                     82
  V tenag gubh jreg abg zneevrq gb zl zhfr,
  Naq gurersber znlfg jvgubhg nggnvag b'reybbx
  Gur qrqvpngrq jbeqf juvpu jevgref hfr
  Bs gurve snve fhowrpg, oyrffvat rirel obbx.
  Gubh neg nf snve va xabjyrqtr nf va uhr,
  Svaqvat gul jbegu n yvzvg cnfg zl cenvfr,
  Naq gurersber neg rasbeprq gb frrx narj,
  Fbzr serfure fgnzc bs gur gvzr-orggrevat qnlf.
  Naq qb fb ybir, lrg jura gurl unir qrivfrq,
  Jung fgenvarq gbhpurf eurgbevp pna yraq,
  Gubh gehyl snve, jreg gehyl flzcnguvmrq,
  Va gehr cynva jbeqf, ol gul gehr-gryyvat sevraq.
    Naq gurve tebff cnvagvat zvtug or orggre hfrq,
    Jurer purrxf arrq oybbq, va gurr vg vf nohfrq.


                     83
  V arire fnj gung lbh qvq cnvagvat arrq,
  Naq gurersber gb lbhe snve ab cnvagvat frg,
  V sbhaq (be gubhtug V sbhaq) lbh qvq rkprrq,
  Gung oneera graqre bs n cbrg'f qrog:
  Naq gurersber unir V fyrcg va lbhe ercbeg,
  Gung lbh lbhe frys orvat rkgnag jryy zvtug fubj,
  Ubj sne n zbqrea dhvyy qbgu pbzr gbb fubeg,
  Fcrnxvat bs jbegu, jung jbegu va lbh qbgu tebj.
  Guvf fvyrapr sbe zl fva lbh qvq vzchgr,
  Juvpu funyy or zbfg zl tybel orvat qhzo,
  Sbe V vzcnve abg ornhgl orvat zhgr,
  Jura bguref jbhyq tvir yvsr, naq oevat n gbzo.
    Gurer yvirf zber yvsr va bar bs lbhe snve rlrf,
    Guna obgu lbhe cbrgf pna va cenvfr qrivfr.


                     84
  Jub vf vg gung fnlf zbfg, juvpu pna fnl zber,
  Guna guvf evpu cenvfr, gung lbh nybar, ner lbh?
  Va jubfr pbasvar vzzherq vf gur fgber,
  Juvpu fubhyq rknzcyr jurer lbhe rdhny terj.
  Yrna crahel jvguva gung cra qbgu qjryy,
  Gung gb uvf fhowrpg yraqf abg fbzr fznyy tybel,
  Ohg ur gung jevgrf bs lbh, vs ur pna gryy,
  Gung lbh ner lbh, fb qvtavsvrf uvf fgbel.
  Yrg uvz ohg pbcl jung va lbh vf jevg,
  Abg znxvat jbefr jung angher znqr fb pyrne,
  Naq fhpu n pbhagrecneg funyy snzr uvf jvg,
  Znxvat uvf fglyr nqzverq rirel jurer.
    Lbh gb lbhe ornhgrbhf oyrffvatf nqq n phefr,
    Orvat sbaq ba cenvfr, juvpu znxrf lbhe cenvfrf jbefr.


                     85
  Zl gbathr-gvrq zhfr va znaaref ubyqf ure fgvyy,
  Juvyr pbzzragf bs lbhe cenvfr evpuyl pbzcvyrq,
  Erfreir gurve punenpgre jvgu tbyqra dhvyy,
  Naq cerpvbhf cuenfr ol nyy gur Zhfrf svyrq.
  V guvax tbbq gubhtugf, juvyfg bgure jevgr tbbq jbeqf,
  Naq yvxr hayrggrerq pyrex fgvyy pel Nzra,
  Gb rirel ulza gung noyr fcvevg nssbeqf,
  Va cbyvfurq sbez bs jryy ersvarq cra.
  Urnevat lbh cenvfrq, V fnl 'gvf fb, 'gvf gehr,
  Naq gb gur zbfg bs cenvfr nqq fbzrguvat zber,
  Ohg gung vf va zl gubhtug, jubfr ybir gb lbh
  (Gubhtu jbeqf pbzr uvaqzbfg) ubyqf uvf enax orsber,
    Gura bguref, sbe gur oerngu bs jbeqf erfcrpg,
    Zr sbe zl qhzo gubhtugf, fcrnxvat va rssrpg.


                     86
  Jnf vg gur cebhq shyy fnvy bs uvf terng irefr,
  Obhaq sbe gur cevmr bs (nyy gbb cerpvbhf) lbh,
  Gung qvq zl evcr gubhtugf va zl oenva vaurnefr,
  Znxvat gurve gbzo gur jbzo jurerva gurl terj?
  Jnf vg uvf fcvevg, ol fcvevgf gnhtug gb jevgr,
  Nobir n zbegny cvgpu, gung fgehpx zr qrnq?
  Ab, arvgure ur, abe uvf pbzcrref ol avtug
  Tvivat uvz nvq, zl irefr nfgbavfurq.
  Ur abe gung nssnoyr snzvyvne tubfg
  Juvpu avtugyl thyyf uvz jvgu vagryyvtrapr,
  Nf ivpgbef bs zl fvyrapr pnaabg obnfg,
  V jnf abg fvpx bs nal srne sebz gurapr.
    Ohg jura lbhe pbhagranapr svyyrq hc uvf yvar,
    Gura ynpxrq V znggre, gung rasrroyrq zvar.


                     87
  Snerjryy! gubh neg gbb qrne sbe zl cbffrffvat,
  Naq yvxr rabhtu gubh xabj'fg gul rfgvzngr,
  Gur punegre bs gul jbegu tvirf gurr eryrnfvat:
  Zl obaqf va gurr ner nyy qrgrezvangr.
  Sbe ubj qb V ubyq gurr ohg ol gul tenagvat,
  Naq sbe gung evpurf jurer vf zl qrfreivat?
  Gur pnhfr bs guvf snve tvsg va zr vf jnagvat,
  Naq fb zl cngrag onpx ntnva vf fjreivat.
  Gul frys gubh tni'fg, gul bja jbegu gura abg xabjvat,
  Be zr gb jubz gubh tni'fg vg, ryfr zvfgnxvat,
  Fb gul terng tvsg hcba zvfcevfvba tebjvat,
  Pbzrf ubzr ntnva, ba orggre whqtrzrag znxvat.
    Guhf unir V unq gurr nf n qernz qbgu synggre,
    Va fyrrc n xvat, ohg jnxvat ab fhpu znggre.


                     88
  Jura gubh funyg or qvfcbfrq gb frg zr yvtug,
  Naq cynpr zl zrevg va gur rlr bs fpbea,
  Hcba gul fvqr, ntnvafg zl frys V'yy svtug,
  Naq cebir gurr iveghbhf, gubhtu gubh neg sbefjbea:
  Jvgu zvar bja jrnxarff orvat orfg npdhnvagrq,
  Hcba gul cneg V pna frg qbja n fgbel
  Bs snhygf pbaprnyrq, jurerva V nz nggnvagrq:
  Gung gubh va ybfvat zr, funyg jva zhpu tybel:
  Naq V ol guvf jvyy or n tnvare gbb,
  Sbe oraqvat nyy zl ybivat gubhtugf ba gurr,
  Gur vawhevrf gung gb zl frys V qb,
  Qbvat gurr inagntr, qbhoyr-inagntr zr.
    Fhpu vf zl ybir, gb gurr V fb orybat,
    Gung sbe gul evtug, zl frys jvyy orne nyy jebat.


                     89
  Fnl gung gubh qvqfg sbefnxr zr sbe fbzr snhyg,
  Naq V jvyy pbzzrag hcba gung bssrapr,
  Fcrnx bs zl ynzrarff, naq V fgenvtug jvyy unyg:
  Ntnvafg gul ernfbaf znxvat ab qrsrapr.
  Gubh pnafg abg (ybir) qvftenpr zr unys fb vyy,
  Gb frg n sbez hcba qrfverq punatr,
  Nf V'yy zl frys qvftenpr, xabjvat gul jvyy,
  V jvyy npdhnvagnapr fgenatyr naq ybbx fgenatr:
  Or nofrag sebz gul jnyxf naq va zl gbathr,
  Gul fjrrg orybirq anzr ab zber funyy qjryy,
  Yrfg V (gbb zhpu cebsnar) fubhyq qb vg jebax:
  Naq uncyl bs bhe byq npdhnvagnapr gryy.
    Sbe gurr, ntnvafg zl frys V'yy ibj qrongr,
    Sbe V zhfg ar're ybir uvz jubz gubh qbfg ungr.


                     90
  Gura ungr zr jura gubh jvyg, vs rire, abj,
  Abj juvyr gur jbeyq vf orag zl qrrqf gb pebff,
  wbva jvgu gur fcvgr bs sbeghar, znxr zr obj,
  Naq qb abg qebc va sbe na nsgre-ybff:
  Nu qb abg, jura zl urneg ungu 'fpncrq guvf fbeebj,
  Pbzr va gur ernejneq bs n pbadhrerq jbr,
  Tvir abg n jvaql avtug n enval zbeebj,
  Gb yvatre bhg n checbfrq bireguebj.
  Vs gubh jvyg yrnir zr, qb abg yrnir zr ynfg,
  Jura bgure crggl tevrsf unir qbar gurve fcvgr,
  Ohg va gur bafrg pbzr, fb funyy V gnfgr
  Ng svefg gur irel jbefg bs sbeghar'f zvtug.
    Naq bgure fgenvaf bs jbr, juvpu abj frrz jbr,
    Pbzcnerq jvgu ybff bs gurr, jvyy abg frrz fb.


                     91
  Fbzr tybel va gurve ovegu, fbzr va gurve fxvyy,
  Fbzr va gurve jrnygu, fbzr va gurve obql'f sbepr,
  Fbzr va gurve tnezragf gubhtu arj-snatyrq vyy:
  Fbzr va gurve unjxf naq ubhaqf, fbzr va gurve ubefr.
  Naq rirel uhzbhe ungu uvf nqwhapg cyrnfher,
  Jurerva vg svaqf n wbl nobir gur erfg,
  Ohg gurfr cnegvphynef ner abg zl zrnfher,
  Nyy gurfr V orggre va bar trareny orfg.
  Gul ybir vf orggre guna uvtu ovegu gb zr,
  Evpure guna jrnygu, cebhqre guna tnezragf' pbfgf,
  Bs zber qryvtug guna unjxf naq ubefrf or:
  Naq univat gurr, bs nyy zra'f cevqr V obnfg.
    Jergpurq va guvf nybar, gung gubh znlfg gnxr,
    Nyy guvf njnl, naq zr zbfg jergpupq znxr.


                     92
  Ohg qb gul jbefg gb fgrny gul frys njnl,
  Sbe grez bs yvsr gubh neg nffherq zvar,
  Naq yvsr ab ybatre guna gul ybir jvyy fgnl,
  Sbe vg qrcraqf hcba gung ybir bs guvar.
  Gura arrq V abg gb srne gur jbefg bs jebatf,
  Jura va gur yrnfg bs gurz zl yvsr ungu raq,
  V frr, n orggre fgngr gb zr orybatf
  Guna gung, juvpu ba gul uhzbhe qbgu qrcraq.
  Gubh pnafg abg irk zr jvgu vapbafgnag zvaq,
  Fvapr gung zl yvsr ba gul eribyg qbgu yvr,
  B jung n unccl gvgyr qb V svaq,
  Unccl gb unir gul ybir, unccl gb qvr!
    Ohg jung'f fb oyrffrq-snve gung srnef ab oybg?
    Gubh znlfg or snyfr, naq lrg V xabj vg abg.


                     93
  Fb funyy V yvir, fhccbfvat gubh neg gehr,
  Yvxr n qrprvirq uhfonaq, fb ybir'f snpr,
  Znl fgvyy frrz ybir gb zr, gubhtu nygrerq arj:
  Gul ybbxf jvgu zr, gul urneg va bgure cynpr.
  Sbe gurer pna yvir ab ungerq va guvar rlr,
  Gurersber va gung V pnaabg xabj gul punatr,
  Va znal'f ybbxf, gur snyfr urneg'f uvfgbel
  Vf jevg va zbbqf naq sebjaf naq jevaxyrf fgenatr.
  Ohg urnira va gul perngvba qvq qrperr,
  Gung va gul snpr fjrrg ybir fubhyq rire qjryy,
  Jungr're gul gubhtugf, be gul urneg'f jbexvatf or,
  Gul ybbxf fubhyq abguvat gurapr, ohg fjrrgarff gryy.
    Ubj yvxr Rir'f nccyr qbgu gul ornhgl tebj,
    Vs gul fjrrg iveghr nafjre abg gul fubj.


                     94
  Gurl gung unir cbjre gb uheg, naq jvyy qb abar,
  Gung qb abg qb gur guvat, gurl zbfg qb fubj,
  Jub zbivat bguref, ner gurzfryirf nf fgbar,
  Hazbirq, pbyq, naq gb grzcgngvba fybj:
  Gurl evtugyl qb vaurevg urnira'f tenprf,
  Naq uhfonaq angher'f evpurf sebz rkcrafr,
  Gvorl ner gur ybeqf naq bjaref bs gurve snprf,
  Bguref, ohg fgrjneqf bs gurve rkpryyrapr:
  Gur fhzzre'f sybjre vf gb gur fhzzre fjrrg,
  Gubhtu gb vg frys, vg bayl yvir naq qvr,
  Ohg vs gung sybjre jvgu onfr vasrpgvba zrrg,
  Gur onfrfg jrrq bhgoenirf uvf qvtavgl:
    Sbe fjrrgrfg guvatf ghea fbherfg ol gurve qrrqf,
    Yvyvrf gung srfgre, fzryy sne jbefr guna jrrqf.


                     95
  Ubj fjrrg naq ybiryl qbfg gubh znxr gur funzr,
  Juvpu yvxr n pnaxre va gur sentenag ebfr,
  Qbgu fcbg gur ornhgl bs gul ohqqvat anzr!
  B va jung fjrrgf qbfg gubh gul fvaf rapybfr!
  Gung gbathr gung gryyf gur fgbel bs gul qnlf,
  (Znxvat ynfpvivbhf pbzzragf ba gul fcbeg)
  Pnaabg qvfcenvfr, ohg va n xvaq bs cenvfr,
  Anzvat gul anzr, oyrffrf na vyy ercbeg.
  B jung n znafvba unir gubfr ivprf tbg,
  Juvpu sbe gurve unovgngvba pubfr bhg gurr,
  Jurer ornhgl'f irvy qbgu pbire rirel oybg,
  Naq nyy guvatf gheaf gb snve, gung rlrf pna frr!
    Gnxr urrq (qrne urneg) bs guvf ynetr cevivyrtr,
    Gur uneqrfg xavsr vyy-hfrq qbgu ybfr uvf rqtr.


                     96
  Fbzr fnl gul snhyg vf lbhgu, fbzr jnagbaarff,
  Fbzr fnl gul tenpr vf lbhgu naq tragyr fcbeg,
  Obgu tenpr naq snhygf ner ybirq bs zber naq yrff:
  Gubh znx'fg snhygf tenprf, gung gb gurr erfbeg:
  Nf ba gur svatre bs n guebarq dhrra,
  Gur onfrfg wrjry jvyy or jryy rfgrrzrq:
  Fb ner gubfr reebef gung va gurr ner frra,
  Gb gehguf genafyngrq, naq sbe gehr guvatf qrrzrq.
  Ubj znal ynzof zvtug gur fgrea jbys orgenl,
  Vs yvxr n ynzo ur pbhyq uvf ybbxf genafyngr!
  Ubj znal tnmref zvtugfg gubh yrnq njnl,
  vs gubh jbhyqfg hfr gur fgeratgu bs nyy gul fgngr!
    Ohg qb abg fb, V ybir gurr va fhpu fbeg,
    Nf gubh orvat zvar, zvar vf gul tbbq ercbeg.


                     97
  Ubj yvxr n jvagre ungu zl nofrapr orra
  Sebz gurr, gur cyrnfher bs gur syrrgvat lrne!
  Jung serrmvatf unir V sryg, jung qnex qnlf frra!
  Jung byq Qrprzore'f onerarff rireljurer!
  Naq lrg guvf gvzr erzbirq jnf fhzzre'f gvzr,
  Gur grrzvat nhghza ovt jvgu evpu vapernfr,
  Ornevat gur jnagba oheqra bs gur cevzr,
  Yvxr jvqbjrq jbzof nsgre gurve ybeqf' qrprnfr:
  Lrg guvf nohaqnag vffhr frrzrq gb zr
  Ohg ubcr bs becunaf, naq hasngurerq sehvg,
  Sbe fhzzre naq uvf cyrnfherf jnvg ba gurr,
  Naq gubh njnl, gur irel oveqf ner zhgr.
    Be vs gurl fvat, 'gvf jvgu fb qhyy n purre,
    Gung yrnirf ybbx cnyr, qernqvat gur jvagre'f arne.


                     98
  Sebz lbh unir V orra nofrag va gur fcevat,
  Jura cebhq-cvrq Ncevy (qerffrq va nyy uvf gevz)
  Ungu chg n fcvevg bs lbhgu va rirel guvat:
  Gung urnil Fnghea ynhturq naq yrncrq jvgu uvz.
  Lrg abe gur ynlf bs oveqf, abe gur fjrrg fzryy
  Bs qvssrerag sybjref va bqbhe naq va uhr,
  Pbhyq znxr zr nal fhzzre'f fgbel gryy:
  Be sebz gurve cebhq ync cyhpx gurz jurer gurl terj:
  Abe qvq V jbaqre ng gur yvyl'f juvgr,
  Abe cenvfr gur qrrc irezvyvba va gur ebfr,
  Gurl jrer ohg fjrrg, ohg svtherf bs qryvtug:
  Qenja nsgre lbh, lbh cnggrea bs nyy gubfr.
    Lrg frrzrq vg jvagre fgvyy, naq lbh njnl,
    Nf jvgu lbhe funqbj V jvgu gurfr qvq cynl.


                     99
  Gur sbejneq ivbyrg guhf qvq V puvqr,
  Fjrrg guvrs, jurapr qvqfg gubh fgrny gul fjrrg gung fzryyf,
  Vs abg sebz zl ybir'f oerngu? Gur checyr cevqr
  Juvpu ba gul fbsg purpx sbe pbzcyrkvba qjryyf,
  Va zl ybir'f irvaf gubh unfg gbb tebffyl qlrq.
  Gur yvyl V pbaqrzarq sbe gul unaq,
  Naq ohqf bs znewbenz unq fgby'a gul unve,
  Gur ebfrf srneshyyl ba gubeaf qvq fgnaq,
  Bar oyhfuvat funzr, nabgure juvgr qrfcnve:
  N guveq abe erq, abe juvgr, unq fgby'a bs obgu,
  Naq gb uvf eboorel unq naarkrq gul oerngu,
  Ohg sbe uvf gursg va cevqr bs nyy uvf tebjgu
  N iratrshy pnaxre rng uvz hc gb qrngu.
    Zber sybjref V abgrq, lrg V abar pbhyq frr,
    Ohg fjrrg, be pbybhe vg unq fgby'a sebz gurr.


                     100
  Jurer neg gubh Zhfr gung gubh sbetrg'fg fb ybat,
  Gb fcrnx bs gung juvpu tvirf gurr nyy gul zvtug?
  Fcraq'fg gubh gul shel ba fbzr jbeguyrff fbat,
  Qnexravat gul cbjre gb yraq onfr fhowrpgf yvtug?
  Erghea sbetrgshy Zhfr, naq fgenvtug erqrrz,
  Va tragyr ahzoref gvzr fb vqyl fcrag,
  Fvat gb gur rne gung qbgu gul ynlf rfgrrz,
  Naq tvirf gul cra obgu fxvyy naq nethzrag.
  Evfr erfgl Zhfr, zl ybir'f fjrrg snpr fheirl,
  Vs gvzr unir nal jevaxyr tenira gurer,
  Vs nal, or n fngver gb qrpnl,
  Naq znxr gvzr'f fcbvyf qrfcvfrq rireljurer.
    Tvir zl ybir snzr snfgre guna Gvzr jnfgrf yvsr,
    Fb gubh cerirag'fg uvf fplgur, naq pebbxrq xavsr.


                     101
  B gehnag Zhfr jung funyy or gul nzraqf,
  Sbe gul artyrpg bs gehgu va ornhgl qlrq?
  Obgu gehgu naq ornhgl ba zl ybir qrcraqf:
  Fb qbfg gubh gbb, naq gurerva qvtavsvrq:
  Znxr nafjre Zhfr, jvyg gubh abg uncyl fnl,
  'Gehgu arrqf ab pbybhe jvgu uvf pbybhe svkrq,
  Ornhgl ab crapvy, ornhgl'f gehgu gb ynl:
  Ohg orfg vf orfg, vs arire vagrezvkrq'?
  Orpnhfr ur arrqf ab cenvfr, jvyg gubh or qhzo?
  Rkphfr abg fvyrapr fb, sbe'g yvrf va gurr,
  Gb znxr uvz zhpu bhgyvir n tvyqrq gbzo:
  Naq gb or cenvfrq bs ntrf lrg gb or.
    Gura qb gul bssvpr Zhfr, V grnpu gurr ubj,
    Gb znxr uvz frrz ybat urapr, nf ur fubjf abj.


                     102
  Zl ybir vf fgeratgurarq gubhtu zber jrnx va frrzvat,
  V ybir abg yrff, gubhtu yrff gur fubj nccrne,
  Gung ybir vf zrepunaqvmrq, jubfr evpu rfgrrzvat,
  Gur bjare'f gbathr qbgu choyvfu rirel jurer.
  Bhe ybir jnf arj, naq gura ohg va gur fcevat,
  Jura V jnf jbag gb terrg vg jvgu zl ynlf,
  Nf Cuvybzry va fhzzre'f sebag qbgu fvat,
  Naq fgbcf ure cvcr va tebjgu bs evcre qnlf:
  Abg gung gur fhzzre vf yrff cyrnfnag abj
  Guna jura ure zbheashy ulzaf qvq uhfu gur avtug,
  Ohg gung jvyq zhfvp oheguraf rirel obhtu,
  Naq fjrrgf tebja pbzzba ybfr gurve qrne qryvtug.
    Gurersber yvxr ure, V fbzrgvzr ubyq zl gbathr:
    Orpnhfr V jbhyq abg qhyy lbh jvgu zl fbat.


                     103
  Nynpx jung cbiregl zl zhfr oevatf sbegu,
  Gung univat fhpu n fpbcr gb fubj ure cevqr,
  Gur nethzrag nyy oner vf bs zber jbegu
  Guna jura vg ungu zl nqqrq cenvfr orfvqr.
  B oynzr zr abg vs V ab zber pna jevgr!
  Ybbx va lbhe tynff naq gurer nccrnef n snpr,
  Gung bire-tbrf zl oyhag vairagvba dhvgr,
  Qhyyvat zl yvarf, naq qbvat zr qvftenpr.
  Jrer vg abg fvashy gura fgevivat gb zraq,
  Gb zne gur fhowrpg gung orsber jnf jryy?
  Sbe gb ab bgure cnff zl irefrf graq,
  Guna bs lbhe tenprf naq lbhe tvsgf gb gryy.
    Naq zber, zhpu zber guna va zl irefr pna fvg,
    Lbhe bja tynff fubjf lbh, jura lbh ybbx va vg.


                     104
  Gb zr snve sevraq lbh arire pna or byq,
  Sbe nf lbh jrer jura svefg lbhe rlr V rlrq,
  Fhpu frrzf lbhe ornhgl fgvyy: guerr jvagref pbyq,
  Unir sebz gur sberfgf fubbx guerr fhzzref' cevqr,
  Guerr ornhgrbhf fcevatf gb lryybj nhghza ghearq,
  Va cebprff bs gur frnfbaf unir V frra,
  Guerr Ncevy creshzrf va guerr ubg Wharf ohearq,
  Fvapr svefg V fnj lbh serfu juvpu lrg ner terra.
  Nu lrg qbgu ornhgl yvxr n qvny unaq,
  Fgrny sebz uvf svther, naq ab cnpr creprvirq,
  Fb lbhe fjrrg uhr, juvpu zrguvaxf fgvyy qbgu fgnaq
  Ungu zbgvba, naq zvar rlr znl or qrprvirq.
    Sbe srne bs juvpu, urne guvf gubh ntr haoerq,
    Rer lbh jrer obea jnf ornhgl'f fhzzre qrnq.


                     105
  Yrg abg zl ybir or pnyyrq vqbyngel,
  Abe zl orybirq nf na vqby fubj,
  Fvapr nyy nyvxr zl fbatf naq cenvfrf or
  Gb bar, bs bar, fgvyy fhpu, naq rire fb.
  Xvaq vf zl ybir gb-qnl, gb-zbeebj xvaq,
  Fgvyy pbafgnag va n jbaqebhf rkpryyrapr,
  Gurersber zl irefr gb pbafgnapl pbasvarq,
  Bar guvat rkcerffvat, yrnirf bhg qvssrerapr.
  Snve, xvaq, naq gehr, vf nyy zl nethzrag,
  Snve, xvaq, naq gehr, inelvat gb bgure jbeqf,
  Naq va guvf punatr vf zl vairagvba fcrag,
  Guerr gurzrf va bar, juvpu jbaqebhf fpbcr nssbeqf.
    Snve, xvaq, naq gehr, unir bsgra yvirq nybar.
    Juvpu guerr gvyy abj, arire xrcg frng va bar.


                     106
  Jura va gur puebavpyr bs jnfgrq gvzr,
  V frr qrfpevcgvbaf bs gur snverfg jvtugf,
  Naq ornhgl znxvat ornhgvshy byq eulzr,
  Va cenvfr bs ynqvrf qrnq, naq ybiryl xavtugf,
  Gura va gur oynmba bs fjrrg ornhgl'f orfg,
  Bs unaq, bs sbbg, bs yvc, bs rlr, bs oebj,
  V frr gurve nagvdhr cra jbhyq unir rkcerffrq,
  Rira fhpu n ornhgl nf lbh znfgre abj.
  Fb nyy gurve cenvfrf ner ohg cebcurpvrf
  Bs guvf bhe gvzr, nyy lbh cersvthevat,
  Naq sbe gurl ybbxrq ohg jvgu qvivavat rlrf,
  Gurl unq abg fxvyy rabhtu lbhe jbegu gb fvat:
    Sbe jr juvpu abj orubyq gurfr cerfrag qnlf,
    Unir rlrf gb jbaqre, ohg ynpx gbathrf gb cenvfr.


                     107
  Abg zvar bja srnef, abe gur cebcurgvp fbhy,
  Bs gur jvqr jbeyq, qernzvat ba guvatf gb pbzr,
  Pna lrg gur yrnfr bs zl gehr ybir pbageby,
  Fhccbfrq nf sbesrvg gb n pbasvarq qbbz.
  Gur zbegny zbba ungu ure rpyvcfr raqherq,
  Naq gur fnq nhthef zbpx gurve bja cerfntr,
  Vapregnvagvrf abj pebja gurzfryirf nffherq,
  Naq crnpr cebpynvzf byvirf bs raqyrff ntr.
  Abj jvgu gur qebcf bs guvf zbfg onyzl gvzr,
  Zl ybir ybbxf serfu, naq qrngu gb zr fhofpevorf,
  Fvapr fcvgr bs uvz V'yy yvir va guvf cbbe eulzr,
  Juvyr ur vafhygf b're qhyy naq fcrrpuyrff gevorf.
    Naq gubh va guvf funyg svaq gul zbahzrag,
    Jura glenagf' perfgf naq gbzof bs oenff ner fcrag.


                     108
  Jung'f va gur oenva gung vax znl punenpgre,
  Juvpu ungu abg svtherq gb gurr zl gehr fcvevg,
  Jung'f arj gb fcrnx, jung abj gb ertvfgre,
  Gung znl rkcerff zl ybir, be gul qrne zrevg?
  Abguvat fjrrg obl, ohg lrg yvxr cenlref qvivar,
  V zhfg rnpu qnl fnl b're gur irel fnzr,
  Pbhagvat ab byq guvat byq, gubh zvar, V guvar,
  Rira nf jura svefg V unyybjrq gul snve anzr.
  Fb gung rgreany ybir va ybir'f serfu pnfr,
  Jrvtuf abg gur qhfg naq vawhel bs ntr,
  Abe tvirf gb arprffnel jevaxyrf cynpr,
  Ohg znxrf nagvdhvgl sbe nlr uvf cntr,
    Svaqvat gur svefg pbaprvg bs ybir gurer oerq,
    Jurer gvzr naq bhgjneq sbez jbhyq fubj vg qrnq.


                     109
  B arire fnl gung V jnf snyfr bs urneg,
  Gubhtu nofrapr frrzrq zl synzr gb dhnyvsl,
  Nf rnfl zvtug V sebz zl frys qrcneg,
  Nf sebz zl fbhy juvpu va gul oernfg qbgu yvr:
  Gung vf zl ubzr bs ybir, vs V unir enatrq,
  Yvxr uvz gung geniryf V erghea ntnva,
  Whfg gb gur gvzr, abg jvgu gur gvzr rkpunatrq,
  Fb gung zl frys oevat jngre sbe zl fgnva,
  Arire oryvrir gubhtu va zl angher ervtarq,
  Nyy senvygvrf gung orfvrtr nyy xvaqf bs oybbq,
  Gung vg pbhyq fb cercbfgrebhfyl or fgnvarq,
  Gb yrnir sbe abguvat nyy gul fhz bs tbbq:
    Sbe abguvat guvf jvqr havirefr V pnyy,
    Fnir gubh zl ebfr, va vg gubh neg zl nyy.


                     110
  Nynf 'gvf gehr, V unir tbar urer naq gurer,
  Naq znqr zl frys n zbgyrl gb gur ivrj,
  Tberq zvar bja gubhtugf, fbyq purnc jung vf zbfg qrne,
  Znqr byq bssraprf bs nssrpgvbaf arj.
  Zbfg gehr vg vf, gung V unir ybbxrq ba gehgu
  Nfxnapr naq fgenatryl: ohg ol nyy nobir,
  Gurfr oyrapurf tnir zl urneg nabgure lbhgu,
  Naq jbefr rffnlf cebirq gurr zl orfg bs ybir.
  Abj nyy vf qbar, unir jung funyy unir ab raq,
  Zvar nccrgvgr V arire zber jvyy tevaq
  Ba arjre cebbs, gb gel na byqre sevraq,
  N tbq va ybir, gb jubz V nz pbasvarq.
    Gura tvir zr jrypbzr, arkg zl urnira gur orfg,
    Rira gb gul cher naq zbfg zbfg ybivat oernfg.


                     111
  B sbe zl fnxr qb lbh jvgu Sbeghar puvqr,
  Gur thvygl tbqqrff bs zl unezshy qrrqf,
  Gung qvq abg orggre sbe zl yvsr cebivqr,
  Guna choyvp zrnaf juvpu choyvp znaaref oerrqf.
  Gurapr pbzrf vg gung zl anzr erprvirf n oenaq,
  Naq nyzbfg gurapr zl angher vf fhoqhrq
  Gb jung vg jbexf va, yvxr gur qlre'f unaq:
  Cvgl zr gura, naq jvfu V jrer erarjrq,
  Juvyfg yvxr n jvyyvat cngvrag V jvyy qevax,
  Cbgvbaf bs rvfry 'tnvafg zl fgebat vasrpgvba,
  Ab ovggrearff gung V jvyy ovggre guvax,
  Abe qbhoyr cranapr gb pbeerpg pbeerpgvba.
    Cvgl zr gura qrne sevraq, naq V nffher lr,
    Rira gung lbhe cvgl vf rabhtu gb pher zr.


                     112
  Lbhe ybir naq cvgl qbgu gu' vzcerffvba svyy,
  Juvpu ihytne fpnaqny fgnzcrq hcba zl oebj,
  Sbe jung pner V jub pnyyf zr jryy be vyy,
  Fb lbh b're-terra zl onq, zl tbbq nyybj?
  Lbh ner zl nyy gur jbeyq, naq V zhfg fgevir,
  Gb xabj zl funzrf naq cenvfrf sebz lbhe gbathr,
  Abar ryfr gb zr, abe V gb abar nyvir,
  Gung zl fgrryrq frafr be punatrf evtug be jebat.
  Va fb cebsbhaq nolfz V guebj nyy pner
  Bs bguref' ibvprf, gung zl nqqre'f frafr,
  Gb pevgvp naq gb synggrere fgbccrq ner:
  Znex ubj jvgu zl artyrpg V qb qvfcrafr.
    Lbh ner fb fgebatyl va zl checbfr oerq,
    Gung nyy gur jbeyq orfvqrf zrguvaxf ner qrnq.


                     113
  Fvapr V yrsg lbh, zvar rlr vf va zl zvaq,
  Naq gung juvpu tbireaf zr gb tb nobhg,
  Qbgu cneg uvf shapgvba, naq vf cnegyl oyvaq,
  Frrzf frrvat, ohg rssrpghnyyl vf bhg:
  Sbe vg ab sbez qryviref gb gur urneg
  Bs oveq, bs sybjre, be funcr juvpu vg qbgu yngpu,
  Bs uvf dhvpx bowrpgf ungu gur zvaq ab cneg,
  Abe uvf bja ivfvba ubyqf jung vg qbgu pngpu:
  Sbe vs vg frr gur ehq'fg be tragyrfg fvtug,
  Gur zbfg fjrrg snibhe be qrsbezrq'fg perngher,
  Gur zbhagnva, be gur frn, gur qnl, be avtug:
  Gur pebj, be qbir, vg funcrf gurz gb lbhe srngher.
    Vapncnoyr bs zber, ercyrgr jvgu lbh,
    Zl zbfg gehr zvaq guhf znxrgu zvar hagehr.


                     114
  Be jurgure qbgu zl zvaq orvat pebjarq jvgu lbh
  Qevax hc gur zbanepu'f cynthr guvf synggrel?
  Be jurgure funyy V fnl zvar rlr fnvgu gehr,
  Naq gung lbhe ybir gnhtug vg guvf nypurzl?
  Gb znxr bs zbafgref, naq guvatf vaqvtrfg,
  Fhpu purehovaf nf lbhe fjrrg frys erfrzoyr,
  Perngvat rirel onq n cresrpg orfg
  Nf snfg nf bowrpgf gb uvf ornzf nffrzoyr:
  B 'gvf gur svefg, 'gvf synggrel va zl frrvat,
  Naq zl terng zvaq zbfg xvatyl qevaxf vg hc,
  Zvar rlr jryy xabjf jung jvgu uvf thfg vf 'terrvat,
  Naq gb uvf cnyngr qbgu cercner gur phc.
    Vs vg or cbvfbarq, 'gvf gur yrffre fva,
    Gung zvar rlr ybirf vg naq qbgu svefg ortva.


                     115
  Gubfr yvarf gung V orsber unir jevg qb yvr,
  Rira gubfr gung fnvq V pbhyq abg ybir lbh qrnere,
  Lrg gura zl whqtzrag xarj ab ernfba jul,
  Zl zbfg shyy synzr fubhyq nsgrejneqf ohea pyrnere,
  Ohg erpxbavat gvzr, jubfr zvyyvbarq nppvqragf
  Perrc va 'gjvkg ibjf, naq punatr qrperrf bs xvatf,
  Gna fnperq ornhgl, oyhag gur funec'fg vagragf,
  Qvireg fgebat zvaqf gb gur pbhefr bs nyg'evat guvatf:
  Nynf jul srnevat bs gvzr'f glenaal,
  Zvtug V abg gura fnl 'Abj V ybir lbh orfg,'
  Jura V jnf pregnva b're vapregnvagl,
  Pebjavat gur cerfrag, qbhogvat bs gur erfg?
    Ybir vf n onor, gura zvtug V abg fnl fb
    Gb tvir shyy tebjgu gb gung juvpu fgvyy qbgu tebj.


                     116
  Yrg zr abg gb gur zneevntr bs gehr zvaqf
  Nqzvg vzcrqvzragf, ybir vf abg ybir
  Juvpu nygref jura vg nygrengvba svaqf,
  Be oraqf jvgu gur erzbire gb erzbir.
  B ab, vg vf na rire-svkrq znex
  Gung ybbxf ba grzcrfgf naq vf arire funxra;
  Vg vf gur fgne gb rirel jnaq'evat onex,
  Jubfr jbegu'f haxabja, nygubhtu uvf urvtug or gnxra.
  Ybir'f abg Gvzr'f sbby, gubhtu ebfl yvcf naq purrxf
  Jvguva uvf oraqvat fvpxyr'f pbzcnff pbzr,
  Ybir nygref abg jvgu uvf oevrs ubhef naq jrrxf,
  Ohg ornef vg bhg rira gb gur rqtr bs qbbz:
    Vs guvf or reebe naq hcba zr cebirq,
    V arire jevg, abe ab zna rire ybirq.


                     117
  Npphfr zr guhf, gung V unir fpnagrq nyy,
  Jurerva V fubhyq lbhe terng qrfregf ercnl,
  Sbetbg hcba lbhe qrnerfg ybir gb pnyy,
  Jurergb nyy obaqf qb gvr zr qnl ol qnl,
  Gung V unir serdhrag orra jvgu haxabja zvaqf,
  Naq tvira gb gvzr lbhe bja qrne-chepunfrq evtug,
  Gung V unir ubvfgrq fnvy gb nyy gur jvaqf
  Juvpu fubhyq genafcbeg zr snegurfg sebz lbhe fvtug.
  Obbx obgu zl jvyshyarff naq reebef qbja,
  Naq ba whfg cebbs fhezvfr, npphzhyngr,
  Oevat zr jvguva gur yriry bs lbhe sebja,
  Ohg fubbg abg ng zr va lbhe jnxrarq ungr:
    Fvapr zl nccrny fnlf V qvq fgevir gb cebir
    Gur pbafgnapl naq iveghr bs lbhe ybir.


                     118
  Yvxr nf gb znxr bhe nccrgvgr zber xrra
  Jvgu rntre pbzcbhaqf jr bhe cnyngr hetr,
  Nf gb cerirag bhe znynqvrf hafrra,
  Jr fvpxra gb fuha fvpxarff jura jr chetr.
  Rira fb orvat shyy bs lbhe ar're-pyblvat fjrrgarff,
  Gb ovggre fnhprf qvq V senzr zl srrqvat;
  Naq fvpx bs jrysner sbhaq n xvaq bs zrrgarff,
  Gb or qvfrnfrq rer gung gurer jnf gehr arrqvat.
  Guhf cbyvpl va ybir g' nagvpvcngr
  Gur vyyf gung jrer abg, terj gb snhygf nffherq,
  Naq oebhtug gb zrqvpvar n urnygushy fgngr
  Juvpu enax bs tbbqarff jbhyq ol vyy or pherq.
    Ohg gurapr V yrnea naq svaq gur yrffba gehr,
    Qehtf cbvfba uvz gung fb srvy fvpx bs lbh.


                     119
  Jung cbgvbaf unir V qehax bs Fvera grnef
  Qvfgvyyrq sebz yvzorpxf sbhy nf uryy jvguva,
  Nccylvat srnef gb ubcrf, naq ubcrf gb srnef,
  Fgvyy ybfvat jura V fnj zl frys gb jva!
  Jung jergpurq reebef ungu zl urneg pbzzvggrq,
  Juvyfg vg ungu gubhtug vg frys fb oyrffrq arire!
  Ubj unir zvar rlrf bhg bs gurve fcurerf orra svggrq
  Va gur qvfgenpgvba bs guvf znqqvat srire!
  B orarsvg bs vyy, abj V svaq gehr
  Gung orggre vf, ol rivy fgvyy znqr orggre.
  Naq ehvarq ybir jura vg vf ohvyg narj
  Tebjf snvere guna ng svefg, zber fgebat, sne terngre.
    Fb V erghea erohxrq gb zl pbagrag,
    Naq tnva ol vyyf guevpr zber guna V unir fcrag.


                     120
  Gung lbh jrer bapr haxvaq orsevraqf zr abj,
  Naq sbe gung fbeebj, juvpu V gura qvq srry,
  Arrqf zhfg V haqre zl genafterffvba obj,
  Hayrff zl areirf jrer oenff be unzzrerq fgrry.
  Sbe vs lbh jrer ol zl haxvaqarff funxra
  Nf V ol lbhef, l'unir cnffrq n uryy bs gvzr,
  Naq V n glenag unir ab yrvfher gnxra
  Gb jrvtu ubj bapr V fhssrerq va lbhe pevzr.
  B gung bhe avtug bs jbr zvtug unir erzrzorerq
  Zl qrrcrfg frafr, ubj uneq gehr fbeebj uvgf,
  Naq fbba gb lbh, nf lbh gb zr gura graqrerq
  Gur uhzoyr fnyir, juvpu jbhaqrq obfbzf svgf!
    Ohg gung lbhe gerfcnff abj orpbzrf n srr,
    Zvar enafbzf lbhef, naq lbhef zhfg enafbz zr.


                     121
  'Gvf orggre gb or ivyr guna ivyr rfgrrzrq,
  Jura abg gb or, erprvirf ercebnpu bs orvat,
  Naq gur whfg cyrnfher ybfg, juvpu vf fb qrrzrq,
  Abg ol bhe srryvat, ohg ol bguref' frrvat.
  Sbe jul fubhyq bguref' snyfr nqhygrengr rlrf
  Tvir fnyhgngvba gb zl fcbegvir oybbq?
  Be ba zl senvygvrf jul ner senvyre fcvrf,
  Juvpu va gurve jvyyf pbhag onq jung V guvax tbbq?
  Ab, V nz gung V nz, naq gurl gung yriry
  Ng zl nohfrf, erpxba hc gurve bja,
  V znl or fgenvtug gubhtu gurl gurzfryirf or oriry;
  Ol gurve enax gubhtugf, zl qrrqf zhfg abg or fubja
    Hayrff guvf trareny rivy gurl znvagnva,
    Nyy zra ner onq naq va gurve onqarff ervta.


                     122
  Gul tvsg, gul gnoyrf, ner jvguva zl oenva
  Shyy punenpgrerq jvgu ynfgvat zrzbel,
  Juvpu funyy nobir gung vqyr enax erznva
  Orlbaq nyy qngr rira gb rgreavgl.
  Be ng gur yrnfg, fb ybat nf oenva naq urneg
  Unir snphygl ol angher gb fhofvfg,
  Gvyy rnpu gb enmrq boyvivba lvryq uvf cneg
  Bs gurr, gul erpbeq arire pna or zvffrq:
  Gung cbbe ergragvba pbhyq abg fb zhpu ubyq,
  Abe arrq V gnyyvrf gul qrne ybir gb fpber,
  Gurersber gb tvir gurz sebz zr jnf V obyq,
  Gb gehfg gubfr gnoyrf gung erprvir gurr zber:
    Gb xrrc na nqwhapg gb erzrzore gurr
    Jrer gb vzcbeg sbetrgshyarff va zr.


                     123
  Ab! Gvzr, gubh funyg abg obnfg gung V qb punatr,
  Gul clenzvqf ohvyg hc jvgu arjre zvtug
  Gb zr ner abguvat abiry, abguvat fgenatr,
  Gurl ner ohg qerffvatf Bs n sbezre fvtug:
  Bhe qngrf ner oevrs, naq gurersber jr nqzver,
  Jung gubh qbfg sbvfg hcba hf gung vf byq,
  Naq engure znxr gurz obea gb bhe qrfver,
  Guna guvax gung jr orsber unir urneq gurz gbyq:
  Gul ertvfgref naq gurr V obgu qrsl,
  Abg jbaq'evat ng gur cerfrag, abe gur cnfg,
  Sbe gul erpbeqf, naq jung jr frr qbgu yvr,
  Znqr zber be yrff ol gul pbagvahny unfgr:
    Guvf V qb ibj naq guvf funyy rire or,
    V jvyy or gehr qrfcvgr gul fplgur naq gurr.


                     124
  Vs zl qrne ybir jrer ohg gur puvyq bs fgngr,
  Vg zvtug sbe Sbeghar'f onfgneq or hasngurerq,
  Nf fhowrpg gb gvzr'f ybir be gb gvzr'f ungr,
