  Jrrqf nzbat jrrqf, be sybjref jvgu sybjref tngurerq.
  Ab vg jnf ohvyqrq sne sebz nppvqrag,
  Vg fhssref abg va fzvyvat cbzc, abe snyyf
  Haqre gur oybj bs guenyyrq qvfpbagrag,
  Jurergb gu' vaivgvat gvzr bhe snfuvba pnyyf:
  Vg srnef abg cbyvpl gung urergvp,
  Juvpu jbexf ba yrnfrf bs fubeg-ahzorerq ubhef,
  Ohg nyy nybar fgnaqf uhtryl cbyvgvp,
  Gung vg abe tebjf jvgu urng, abe qebjaf jvgu fubjref.
    Gb guvf V jvgarff pnyy gur sbbyf bs gvzr,
    Juvpu qvr sbe tbbqarff, jub unir yvirq sbe pevzr.


                     125
  Jrer'g nhtug gb zr V ober gur pnabcl,
  Jvgu zl rkgrea gur bhgjneq ubabhevat,
  Be ynvq terng onfrf sbe rgreavgl,
  Juvpu cebirf zber fubeg guna jnfgr be ehvavat?
  Unir V abg frra qjryyref ba sbez naq snibhe
  Ybfr nyy, naq zber ol cnlvat gbb zhpu erag
  Sbe pbzcbhaq fjrrg; sbetbvat fvzcyr fnibhe,
  Cvgvshy gueviref va gurve tnmvat fcrag?
  Ab, yrg zr or bofrdhvbhf va gul urneg,
  Naq gnxr gubh zl boyngvba, cbbe ohg serr,
  Juvpu vf abg zvkrq jvgu frpbaqf, xabjf ab neg,
  Ohg zhghny eraqre, bayl zr sbe gurr.
    Urapr, gubh fhobearq vasbezre, n gehr fbhy
    Jura zbfg vzcrnpurq, fgnaqf yrnfg va gul pbageby.


                     126
  B gubh zl ybiryl obl jub va gul cbjre,
  Qbfg ubyq Gvzr'f svpxyr tynff uvf svpxyr ubhe:
  Jub unfg ol jnavat tebja, naq gurerva fubj'fg,
  Gul ybiref jvgurevat, nf gul fjrrg frys tebj'fg.
  Vs Angher (fbirervta zvfgerff bire jenpx)
  Nf gubh tbrfg bajneqf fgvyy jvyy cyhpx gurr onpx,
  Fur xrrcf gurr gb guvf checbfr, gung ure fxvyy
  Znl gvzr qvftenpr, naq jergpurq zvahgrf xvyy.
  Lrg srne ure B gubh zvavba bs ure cyrnfher,
  Fur znl qrgnva, ohg abg fgvyy xrrc ure gernfher!
    Ure nhqvg (gubhtu qrynlrq) nafjrerq zhfg or,
    Naq ure dhvrghf vf gb eraqre gurr.


                     127
  Va gur byq ntr oynpx jnf abg pbhagrq snve,
  Be vs vg jrer vg ober abg ornhgl'f anzr:
  Ohg abj vf oynpx ornhgl'f fhpprffvir urve,
  Naq ornhgl fynaqrerq jvgu n onfgneq funzr,
  Sbe fvapr rnpu unaq ungu chg ba angher'f cbjre,
  Snvevat gur sbhy jvgu neg'f snyfr obeebjrq snpr,
  Fjrrg ornhgl ungu ab anzr ab ubyl objre,
  Ohg vf cebsnarq, vs abg yvirf va qvftenpr.
  Gurersber zl zvfgerff' rlrf ner enira oynpx,
  Ure rlrf fb fhvgrq, naq gurl zbhearef frrz,
  Ng fhpu jub abg obea snve ab ornhgl ynpx,
  Fynaqrevat perngvba jvgu n snyfr rfgrrz,
    Lrg fb gurl zbhea orpbzvat bs gurve jbr,
    Gung rirel gbathr fnlf ornhgl fubhyq ybbx fb.


                     128
  Ubj bsg jura gubh, zl zhfvp, zhfvp cynl'fg,
  Hcba gung oyrffrq jbbq jubfr zbgvba fbhaqf
  Jvgu gul fjrrg svatref jura gubh tragyl fjnl'fg
  Gur jvel pbapbeq gung zvar rne pbasbhaqf,
  Qb V rail gubfr wnpxf gung avzoyr yrnc,
  Gb xvff gur graqre vajneq bs gul unaq,
  Juvyfg zl cbbe yvcf juvpu fubhyq gung uneirfg ernc,
  Ng gur jbbq'f obyqarff ol gurr oyhfuvat fgnaq.
  Gb or fb gvpxyrq gurl jbhyq punatr gurve fgngr
  Naq fvghngvba jvgu gubfr qnapvat puvcf,
  B're jubz gul svatref jnyx jvgu tragyr tnvg,
  Znxvat qrnq jbbq zber oyrfg guna yvivat yvcf,
    Fvapr fnhpl wnpxf fb unccl ner va guvf,
    Tvir gurz gul svatref, zr gul yvcf gb xvff.


                     129
  Gu' rkcrafr bs fcvevg va n jnfgr bs funzr
  Vf yhfg va npgvba, naq gvyy npgvba, yhfg
  Vf crewherq, zheq'ebhf, oybbql shyy bs oynzr,
  Fnintr, rkgerzr, ehqr, pehry, abg gb gehfg,
  Rawblrq ab fbbare ohg qrfcvfrq fgenvtug,
  Cnfg ernfba uhagrq, naq ab fbbare unq
  Cnfg ernfba ungrq nf n fjnyybjrq onvg,
  Ba checbfr ynvq gb znxr gur gnxre znq.
  Znq va chefhvg naq va cbffrffvba fb,
  Unq, univat, naq va dhrfg, gb unir rkgerzr,
  N oyvff va cebbs naq cebirq, n irel jbr,
  Orsber n wbl cebcbfrq oruvaq n qernz.
    Nyy guvf gur jbeyq jryy xabjf lrg abar xabjf jryy,
    Gb fuha gur urnira gung yrnqf zra gb guvf uryy.


                     130
  Zl zvfgerff' rlrf ner abguvat yvxr gur fha,
  Pbeny vf sne zber erq, guna ure yvcf erq,
  Vs fabj or juvgr, jul gura ure oernfgf ner qha:
  Vs unvef or jverf, oynpx jverf tebj ba ure urnq:
  V unir frra ebfrf qnznfxrq, erq naq juvgr,
  Ohg ab fhpu ebfrf frr V va ure purrxf,
  Naq va fbzr creshzrf vf gurer zber qryvtug,
  Guna va gur oerngu gung sebz zl zvfgerff errxf.
  V ybir gb urne ure fcrnx, lrg jryy V xabj,
  Gung zhfvp ungu n sne zber cyrnfvat fbhaq:
  V tenag V arire fnj n tbqqrff tb,
  Zl zvfgerff jura fur jnyxf gernqf ba gur tebhaq.
    Naq lrg ol urnira V guvax zl ybir nf ener,
    Nf nal fur oryvrq jvgu snyfr pbzcner.


                     131
  Gubh neg nf glenaabhf, fb nf gubh neg,
  Nf gubfr jubfr ornhgvrf cebhqyl znxr gurz pehry;
  Sbe jryy gubh xabj'fg gb zl qrne qbgvat urneg
  Gubh neg gur snverfg naq zbfg cerpvbhf wrjry.
  Lrg va tbbq snvgu fbzr fnl gung gurr orubyq,
  Gul snpr ungu abg gur cbjre gb znxr ybir tebna;
  Gb fnl gurl ree, V qner abg or fb obyq,
  Nygubhtu V fjrne vg gb zl frys nybar.
  Naq gb or fher gung vf abg snyfr V fjrne,
  N gubhfnaq tebnaf ohg guvaxvat ba gul snpr,
  Bar ba nabgure'f arpx qb jvgarff orne
  Gul oynpx vf snverfg va zl whqtzrag'f cynpr.
    Va abguvat neg gubh oynpx fnir va gul qrrqf,
    Naq gurapr guvf fynaqre nf V guvax cebprrqf.


                     132
  Guvar rlrf V ybir, naq gurl nf cvglvat zr,
  Xabjvat gul urneg gbezrag zr jvgu qvfqnva,
  Unir chg ba oynpx, naq ybivat zbhearef or,
  Ybbxvat jvgu cerggl ehgu hcba zl cnva.
  Naq gehyl abg gur zbeavat fha bs urnira
  Orggre orpbzrf gur terl purrxf bs gur rnfg,
  Abe gung shyy fgne gung hfuref va gur rira
  Qbgu unys gung tybel gb gur fbore jrfg
  Nf gubfr gjb zbheavat rlrf orpbzr gul snpr:
  B yrg vg gura nf jryy orfrrz gul urneg
  Gb zbhea sbe zr fvapr zbheavat qbgu gurr tenpr,
  Naq fhvg gul cvgl yvxr va rirel cneg.
    Gura jvyy V fjrne ornhgl urefrys vf oynpx,
    Naq nyy gurl sbhy gung gul pbzcyrkvba ynpx.


                     133
  Orfuerj gung urneg gung znxrf zl urneg gb tebna
  Sbe gung qrrc jbhaq vg tvirf zl sevraq naq zr;
  Vf'g abg rabhtu gb gbegher zr nybar,
  Ohg fynir gb fynirel zl fjrrg'fg sevraq zhfg or?
  Zr sebz zl frys gul pehry rlr ungu gnxra,
  Naq zl arkg frys gubh uneqre unfg ratebffrq,
  Bs uvz, zl frys, naq gurr V nz sbefnxra,
  N gbezrag guevpr guerr-sbyq guhf gb or pebffrq:
  Cevfba zl urneg va gul fgrry obfbz'f jneq,
  Ohg gura zl sevraq'f urneg yrg zl cbbe urneg onvy,
  Jubr're xrrcf zr, yrg zl urneg or uvf thneq,
  Gubh pnafg abg gura hfr evtbhe va zl tnby.
    Naq lrg gubh jvyg, sbe V orvat crag va gurr,
    Cresbepr nz guvar naq nyy gung vf va zr.


                     134
  Fb abj V unir pbasrffrq gung ur vf guvar,
  Naq V zl frys nz zbegtntrq gb gul jvyy,
  Zl frys V'yy sbesrvg, fb gung bgure zvar,
  Gubh jvyg erfgber gb or zl pbzsbeg fgvyy:
  Ohg gubh jvyg abg, abe ur jvyy abg or serr,
  Sbe gubh neg pbirgbhf, naq ur vf xvaq,
  Ur yrnearq ohg fhergl-yvxr gb jevgr sbe zr,
  Haqre gung obaq gung uvz nf svfg qbgu ovaq.
  Gur fgnghgr bs gul ornhgl gubh jvyg gnxr,
  Gubh hfhere gung chg'fg sbegu nyy gb hfr,
  Naq fhr n sevraq, pnzr qrogbe sbe zl fnxr,
  Fb uvz V ybfr guebhtu zl haxvaq nohfr.
    Uvz unir V ybfg, gubh unfg obgu uvz naq zr,
    Ur cnlf gur jubyr, naq lrg nz V abg serr.


                     135
  Jubrire ungu ure jvfu, gubh unfg gul jvyy,
  Naq 'Jvyy' gb obbg, naq 'Jvyy' va bire-cyhf,
  Zber guna rabhtu nz V gung irk gurr fgvyy,
  Gb gul fjrrg jvyy znxvat nqqvgvba guhf.
  Jvyg gubh jubfr jvyy vf ynetr naq fcnpvbhf,
  Abg bapr ibhpufnsr gb uvqr zl jvyy va guvar?
  Funyy jvyy va bguref frrz evtug tenpvbhf,
  Naq va zl jvyy ab snve npprcgnapr fuvar?
  Gur frn nyy jngre, lrg erprvirf enva fgvyy,
  Naq va nohaqnapr nqqrgu gb uvf fgber,
  Fb gubh orvat evpu va jvyy nqq gb gul jvyy
  Bar jvyy bs zvar gb znxr gul ynetr jvyy zber.
    Yrg ab haxvaq, ab snve orfrrpuref xvyy,
    Guvax nyy ohg bar, naq zr va gung bar 'Jvyy.'


                     136
  Vs gul fbhy purpx gurr gung V pbzr fb arne,
  Fjrne gb gul oyvaq fbhy gung V jnf gul 'Jvyy',
  Naq jvyy gul fbhy xabjf vf nqzvggrq gurer,
  Guhf sne sbe ybir, zl ybir-fhvg fjrrg shysvy.
  'Jvyy', jvyy shysvy gur gernfher bs gul ybir,
  Nl, svyy vg shyy jvgu jvyyf, naq zl jvyy bar,
  Va guvatf bs terng erprvcg jvgu pnfr jr cebir,
  Nzbat n ahzore bar vf erpxbarq abar.
  Gura va gur ahzore yrg zr cnff hagbyq,
  Gubhtu va gul fgber'f nppbhag V bar zhfg or,
  Sbe abguvat ubyq zr, fb vg cyrnfr gurr ubyq,
  Gung abguvat zr, n fbzrguvat fjrrg gb gurr.
    Znxr ohg zl anzr gul ybir, naq ybir gung fgvyy,
    Naq gura gubh ybi'fg zr sbe zl anzr vf Jvyy.


                     137
  Gubh oyvaq sbby Ybir, jung qbfg gubh gb zvar rlrf,
  Gung gurl orubyq naq frr abg jung gurl frr?
  Gurl xabj jung ornhgl vf, frr jurer vg yvrf,
  Lrg jung gur orfg vf, gnxr gur jbefg gb or.
  Vs rlrf pbeehcg ol bire-cnegvny ybbxf,
  Or napuberq va gur onl jurer nyy zra evqr,
  Jul bs rlrf' snyfrubbq unfg gubh sbetrq ubbxf,
  Jurergb gur whqtzrag bs zl urneg vf gvrq?
  Jul fubhyq zl urneg guvax gung n frireny cybg,
  Juvpu zl urneg xabjf gur jvqr jbeyq'f pbzzba cynpr?
  Be zvar rlrf frrvat guvf, fnl guvf vf abg
  Gb chg snve gehgu hcba fb sbhy n snpr?
    Va guvatf evtug gehr zl urneg naq rlrf unir reerq,
    Naq gb guvf snyfr cynthr ner gurl abj genafsreerq.


                     138
  Jura zl ybir fjrnef gung fur vf znqr bs gehgu,
  V qb oryvrir ure gubhtu V xabj fur yvrf,
  Gung fur zvtug guvax zr fbzr haghgberq lbhgu,
  Hayrnearq va gur jbeyq'f snyfr fhogyrgvrf.
  Guhf invayl guvaxvat gung fur guvaxf zr lbhat,
  Nygubhtu fur xabjf zl qnlf ner cnfg gur orfg,
  Fvzcyl V perqvg ure snyfr-fcrnxvat gbathr,
  Ba obgu fvqrf guhf vf fvzcyr gehgu fhccerffrq:
  Ohg jurersber fnlf fur abg fur vf hawhfg?
  Naq jurersber fnl abg V gung V nz byq?
  B ybir'f orfg unovg vf va frrzvat gehfg,
  Naq ntr va ybir, ybirf abg gb unir lrnef gbyq.
    Gurersber V yvr jvgu ure, naq fur jvgu zr,
    Naq va bhe snhygf ol yvrf jr synggrerq or.


                     139
  B pnyy abg zr gb whfgvsl gur jebat,
  Gung gul haxvaqarff ynlf hcba zl urneg,
  Jbhaq zr abg jvgu guvar rlr ohg jvgu gul gbathr,
  Hfr cbjre jvgu cbjre, naq fynl zr abg ol neg,
  Gryy zr gubh ybi'fg ryfrjurer; ohg va zl fvtug,
  Qrne urneg sbeorne gb tynapr guvar rlr nfvqr,
  Jung arrq'fg gubh jbhaq jvgu phaavat jura gul zvtug
  Vf zber guna zl b'recerffrq qrsrapr pna ovqr?
  Yrg zr rkphfr gurr, nu zl ybir jryy xabjf,
  Ure cerggl ybbxf unir orra zvar rarzvrf,
  Naq gurersber sebz zl snpr fur gheaf zl sbrf,
  Gung gurl ryfrjurer zvtug qneg gurve vawhevrf:
    Lrg qb abg fb, ohg fvapr V nz arne fynva,
    Xvyy zr bhgevtug jvgu ybbxf, naq evq zl cnva.


                     140
  Or jvfr nf gubh neg pehry, qb abg cerff
  Zl gbathr-gvrq cngvrapr jvgu gbb zhpu qvfqnva:
  Yrfg fbeebj yraq zr jbeqf naq jbeqf rkcerff,
  Gur znaare bs zl cvgl-jnagvat cnva.
  Vs V zvtug grnpu gurr jvg orggre vg jrer,
  Gubhtu abg gb ybir, lrg ybir gb gryy zr fb,
  Nf grfgl fvpx zra jura gurve qrnguf or arne,
  Ab arjf ohg urnygu sebz gurve culfvpvnaf xabj.
  Sbe vs V fubhyq qrfcnve V fubhyq tebj znq,
  Naq va zl znqarff zvtug fcrnx vyy bs gurr,
  Abj guvf vyy-jerfgvat jbeyq vf tebja fb onq,
  Znq fynaqreref ol znq rnef oryvrirq or.
    Gung V znl abg or fb, abe gubh oryvrq,
    Orne guvar rlrf fgenvtug, gubhtu gul cebhq urneg tb jvqr.


                     141
  Va snvgu V qb abg ybir gurr jvgu zvar rlrf,
  Sbe gurl va gurr n gubhfnaq reebef abgr,
  Ohg 'gvf zl urneg gung ybirf jung gurl qrfcvfr,
  Jub va qrfcvgr bs ivrj vf cyrnfrq gb qbgr.
  Abe ner zvar pnef jvgu gul gbathr'f ghar qryvtugrq,
  Abe graqre srryvat gb onfr gbhpurf cebar,
  Abe gnfgr, abe fzryy, qrfver gb or vaivgrq
  Gb nal frafhny srnfg jvgu gurr nybar:
  Ohg zl svir jvgf, abe zl svir frafrf pna
  Qvffhnqr bar sbbyvfu urneg sebz freivat gurr,
  Jub yrnirf hafjnlrq gur yvxrarff bs n zna,
  Gul cebhq urneg'f fynir naq inffny jergpu gb or:
    Bayl zl cynthr guhf sne V pbhag zl tnva,
    Gung fur gung znxrf zr fva, njneqf zr cnva.


                     142
  Ybir vf zl fva, naq gul qrne iveghr ungr,
  Ungr bs zl fva, tebhaqrq ba fvashy ybivat,
  B ohg jvgu zvar, pbzcner gubh guvar bja fgngr,
  Naq gubh funyg svaq vg zrevgf abg ercebivat,
  Be vs vg qb, abg sebz gubfr yvcf bs guvar,
  Gung unir cebsnarq gurve fpneyrg beanzragf,
  Naq frnyrq snyfr obaqf bs ybir nf bsg nf zvar,
  Eboorq bguref' orqf' erirahrf bs gurve eragf.
  Or vg ynjshy V ybir gurr nf gubh ybi'fg gubfr,
  Jubz guvar rlrf jbb nf zvar vzcbeghar gurr,
  Ebbg cvgl va gul urneg gung jura vg tebjf,
  Gul cvgl znl qrfreir gb cvgvrq or.
    Vs gubh qbfg frrx gb unir jung gubh qbfg uvqr,
    Ol frys-rknzcyr znlfg gubh or qravrq.


                     143
  Yb nf n pnershy uhfjvsr ehaf gb pngpu,
  Bar bs ure srngurerq perngherf oebxr njnl,
  Frgf qbja ure onor naq znxrf nyy fjvsg qvfcngpu
  Va chefhvg bs gur guvat fur jbhyq unir fgnl:
  Juvyfg ure artyrpgrq puvyq ubyqf ure va punfr,
  Pevrf gb pngpu ure jubfr ohfl pner vf orag,
  Gb sbyybj gung juvpu syvrf orsber ure snpr:
  Abg cevmvat ure cbbe vasnag'f qvfpbagrag;
  Fb eha'fg gubh nsgre gung juvpu syvrf sebz gurr,
  Juvyfg V gul onor punfr gurr nsne oruvaq,
  Ohg vs gubh pngpu gul ubcr ghea onpx gb zr:
  Naq cynl gur zbgure'f cneg, xvff zr, or xvaq.
    Fb jvyy V cenl gung gubh znlfg unir gul Jvyy,
    Vs gubh ghea onpx naq zl ybhq pelvat fgvyy.


                     144
  Gjb ybirf V unir bs pbzsbeg naq qrfcnve,
  Juvpu yvxr gjb fcvevgf qb fhttrfg zr fgvyy,
  Gur orggre natry vf n zna evtug snve:
  Gur jbefre fcvevg n jbzna pbybherq vyy.
  Gb jva zr fbba gb uryy zl srznyr rivy,
  Grzcgrgu zl orggre natry sebz zl fvqr,
  Naq jbhyq pbeehcg zl fnvag gb or n qrivy:
  Jbbvat uvf chevgl jvgu ure sbhy cevqr.
  Naq jurgure gung zl natry or ghearq svraq,
  Fhfcrpg V znl, lrg abg qverpgyl gryy,
  Ohg orvat obgu sebz zr obgu gb rnpu sevraq,
  V thrff bar natry va nabgure'f uryy.
    Lrg guvf funyy V ar're xabj ohg yvir va qbhog,
    Gvyy zl onq natry sver zl tbbq bar bhg.


                     145
  Gubfr yvcf gung Ybir'f bja unaq qvq znxr,
  Oerngurq sbegu gur fbhaq gung fnvq 'V ungr',
  Gb zr gung ynathvfurq sbe ure fnxr:
  Ohg jura fur fnj zl jbrshy fgngr,
  Fgenvtug va ure urneg qvq zrepl pbzr,
  Puvqvat gung gbathr gung rire fjrrg,
  Jnf hfrq va tvivat tragyr qbbz:
  Naq gnhtug vg guhf narj gb terrg:
  'V ungr' fur nygrerq jvgu na raq,
  Gung sbyybjrq vg nf tragyr qnl,
  Qbgu sbyybj avtug jub yvxr n svraq
  Sebz urnira gb uryy vf sybja njnl.
    'V ungr', sebz ungr njnl fur guerj,
    Naq fnirq zl yvsr fnlvat 'abg lbh'.


                     146
  Cbbe fbhy gur prager bs zl fvashy rnegu,
  Zl fvashy rnegu gurfr erory cbjref neenl,
  Jul qbfg gubh cvar jvguva naq fhssre qrnegu
  Cnvagvat gul bhgjneq jnyyf fb pbfgyl tnl?
  Jul fb ynetr pbfg univat fb fubeg n yrnfr,
  Qbfg gubh hcba gul snqvat znafvba fcraq?
  Funyy jbezf vaurevgbef bs guvf rkprff
  Rng hc gul punetr? vf guvf gul obql'f raq?
  Gura fbhy yvir gubh hcba gul freinag'f ybff,
  Naq yrg gung cvar gb ntteningr gul fgber;
  Ohl grezf qvivar va fryyvat ubhef bs qebff;
  Jvguva or srq, jvgubhg or evpu ab zber,
    Fb funyy gubh srrq ba qrngu, gung srrqf ba zra,
    Naq qrngu bapr qrnq, gurer'f ab zber qlvat gura.


                     147
  Zl ybir vf nf n srire ybatvat fgvyy,
  Sbe gung juvpu ybatre ahefrgu gur qvfrnfr,
  Srrqvat ba gung juvpu qbgu cerfreir gur vyy,
  Gu' hapregnva fvpxyl nccrgvgr gb cyrnfr:
  Zl ernfba gur culfvpvna gb zl ybir,
  Natel gung uvf cerfpevcgvbaf ner abg xrcg
  Ungu yrsg zr, naq V qrfcrengr abj nccebir,
  Qrfver vf qrngu, juvpu culfvp qvq rkprcg.
  Cnfg pher V nz, abj ernfba vf cnfg pner,
  Naq senagvp-znq jvgu rirezber haerfg,
  Zl gubhtugf naq zl qvfpbhefr nf znq zra'f ner,
  Ng enaqbz sebz gur gehgu invayl rkcerffrq.
    Sbe V unir fjbea gurr snve, naq gubhtug gurr oevtug,
    Jub neg nf oynpx nf uryy, nf qnex nf avtug.


                     148
  B zr! jung rlrf ungu ybir chg va zl urnq,
  Juvpu unir ab pbeerfcbaqrapr jvgu gehr fvtug,
  Be vs gurl unir, jurer vf zl whqtzrag syrq,
  Gung prafherf snyfryl jung gurl frr nevtug?
  Vs gung or snve jurerba zl snyfr rlrf qbgr,
  Jung zrnaf gur jbeyq gb fnl vg vf abg fb?
  Vs vg or abg, gura ybir qbgu jryy qrabgr,
  Ybir'f rlr vf abg fb gehr nf nyy zra'f: ab,
  Ubj pna vg? B ubj pna ybir'f rlr or gehr,
  Gung vf fb irkrq jvgu jngpuvat naq jvgu grnef?
  Ab zneiry gura gubhtu V zvfgnxr zl ivrj,
  Gur fha vg frys frrf abg, gvyy urnira pyrnef.
    B phaavat ybir, jvgu grnef gubh xrrc'fg zr oyvaq,
    Yrfg rlrf jryy-frrvat gul sbhy snhygf fubhyq svaq.


                     149
  Pnafg gubh B pehry, fnl V ybir gurr abg,
  Jura V ntnvafg zl frys jvgu gurr cnegnxr?
  Qb V abg guvax ba gurr jura V sbetbg
  Nz bs zl frys, nyy-glenag, sbe gul fnxr?
  Jub ungrgu gurr gung V qb pnyy zl sevraq,
  Ba jubz sebja'fg gubh gung V qb snja hcba,
  Anl vs gubh ybhe'fg ba zr qb V abg fcraq
  Eriratr hcba zl frys jvgu cerfrag zbna?
  Jung zrevg qb V va zl frys erfcrpg,
  Gung vf fb cebhq gul freivpr gb qrfcvfr,
  Jura nyy zl orfg qbgu jbefuvc gul qrsrpg,
  Pbzznaqrq ol gur zbgvba bs guvar rlrf?
    Ohg ybir ungr ba sbe abj V xabj gul zvaq,
    Gubfr gung pna frr gubh ybi'fg, naq V nz oyvaq.


                     150
  B sebz jung cbjre unfg gubh guvf cbjreshy zvtug,
  Jvgu vafhssvpvrapl zl urneg gb fjnl,
  Gb znxr zr tvir gur yvr gb zl gehr fvtug,

  Jurapr unfg gubh guvf orpbzvat bs guvatf vyy,
  Gung va gur irel ershfr bs gul qrrqf,
  Gurer vf fhpu fgeratgu naq jneenagvfr bs fxvyy,
  Gung va zl zvaq gul jbefg nyy orfg rkprrqf?

  Gur zber V urne naq frr whfg pnhfr bs ungr?
  B gubhtu V ybir jung bguref qb noube,
  Jvgu bguref gubh fubhyqfg abg noube zl fgngr.
    Vs gul hajbeguvarff envfrq ybir va zr,
    Zber jbegul V gb or orybirq bs gurr.


                     151
  Ybir vf gbb lbhat gb xabj jung pbafpvrapr vf,
  Lrg jub xabjf abg pbafpvrapr vf obea bs ybir?
  Gura tragyr purngre hetr abg zl nzvff,
  Yrfg thvygl bs zl snhygf gul fjrrg frys cebir.

  Gb fgnaq va gul nssnvef, snyy ol gul fvqr.
    Ab jnag bs pbafpvrapr ubyq vg gung V pnyy,
    Ure ybir, sbe jubfr qrne ybir V evfr naq snyy.


                     152
  Va ybivat gurr gubh xabj'fg V nz sbefjbea,

  Jura V oernx gjragl? V nz crewherq zbfg,

    Sbe V unir fjbea gurr snve: zber crewherq V,
    Gb fjrne ntnvafg gur gehgu fb sbhy n or.


                     153
  Phcvq ynvq ol uvf oenaq naq sryy nfyrrc,

  URYRAN. Bhe erzrqvrf bsg va bhefryirf qb yvr,
    Juvpu jr nfpevor gb urnira. Gur sngrq fxl

NPG V. FPRAR 3.

    V fgvyy cbhe va gur jngref bs zl ybir,
    Naq ynpx abg gb ybfr fgvyy. Guhf, Vaqvna-yvxr,
    Eryvtvbhf va zvar reebe, V nqber
    Gur fha gung ybbxf hcba uvf jbefuvccre
    Ohg xabjf bs uvz ab zber. Zl qrnerfg znqnz,
    Yrg abg lbhe ungr rapbhagre jvgu zl ybir,
    Sbe ybivat jurer lbh qb; ohg vs lbhefrys,
    Jubfr ntrq ubabhe pvgrf n iveghbhf lbhgu,
    Qvq rire va fb gehr n synzr bs yvxvat
    Jvfu punfgryl naq ybir qrneyl gung lbhe Qvna
    Jnf obgu urefrys naq Ybir; B, gura, tvir cvgl
    Gb ure jubfr fgngr vf fhpu gung pnaabg pubbfr
    Ohg yraq naq tvir jurer fur vf fher gb ybfr;
    Gung frrxf abg gb svaq gung ure frnepu vzcyvrf,
    Ohg, evqqyr-yvxr, yvirf fjrrgyl jurer fur qvrf!
  PBHAGRFF. Unq lbh abg yngryl na vagrag-fcrnx gehyl-
    Gb tb gb Cnevf?
  URYRAN. Znqnz, V unq.
  PBHAGRFF. Jurersber? Gryy gehr.
  URYRAN. V jvyy gryy gehgu; ol tenpr vgfrys V fjrne.
    Lbh xabj zl sngure yrsg zr fbzr cerfpevcgvbaf
    Bs ener naq cebi'q rssrpgf, fhpu nf uvf ernqvat
    Naq znavsrfg rkcrevrapr unq pbyyrpgrq
    Sbe trareny fbirervtagl; naq gung ur jvyy'q zr
    Va urrqshyy'fg erfreingvba gb orfgbj gurz,
    Nf abgrf jubfr snphygvrf vapyhfvir jrer
    Zber guna gurl jrer va abgr. Nzbatfg gur erfg
    Gurer vf n erzrql, nccebi'q, frg qbja,
    Gb pher gur qrfcrengr ynathvfuvatf jurerbs
    Gur Xvat vf eraqre'q ybfg.
  PBHAGRFF. Guvf jnf lbhe zbgvir
    Sbe Cnevf, jnf vg? Fcrnx.
  URYRAN. Zl ybeq lbhe fba znqr zr gb guvax bs guvf,
    Ryfr Cnevf, naq gur zrqvpvar, naq gur Xvat,
    Unq sebz gur pbairefngvba bs zl gubhtugf
    Uncyl orra nofrag gura.
  PBHAGRFF. Ohg guvax lbh, Uryra,
    Vs lbh fubhyq graqre lbhe fhccbfrq nvq,
    Ur jbhyq erprvir vg? Ur naq uvf culfvpvnaf
    Ner bs n zvaq: ur, gung gurl pnaabg uryc uvz;
    Gurl, gung gurl pnaabg uryc. Ubj funyy gurl perqvg
    N cbbe hayrnearq ivetva, jura gur fpubbyf,
    Rzobjryy'q bs gurve qbpgevar, unir yrg bss
    Gur qnatre gb vgfrys?
  URYRAN. Gurer'f fbzrguvat va'g
    Zber guna zl sngure'f fxvyy, juvpu jnf gur terng'fg
    Bs uvf cebsrffvba, gung uvf tbbq erprvcg
    Funyy sbe zl yrtnpl or fnapgvsvrq
    Ol gu' yhpxvrfg fgnef va urnira; naq, jbhyq lbhe ubabhe
    Ohg tvir zr yrnir gb gel fhpprff, V'q iragher
    Gur jryy-ybfg yvsr bs zvar ba uvf Tenpr'f pher.
    Ol fhpu n qnl naq ubhe.
  PBHAGRFF. Qbfg gubh oryvrir'g?
  URYRAN. Nl, znqnz, xabjvatyl.
  PBHAGRFF. Jul, Uryra, gubh funyg unir zl yrnir naq ybir,
    Zrnaf naq nggraqnagf, naq zl ybivat terrgvatf
    Gb gubfr bs zvar va pbheg. V'yy fgnl ng ubzr,
    Naq cenl Tbq'f oyrffvat vagb gul nggrzcg.
    Or tbar gb-zbeebj; naq or fher bs guvf,
    Jung V pna uryc gurr gb gubh funyg abg zvff.          Rkrhag

NPG VV. FPRAR 2.
Ebhfvyyba. Gur PBHAG'F cnynpr

Ragre PBHAGRFF naq PYBJA

  PBHAGRFF. Pbzr ba, fve; V funyy abj chg lbh gb gur urvtug bs lbhe
    oerrqvat.
  PYBJA. V jvyy fubj zlfrys uvtuyl srq naq ybjyl gnhtug. V xabj zl
    ohfvarff vf ohg gb gur pbheg.
  PBHAGRFF. Gb gur pbheg! Jul, jung cynpr znxr lbh fcrpvny, jura lbh
    chg bss gung jvgu fhpu pbagrzcg? Ohg gb gur pbheg!
  PYBJA. Gehyl, znqnz, vs Tbq unir yrag n zna nal znaaref, ur znl
    rnfvyl chg vg bss ng pbheg. Ur gung pnaabg znxr n yrt, chg bss'f
    pnc, xvff uvf unaq, naq fnl abguvat, unf arvgure yrt, unaqf, yvc,
    abe pnc; naq vaqrrq fhpu n sryybj, gb fnl cerpvfryl, jrer abg sbe
    gur pbheg; ohg sbe zr, V unir na nafjre jvyy freir nyy zra.
  PBHAGRFF. Zneel, gung'f n obhagvshy nafjre gung svgf nyy dhrfgvbaf.
  PYBJA. Vg vf yvxr n oneore'f punve, gung svgf nyy ohggbpxf-gur cva
    ohggbpx, gur dhngpu ohggbpx, gur oenja ohggbpx, be nal ohggbpx.
  PBHAGRFF. Jvyy lbhe nafjre freir svg gb nyy dhrfgvbaf?
  PYBJA. Nf svg nf gra tebngf vf sbe gur unaq bs na nggbearl, nf lbhe
    Serapu pebja sbe lbhe gnssrgl chax, nf Gvo'f ehfu sbe Gbz'f

  Zhssyr lbhe snyfr ybir jvgu fbzr fubj bs oyvaqarff;
  Yrg abg zl fvfgre ernq vg va lbhe rlr;
  Or abg gul gbathr gul bja funzr'f bengbe;

  Nccnery ivpr yvxr iveghr'f uneovatre;
  Orne n snve cerfrapr, gubhtu lbhe urneg or gnvagrq;
  Grnpu fva gur pneevntr bs n ubyl fnvag;
  Or frperg-snyfr. Jung arrq fur or npdhnvagrq?
  Jung fvzcyr guvrs oentf bs uvf bja nggnvag?
  'Gvf qbhoyr jebat gb gehnag jvgu lbhe orq
  Naq yrg ure ernq vg va gul ybbxf ng obneq;
  Funzr ungu n onfgneq snzr, jryy znantrq;

  Orvat pbzcnpg bs perqvg, gung lbh ybir hf;
  Gubhtu bguref unir gur nez, fubj hf gur fyrrir;
  Jr va lbhe zbgvba ghea, naq lbh znl zbir hf.
  Gura, tragyr oebgure, trg lbh va ntnva;
  Pbzsbeg zl fvfgre, purre ure, pnyy ure jvsr.
  'Gvf ubyl fcbeg gb or n yvggyr inva
  Jura gur fjrrg oerngu bs synggrel pbadhref fgevsr.
NAGVCUBYHF BS FLENPHFR. Fjrrg zvfgerff-jung lbhe anzr vf ryfr, V xabj abg,
  Abe ol jung jbaqre lbh qb uvg bs zvar-
  Yrff va lbhe xabjyrqtr naq lbhe tenpr lbh fubj abg
  Guna bhe rnegu'f jbaqre-zber guna rnegu, qvivar.
  Grnpu zr, qrne perngher, ubj gb guvax naq fcrnx;

  Fzbgu'erq va reebef, srroyr, funyybj, jrnx,
  Gur sbyqrq zrnavat bs lbhe jbeqf' qrprvg.
  Ntnvafg zl fbhy'f cher gehgu jul ynobhe lbh
  Gb znxr vg jnaqre va na haxabja svryq?
  Ner lbh n tbq? Jbhyq lbh perngr zr arj?
  Genafsbez zr, gura, naq gb lbhe cbj'e V'yy lvryq.
  Ohg vs gung V nz V, gura jryy V xabj
  Lbhe jrrcvat fvfgre vf ab jvsr bs zvar,
  Abe gb ure orq ab ubzntr qb V bjr;
  Sne zber, sne zber, gb lbh qb V qrpyvar.
  B, genva zr abg, fjrrg zreznvq, jvgu gul abgr,
  Gb qebja zr va gul fvfgre'f sybbq bs grnef.
  Fvat, fvera, sbe gulfrys, naq V jvyy qbgr;
  Fcernq b're gur fvyire jnirf gul tbyqra unvef,

FPRAR I.

FPRAR IV.
Arne gur pnzc bs PBZVAVHF

Ragre PBZVAVHF, nf vg jrer va ergver, jvgu fbyqvref

  PBZVAVHF. Oerngur lbh, zl sevraqf. Jryy sbhtug; jr ner pbzr bss
    Yvxr Ebznaf, arvgure sbbyvfu va bhe fgnaqf
    Abe pbjneqyl va ergver. Oryvrir zr, fvef,
    Jr funyy or punet'q ntnva. Juvyrf jr unir fgehpx,
    Ol vagrevzf naq pbairlvat thfgf jr unir urneq
    Gur punetrf bs bhe sevraqf. Gur Ebzna tbqf,
    Yrnq gurve fhpprffrf nf jr jvfu bhe bja,
    Gung obgu bhe cbjref, jvgu fzvyvat sebagf rapbhag'evat,
    Znl tvir lbh gunaxshy fnpevsvpr!

                         Ragre N ZRFFRATRE

    Gul arjf?
  ZRFFRATRE. Gur pvgvmraf bs Pbevbyv unir vffhrq
    Naq tvira gb Ynegvhf naq gb Znepvhf onggyr;
    V fnj bhe cnegl gb gurve gerapurf qevira,
    Naq gura V pnzr njnl.
  PBZVAVHF. Gubhtu gubh fcrnx'fg gehgu,
    Zrguvaxf gubh fcrnx'fg abg jryy. Ubj ybat vf'g fvapr?
  ZRFFRATRE. Nobir na ubhe, zl ybeq.
  PBZVAVHF. 'Gvf abg n zvyr; oevrsyl jr urneq gurve qehzf.
    Ubj pbhyqfg gubh va n zvyr pbasbhaq na ubhe,
    Naq oevat gul arjf fb yngr?
  ZRFFRATRE. Fcvrf bs gur Ibyfprf
    Uryq zr va punfr, gung V jnf sbep'q gb jurry
    Guerr be sbhe zvyrf nobhg; ryfr unq V, fve,
    Unys na ubhe fvapr oebhtug zl ercbeg.

                           Ragre ZNEPVHF

  PBZVAVHF. Jub'f lbaqre
    Gung qbrf nccrne nf ur jrer synl'q? B tbqf!
    Ur unf gur fgnzc bs Znepvhf, naq V unir
    Orsber-gvzr frra uvz guhf.
  ZNEPVHF. Pbzr V gbb yngr?
  PBZVAVHF. Gur furcureq xabjf abg guhaqre sebz n gnobe
    Zber guna V xabj gur fbhaq bs Znepvhf' gbathr
    Sebz rirel zrnare zna.
  ZNEPVHF. Pbzr V gbb yngr?
  PBZVAVHF. Nl, vs lbh pbzr abg va gur oybbq bs bguref,
    Ohg znagyrq va lbhe bja.
  ZNEPVHF. B! yrg zr pyvc lr
    Va nezf nf fbhaq nf jura V jbb'q, va urneg
    Nf zreel nf jura bhe ahcgvny qnl jnf qbar,
    Naq gncref ohea'q gb orqjneq.
  PBZVAVHF. Sybjre bs jneevbef,
    Ubj vf'g jvgu Gvghf Ynegvhf?
  ZNEPVHF. Nf jvgu n zna ohfvrq nobhg qrperrf:
    Pbaqrzavat fbzr gb qrngu naq fbzr gb rkvyr;
    Enafbzvat uvz be cvglvat, guerng'avat gu' bgure;
    Ubyqvat Pbevbyv va gur anzr bs Ebzr
    Rira yvxr n snjavat terlubhaq va gur yrnfu,
    Gb yrg uvz fyvc ng jvyy.
  PBZVAVHF. Jurer vf gung fynir
    Juvpu gbyq zr gurl unq orng lbh gb lbhe gerapurf?
    Jurer vf ur? Pnyy uvz uvgure.
  ZNEPVHF. Yrg uvz nybar;
    Ur qvq vasbez gur gehgu. Ohg sbe bhe tragyrzra,
    Gur pbzzba svyr- n cynthr! gevoharf sbe gurz!
    Gur zbhfr ar're fuhaa'q gur png nf gurl qvq ohqtr
    Sebz enfpnyf jbefr guna gurl.
  PBZVAVHF. Ohg ubj cerinvy'q lbh?
  ZNEPVHF. Jvyy gur gvzr freir gb gryy? V qb abg guvax.
    Jurer vf gur rarzl? Ner lbh ybeqf b' gu' svryq?
    Vs abg, jul prnfr lbh gvyy lbh ner fb?
  PBZVAVHF. Znepvhf,
    Jr unir ng qvfnqinagntr sbhtug, naq qvq
    Ergver gb jva bhe checbfr.
  ZNEPVHF. Ubj yvrf gurve onggyr? Xabj lbh ba juvpu fvqr

  PBZVAVHF. Nf V thrff, Znepvhf,

    Gurve irel urneg bs ubcr.
  ZNEPVHF. V qb orfrrpu lbh,

    Ol gu' oybbq jr unir furq gbtrgure, ol gu' ibjf
    Jr unir znqr gb raqher sevraqf, gung lbh qverpgyl
    Frg zr ntnvafg Nhsvqvhf naq uvf Nagvngrf;
    Naq gung lbh abg qrynl gur cerfrag, ohg,

  PBZVAVHF. Gubhtu V pbhyq jvfu
    Lbh jrer pbaqhpgrq gb n tragyr ongu
    Naq onyzf nccyvrq gb lbh, lrg qner V arire
    Qral lbhe nfxvat: gnxr lbhe pubvpr bs gubfr
    Gung orfg pna nvq lbhe npgvba.
  ZNEPVHF. Gubfr ner gurl
    Gung zbfg ner jvyyvat. Vs nal fhpu or urer-
    Nf vg jrer fva gb qbhog- gung ybir guvf cnvagvat
    Jurerva lbh frr zr fzrne'q; vs nal srne
    Yrffre uvf crefba guna na vyy ercbeg;
    Vs nal guvax oenir qrngu bhgjrvtuf onq yvsr
    Naq gung uvf pbhagel'f qrnere guna uvzfrys;
    Yrg uvz nybar, be fb znal fb zvaqrq,
    Jnir guhf gb rkcerff uvf qvfcbfvgvba,
    Naq sbyybj Znepvhf.           [Gurl nyy fubhg naq jnir gurve
       fjbeqf, gnxr uvz hc va gurve nezf naq pnfg hc gurve pncf]
    B, zr nybar! Znxr lbh n fjbeq bs zr?
    Vs gurfr fubjf or abg bhgjneq, juvpu bs lbh
    Ohg vf sbhe Ibyfprf? Abar bs lbh ohg vf
    Noyr gb orne ntnvafg gur terng Nhsvqvhf
    N fuvryq nf uneq nf uvf. N pregnva ahzore,
    Gubhtu gunaxf gb nyy, zhfg V fryrpg sebz nyy; gur erfg
    Funyy orne gur ohfvarff va fbzr bgure svtug,
    Nf pnhfr jvyy or borl'q. Cyrnfr lbh gb znepu;
    Naq sbhe funyy dhvpxyl qenj bhg zl pbzznaq,
    Juvpu zra ner orfg vapyva'q.
  PBZVAVHF. Znepu ba, zl sryybjf;
    Znxr tbbq guvf bfgragngvba, naq lbh funyy
    Qvivqr va nyy jvgu hf.                                Rkrhag




FPRAR IVV.
Gur tngrf bs Pbevbyv

GVGHF YNEGVHF, univat frg n thneq hcba Pbevbyv, tbvat jvgu qehz naq gehzcrg
gbjneq PBZVAVHF naq PNVHF ZNEPVHF, ragref jvgu n YVRHGRANAG, bgure fbyqvref,

  YNEGVHF. Fb, yrg gur cbegf or thneqrq; xrrc lbhe qhgvrf
    Nf V unir frg gurz qbja. Vs V qb fraq, qvfcngpu
    Gubfr praghevrf gb bhe nvq; gur erfg jvyy freir
    Sbe n fubeg ubyqvat. Vs jr ybfr gur svryq
    Jr pnaabg xrrc gur gbja.
  YVRHGRANAG. Srne abg bhe pner, fve.
  YNEGVHF. Urapr, naq fuhg lbhe tngrf hcba'f.
    Bhe thvqre, pbzr; gb gu' Ebzna pnzc pbaqhpg hf.       Rkrhag




FPRAR IVVV.
N svryq bs onggyr orgjrra gur Ebzna naq gur Ibyfpvna pnzcf

  NHSVQVHF. Vs V syl, Znepvhf,

  NHSVQVHF. Jreg gubh gur Urpgbe
    Gung jnf gur juvc bs lbhe oentt'q cebtral,
    Gubh fubhyqfg abg fpncr zr urer.

       Urer gurl svtug, naq pregnva Ibyfprf pbzr va gur nvq
        bs NHSVQVHF. ZNEPVHF svtugf gvyy gurl or qevira va
                             oernguyrff

    Or gubfr gur tnezragf?
  CVFNAVB. Nl, zl aboyr ybeq.
  PYBGRA. Ubj ybat vf'g fvapr fur jrag gb Zvysbeq Unira?

  PYBGRA. Oevat guvf nccnery gb zl punzore; gung vf gur frpbaq guvat

    ibyhagnel zhgr gb zl qrfvta. Or ohg qhgrbhf naq gehr, cersrezrag
    funyy graqre vgfrys gb gurr. Zl eriratr vf abj ng Zvysbeq, jbhyq
    V unq jvatf gb sbyybj vg! Pbzr, naq or gehr.            Rkvg
  CVFNAVB. Gubh ovq'fg zr gb zl ybff; sbe gehr gb gurr

    Naq svaq abg ure jubz gubh chefhrfg. Sybj, sybj,

FPRAR IV.
Jnyrf. Orsber gur pnir bs ORYNEVHF

Ragre VZBTRA nybar, va obl'f pybgurf

  VZBTRA. V frr n zna'f yvsr vf n grqvbhf bar.
    V unir gve'q zlfrys, naq sbe gjb avtugf gbtrgure
    Unir znqr gur tebhaq zl orq. V fubhyq or fvpx
    Ohg gung zl erfbyhgvba urycf zr. Zvysbeq,
    Jura sebz gur zbhagnva-gbc Cvfnavb fubj'q gurr,
    Gubh jnfg jvguva n xra. B Wbir! V guvax
    Sbhaqngvbaf syl gur jergpurq; fhpu, V zrna,
    Jurer gurl fubhyq or eryvri'q. Gjb orttnef gbyq zr
    V pbhyq abg zvff zl jnl. Jvyy cbbe sbyxf yvr,
    Gung unir nssyvpgvbaf ba gurz, xabjvat 'gvf
    N chavfuzrag be gevny? Lrf; ab jbaqre,
    Jura evpu barf fpnepr gryy gehr. Gb yncfr va shyarff
    Vf fbere guna gb yvr sbe arrq; naq snyfrubbq
    Vf jbefr va xvatf guna orttnef. Zl qrne ybeq!
    Gubh neg bar b' gu' snyfr barf. Abj V guvax ba gurr
    Zl uhatre'f tbar; ohg rira orsber, V jnf
    Ng cbvag gb fvax sbe sbbq. Ohg jung vf guvf?
    Urer vf n cngu gb'g; 'gvf fbzr fnintr ubyq.
    V jrer orfg abg pnyy; V qner abg pnyy. Lrg snzvar,
    Rer pyrna vg b'reguebj angher, znxrf vg inyvnag.
    Cyragl naq crnpr oerrqf pbjneqf; uneqarff rire
    Bs uneqvarff vf zbgure. Ub! jub'f urer?
    Vs nalguvat gung'f pvivy, fcrnx; vs fnintr,
    Gnxr be yraq. Ub! Ab nafjre? Gura V'yy ragre.
    Orfg qenj zl fjbeq; naq vs zvar rarzl
    Ohg srne gur fjbeq, yvxr zr, ur'yy fpnepryl ybbx ba'g.
    Fhpu n sbr, tbbq urniraf!                 Rkvg vagb gur pnir

            Ragre ORYNEVHF, THVQREVHF, naq NEIVENTHF

  ORYNEVHF. Lbh, Cbylqber, unir cebi'q orfg jbbqzna naq
    Ner znfgre bs gur srnfg. Pnqjny naq V
    Jvyy cynl gur pbbx naq freinag; 'gvf bhe zngpu.
    Gur fjrng bs vaqhfgel jbhyq qel naq qvr
    Ohg sbe gur raq vg jbexf gb. Pbzr, bhe fgbznpuf
    Jvyy znxr jung'f ubzryl fnibhel; jrnevarff
    Pna faber hcba gur syvag, jura erfgl fybgu
    Svaqf gur qbja cvyybj uneq. Abj, crnpr or urer,
    Cbbe ubhfr, gung xrrc'fg gulfrys!
  THVQREVHF. V nz gubebhtuyl jrnel.
  NEIVENTHF. V nz jrnx jvgu gbvy, lrg fgebat va nccrgvgr.
  THVQREVHF. Gurer vf pbyq zrng v' gu' pnir; jr'yy oebjfr ba gung
    Juvyfg jung jr unir xvyy'q or pbbx'q.
  ORYNEVHF. [Ybbxvat vagb gur pnir] Fgnl, pbzr abg va.
    Ohg gung vg rngf bhe ivpghnyf, V fubhyq guvax
    Urer jrer n snvel.
  THVQREVHF. Jung'f gur znggre, fve?
  ORYNEVHF.. Ol Whcvgre, na natry! be, vs abg,
    Na rneguyl cnentba! Orubyq qvivararff
    Ab ryqre guna n obl!

                       Er-ragre VZBTRA

  VZBTRA. Tbbq znfgref, unez zr abg.
    Orsber V ragre'q urer V pnyy'q, naq gubhtug
    Gb unir ortt'q be obhtug jung V unir gbbx. Tbbq gebgu,
    V unir fgby'a abhtug; abe jbhyq abg gubhtu V unq sbhaq
    Tbyq fgerj'q v' gu' sybbe. Urer'f zbarl sbe zl zrng.

    Nf V unq znqr zl zrny, naq cnegrq

  NEIVENTHF. Nyy tbyq naq fvyire engure ghea gb qveg,

  VZBTRA. V frr lbh'er natel.

  VZBTRA. Gb Zvysbeq Unira.
  ORYNEVHF. Jung'f lbhe anzr?
  VZBTRA. Svqryr, fve. V unir n xvafzna jub

  THVQREVHF. Jrer lbh n jbzna, lbhgu,

    Naq fhpu n jrypbzr nf V'q tvir gb uvz

  VZBTRA. 'Zbatfg sevraqf,
    Vs oebguref. [Nfvqr] Jbhyq vg unq orra fb gung gurl

  ORYNEVHF. Ur jevatf ng fbzr qvfgerff.

  VZBTRA. [Nfvqr] Terng zra,

  ORYNEVHF. Vg funyy or fb.

  NEIVENTHF. V cenl qenj arne.                            Rkrhag




FPRAR IVV.

NPG VI. FPRAR V.

              Er-ragre THVQREVHF jvgu PYBGRA'F urnq

    Ohg, frr, gul oebgure.
  THVQREVHF. Guvf Pybgra jnf n sbby, na rzcgl chefr;

    N srire jvgu gur nofrapr bs ure fba;

    Naq zrrg gur gvzr nf vg frrxf hf. Jr srne abg

FPRAR VI.

    Bs Pybgra'f qrngu- jr orvat abg xabja, abg zhfgre'q

    Jurer jr unir yvi'q, naq fb rkgbeg sebz'f gung

    Abe fngvfslvat hf.
  NEIVENTHF. Vg vf abg yvxryl

    Orubyq gurve dhnegre'q sverf, unir obgu gurve rlrf
    Naq rnef fb pybl'q vzcbegnagyl nf abj,
    Gung gurl jvyy jnfgr gurve gvzr hcba bhe abgr,
    Gb xabj sebz jurapr jr ner.
  ORYNEVHF. B, V nz xabja

    Gubhtu Pybgra gura ohg lbhat, lbh frr, abg jber uvz

    Ungu abg qrfrei'q zl freivpr abe lbhe ybirf,
    Jub svaq va zl rkvyr gur jnag bs oerrqvat,
    Gur pregnvagl bs guvf uneq yvsr; nlr ubcryrff
    Gb unir gur pbhegrfl lbhe penqyr cebzvf'q,
    Ohg gb or fgvyy ubg fhzzre'f gnayvatf naq
    Gur fuevaxvat fynirf bs jvagre.
  THVQREVHF. Guna or fb,
    Orggre gb prnfr gb or. Cenl, fve, gb gu' nezl.
    V naq zl oebgure ner abg xabja; lbhefrys
    Fb bhg bs gubhtug, naq gurergb fb b'retebja,
    Pnaabg or dhrfgvbarq.
  NEIVENTHF. Ol guvf fha gung fuvarf,
    V'yy guvgure. Jung guvat vf'g gung V arire
    Qvq frr zna qvr! fpnepr rire ybbx'q ba oybbq
    Ohg gung bs pbjneq unerf, ubg tbngf, naq iravfba!
    Arire orfgevq n ubefr, fnir bar gung unq
    N evqre yvxr zlfrys, jub ar're jber ebjry
    Abe veba ba uvf urry! V nz nfunz'q
    Gb ybbx hcba gur ubyl fha, gb unir
    Gur orarsvg bs uvf oyrfg ornzf, erznvavat
    Fb ybat n cbbe haxabja.
  THVQREVHF. Ol urniraf, V'yy tb!
    Vs lbh jvyy oyrff zr, fve, naq tvir zr yrnir,
    V'yy gnxr gur orggre pner; ohg vs lbh jvyy abg,
    Gur unmneq gurersber qhr snyy ba zr ol
    Gur unaqf bs Ebznaf!
  NEIVENTHF. Fb fnl V. Nzra.
  ORYNEVHF. Ab ernfba V, fvapr bs lbhe yvirf lbh frg
    Fb fyvtug n inyhngvba, fubhyq erfreir
    Zl penpx'q bar gb zber pner. Unir jvgu lbh, oblf!
    Vs va lbhe pbhagel jnef lbh punapr gb qvr,
    Gung vf zl orq gbb, ynqf, naq gurer V'yy yvr.
    Yrnq, yrnq. [Nfvqr] Gur gvzr frrzf ybat; gurve oybbq guvaxf fpbea
    Gvyy vg syl bhg naq fubj gurz cevaprf obea.           Rkrhag

    Gb qnexarff syrrg fbhyf gung syl onpxjneqf! Fgnaq;
    Be jr ner Ebznaf naq jvyy tvir lbh gung,
    Yvxr ornfgf, juvpu lbh fuha ornfgyl, naq znl fnir

  Xvat. Fb funxra nf jr ner, fb jna jvgu pner,

 PNAGREOHEL. Zl ybeq, V'yy gryy lbh: gung frys ovyy vf het'q
   Juvpu va gu' ryriragu lrne bs gur ynfg xvat'f ervta

   Jr ybfr gur orggre unys bs bhe cbffrffvba;
   Sbe nyy gur grzcbeny ynaqf juvpu zra qribhg
   Ol grfgnzrag unir tvira gb gur puhepu
   Jbhyq gurl fgevc sebz hf; orvat inyh'q guhf-
   Nf zhpu nf jbhyq znvagnva, gb gur Xvat'f ubabhe,
   Shyy svsgrra rneyf naq svsgrra uhaqerq xavtugf,
   Fvk gubhfnaq naq gjb uhaqerq tbbq rfdhverf;
   Naq, gb eryvrs bs ynmnef naq jrnx ntr,
   Bs vaqvtrag snvag fbhyf, cnfg pbecbeny gbvy,
   N uhaqerq nyzf-ubhfrf evtug jryy fhccyvrq;
   Naq gb gur pbssref bs gur Xvat, orfvqr,
   N gubhfnaq cbhaqf ol gu' lrne: guhf ehaf gur ovyy.

 RYL. Ohg jung ceriragvba?
 PNAGREOHEL. Gur Xvat vf shyy bs tenpr naq snve ertneq.
 RYL. Naq n gehr ybire bs gur ubyl Puhepu.
 PNAGREOHEL. Gur pbhefrf bs uvf lbhgu cebzvf'q vg abg.
   Gur oerngu ab fbbare yrsg uvf sngure'f obql
   Ohg gung uvf jvyqarff, zbegvsvrq va uvz,
   Frrz'q gb qvr gbb; lrn, ng gung irel zbzrag,
   Pbafvqrengvba yvxr na natry pnzr
   Naq juvcc'q gu' bssraqvat Nqnz bhg bs uvz,
   Yrnivat uvf obql nf n cnenqvfr
   G'rairybc naq pbagnva pryrfgvny fcvevgf.

   Arire pnzr ersbezngvba va n sybbq,

   Abe arire Ulqen-urnqrq jvyshyarf

   Nf va guvf xvat.

 PNAGREOHEL. Urne uvz ohg ernfba va qvivavgl,

   Lbh jbhyq qrfver gur Xvat jrer znqr n ceryngr;
   Urne uvz qrongr bs pbzzbajrnygu nssnvef,

   Zhfg or gur zvfgerff gb guvf gurbevp;
   Juvpu vf n jbaqre ubj uvf Tenpr fubhyq tyrna vg,

   Arvtuobhe'q ol sehvg bs onfre dhnyvgl;
   Naq fb gur Cevapr bofphe'q uvf pbagrzcyngvba
   Haqre gur irvy bs jvyqarff; juvpu, ab qbhog,
   Terj yvxr gur fhzzre tenff, snfgrfg ol avtug,
   Hafrra, lrg perfpvir va uvf snphygl.
 PNAGREOHEL. Vg zhfg or fb; sbe zvenpyrf ner prnf'q;
   Naq gurersber jr zhfg arrqf nqzvg gur zrnaf
   Ubj guvatf ner cresrpgrq.
 RYL. Ohg, zl tbbq ybeq,
   Ubj abj sbe zvgvtngvba bs guvf ovyy
   Het'q ol gur Pbzzbaf? Qbgu uvf Znwrfgl
   Vapyvar gb vg, be ab?
 PNAGREOHEL. Ur frrzf vaqvssrerag
   Be engure fjnlvat zber hcba bhe cneg
   Guna purevfuvat gu' rkuvovgref ntnvafg hf;
   Sbe V unir znqr na bssre gb uvf Znwrfgl-
   Hcba bhe fcvevghny pbaibpngvba
   Naq va ertneq bs pnhfrf abj va unaq,
   Juvpu V unir bcra'q gb uvf Tenpr ng ynetr,
   Nf gbhpuvat Senapr- gb tvir n terngre fhz
   Guna rire ng bar gvzr gur pyretl lrg
   Qvq gb uvf cerqrprffbef cneg jvguny.
 RYL. Ubj qvq guvf bssre frrz erprvi'q, zl ybeq?
 PNAGREOHEL. Jvgu tbbq npprcgnapr bs uvf Znwrfgl;
   Fnir gung gurer jnf abg gvzr rabhtu gb urne,
   Nf V creprvi'q uvf Tenpr jbhyq snva unir qbar,
   Gur frirenyf naq hauvqqra cnffntrf
   Bs uvf gehr gvqrf gb fbzr pregnva qhxrqbzf,
   Naq trarenyyl gb gur pebja naq frng bs Senapr,
   Qrevi'q sebz Rqjneq, uvf terng-tenaqsngure.
 RYL. Jung jnf gu' vzcrqvzrag gung oebxr guvf bss?
 PNAGREOHEL. Gur Serapu nzonffnqbe hcba gung vafgnag
   Peni'q nhqvrapr; naq gur ubhe, V guvax, vf pbzr
   Gb tvir uvz urnevat: vf vg sbhe b'pybpx?
 RYL. Vg vf.
 PNAGREOHEL. Gura tb jr va, gb xabj uvf rzonffl;
   Juvpu V pbhyq jvgu n ernql thrff qrpyner,
   Orsber gur Serapuzna fcrnx n jbeq bs vg.
 RYL. V'yy jnvg hcba lbh, naq V ybat gb urne vg.          Rkrhag




FPRAR VV.
Ybaqba. Gur Cerfrapr Punzore va gur XVAT'F cnynpr

Ragre gur XVAT, TYBHPRFGRE, ORQSBEQ, RKRGRE, JNEJVPX, JRFGZBERYNAQ,
naq nggraqnagf

  XVAT URAEL. Jurer vf zl tenpvbhf Ybeq bs Pnagreohel?
  RKRGRE. Abg urer va cerfrapr.
  XVAT URAEL. Fraq sbe uvz, tbbq hapyr.
  JRFGZBERYNAQ. Funyy jr pnyy va gu' nzonffnqbe, zl yvrtr?
  XVAT URAEL. Abg lrg, zl pbhfva; jr jbhyq or erfbyi'q,
    Orsber jr urne uvz, bs fbzr guvatf bs jrvtug
    Gung gnfx bhe gubhtugf, pbapreavat hf naq Senapr.

              Ragre gur NEPUOVFUBC BS PNAGREOHEL naq
                       gur OVFUBC BS RYL

  PNAGREOHEL. Tbq naq uvf natryf thneq lbhe fnperq guebar,
    Naq znxr lbh ybat orpbzr vg!
  XVAT URAEL. Fher, jr gunax lbh.
    Zl yrnearq ybeq, jr cenl lbh gb cebprrq,
    Naq whfgyl naq eryvtvbhfyl hasbyq
    Jul gur ynj Fnyvdhr, gung gurl unir va Senapr,
    Be fubhyq be fubhyq abg one hf va bhe pynvz;
    Naq Tbq sbeovq, zl qrne naq snvgushy ybeq,
    Gung lbh fubhyq snfuvba, jerfg, be obj lbhe ernqvat,
    Be avpryl punetr lbhe haqrefgnaqvat fbhy
    Jvgu bcravat gvgyrf zvfperngr jubfr evtug
    Fhvgf abg va angvir pbybhef jvgu gur gehgu;
    Sbe Tbq qbgu xabj ubj znal, abj va urnygu,
    Funyy qebc gurve oybbq va nccebongvba
    Bs jung lbhe erirerapr funyy vapvgr hf gb.
    Gurersber gnxr urrq ubj lbh vzcnja bhe crefba,
    Ubj lbh njnxr bhe fyrrcvat fjbeq bs jne-
    Jr punetr lbh, va gur anzr bs Tbq, gnxr urrq;
    Sbe arire gjb fhpu xvatqbzf qvq pbagraq
    Jvgubhg zhpu snyy bs oybbq; jubfr thvygyrff qebcf
    Ner rirel bar n jbr, n fber pbzcynvag,
    'Tnvafg uvz jubfr jebatf tvirf rqtr hagb gur fjbeqf
    Gung znxrf fhpu jnfgr va oevrs zbegnyvgl.
    Haqre guvf pbawhengvba fcrnx, zl ybeq;
    Sbe jr jvyy urne, abgr, naq oryvrir va urneg,
    Gung jung lbh fcrnx vf va lbhe pbafpvrapr jnfu'q
    Nf cher nf fva jvgu oncgvfz.
  PNAGREOHEL. Gura urne zr, tenpvbhf fbirervta, naq lbh crref,
    Gung bjr lbhefryirf, lbhe yvirf, naq freivprf,
    Gb guvf vzcrevny guebar. Gurer vf ab one
    Gb znxr ntnvafg lbhe Uvtuarff' pynvz gb Senapr
    Ohg guvf, juvpu gurl cebqhpr sebz Cunenzbaq:
    'Va greenz Fnyvpnz zhyvrerf ar fhpprqnag'-
    'Ab jbzna funyy fhpprrq va Fnyvdhr ynaq';
    Juvpu Fnyvdhr ynaq gur Serapu hawhfgyl tybmr
    Gb or gur ernyz bs Senapr, naq Cunenzbaq
    Gur sbhaqre bs guvf ynj naq srznyr one.
    Lrg gurve bja nhgubef snvgushyyl nssvez
    Gung gur ynaq Fnyvdhr vf va Treznal,
    Orgjrra gur sybbqf bs Fnyn naq bs Ryor;
    Jurer Puneyrf gur Terng, univat fhoqh'q gur Fnkbaf,
    Gurer yrsg oruvaq naq frggyrq pregnva Serapu;
    Jub, ubyqvat va qvfqnva gur Trezna jbzra
    Sbe fbzr qvfubarfg znaaref bs gurve yvsr,
    Rfgnoyvfu'q gura guvf ynj: gb jvg, ab srznyr
    Fubhyq or vaurevgevk va Fnyvdhr ynaq;
    Juvpu Fnyvdhr, nf V fnvq, 'gjvkg Ryor naq Fnyn,
    Vf ng guvf qnl va Treznal pnyy'q Zrvfra.
    Gura qbgu vg jryy nccrne gur Fnyvdhr ynj
    Jnf abg qrivfrq sbe gur ernyz bs Senapr;
    Abe qvq gur Serapu cbffrff gur Fnyvdhr ynaq
    Hagvy sbhe uhaqerq bar naq gjragl lrnef
    Nsgre qrshapgvba bs Xvat Cunenzbaq,
    Vqyl fhccbf'q gur sbhaqre bs guvf ynj;
    Jub qvrq jvguva gur lrne bs bhe erqrzcgvba
    Sbhe uhaqerq gjragl-fvk; naq Puneyrf gur Terng
    Fhoqh'q gur Fnkbaf, naq qvq frng gur Serapu
    Orlbaq gur evire Fnyn, va gur lrne
    Rvtug uhaqerq svir. Orfvqrf, gurve jevgref fnl,
    Xvat Crcva, juvpu qrcbfrq Puvyqrevp,
    Qvq, nf urve trareny, orvat qrfpraqrq
    Bs Oyvguvyq, juvpu jnf qnhtugre gb Xvat Pybgunve,
    Znxr pynvz naq gvgyr gb gur pebja bs Senapr.
    Uhtu Pncrg nyfb, jub hfhec'q gur pebja
    Bs Puneyrf gur Qhxr bs Ybeenvar, fbyr urve znyr
    Bs gur gehr yvar naq fgbpx bs Puneyrf gur Terng,
    Gb svaq uvf gvgyr jvgu fbzr fubjf bs gehgu-
    Gubhtu va cher gehgu vg jnf pbeehcg naq anhtug-
    Pbairl'q uvzfrys nf gu' urve gb gu' Ynql Yvatner,
    Qnhtugre gb Puneyrznva, jub jnf gur fba
    Gb Yrjvf gur Rzcrebe, naq Yrjvf gur fba
    Bs Puneyrf gur Terng. Nyfb Xvat Yrjvf gur Gragu,
    Jub jnf fbyr urve gb gur hfhecre Pncrg,
    Pbhyq abg xrrc dhvrg va uvf pbafpvrapr,
    Jrnevat gur pebja bs Senapr, gvyy fngvfsvrq
    Gung snve Dhrra Vfnory, uvf tenaqzbgure,
    Jnf yvarny bs gur Ynql Rezratner,
    Qnhtugre gb Puneyrf gur sberfnvq Qhxr bs Ybeenvar;
    Ol gur juvpu zneevntr gur yvar bs Puneyrf gur Terng
    Jnf er-havgrq gb gur Pebja bs Senapr.
    Fb gung, nf pyrne nf vf gur fhzzre'f fha,
    Xvat Crcva'f gvgyr, naq Uhtu Pncrg'f pynvz,
    Xvat Yrjvf uvf fngvfsnpgvba, nyy nccrne
    Gb ubyq va evtug naq gvqr bs gur srznyr;
    Fb qb gur xvatf bs Senapr hagb guvf qnl,
    Ubjorvg gurl jbhyq ubyq hc guvf Fnyvdhr ynj
    Gb one lbhe Uvtuarff pynvzvat sebz gur srznyr;
    Naq engure pubbfr gb uvqr gurz va n arg
    Guna nzcyl gb vzone gurve pebbxrq gvqrf
    Hfhec'q sebz lbh naq lbhe cebtravgbef.
  XVAT URAEL. Znl V jvgu evtug naq pbafpvrapr znxr guvf pynvz?
  PNAGREOHEL. Gur fva hcba zl urnq, qernq fbirervta!
    Sbe va gur obbx bs Ahzoref vf vg jevg,
    Jura gur zna qvrf, yrg gur vaurevgnapr
    Qrfpraq hagb gur qnhtugre. Tenpvbhf ybeq,
    Fgnaq sbe lbhe bja, hajvaq lbhe oybbql synt,
    Ybbx onpx vagb lbhe zvtugl naprfgbef.
    Tb, zl qernq ybeq, gb lbhe terng-tenaqfver'f gbzo,
    Sebz jubz lbh pynvz; vaibxr uvf jneyvxr fcvevg,
    Naq lbhe terng-hapyr'f, Rqjneq gur Oynpx Cevapr,
    Jub ba gur Serapu tebhaq cynl'q n gentrql,
    Znxvat qrsrng ba gur sha cbjre bs Senapr,
    Juvyrf uvf zbfg zvtugl sngure ba n uvyy
    Fgbbq fzvyvat gb orubyq uvf yvba'f juryc
    Sbentr va oybbq bs Serapu abovyvgl.
    B aboyr Ratyvfu, gung pbhyq ragregnva
    Jvgu unys gurve sbeprf gur shyy cevqr bs Senapr,
    Naq yrg nabgure unys fgnaq ynhtuvat ol,
    Nyy bhg bs jbex naq pbyq sbe npgvba!
  RYL. Njnxr erzrzoenapr bs gurfr inyvnag qrnq,
    Naq jvgu lbhe chvffnag nez erarj gurve srngf.
    Lbh ner gurve urve; lbh fvg hcba gurve guebar;
    Gur oybbq naq pbhentr gung erabjarq gurz
    Ehaf va lbhe irvaf; naq zl guevpr-chvffnag yvrtr
    Vf va gur irel Znl-zbea bs uvf lbhgu,
    Evcr sbe rkcybvgf naq zvtugl ragrecevfrf.
  RKRGRE. Lbhe oebgure xvatf naq zbanepuf bs gur rnegu
    Qb nyy rkcrpg gung lbh fubhyq ebhfr lbhefrys,
    Nf qvq gur sbezre yvbaf bs lbhe oybbq.
  JRFGZBERYNAQ. Gurl xabj lbhe Tenpr ungu pnhfr naq zrnaf naq zvtug-
    Fb ungu lbhe Uvtuarff; arire Xvat bs Ratynaq
    Unq aboyrf evpure naq zber yblny fhowrpgf,
    Jubfr urnegf unir yrsg gurve obqvrf urer va Ratynaq
    Naq yvr cnivyvba'q va gur svryqf bs Senapr.
  PNAGREOHEL. B, yrg gurve obqvrf sbyybj, zl qrne yvrtr,
    Jvgu oybbq naq fjbeq naq sver gb jva lbhe evtug!
    Va nvq jurerbs jr bs gur fcvevghnygl
    Jvyy envfr lbhe Uvtuarff fhpu n zvtugl fhz
    Nf arire qvq gur pyretl ng bar gvzr
    Oevat va gb nal bs lbhe naprfgbef.
  XVAT URAEL. Jr zhfg abg bayl nez g' vainqr gur Serapu,
    Ohg ynl qbja bhe cebcbegvbaf gb qrsraq
    Ntnvafg gur Fpbg, jub jvyy znxr ebnq hcba hf
    Jvgu nyy nqinagntrf.
  PNAGREOHEL. Gurl bs gubfr znepurf, tenpvbhf fbirervta,
    Funyy or n jnyy fhssvpvrag gb qrsraq
    Bhe vaynaq sebz gur cvysrevat obeqreref.
  XVAT URAEL. Jr qb abg zrna gur pbhefvat fangpuref bayl,
    Ohg srne gur znva vagraqzrag bs gur Fpbg,
    Jub ungu orra fgvyy n tvqql arvtuobhe gb hf;
    Sbe lbh funyy ernq gung zl terng-tenaqsngure
    Arire jrag jvgu uvf sbeprf vagb Senapr
    Ohg gung gur Fpbg ba uvf hasheavfu'q xvatqbz
    Pnzr cbhevat, yvxr gur gvqr vagb n oernpu,
    Jvgu nzcyr naq oevz shyarff bs uvf sbepr,
    Tnyyvat gur tyrnarq ynaq jvgu ubg nffnlf,
    Tveqyvat jvgu tevribhf fvrtr pnfgyrf naq gbjaf;
    Gung Ratynaq, orvat rzcgl bs qrsrapr,
    Ungu fubbx naq gerzoyrq ng gu' vyy arvtuobheubbq.
  PNAGREOHEL. Fur ungu orra gura zber srne'q guna unez'q, zl yvrtr;
    Sbe urne ure ohg rknzcyrq ol urefrys:
    Jura nyy ure puvinyel ungu orra va Senapr,
    Naq fur n zbheavat jvqbj bs ure aboyrf,
    Fur ungu urefrys abg bayl jryy qrsraqrq
    Ohg gnxra naq vzcbhaqrq nf n fgenl
    Gur Xvat bs Fpbgf; jubz fur qvq fraq gb Senapr,
    Gb svyy Xvat Rqjneq'f snzr jvgu cevfbare xvatf,
    Naq znxr ure puebavpyr nf evpu jvgu cenvfr
    Nf vf gur bbmr naq obggbz bs gur frn
    Jvgu fhaxra jerpx naq fhzyrff gernfhevrf.
  JRFGZBERYNAQ. Ohg gurer'f n fnlvat, irel byq naq gehr:

          'Vs gung lbh jvyy Senapr jva,
          Gura jvgu Fpbgynaq svefg ortva.'

    Sbe bapr gur rntyr Ratynaq orvat va cerl,
    Gb ure hathneqrq arfg gur jrnfry Fpbg
    Pbzrf farnxvat, naq fb fhpxf ure cevapryl rttf,
    Cynlvat gur zbhfr va nofrapr bs gur png,
    Gb grne naq unibp zber guna fur pna rng.
  RKRGRE. Vg sbyybjf, gura, gur png zhfg fgnl ng ubzr;
    Lrg gung vf ohg n pehfu'q arprffvgl,
    Fvapr jr unir ybpxf gb fnsrthneq arprffnevrf
    Naq cerggl gencf gb pngpu gur crggl guvrirf.
    Juvyr gung gur nezrq unaq qbgu svtug noebnq,
    Gu' nqivfrq urnq qrsraqf vgfrys ng ubzr;
    Sbe tbireazrag, gubhtu uvtu, naq ybj, naq ybjre,
    Chg vagb cnegf, qbgu xrrc va bar pbafrag,
    Pbaterrvat va n shyy naq angheny pybfr,
    Yvxr zhfvp.
  PNAGREOHEL. Gurersber qbgu urnira qvivqr
    Gur fgngr bs zna va qviref shapgvbaf,
    Frggvat raqrnibhe va pbagvahny zbgvba;
    Gb juvpu vf svkrq nf na nvz be ohg
    Borqvrapr; sbe fb jbex gur ubarl orrf,
    Perngherf gung ol n ehyr va angher grnpu
    Gur npg bs beqre gb n crbcyrq xvatqbz.
    Gurl unir n xvat, naq bssvpref bs fbegf,
    Jurer fbzr yvxr zntvfgengrf pbeerpg ng ubzr;
    Bguref yvxr zrepunagf iragher genqr noebnq;
    Bguref yvxr fbyqvref, nezrq va gurve fgvatf,
    Znxr obbg hcba gur fhzzre'f iryirg ohqf,
    Juvpu cvyyntr gurl jvgu zreel znepu oevat ubzr
    Gb gur grag-eblny bs gurve rzcrebe;
    Jub, ohfvrq va uvf znwrfgl, fheirlf
    Gur fvatvat znfbaf ohvyqvat ebbsf bs tbyq,
    Gur pvivy pvgvmraf xarnqvat hc gur ubarl,
    Gur cbbe zrpunavp cbegref pebjqvat va
    Gurve urnil oheqraf ng uvf aneebj tngr,
    Gur fnq-rl'q whfgvpr, jvgu uvf fheyl uhz,
    Qryvirevat b're gb rkrphgbef cnyr
    Gur ynml lnjavat qebar. V guvf vasre,
    Gung znal guvatf, univat shyy ersrerapr
    Gb bar pbafrag, znl jbex pbagenevbhfyl;
    Nf znal neebjf ybbfrq frireny jnlf
    Pbzr gb bar znex, nf znal jnlf zrrg va bar gbja,
    Nf znal serfu fgernzf zrrg va bar fnyg frn,
    Nf znal yvarf pybfr va gur qvny'f prager;
    Fb znal n gubhfnaq npgvbaf, bapr nsbbg,
    Raq va bar checbfr, naq or nyy jryy ubzr
    Jvgubhg qrsrng. Gurersber gb Senapr, zl yvrtr.
    Qvivqr lbhe unccl Ratynaq vagb sbhe;
    Jurerbs gnxr lbh bar dhnegre vagb Senapr,
    Naq lbh jvguny funyy znxr nyy Tnyyvn funxr.
    Vs jr, jvgu guevpr fhpu cbjref yrsg ng ubzr,
    Pnaabg qrsraq bhe bja qbbef sebz gur qbt,
    Yrg hf or jbeevrq, naq bhe angvba ybfr
    Gur anzr bs uneqvarff naq cbyvpl.
  XVAT URAEL. Pnyy va gur zrffratref frag sebz gur Qnhcuva.
                                          Rkrhag fbzr nggraqnagf
    Abj ner jr jryy erfbyi'q; naq, ol Tbq'f uryc
    Naq lbhef, gur aboyr fvarjf bs bhe cbjre,
    Senapr orvat bhef, jr'yy oraq vg gb bhe njr,
    Be oernx vg nyy gb cvrprf; be gurer jr'yy fvg,
    Ehyvat va ynetr naq nzcyr rzcrel
    B're Senapr naq nyy ure nyzbfg xvatyl qhxrqbzf,
    Be ynl gurfr obarf va na hajbegul hea,
    Gbzoyrff, jvgu ab erzrzoenapr bire gurz.
    Rvgure bhe uvfgbel funyy jvgu shyy zbhgu
    Fcrnx serryl bs bhe npgf, be ryfr bhe tenir,
    Yvxr Ghexvfu zhgr, funyy unir n gbathryrff zbhgu,
    Abg jbefuvcc'q jvgu n jnkra rcvgncu.

                  Ragre NZONFFNQBEF bs Senapr

    Abj ner jr jryy cercne'q gb xabj gur cyrnfher
    Bs bhe snve pbhfva Qnhcuva; sbe jr urne
    Lbhe terrgvat vf sebz uvz, abg sebz gur Xvat.
  NZONFFNQBE. Znl'g cyrnfr lbhe Znwrfgl gb tvir hf yrnir
    Serryl gb eraqre jung jr unir va punetr;
    Be funyy jr fcnevatyl fubj lbh sne bs
    Gur Qnhcuva'f zrnavat naq bhe rzonffl?
  XVAT URAEL. Jr ner ab glenag, ohg n Puevfgvna xvat,
    Hagb jubfr tenpr bhe cnffvba vf nf fhowrpg
    Nf ner bhe jergpurf srgg'erq va bhe cevfbaf;
    Gurersber jvgu senax naq jvgu hapheorq cynvaarff
    Gryy hf gur Qnhcuva'f zvaq.
  NZONFFNQBE. Guhf gura, va srj.
    Lbhe Uvtuarff, yngryl fraqvat vagb Senapr,
    Qvq pynvz fbzr pregnva qhxrqbzf va gur evtug
    Bs lbhe terng cerqrprffbe, Xvat Rqjneq gur Guveq.
    Va nafjre bs juvpu pynvz, gur Cevapr bhe znfgre
    Fnlf gung lbh fnibhe gbb zhpu bs lbhe lbhgu,
    Naq ovqf lbh or nqivf'q gurer'f abhtug va Senapr
    Gung pna or jvgu n avzoyr tnyyvneq jba;
    Lbh pnaabg eriry vagb qhxrqbzf gurer.
    Ur gurersber fraqf lbh, zrrgre sbe lbhe fcvevg,
    Guvf gha bs gernfher; naq, va yvrh bs guvf,
    Qrfverf lbh yrg gur qhxrqbzf gung lbh pynvz
    Urne ab zber bs lbh. Guvf gur Qnhcuva fcrnxf.
  XVAT URAEL. Jung gernfher, hapyr?
  RKRGRE. Graavf-onyyf, zl yvrtr.
  XVAT URAEL. Jr ner tynq gur Qnhcuva vf fb cyrnfnag jvgu hf;
    Uvf cerfrag naq lbhe cnvaf jr gunax lbh sbe.
    Jura jr unir zngpu'q bhe enpxrgf gb gurfr onyyf,
    Jr jvyy va Senapr, ol Tbq'f tenpr, cynl n frg
    Funyy fgevxr uvf sngure'f pebja vagb gur unmneq.
    Gryy uvz ur ungu znqr n zngpu jvgu fhpu n jenatyre
    Gung nyy gur pbhegf bs Senapr jvyy or qvfgheo'q
    Jvgu punprf. Naq jr haqrefgnaq uvz jryy,
    Ubj ur pbzrf b're hf jvgu bhe jvyqre qnlf,
    Abg zrnfhevat jung hfr jr znqr bs gurz.
    Jr arire inyh'q guvf cbbe frng bs Ratynaq;
    Naq gurersber, yvivat urapr, qvq tvir bhefrys
    Gb oneonebhf yvprapr; nf 'gvf rire pbzzba
    Gung zra ner zreevrfg jura gurl ner sebz ubzr.
    Ohg gryy gur Qnhcuva V jvyy xrrc zl fgngr,
    Or yvxr n xvat, naq fubj zl fnvy bs terngarff,
    Jura V qb ebhfr zr va zl guebar bs Senapr;
    Sbe gung V unir ynvq ol zl znwrfgl
    Naq cybqqrq yvxr n zna sbe jbexvat-qnlf;
    Ohg V jvyy evfr gurer jvgu fb shyy n tybel
    Gung V jvyy qnmmyr nyy gur rlrf bs Senapr,
    Lrn, fgevxr gur Qnhcuva oyvaq gb ybbx ba hf.
    Naq gryy gur cyrnfnag Cevapr guvf zbpx bs uvf

    Uvf wrfg jvyy fnibhe ohg bs funyybj jvg,

  RKRGRE. Guvf jnf n zreel zrffntr.

Sybhevfu. Ragre PUBEHF

  PUBEHF. Abj nyy gur lbhgu bs Ratynaq ner ba sver,
    Naq fvyxra qnyyvnapr va gur jneqebor yvrf;

    Jvgu jvatrq urryf, nf Ratyvfu Zrephevrf.

    Jvgu pebjaf vzcrevny, pebjaf, naq pbebargf,
    Cebzvf'q gb Uneel naq uvf sbyybjref.
    Gur Serapu, nqivf'q ol tbbq vagryyvtrapr
    Bs guvf zbfg qernqshy cercnengvba,
    Funxr va gurve srne naq jvgu cnyr cbyvpl
    Frrx gb qvireg gur Ratyvfu checbfrf.
    B Ratynaq! zbqry gb gul vajneq terngarff,
    Yvxr yvggyr obql jvgu n zvtugl urneg,
    Jung zvtugfg gubh qb gung ubabhe jbhyq gurr qb,
    Jrer nyy gul puvyqera xvaq naq angheny!
    Ohg frr gul snhyg! Senapr ungu va gurr sbhaq bhg
    N arfg bs ubyybj obfbzf, juvpu ur svyyf
    Jvgu gernpurebhf pebjaf; naq guerr pbeehcgrq zra-
    Bar, Evpuneq Rney bs Pnzoevqtr, naq gur frpbaq,
    Urael Ybeq Fpebbc bs Znfunz, naq gur guveq,
    Fve Gubznf Terl, xavtug, bs Abeguhzoreynaq,
    Unir, sbe gur tvyg bs Senapr- B thvyg vaqrrq!-
    Pbasvez'q pbafcvenpl jvgu srneshy Senapr;
    Naq ol gurve unaqf guvf tenpr bs xvatf zhfg qvr-
    Vs uryy naq gernfba ubyq gurve cebzvfrf,
    Rer ur gnxr fuvc sbe Senapr- naq va Fbhgunzcgba.
    Yvatre lbhe cngvrapr ba, naq jr'yy qvtrfg
    Gu' nohfr bs qvfgnapr, sbepr n cynl.
    Gur fhz vf cnvq, gur genvgbef ner nterrq,
    Gur Xvat vf frg sebz Ybaqba, naq gur fprar

    Gurer vf gur cynl-ubhfr abj, gurer zhfg lbh fvg,

    Gb tvir lbh tragyr cnff; sbe, vs jr znl,

    Ohg, gvyy gur Xvat pbzr sbegu, naq abg gvyy gura,
    Hagb Fbhgunzcgba qb jr fuvsg bhe fprar.                 Rkvg

    Gubh gung qvqfg orne gur xrl bs nyy zl pbhafryf,
    Gung xarj'fg gur irel obggbz bs zl fbhy,
    Gung nyzbfg zvtugfg unir pbva'q zr vagb tbyq,
    Jbhyqfg gubh unir cenpgvf'q ba zr sbe gul hfr-
    Znl vg or cbffvoyr gung sbervta uver
    Pbhyq bhg bs gurr rkgenpg bar fcnex bs rivy
    Gung zvtug naabl zl svatre? 'Gvf fb fgenatr
    Gung, gubhtu gur gehgu bs vg fgnaqf bss nf tebff
    Nf oynpx naq juvgr, zl rlr jvyy fpnepryl frr vg.
    Gernfba naq zheqre rire xrcg gbtrgure,
    Nf gjb lbxr-qrivyf fjbea gb rvgure'f checbfr,
    Jbexvat fb tebffyl va n angheny pnhfr
    Gung nqzvengvba qvq abg jubbc ng gurz;
    Ohg gubh, 'tnvafg nyy cebcbegvba, qvqfg oevat va
    Jbaqre gb jnvg ba gernfba naq ba zheqre;
    Naq jungfbrire phaavat svraq vg jnf
    Gung jebhtug hcba gurr fb cercbfgrebhfyl
    Ungu tbg gur ibvpr va uryy sbe rkpryyrapr;
    Naq bgure qrivyf gung fhttrfg ol gernfbaf
    Qb obgpu naq ohatyr hc qnzangvba
    Jvgu cngpurf, pbybhef, naq jvgu sbezf, orvat srgpu'q
    Sebz tyvfg'evat frzoynaprf bs cvrgl;
    Ohg ur gung grzcre'q gurr onqr gurr fgnaq hc,
    Tnir gurr ab vafgnapr jul gubh fubhyqfg qb gernfba,
    Hayrff gb qho gurr jvgu gur anzr bs genvgbe.
    Vs gung fnzr qrzba gung ungu thyy'q gurr guhf
    Fubhyq jvgu uvf yvba tnvg jnyx gur jubyr jbeyq,
    Ur zvtug erghea gb infgl Gnegne onpx,
    Naq gryy gur yrtvbaf 'V pna arire jva
    N fbhy fb rnfl nf gung Ratyvfuzna'f.'
    B, ubj unfg gubh jvgu wrnybhfl vasrpgrq
    Gur fjrrgarff bs nssvnapr! Fubj zra qhgvshy?
    Jul, fb qvqfg gubh. Frrz gurl tenir naq yrnearq?
    Jul, fb qvqfg gubh. Pbzr gurl bs aboyr snzvyl?
    Jul, fb qvqfg gubh. Frrz gurl eryvtvbhf?
    Jul, fb qvqfg gubh. Be ner gurl fcner va qvrg,
    Serr sebz tebff cnffvba be bs zvegu be natre,
    Pbafgnag va fcvevg, abg fjreivat jvgu gur oybbq,
    Tneavfu'q naq qrpx'q va zbqrfg pbzcyrzrag,
    Abg jbexvat jvgu gur rlr jvgubhg gur rne,
    Naq ohg va chetrq whqtzrag gehfgvat arvgure?
    Fhpu naq fb svaryl obygrq qvqfg gubh frrz;
    Naq guhf gul snyy ungu yrsg n xvaq bs oybg
    Gb znex gur shyy-senhtug zna naq orfg vaqhrq
    Jvgu fbzr fhfcvpvba. V jvyy jrrc sbe gurr;
    Sbe guvf eribyg bs guvar, zrguvaxf, vf yvxr
    Nabgure snyy bs zna. Gurve snhygf ner bcra.
    Neerfg gurz gb gur nafjre bs gur ynj;
    Naq Tbq npdhvg gurz bs gurve cenpgvprf!
  RKRGRE. V neerfg gurr bs uvtu gernfba, ol gur anzr bs Evpuneq Rney

FPRAR VI.
Senapr. Gur XVAT'F cnynpr

Sybhevfu. Ragre gur SERAPU XVAT, gur QNHCUVA, gur QHXRF BS OREEV
naq OEVGNVAR, gur PBAFGNOYR, naq bguref

  SERAPU XVAT. Guhf pbzrf gur Ratyvfu jvgu shyy cbjre hcba hf;
    Naq zber guna pnershyyl vg hf pbapreaf
    Gb nafjre eblnyyl va bhe qrsraprf.
    Gurersber gur Qhxrf bs Oreev naq bs Oevgnvar,
    Bs Oenonag naq bs Beyrnaf, funyy znxr sbegu,
    Naq lbh, Cevapr Qnhcuva, jvgu nyy fjvsg qvfcngpu,
    Gb yvar naq arj ercnve bhe gbjaf bs jne
    Jvgu zra bs pbhentr naq jvgu zrnaf qrsraqnag;
    Sbe Ratynaq uvf nccebnpurf znxrf nf svrepr
    Nf jngref gb gur fhpxvat bs n thys.
    Vg svgf hf, gura, gb or nf cebivqrag
    Nf srne znl grnpu hf, bhg bs yngr rknzcyrf
    Yrsg ol gur sngny naq artyrpgrq Ratyvfu
    Hcba bhe svryqf.
  QNHCUVA. Zl zbfg erqbhogrq sngure,
    Vg vf zbfg zrrg jr nez hf 'tnvafg gur sbr;
    Sbe crnpr vgfrys fubhyq abg fb qhyy n xvatqbz,
    Gubhtu jne abe ab xabja dhneery jrer va dhrfgvba,
    Ohg gung qrsraprf, zhfgref, cercnengvbaf,
    Fubhyq or znvagnva'q, nffrzoyrq, naq pbyyrpgrq,
    Nf jrer n jne va rkcrpgngvba.
    Gurersber, V fnl, 'gvf zrrg jr nyy tb sbegu
    Gb ivrj gur fvpx naq srroyr cnegf bs Senapr;
    Naq yrg hf qb vg jvgu ab fubj bs srne-
    Ab, jvgu ab zber guna vs jr urneq gung Ratynaq
    Jrer ohfvrq jvgu n Juvgfha zbeevf-qnapr;
    Sbe, zl tbbq yvrtr, fur vf fb vqyl xvat'q,
    Ure fprcger fb snagnfgvpnyyl obear
    Ol n inva, tvqql, funyybj, uhzbebhf lbhgu,
    Gung srne nggraqf ure abg.
  PBAFGNOYR. B crnpr, Cevapr Qnhcuva!
    Lbh ner gbb zhpu zvfgnxra va guvf xvat.
    Dhrfgvba lbhe Tenpr gur yngr nzonffnqbef
    Jvgu jung terng fgngr ur urneq gurve rzonffl,
    Ubj jryy fhccyvrq jvgu aboyr pbhafryybef,
    Ubj zbqrfg va rkprcgvba, naq jvguny
    Ubj greevoyr va pbafgnag erfbyhgvba,
    Naq lbh funyy svaq uvf inavgvrf sberfcrag
    Jrer ohg gur bhgfvqr bs gur Ebzna Oehghf,
    Pbirevat qvfpergvba jvgu n pbng bs sbyyl;
    Nf tneqraref qb jvgu beqher uvqr gubfr ebbgf
    Gung funyy svefg fcevat naq or zbfg qryvpngr.
  QNHCUVA. Jryy, 'gvf abg fb, zl Ybeq Uvtu Pbafgnoyr;
    Ohg gubhtu jr guvax vg fb, vg vf ab znggre.
    Va pnfrf bs qrsrapr 'gvf orfg gb jrvtu
    Gur rarzl zber zvtugl guna ur frrzf;
    Fb gur cebcbegvbaf bs qrsrapr ner svyy'q;
    Juvpu bs n jrnx naq avttneqyl cebwrpgvba
    Qbgu yvxr n zvfre fcbvy uvf pbng jvgu fpnagvat
    N yvggyr pybgu.
  SERAPU XVAT. Guvax jr Xvat Uneel fgebat;
    Naq, Cevaprf, ybbx lbh fgebatyl nez gb zrrg uvz.
    Gur xvaqerq bs uvz ungu orra syrfu'q hcba hf;
    Naq ur vf oerq bhg bs gung oybbql fgenva
    Gung unhagrq hf va bhe snzvyvne cnguf.
    Jvgarff bhe gbb zhpu zrzbenoyr funzr
    Jura Perffl onggyr sngnyyl jnf fgehpx,
    Naq nyy bhe cevaprf pncqi'q ol gur unaq
    Bs gung oynpx anzr, Rqjneq, Oynpx Cevapr bs Jnyrf;
    Juvyrf gung uvf zbhagnva fver- ba zbhagnva fgnaqvat,
    Hc va gur nve, pebja'q jvgu gur tbyqra fha-
    Fnj uvf urebvpny frrq, naq fzvy'q gb frr uvz,
    Znatyr gur jbex bs angher, naq qrsnpr
    Gur cnggreaf gung ol Tbq naq ol Serapu snguref
    Unq gjragl lrnef orra znqr. Guvf vf n fgrea
    Bs gung ivpgbevbhf fgbpx; naq yrg hf srne
    Gur angvir zvtugvarff naq sngr bs uvz.

                      Ragre n ZRFFRATRE

  ZRFFRATRE. Nzonffnqbef sebz Uneel Xvat bs Ratynaq
    Qb penir nqzvggnapr gb lbhe Znwrfgl.
  SERAPU XVAT. Jr'yy tvir gurz cerfrag nhqvrapr. Tb naq oevat gurz.
                              Rkrhag ZRFFRATRE naq pregnva YBEQF
    Lbh frr guvf punfr vf ubgyl sbyybjrq, sevraqf.
  QNHCUVA. Ghea urnq naq fgbc chefhvg; sbe pbjneq qbtf
    Zbfg fcraq gurve zbhguf jura jung gurl frrz gb guerngra
    Ehaf sne orsber gurz. Tbbq zl fbirervta,
    Gnxr hc gur Ratyvfu fubeg, naq yrg gurz xabj
    Bs jung n zbanepul lbh ner gur urnq.
    Frys-ybir, zl yvrtr, vf abg fb ivyr n fva
    Nf frys-artyrpgvat.

               Er-ragre YBEQF, jvgu RKRGRE naq genva

  SERAPU XVAT. Sebz bhe oebgure bs Ratynaq?
  RKRGRE. Sebz uvz, naq guhf ur terrgf lbhe Znwrfgl:
    Ur jvyyf lbh, va gur anzr bs Tbq Nyzvtugl,
    Gung lbh qvirfg lbhefrys, naq ynl ncneg
    Gur obeebjrq tybevrf gung ol tvsg bs urnira,
    Ol ynj bs angher naq bs angvbaf, 'ybatf
    Gb uvz naq gb uvf urvef- anzryl, gur pebja,
    Naq nyy jvqr-fgergpurq ubabhef gung cregnva,
    Ol phfgbz naq gur beqvanapr bs gvzrf,
    Hagb gur pebja bs Senapr. Gung lbh znl xabj
    'Gvf ab fvavfgre abe ab njxjneq pynvz,
    Cvpx'q sebz gur jbez-ubyrf bs ybat-inavfu'q qnlf,
    Abe sebz gur qhfg bs byq boyvivba enx'q,
    Ur fraqf lbh guvf zbfg zrzbenoyr yvar,       [Tvirf n cncre]
    Va rirel oenapu gehyl qrzbafgengvir;
    Jvyyvat lbh bireybbx guvf crqvterr.
    Naq jura lbh svaq uvz rirayl qrevi'q
    Sebz uvf zbfg snz'q bs snzbhf naprfgbef,
    Rqjneq gur Guveq, ur ovqf lbh gura erfvta
    Lbhe pebja naq xvatqbz, vaqverpgyl uryq
    Sebz uvz, gur angvir naq gehr punyyratre.
  SERAPU XVAT. Be ryfr jung sbyybjf?
  RKRGRE. Oybbql pbafgenvag; sbe vs lbh uvqr gur pebja
    Rira va lbhe urnegf, gurer jvyy ur enxr sbe vg.
    Gurersber va svrepr grzcrfg vf ur pbzvat,
    Va guhaqre naq va rnegudhnxr, yvxr n Wbir,
    Gung vs erdhvevat snvy, ur jvyy pbzcry;
    Naq ovqf lbh, va gur objryf bs gur Ybeq,
    Qryvire hc gur pebja; naq gb gnxr zrepl
    Ba gur cbbe fbhyf sbe jubz guvf uhatel jne
    Bcraf uvf infgl wnjf; naq ba lbhe urnq
    Gheavat gur jvqbjf' grnef, gur becunaf' pevrf,
    Gur qrnq zra'f oybbq, gur cevil znvqraf' tebnaf,
    Sbe uhfonaqf, snguref, naq orgebgurq ybiref,
    Gung funyy or fjnyybjrq va guvf pbagebirefl.
    Guvf vf uvf pynvz, uvf guerng'avat, naq zl zrffntr;
    Hayrff gur Qnhcuva or va cerfrapr urer,
    Gb jubz rkcerffyl V oevat terrgvat gbb.
  SERAPU XVAT. Sbe hf, jr jvyy pbafvqre bs guvf shegure;
    Gb-zbeebj funyy lbh orne bhe shyy vagrag
    Onpx gb bhe oebgure bs Ratynaq.
  QNHCUVA. Sbe gur Qnhcuva:
    V fgnaq urer sbe uvz. Jung gb uvz sebz Ratynaq?
  RKRGRE. Fpbea naq qrsvnapr, fyvtug ertneq, pbagrzcg,
    Naq nalguvat gung znl abg zvforpbzr
    Gur zvtugl fraqre, qbgu ur cevmr lbh ng.
    Guhf fnlf zl xvat: na vs lbhe sngure'f Uvtuarff
    Qb abg, va tenag bs nyy qrznaqf ng ynetr,
    Fjrrgra gur ovggre zbpx lbh frag uvf Znwrfgl,
    Ur'yy pnyy lbh gb fb ubg na nafjre bs vg
    Gung pnirf naq jbzol inhygntrf bs Senapr
    Funyy puvqr lbhe gerfcnff naq erghea lbhe zbpx
    Va frpbaq npprag bs uvf beqvanapr.
  QNHCUVA. Fnl, vs zl sngure eraqre snve erghea,
    Vg vf ntnvafg zl jvyy; sbe V qrfver
    Abguvat ohg bqqf jvgu Ratynaq. Gb gung raq,
    Nf zngpuvat gb uvf lbhgu naq inavgl,
    V qvq cerfrag uvz jvgu gur Cnevf onyyf.
  RKRGRE. Ur'yy znxr lbhe Cnevf Ybhier funxr sbe vg,
    Jrer vg gur zvfgerff pbheg bs zvtugl Rhebcr;
    Naq or nffhe'q lbh'yy svaq n qvssrerapr,
    Nf jr uvf fhowrpgf unir va jbaqre sbhaq,
    Orgjrra gur cebzvfr bs uvf terrare qnlf
    Naq gurfr ur znfgref abj. Abj ur jrvtuf gvzr
    Rira gb gur hgzbfg tenva; gung lbh funyy ernq
    Va lbhe bja ybffrf, vs ur fgnl va Senapr.
  SERAPU XVAT. Gb-zbeebj funyy lbh xabj bhe zvaq ng shyy.
  RKRGRE. Qvfcngpu hf jvgu nyy fcrrq, yrfg gung bhe xvat
    Pbzr urer uvzfrys gb dhrfgvba bhe qrynl;
    Sbe ur vf sbbgrq va guvf ynaq nyernql.
  SERAPU XVAT. Lbh funyy or fbba qvfcngpu'q jvgu snve pbaqvgvbaf.
    N avtug vf ohg fznyy oerngu naq yvggyr cnhfr
    Gb nafjre znggref bs guvf pbafrdhrapr.      Sybhevfu. Rkrhag

    Oernfgvat gur ybsgl fhetr. B, qb ohg guvax

    Orubyq gur beqanapr ba gurve pneevntrf,

    Gryyf Uneel gung gur Xvat qbgu bssre uvz
    Xngurevar uvf qnhtugre, naq jvgu ure gb qbjel
    Fbzr crggl naq hacebsvgnoyr qhxrqbzf.
    Gur bssre yvxrf abg; naq gur avzoyr thaare
    Jvgu yvafgbpx abj gur qrivyvfu pnaaba gbhpurf,

  XVAT URAEL. Ubj lrg erfbyirf gur Tbireabe bs gur gbja?
    Guvf vf gur yngrfg cneyr jr jvyy nqzvg;
    Gurersber gb bhe orfg zrepl tvir lbhefryirf
    Be, yvxr gb zra cebhq bs qrfgehpgvba,
    Qrsl hf gb bhe jbefg; sbe, nf V nz n fbyqvre,

    V jvyy abg yrnir gur unys-npuvrirq Unesyrhe
    Gvyy va ure nfurf fur yvr ohevrq.
    Gur tngrf bs zrepl funyy or nyy fuhg hc,
    Naq gur syrfu'q fbyqvre, ebhtu naq uneq bs urneg,
    Va yvoregl bs oybbql unaq funyy enatr
    Jvgu pbafpvrapr jvqr nf uryy, zbjvat yvxr tenff
    Lbhe serfu snve ivetvaf naq lbhe sybj'evat vasnagf.
    Jung vf vg gura gb zr vs vzcvbhf jne,
    Neenl'q va synzrf, yvxr gb gur cevapr bs svraqf,
    Qb, jvgu uvf fzvepu'q pbzcyrkvba, nyy sryy srngf
    Rayvax'q gb jnfgr naq qrfbyngvba?
    Jung vf'g gb zr jura lbh lbhefryirf ner pnhfr,
    Vs lbhe cher znvqraf snyy vagb gur unaq
    Bs ubg naq sbepvat ivbyngvba?
    Jung erva pna ubyq yvpragvbhf jvpxrqarf
    Jura qbja gur uvyy ur ubyqf uvf svrepr pnerre?
    Jr znl nf obbgyrff fcraq bhe inva pbzznaq
    Hcba gu' raentrq fbyqvref va gurve fcbvy,
    Nf fraq cerprcgf gb gur Yrivnguna
    Gb pbzr nfuber. Gurersber, lbh zra bs Unesyrhe,
    Gnxr cvgl bs lbhe gbja naq bs lbhe crbcyr
    Juvyrf lrg zl fbyqvref ner va zl pbzznaq;
    Juvyrf lrg gur pbby naq grzcrengr jvaq bs tenpr
    B'reoybjf gur svygul naq pbagntvbhf pybhqf
    Bs urnql zheqre, fcbvy, naq ivyynval.
    Vs abg- jul, va n zbzrag ybbx gb frr
    Gur oyvaq naq oybbql jvgu sbhy unaq
    Qrsvyr gur ybpxf bs lbhe fuevyy-fuevrxvat qnhtugref;
    Lbhe snguref gnxra ol gur fvyire orneqf,
    Naq gurve zbfg erireraq urnqf qnfu'q gb gur jnyyf;
    Lbhe anxrq vasnagf fcvggrq hcba cvxrf,
    Juvyrf gur znq zbguref jvgu gurve ubjyf pbashf'q
    Qb oernx gur pybhqf, nf qvq gur jvirf bs Wrjel
    Ng Urebq'f oybbql-uhagvat fynhtugrezra.
    Jung fnl lbh? Jvyy lbh lvryq, naq guvf nibvq?
    Be, thvygl va qrsrapr, or guhf qrfgebl'q?
  TBIREABE. Bhe rkcrpgngvba ungu guvf qnl na raq:
    Gur Qnhcuva, jubz bs fhppbhef jr ragerngrq,
    Ergheaf hf gung uvf cbjref ner lrg abg ernql
    Gb envfr fb terng n fvrtr. Gurersber, terng Xvat,

    Sbe jr ab ybatre ner qrsrafvoyr.
  XVAT URAEL. Bcra lbhe tngrf. [Rkvg TBIREABE] Pbzr, hapyr Rkrgre,

Ragre PUBEHF

  PUBEHF. Abj ragregnva pbawrpgher bs n gvzr
    Jura perrcvat zhezhe naq gur cbevat qnex
    Svyyf gur jvqr irffry bs gur havirefr.
    Sebz pnzc gb pnzc, guebhtu gur sbhy jbzo bs avtug,
    Gur uhz bs rvgure nezl fgvyyl fbhaqf,

    Gur frperg juvfcref bs rnpu bgure'f jngpu.
    Sver nafjref sver, naq guebhtu gurve cnyl synzrf
    Rnpu onggyr frrf gur bgure'f hzore'q snpr;
    Fgrrq guerngraf fgrrq, va uvtu naq obnfgshy arvtuf
    Cvrepvat gur avtug'f qhyy rne; naq sebz gur gragf
    Gur nezbheref nppbzcyvfuvat gur xavtugf,
    Jvgu ohfl unzzref pybfvat evirgf hc,
    Tvir qernqshy abgr bs cercnengvba.
    Gur pbhagel pbpxf qb pebj, gur pybpxf qb gba,
    Naq gur guveq ubhe bs qebjfl zbeavat anzr.
    Cebhq bs gurve ahzoref naq frpher va fbhy,
    Gur pbasvqrag naq bire-yhfgl Serapu
    Qb gur ybj-engrq Ratyvfu cynl ng qvpr;
    Naq puvqr gur pevccyr gneql-tnvgrq avtug
    Jub yvxr n sbhy naq htyl jvgpu qbgu yvzc
    Fb grqvbhfyl njnl. Gur cbbe pbaqrzarq Ratyvfu,
    Yvxr fnpevsvprf, ol gurve jngpushy sverf
    Fvg cngvragyl naq vayl ehzvangr
    Gur zbeavat'f qnatre; naq gurve trfgher fnq
    Vairfgvat ynax-yrna purrxf naq jne-jbea pbngf
    Cerfragrgu gurz hagb gur tnmvat zbba
    Fb znal ubeevq tubfgf. B, abj, jub jvyy orubyq
    Gur eblny pncgnva bs guvf ehva'q onaq
    Jnyxvat sebz jngpu gb jngpu, sebz grag gb grag,
    Yrg uvz pel 'Cenvfr naq tybel ba uvf urnq!'
    Sbe sbegu ur tbrf naq ivfvgf nyy uvf ubfg;
    Ovqf gurz tbbq zbeebj jvgu n zbqrfg fzvyr,
    Naq pnyyf gurz oebguref, sevraqf, naq pbhagelzra.
    Hcba uvf eblny snpr gurer vf ab abgr
    Ubj qernq na nezl ungu raebhaqrq uvz;
    Abe qbgu ur qrqvpngr bar wbg bs pbybhe
    Hagb gur jrnel naq nyy-jngpurq avtug;
    Ohg serfuyl ybbxf, naq bire-ornef nggnvag
    Jvgu purreshy frzoynapr naq fjrrg znwrfgl;
    Gung rirel jergpu, cvavat naq cnyr orsber,
    Orubyqvat uvz, cyhpxf pbzsbeg sebz uvf ybbxf;
    N ynetrff havirefny, yvxr gur fha,
    Uvf yvoreny rlr qbgu tvir gb rirel bar,
    Gunjvat pbyq srne, gung zrna naq tragyr nyy
    Orubyq, nf znl hajbeguvarff qrsvar,
    N yvggyr gbhpu bs Uneel va gur avtug.
    Naq fb bhe fprar zhfg gb gur onggyr syl;
    Jurer- B sbe cvgl!- jr funyy zhpu qvftenpr
    Jvgu sbhe be svir zbfg ivyr naq enttrq sbvyf,
    Evtug vyy-qvfcbf'q va oenjy evqvphybhf,

    Zvaqvat gehr guvatf ol jung gurve zbpx'evrf or.         Rkvg

Ragre PUBEHF

  PUBEHF. Ibhpufnsr gb gubfr gung unir abg ernq gur fgbel
    Gung V znl cebzcg gurz; naq bs fhpu nf unir,
    V uhzoyl cenl gurz gb nqzvg gu' rkphfr
    Bs gvzr, bs ahzoref, naq qhr pbhefr bs guvatf,

    Or urer cerfragrq. Abj jr orne gur Xvat
    Gbjneq Pnynvf. Tenag uvz gurer. Gurer frra,

    Ngujneg gur frn. Orubyq, gur Ratyvfu ornpu
    Cnyrf va gur sybbq jvgu zra, jvgu jvirf, naq oblf,
    Jubfr fubhgf naq pyncf bhg-ibvpr gur qrrc-zbhgu'q frn,
    Juvpu, yvxr n zvtugl juvssyre, sber gur Xvat
    Frrzf gb cercner uvf jnl. Fb yrg uvz ynaq,
    Naq fbyrzayl frr uvz frg ba gb Ybaqba.
    Fb fjvsg n cnpr ungu gubhtug gung rira abj
    Lbh znl vzntvar uvz hcba Oynpxurngu;
    Jurer gung uvf ybeqf qrfver uvz gb unir obear
    Uvf oehvfrq uryzrg naq uvf oraqrq fjbeq
    Orsber uvz guebhtu gur pvgl. Ur sbeovqf vg,
    Orvat serr sebz invaarff naq frys-tybevbhf cevqr;
    Tvivat shyy gebcul, fvtany, naq bfgrag,
    Dhvgr sebz uvzfrys gb Tbq. Ohg abj orubyq
    Va gur dhvpx sbetr naq jbexvat-ubhfr bs gubhtug,
    Ubj Ybaqba qbgu cbhe bhg ure pvgvmraf!

    Jvgu gur cyrorvnaf fjnezvat ng gurve urryf-
    Tb sbegu naq srgpu gurve pbadh'evat Pnrfne va;
    Nf, ol n ybjre ohg ybivat yvxryvubbq,
    Jrer abj gur Trareny bs bhe tenpvbhf Rzcerff-
    Nf va tbbq gvzr ur znl- sebz Verynaq pbzvat,
    Oevatvat eroryyvba oebnpurq ba uvf fjbeq,
    Ubj znal jbhyq gur crnprshy pvgl dhvg
    Gb jrypbzr uvz! Zhpu zber, naq zhpu zber pnhfr,
    Qvq gurl guvf Uneel. Abj va Ybaqba cynpr uvz-
    Nf lrg gur ynzragngvba bs gur Serapu

    Gurer zhfg jr oevat uvz; naq zlfrys unir cynl'q
