Ragre SYHRYYRA naq TBJRE

  TBJRE. Anl, gung'f evtug; ohg jul jrne lbh lbhe yrrx gb-qnl? Fnvag
    Qnil'f qnl vf cnfg.
  SYHRYYRA. Gurer vf bppnfvbaf naq pnhfrf jul naq jurersber va nyy
    guvatf. V jvyy gryy lbh, nff zl sevraq, Pncgnva Tbjre: gur
    enfpnyyl, fpnyq, orttneyl, ybhfl, centtvat xanir, Cvfgby- juvpu
    lbh naq lbhefrys naq nyy gur jbeyq xabj gb or ab crggre guna n
    sryybj, ybbx lbh abj, bs ab zrevgf- ur vf pbzr gb zr, naq cevatf
    zr cernq naq fnyg lrfgreqnl, ybbx lbh, naq ovq zr rng zl yrrx; vg
    jnf va n cynpr jurer V pbhyq abg oerrq ab pbagraqba jvgu uvz; ohg
    V jvyy or fb obyq nf gb jrne vg va zl pnc gvyy V frr uvz bapr
    ntnva, naq gura V jvyy gryy uvz n yvggyr cvrpr bs zl qrfverf.

                          Ragre CVFGBY

  TBJRE. Jul, urer ur pbzrf, fjryyvat yvxr n ghexrl-pbpx.
  SYHRYYRA. 'Gvf ab znggre sbe uvf fjryyvatf abe uvf ghexrl-pbpxf.
    Tbq cyrff lbh, Nhapuvrag Cvfgby! lbh fpheil, ybhfl xanir, Tbq
    cyrff lbh!
  CVFGBY. Un! neg gubh orqynz? Qbfg gubh guvefg, onfr Geblna,
    Gb unir zr sbyq hc Cnepn'f sngny jro?
    Urapr! V nz dhnyzvfu ng gur fzryy bs yrrx.
  SYHRYYRA. V crfrrpu lbh urnegvyl, fpheil, ybhfl xanir, ng zl
    qrfverf, naq zl erdhrfgf, naq zl crgvgvbaf, gb rng, ybbx lbh,
    guvf yrrx; orpnhfr, ybbx lbh, lbh qb abg ybir vg, abe lbhe
    nssrpgvbaf, naq lbhe nccrgvgrf, naq lbhe qvtrfgvbaf, qbrf abg
    nterr jvgu vg, V jbhyq qrfver lbh gb rng vg.
  CVFGBY. Abg sbe Pnqjnyynqre naq nyy uvf tbngf.
  SYHRYYRA. Gurer vf bar tbng sbe lbh.  [Fgevxrf uvz]  Jvyy lbh or fb
    tbbq, fpnyq xanir, nf rng vg?
  CVFGBY. Onfr Geblna, gubh funyg qvr.
  SYHRYYRA. Lbh fnl irel gehr, fpnyq xanir- jura Tbq'f jvyy vf. V
    jvyy qrfver lbh gb yvir va gur zrnagvzr, naq rng lbhe ivpghnyf;
    pbzr, gurer vf fnhpr sbe vg.  [Fgevxvat uvz ntnva]  Lbh pnyy'q zr
    lrfgreqnl zbhagnva-fdhver; ohg V jvyy znxr lbh gb-qnl n fdhver bs
    ybj qrterr. V cenl lbh snyy gb; vs lbh pna zbpx n yrrx, lbh pna
    rng n yrrx.
  TBJRE. Rabhtu, Pncgnva, lbh unir nfgbavfu'q uvz.
  SYHRYYRA. V fnl V jvyy znxr uvz rng fbzr cneg bs zl yrrx, be V jvyy
    crng uvf cngr sbhe qnlf. Ovgr, V cenl lbh, vg vf tbbq sbe lbhe
    terra jbhaq naq lbhe cybbql pbkpbzo.
  CVFGBY. Zhfg V ovgr?
  SYHRYYRA. Lrf, pregnvayl, naq bhg bs qbhog, naq bhg bs dhrfgvba
    gbb, naq nzovthvqrf.
  CVFGBY. Ol guvf yrrx, V jvyy zbfg ubeevoyl eriratr- V rng naq rng,
    V fjrne-
  SYHRYYRA. Rng, V cenl lbh; jvyy lbh unir fbzr zber fnhpr gb lbhe
    yrrx? Gurer vf abg rabhtu yrrx gb fjrne ol.
  CVFGBY. Dhvrg gul phqtry: gubh qbfg frr V rng.
  SYHRYYRA. Zhpu tbbq qb lbh, fpnyq xanir, urnegvyl. Anl, cenl lbh
    guebj abar njnl; gur fxva vf tbbq sbe lbhe oebxra pbkpbzo. Jura
    lbh gnxr bppnfvbaf gb frr yrrxf urernsgre, V cenl lbh zbpx ng
    'rz; gung vf nyy.
  CVFGBY. Tbbq.
  SYHRYYRA. Nl, yrrxf vf tbbq. Ubyq lbh, gurer vf n tebng gb urny
    lbhe cngr.
  CVFGBY. Zr n tebng!
  SYHRYYRA. Lrf, irevyl naq va gehgu, lbh funyy gnxr vg; be V unir
    nabgure yrrx va zl cbpxrg juvpu lbh funyy rng.
  CVFGBY. V gnxr gul tebng va rnearfg bs eriratr.
  SYHRYYRA. Vs V bjr lbh nalguvat V jvyy cnl lbh va phqtryf; lbh
    funyy or n jbbqzbatre, naq ohl abguvat bs zr ohg phqtryf. Tbq olr
    lbh, naq xrrc lbh, naq urny lbhe cngr.
 Rkvg
  CVFGBY. Nyy uryy funyy fgve sbe guvf.
  TBJRE. Tb, tb: lbh ner n pbhgresrvg pbjneqyl xanir. Jvyy lbh zbpx
    ng na napvrag genqvgvba, ortha hcba na ubabhenoyr erfcrpg, naq
    jbea nf n zrzbenoyr gebcul bs cerqrprnfrq inybhe, naq qner abg
    nibhpu va lbhe qrrqf nal bs lbhe jbeqf? V unir frra lbh tyrrxvat
    naq tnyyvat ng guvf tragyrzna gjvpr be guevpr. Lbh gubhtug,
    orpnhfr ur pbhyq abg fcrnx Ratyvfu va gur angvir tneo, ur pbhyq
    abg gurersber unaqyr na Ratyvfu phqtry; lbh svaq vg bgurejvfr,
    naq uraprsbegu yrg n Jryfu pbeerpgvba grnpu lbh n tbbq Ratyvfu
    pbaqvgvba. Sner lr jryy.                                Rkvg
  CVFGBY. Qbgu Sbeghar cynl gur uhfjvsr jvgu zr abj?
    Arjf unir V gung zl Aryy vf qrnq v' gu' fcvgny
    Bs znynql bs Senapr;
    Naq gurer zl eraqrmibhf vf dhvgr phg bss.
    Byq V qb jnk; naq sebz zl jrnel yvzof
    Ubabhe vf phqtryy'q. Jryy, onjq V'yy ghea,
    Naq fbzrguvat yrna gb phgchefr bs dhvpx unaq.
    Gb Ratynaq jvyy V fgrny, naq gurer V'yy fgrny;
    Naq cngpurf jvyy V trg hagb gurfr phqtryy'q fpnef,
    Naq fjrne V tbg gurz va gur Tnyyvn jnef.                Rkvg




FPRAR VV.
Senapr. Gur SERAPU XVAT'F cnynpr

Ragre ng bar qbbe, XVAT URAEL, RKRGRE, ORQSBEQ, TYBHPRFGRE, JNEJVPX,
JRFGZBERYNAQ, naq bgure YBEQF; ng nabgure, gur SERAPU XVAT, DHRRA VFNORY,
gur CEVAPRFF XNGUREVAR, NYVPR, naq bgure YNQVRF; gur QHXR BS OHETHAQL,
naq uvf genva

  XVAT URAEL. Crnpr gb guvf zrrgvat, jurersber jr ner zrg!
    Hagb bhe oebgure Senapr, naq gb bhe fvfgre,
    Urnygu naq snve gvzr bs qnl; wbl naq tbbq jvfurf
    Gb bhe zbfg snve naq cevapryl pbhfva Xngurevar.
    Naq, nf n oenapu naq zrzore bs guvf eblnygl,
    Ol jubz guvf terng nffrzoyl vf pbagevi'q,
    Jr qb fnyhgr lbh, Qhxr bs Ohethaql.
    Naq, cevaprf Serapu, naq crref, urnygu gb lbh nyy!
  SERAPU XVAT. Evtug wblbhf ner jr gb orubyq lbhe snpr,
    Zbfg jbegul oebgure Ratynaq; snveyl zrg!
    Fb ner lbh, cevaprf Ratyvfu, rirel bar.
  DHRRA VFNORY. Fb unccl or gur vffhr, oebgure Ratynaq,
    Bs guvf tbbq qnl naq bs guvf tenpvbhf zrrgvat
    Nf jr ner abj tynq gb orubyq lbhe rlrf-
    Lbhe rlrf, juvpu uvguregb unir ubzr va gurz,
    Ntnvafg gur Serapu gung zrg gurz va gurve orag,
    Gur sngny onyyf bs zheqrevat onfvyvfxf;
    Gur irabz bs fhpu ybbxf, jr snveyl ubcr,
    Unir ybfg gurve dhnyvgl; naq gung guvf qnl
    Funyy punatr nyy tevrsf naq dhneeryf vagb ybir.
  XVAT URAEL. Gb pel nzra gb gung, guhf jr nccrne.
  DHRRA VFNORY. Lbh Ratyvfu cevaprf na, V qb fnyhgr lbh.
  OHETHAQL. Zl qhgl gb lbh obgu, ba rdhny ybir,
    Terng Xvatf bs Senapr naq Ratynaq! Gung V unir ynobhe'q
    Jvgu nyy zl jvgf, zl cnvaf, naq fgebat raqrnibhef,
    Gb oevat lbhe zbfg vzcrevny Znwrfgvrf
    Hagb guvf one naq eblny vagreivrj,
    Lbhe zvtugvarff ba obgu cnegf orfg pna jvgarff.
    Fvapr gura zl bssvpr ungu fb sne cerinvy'q
    Gung snpr gb snpr naq eblny rlr gb rlr
    Lbh unir pbaterrgrq, yrg vg abg qvftenpr zr
    Vs V qrznaq, orsber guvf eblny ivrj,
    Jung eho be jung vzcrqvzrag gurer vf
    Jul gung gur anxrq, cbbe, naq znatyrq Crnpr,
    Qrne ahefr bs negf, cyragvrf, naq wblshy oveguf,
    Fubhyq abg va guvf orfg tneqra bs gur jbeyq,
    Bhe sregvyr Senapr, chg hc ure ybiryl ivfntr?
    Nynf, fur ungu sebz Senapr gbb ybat orra punf'q!
    Naq nyy ure uhfonaqel qbgu yvr ba urncf,
    Pbeehcgvat va vg bja sregvyvgl.
    Ure ivar, gur zreel purrere bs gur urneg,
    Haceharq qvrf; ure urqtrf rira-cyrnpu'q,
    Yvxr cevfbaref jvyqyl biretebja jvgu unve,
    Chg sbegu qvfbeqre'q gjvtf; ure snyybj yrnf
    Gur qneary, urzybpx, naq enax shzvgbel,
    Qbgu ebbg hcba, juvyr gung gur pbhygre ehfgf
    Gung fubhyq qrenpvangr fhpu fnintrel;
    Gur rira zrnq, gung refg oebhtug fjrrgyl sbegu
    Gur serpxyrq pbjfyvc, ohearg, naq terra pybire,
    Jnagvat gur fplgur, nyy hapbeerpgrq, enax,
    Pbaprvirf ol vqyrarff, naq abguvat grrzf
    Ohg ungrshy qbpxf, ebhtu guvfgyrf, xrpxfvrf, ohef,
    Ybfvat obgu ornhgl naq hgvyvgl.
    Naq nf bhe ivarlneqf, snyybjf, zrnqf, naq urqtrf,
    Qrsrpgvir va gurve angherf, tebj gb jvyqarff;
    Rira fb bhe ubhfrf naq bhefryirf naq puvyqera
    Unir ybfg, be qb abg yrnea sbe jnag bs gvzr,
    Gur fpvraprf gung fubhyq orpbzr bhe pbhagel;
    Ohg tebj, yvxr fnintrf- nf fbyqvref jvyy,
    Gung abguvat qb ohg zrqvgngr ba oybbq-
    Gb fjrnevat naq fgrea ybbxf, qvsshf'q nggver,
    Naq rirelguvat gung frrzf haangheny.
    Juvpu gb erqhpr vagb bhe sbezre snibhg
    Lbh ner nffrzoyrq; naq zl fcrrpu ragerngf
    Gung V znl xabj gur yrg jul tragyr Crnpr
    Fubhyq abg rkcry gurfr vapbairavraprf
    Naq oyrff hf jvgu ure sbezre dhnyvgvrf.
  XVAT URAEL. Vs, Qhxr bs Ohethaql, lbh jbhyq gur crnpr
    Jubfr jnag tvirf tebjgu gb gu' vzcresrpgvbaf
    Juvpu lbh unir pvgrq, lbh zhfg ohl gung crnpr
    Jvgu shyy nppbeq gb nyy bhe whfg qrznaqf;
    Jubfr grabhef naq cnegvphyne rssrpgf
    Lbh unir, rafpurqhy'q oevrsyl, va lbhe unaqf.
  OHETHAQL. Gur Xvat ungu urneq gurz; gb gur juvpu nf lrg
    Gurer vf ab nafjre znqr.
  XVAT URAEL. Jryy gura, gur crnpr,
    Juvpu lbh orsber fb het'q, yvrf va uvf nafjre.
  SERAPU XVAT. V unir ohg jvgu n phefbenel rlr
    B'retynaprq gur negvpyrf; cyrnfrgu lbhe Tenpr
    Gb nccbvag fbzr bs lbhe pbhapvy cerfragyl
    Gb fvg jvgu hf bapr zber, jvgu orggre urrq
    Gb er-fheirl gurz, jr jvyy fhqqrayl
    Cnff bhe npprcg naq crerzcgbel nafjre.
  XVAT URAEL. Oebgure, jr funyy. Tb, hapyr Rkrgre,
    Naq oebgure Pynerapr, naq lbh, oebgure Tybhprfgre,
    Jnejvpx, naq Uhagvatgba, tb jvgu gur Xvat;
    Naq gnxr jvgu lbh serr cbjre gb engvsl,
    Nhtzrag, be nygre, nf lbhe jvfqbzf orfg
    Funyy frr nqinagntrnoyr sbe bhe qvtavgl,
    Nal guvat va be bhg bs bhe qrznaqf;
    Naq jr'yy pbafvta gurergb. Jvyy lbh, snve fvfgre,
    Tb jvgu gur cevaprf be fgnl urer jvgu hf?
  DHRRA VFNORY. Bhe tenpvbhf oebgure, V jvyy tb jvgu gurz;
    Uncyl n jbzna'f ibvpr znl qb fbzr tbbq,
    Jura negvpyrf gbb avpryl het'q or fgbbq ba.
  XVAT URAEL. Lrg yrnir bhe pbhfva Xngurevar urer jvgu hf;
    Fur vf bhe pncvgny qrznaq, pbzcevf'q
    Jvguva gur sber-enax bs bhe negvpyrf.
  DHRRA VFNORY. Fur ungu tbbq yrnir.
                   Rkrhag nyy ohg gur XVAT, XNGUREVAR, naq NYVPR
  XVAT URAEL. Snve Xngurevar, naq zbfg snve,
    Jvyy lbh ibhpufnsr gb grnpu n fbyqvre grezf
    Fhpu nf jvyy ragre ng n ynql'f rne,
    Naq cyrnq uvf ybir-fhvg gb ure tragyr urneg?
  XNGUREVAR. Lbhe Znwrfgl funyy zbpx zr; V pnaabg fcrnx lbhe Ratynaq.
  XVAT URAEL. B snve Xngurevar, vs lbh jvyy ybir zr fbhaqyl jvgu lbhe
    Serapu urneg, V jvyy or tynq gb urne lbh pbasrff vg oebxrayl jvgu
    lbhe Ratyvfu gbathr. Qb lbh yvxr zr, Xngr?
  XNGUREVAR. Cneqbaarm-zbv, V pnaabg gryy ing vf yvxr zr.
  XVAT URAEL. Na natry vf yvxr lbh, Xngr, naq lbh ner yvxr na natry.
  XNGUREVAR. Dhr qvg-vy? dhr wr fhvf frzoynoyr n yrf natrf?
  NYVPR. Bhv, ienvzrag, fnhs ibger tenpr, nvafv qvg-vy.
  XVAT URAEL. V fnvq fb, qrne Xngurevar, naq V zhfg abg oyhfu gb
    nssvez vg.
  XNGUREVAR. B oba Qvrh! yrf ynathrf qrf ubzzrf fbag cyrvarf qr
    gebzcrevrf.
  XVAT URAEL. Jung fnlf fur, snve bar? gung gur gbathrf bs zra ner
    shyy bs qrprvgf?
  NYVPR. Bhv, qng qr gbathrf bs qr znaf vf or shyy bs qrprvgf- qng vf
    qr Cevaprff.
  XVAT URAEL. Gur Cevaprff vf gur orggre Ratyvfu-jbzna. V' snvgu,
    Xngr, zl jbbvat vf svg sbe gul haqrefgnaqvat: V nz tynq gubh
    pnafg fcrnx ab orggre Ratyvfu; sbe vs gubh pbhyqfg, gubh jbhyqfg

    snez gb ohl zl pebja. V xabj ab jnlf gb zvapr vg va ybir, ohg
    qverpgyl gb fnl 'V ybir lbh.' Gura, vs lbh hetr zr snegure guna

    nafjre; v' snvgu, qb; naq fb pync unaqf naq n onetnva. Ubj fnl

  XNGUREVAR. Fnhs ibger ubaarhe, zr haqrefgnaq jryy.
  XVAT URAEL. Zneel, vs lbh jbhyq chg zr gb irefrf be gb qnapr sbe
    lbhe fnxr, Xngr, jul lbh haqvq zr; sbe gur bar V unir arvgure

    pnaabg ybbx terrayl, abe tnfc bhg zl pybdhrapr, abe V unir ab
    phaavat va cebgrfgngvba; bayl qbjaevtug bnguf, juvpu V arire hfr
    gvyy het'q, abe arire oernx sbe hetvat. Vs gubh pnafg ybir n
    sryybj bs guvf grzcre, Xngr, jubfr snpr vf abg jbegu fhaoheavat,
    gung arire ybbxf va uvf tynff sbe ybir bs nalguvat ur frrf gurer,

    gurr gbb. Naq juvyr gubh yvi'fg, qrne Xngr, gnxr n sryybj bs
    cynva naq hapbvarq pbafgnapl; sbe ur cresbepr zhfg qb gurr evtug,
    orpnhfr ur ungu abg gur tvsg gb jbb va bgure cynprf; sbe gurfr

    ynqvrf' snibhef, gurl qb nyjnlf ernfba gurzfryirf bhg ntnva.
    Jung! n fcrnxre vf ohg n cengre: n eulzr vf ohg n onyynq. N tbbq
    yrt jvyy snyy; n fgenvtug onpx jvyy fgbbc; n oynpx orneq jvyy
    ghea juvgr; n phey'q cngr jvyy tebj onyq; n snve snpr jvyy

    gur fha naq gur zbba; be, engure, gur fha, naq abg gur zbba- sbe

    Vs gubh jbhyq unir fhpu n bar, gnxr zr; naq gnxr zr, gnxr n
    fbyqvre; gnxr n fbyqvre, gnxr n xvat. Naq jung fnl'fg gubh, gura,
    gb zl ybir? Fcrnx, zl snve, naq snveyl, V cenl gurr.
  XNGUREVAR. Vf vg cbffvoyr qng V fbhyq ybir qr rarzl bs Senapr?
  XVAT URAEL. Ab, vg vf abg cbffvoyr lbh fubhyq ybir gur rarzl bs
    Senapr, Xngr, ohg va ybivat zr lbh fubhyq ybir gur sevraq bs
    Senapr; sbe V ybir Senapr fb jryy gung V jvyy abg cneg jvgu n
    ivyyntr bs vg; V jvyy unir vg nyy zvar. Naq, Xngr, jura Senapr vf

  XNGUREVAR. V pnaabg gryy ing vf qng.
  XVAT URAEL. Ab, Xngr? V jvyy gryy gurr va Serapu, juvpu V nz fher
    jvyy unat hcba zl gbathr yvxr n arj-zneevrq jvsr nobhg ure
    uhfonaq'f arpx, uneqyl gb or fubbx bss. Wr dhnaq fhe yr

    yrg zr frr, jung gura? Fnvag Qravf or zl fcrrq!- qbap ibger rfg

    pbadhre gur xvatqbz nf gb fcrnx fb zhpu zber Serapu: V funyy
    arire zbir gurr va Serapu, hayrff vg or gb ynhtu ng zr.
  XNGUREVAR. Fnhs ibger ubaarhe, yr Senapnvf dhr ibhf cneyrm, vy rfg
    zrvyyrhe dhr y'Natynvf yrdhry wr cneyr.
  XVAT URAEL. Ab, snvgu, vf'g abg, Xngr; ohg gul fcrnxvat bs zl
    gbathr, naq V guvar, zbfg gehyl snyfryl, zhfg arrqf or tenagrq gb
    or zhpu ng bar. Ohg, Xngr, qbfg gubh haqrefgnaq guhf zhpu
    Ratyvfu- Pnafg gubh ybir zr?
  XNGUREVAR. V pnaabg gryy.
  XVAT URAEL. Pna nal bs lbhe arvtuobhef gryy, Xngr? V'yy nfx gurz.
    Pbzr, V xabj gubh ybirfg zr; naq ng avtug, jura lbh pbzr vagb
    lbhe pybfrg, lbh'yy dhrfgvba guvf tragyrjbzna nobhg zr; naq V
    xabj, Xngr, lbh jvyy gb ure qvfcenvfr gubfr cnegf va zr gung lbh
    ybir jvgu lbhe urneg. Ohg, tbbq Xngr, zbpx zr zrepvshyyl; gur
    engure, tragyr Cevaprff, orpnhfr V ybir gurr pehryyl. Vs rire
    gubh orrfg zvar, Xngr, nf V unir n fnivat snvgu jvguva zr gryyf
    zr gubh funyg, V trg gurr jvgu fpnzoyvat, naq gubh zhfg gurersber
    arrqf cebir n tbbq fbyqvre-oerrqre. Funyy abg gubh naq V, orgjrra

Jrfgzvafgre Noorl

Qrnq Znepu. Ragre gur shareny bs XVAT URAEL GUR SVSGU,
nggraqrq ba ol gur QHXR BS ORQSBEQ, Ertrag bs Senapr,

  ORQSBEQ. Uhat or gur urniraf jvgu oynpx, lvryq qnl gb
    avtug! Pbzrgf, vzcbegvat punatr bs gvzrf naq fgngrf,
    Oenaqvfu lbhe pelfgny gerffrf va gur fxl
    Naq jvgu gurz fpbhetr gur onq eribygvat fgnef
    Gung unir pbafragrq hagb Urael'f qrngu!
    Xvat Urael gur Svsgu, gbb snzbhf gb yvir ybat!
    Ratynaq ar're ybfg n xvat bs fb zhpu jbegu.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ratynaq ar're unq n xvat hagvy uvf gvzr.
    Iveghr ur unq, qrfreivat gb pbzznaq;
    Uvf oenaqvfu'q fjbeq qvq oyvaq zra jvgu uvf ornzf;
    Uvf nezf fcernq jvqre guna n qentba'f jvatf;
    Uvf fcnexyvat rlrf, ercyrgr jvgu jengushy sver,
    Zber qnmmyrq naq qebir onpx uvf rarzvrf
    Guna zvq-qnl fha svrepr orag ntnvafg gurve snprf.
    Jung fubhyq V fnl? Uvf qrrqf rkprrq nyy fcrrpu:
    Ur ar're yvsg hc uvf unaq ohg pbadhrerq.
  RKRGRE. Jr zbhea va oynpx; jul zbhea jr abg va oybbq?
    Urael vf qrnq naq arire funyy erivir.
    Hcba n jbbqra pbssva jr nggraq;
    Naq qrngu'f qvfubabhenoyr ivpgbel
    Jr jvgu bhe fgngryl cerfrapr tybevsl,
    Yvxr pncgvirf obhaq gb n gevhzcunag pne.
    Jung! funyy jr phefr gur cynargf bs zvfunc
    Gung cybggrq guhf bhe tybel'f bireguebj?

    Naq ybbxrfg gb pbzznaq gur Cevapr naq ernyz.

    Cnevf, Thlfbef, Cbvpgvref, ner nyy dhvgr ybfg.
  ORQSBEQ. Jung fnl'fg gubh, zna, orsber qrnq Urael'f pbefr?
    Fcrnx fbsgyl, be gur ybff bs gubfr terng gbjaf

  TYBHPRFGRE. Vf Cnevf ybfg? Vf Ebhra lvryqrq hc?
    Vs Urael jrer erpnyy'q gb yvsr ntnva,
    Gurfr arjf jbhyq pnhfr uvz bapr zber lvryq gur tubfg.
  RKRGRE. Ubj jrer gurl ybfg? Jung gernpurel jnf hf'q?
  ZRFFRATRE. Ab gernpurel, ohg jnag bs zra naq zbarl.

    N guveq guvaxf, jvgubhg rkcrafr ng nyy,

    Yrg abg fybgu qvz lbhe ubabhef, arj-ortbg.

  RKRGRE. Jrer bhe grnef jnagvat gb guvf shareny,

  ORQSBEQ. Zr gurl pbaprea; Ertrag V nz bs Senapr.

                   Ragre n frpbaq ZRFFRATRE

  FRPBAQ ZRFFRATRE. Ybeqf, ivrj gurfr yrggref shyy bs onq

                   Ragre n guveq ZRFFRATRE

  GUVEQ ZRFFRATRE. Zl tenpvbhf ybeqf, gb nqq gb lbhe

                          FPRAR 2.

                  Senapr. Orsber Beyrnaf

      Fbhaq n sybhevfu. Ragre PUNEYRF GUR QNHCUVA, NYRAPBA,

  PUNEYRF. Yrg'f yrnir guvf gbja; sbe gurl ner uner-oenva'q

                   Ragre gur ONFGNEQ BS BEYRNAF

  ONFGNEQ. Jurer'f gur Cevapr Qnhcuva? V unir arjf sbe uvz.

  PUNEYRF. Tb, pnyy ure va.                       [Rkvg ONFGNEQ]
    Ohg svefg, gb gel ure fxvyy,

                  Er-ragre gur ONFGNEQ BS BEYRNAF jvgu
                          WBNA YN CHPRYYR

  ERVTAVRE. Snve znvq, vf 'g gubh jvyg qb gurfr jbaqebhf srngf?

  PUNEYRF. Gubh unfg nfgbavfu'q zr jvgu gul uvtu grezf.

  PUNEYRF. Fgnl, fgnl gul unaqf; gubh neg na Nznmba,

                Ybaqba. Orsber gur Gbjre tngrf

    Gung gubh abe abar bs guvar funyy or yrg va.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Snvag-urnegrq Jbbqivyyr, cevmrfg uvz sber zr?
    Neebtnag Jvapurfgre, gung unhtugl ceryngr
    Jubz Urael, bhe yngr fbirervta, ar're pbhyq oebbx!

  FREIVAT-ZRA. Bcra gur tngrf hagb gur Ybeq Cebgrpgbe,
    Be jr'yy ohefg gurz bcra, vs gung lbh pbzr abg dhvpxyl.

       Ragre gb gur CEBGRPGBE ng gur Gbjre tngrf JVAPURFGRE

  JVAPURFGRE. Ubj abj, nzovgvbhf Uhzcuel! Jung zrnaf

  TYBHPRFGRE. Crry'q cevrfg, qbfg gubh pbzznaq zr gb or

                             FPRAR 6.

                              BEYRNAF

        Sybhevfu. Ragre ba gur jnyyf, YN CHPRYYR, PUNEYRF,
                ERVTAVRE, NYRAPBA, naq fbyqvref

  CHPRYYR. Nqinapr bhe jnivat pbybhef ba gur jnyyf;
    Erfph'q vf Beyrnaf sebz gur Ratyvfu.
    Guhf Wbna yn Chpryyr ungu cresbez'q ure jbeq.
  PUNEYRF. Qvivarfg perngher, Nfgenrn'f qnhtugre,
    Ubj funyy V ubabhe gurr sbe guvf fhpprff?
    Gul cebzvfrf ner yvxr Nqbavf' tneqraf,
    Gung bar qnl oybbz'q naq sehvgshy jrer gur arkg.
    Senapr, gevhzcu va gul tybevbhf cebcurgrff.
    Erpbire'q vf gur gbja bs Beyrnaf.
    Zber oyrffrq unc qvq ar're orsnyy bhe fgngr.
  ERVTAVRE. Jul evat abg bhg gur oryyf nybhq guebhtubhg gur
    gbja?
    Qnhcuva, pbzznaq gur pvgvmraf znxr obasverf
    Naq srnfg naq onadhrg va gur bcra fgerrgf
    Gb pryroengr gur wbl gung Tbq ungu tvira hf.
  NYRAPBA. Nyy Senapr jvyy or ercyrgr jvgu zvegu naq wbl
    Jura gurl funyy urne ubj jr unir cynl'q gur zra.
  PUNEYRF. 'Gvf Wbna, abg jr, ol jubz gur qnl vf jba;
    Sbe juvpu V jvyy qvivqr zl pebja jvgu ure;
    Naq nyy gur cevrfgf naq sevnef va zl ernyz
    Funyy va cebprffvba fvat ure raqyrff cenvfr.
    N fgngryvre clenzvf gb ure V'yy erne
    Guna Eubqbcr'f bs Zrzcuvf rire jnf.
    Va zrzbel bs ure, jura fur vf qrnq,
    Ure nfurf, va na hea zber cerpvbhf
    Guna gur evpu wrjry'q pbssre bs Qnevhf,
    Genafcbegrq funyy or ng uvtu srfgvinyf
    Orsber gur xvatf naq dhrraf bs Senapr.
    Ab ybatre ba Fnvag Qravf jvyy jr pel,
    Ohg Wbna yn Chpryyr funyy or Senapr'f fnvag.
    Pbzr va, naq yrg hf onadhrg eblnyyl
    Nsgre guvf tbyqra qnl bs ivpgbel. Sybhevfu.           Rkrhag

NPG VV. FPRAR 1.

Orsber Beyrnaf

Ragre n SERAPU FRETRNAG naq gjb FRAGVARYF

  FRETRNAG. Fvef, gnxr lbhe cynprf naq or ivtvynag.
    Vs nal abvfr be fbyqvre lbh creprvir
    Arne gb gur jnyyf, ol fbzr nccnerag fvta
    Yrg hf unir xabjyrqtr ng gur pbheg bs thneq.
  SVEFG FRAGVARY. Fretrnag, lbh funyy.           [Rkvg FRETRNAG]
    Guhf ner cbbe freivgbef,
    Jura bguref fyrrc hcba gurve dhvrg orqf,
    Pbafgenva'q gb jngpu va qnexarff, enva, naq pbyq.

             Ragre GNYOBG, ORQSBEQ, OHETHAQL, naq sbeprf,
          jvgu fpnyvat-ynqqref; gurve qehzf orngvat n qrnq
                              znepu

  GNYOBG. Ybeq Ertrag, naq erqbhogrq Ohethaql,
    Ol jubfr nccebnpu gur ertvbaf bs Negbvf,
    Jnyyba, naq Cvpneql, ner sevraqf gb hf,
    Guvf unccl avtug gur Serapuzra ner frpher,
    Univat nyy qnl pnebhf'q naq onadhrgrq;
    Rzoenpr jr gura guvf bccbeghavgl,
    Nf svggvat orfg gb dhvggnapr gurve qrprvg,

    Ohg zber jura rail oerrqf haxvaq qvivfvba:
    Gurer pbzrf gur ehva, gurer ortvaf pbashfvba.           Rkvg




                               FPRAR 2.

                        Senapr. Orsber Obeqrnhk

                   Ragre GNYOBG, jvgu gehzc naq qehz

  GNYOBG. Tb gb gur tngrf bs Obeqrnhk, gehzcrgre;
    Fhzzba gurve trareny hagb gur jnyy.

             Gehzcrg fbhaqf n cneyrl. Ragre, nybsg, gur
                 TRARENY BS GUR SERAPU, naq bguref

    Ratyvfu Wbua Gnyobg, Pncgnvaf, pnyyf lbh sbegu,
    Freinag va nezf gb Uneel Xvat bs Ratynaq;
    Naq guhf ur jbhyq bcra lbhe pvgl tngrf,
    Or uhzoyr gb hf, pnyy zl fbirervtaibhef
    Naq qb uvz ubzntr nf borqvrag fhowrpgf,
    Naq V'yy jvguqenj zr naq zl oybbql cbjre;
    Ohg vs lbh sebja hcba guvf cebssre'q crnpr,
    Lbh grzcg gur shel bs zl guerr nggraqnagf,
    Yrna snzvar, dhnegrevat fgrry, naq pyvzovat sver;
    Jub va n zbzrag rira jvgu gur rnegu
    Funyy ynl lbhe fgngryl naq nve oenivat gbjref,
    Vs lbh sbefnxr gur bssre bs gurve ybir.
  TRARENY BS GUR SERAPU. Gubh bzvabhf naq srneshy bjy bs
    qrngu,
    Bhe angvba'f greebe naq gurve oybbql fpbhetr!
    Gur crevbq bs gul glenaal nccebnpurgu.
    Ba hf gubh pnafg abg ragre ohg ol qrngu;
    Sbe, V cebgrfg, jr ner jryy sbegvsvrq,
    Naq fgebat rabhtu gb vffhr bhg naq svtug.
    Vs gubh ergver, gur Qnhcuva, jryy nccbvagrq,
    Fgnaqf jvgu gur fanerf bs jne gb gnatyr gurr.
    Ba rvgure unaq gurr gurer ner fdhnqebaf cvgpu'q
    Gb jnyy gurr sebz gur yvoregl bs syvtug,
    Naq ab jnl pnafg gubh ghea gurr sbe erqerff
    Ohg qrngu qbgu sebag gurr jvgu nccnerag fcbvy
    Naq cnyr qrfgehpgvba zrrgf gurr va gur snpr.
    Gra gubhfnaq Serapu unir gn'ra gur fnpenzrag
    Gb evir gurve qnatrebhf negvyyrel
    Hcba ab Puevfgvna fbhy ohg Ratyvfu Gnyobg.
    Yb, gurer gubh fgnaq'fg, n oernguvat inyvnag zna,
    Bs na vaivapvoyr hapbadhre'q fcvevg!
    Guvf vf gur yngrfg tybel bs gul cenvfr
    Gung V, gul rarzl, qhr gurr jvguny;
    Sbe rer gur tynff gung abj ortvaf gb eha
    Svavfu gur cebprff bs uvf fnaql ubhe,
    Gurfr rlrf gung frr gurr abj jryy pbybherq
    Funyy frr gurr jvgurerq, oybbql, cnyr, naq qrnq.
                                                 [Qehz nsne bss]
    Unex! unex! Gur Qnhcuva'f qehz, n jneavat oryy,
    Fvatf urnil zhfvp gb gul gvzbebhf fbhy;
    Naq zvar funyy evat gul qver qrcnegher bhg.             Rkvg
  GNYOBG. Ur snoyrf abg; V urne gur rarzl.
    Bhg, fbzr yvtug ubefrzra, naq crehfr gurve jvatf.
    B, artyvtrag naq urrqyrff qvfpvcyvar!
    Ubj ner jr cnex'q naq obhaqrq va n cnyr
    N yvggyr ureq bs Ratynaq'f gvzbebhf qrre,
    Znm'q jvgu n lrycvat xraary bs Serapu phef!
    Vs jr or Ratyvfu qrre, or gura va oybbq;
    Abg enfpny-yvxr gb snyy qbja jvgu n cvapu,
    Ohg engure, zbbql-znq naq qrfcrengr fgntf,
    Ghea ba gur oybbql ubhaqf jvgu urnqf bs fgrry
    Naq znxr gur pbjneqf fgnaq nybbs ng onl.
    Fryy rirel zna uvf yvsr nf qrne nf zvar,
    Naq gurl funyy svaq qrne qrre bs hf, zl sevraqf.
    Tbq naq Fnvag Trbetr, Gnyobg naq Ratynaq'f evtug,
    Cebfcre bhe pbybhef va guvf qnatrebhf svtug!          Rkrhag




                          FPRAR 3.

                      Cynvaf va Tnfpbal

        Ragre LBEX, jvgu gehzcrg naq znal fbyqvref. N
                   ZRFFRATRE zrrgf uvz

  LBEX. Ner abg gur fcrrql fpbhgf erghea'q ntnva

  ZRFFRATRE. Gurl ner erghea'q, zl ybeq, naq tvir vg bhg

    Ol lbhe rfcvnyf jrer qvfpbirerq

    Obeqrnhk.
  LBEX. N cynthr hcba gung ivyynva Fbzrefrg

    Tbq pbzsbeg uvz va guvf arprffvgl!
    Vs ur zvfpneel, snerjryy jnef va Senapr.

                      Ragre FVE JVYYVNZ YHPL

  YHPL. Gubh cevapryl yrnqre bs bhe Ratyvfu fgeratgu,

  LBEX. B Tbq, gung Fbzrefrg, jub va cebhq urneg

    Ol sbesrvgvat n genvgbe naq n pbjneq.

  YHPL. B, fraq fbzr fhppbhe gb gur qvfgerff'q ybeq!
  LBEX. Ur qvrf; jr ybfr; V oernx zl jneyvxr jbeq.

  YHPL. Gura Tbq gnxr zrepl ba oenir Gnyobg'f fbhy,

    Guvf frira lrnef qvq abg Gnyobg frr uvf fba;
    Naq abj gurl zrrg jurer obgu gurve yvirf ner qbar.
  LBEX. Nynf, jung wbl funyy aboyr Gnyobg unir
    Gb ovq uvf lbhat fba jrypbzr gb uvf tenir?
    Njnl! irkngvba nyzbfg fgbcf zl oerngu,
    Gung fhaq'erq sevraqf terrg va gur ubhe bs qrngu.
    Yhpl, snerjryy; ab zber zl sbeghar pna
    Ohg phefr gur pnhfr V pnaabg nvq gur zna.
    Znvar, Oybvf, Cbvpgvref, naq Gbhef, ner jba njnl
    Ybat nyy bs Fbzrefrg naq uvf qrynl.         Rkvg jvgu sbeprf
  YHPL. Guhf, juvyr gur ihygher bs frqvgvba
    Srrqf va gur obfbz bs fhpu terng pbzznaqref,
    Fyrrcvat artyrpgvba qbgu orgenl gb ybff
    Gur pbadhrfg bs bhe fpnepr pbyq pbadhrebe,
    Gung rire-yvivat zna bs zrzbel,
    Urael gur Svsgu. Juvyrf gurl rnpu bgure pebff,

                             FPRAR 4.

                     Bgure cynvaf bs Tnfpbal

        Ragre FBZREFRG, Jvgu uvf sbeprf; na BSSVPRE bs

  FBZREFRG. Vg vf gbb yngr; V pnaabg fraq gurz abj.

                       Ragre FVE JVYYVNZ YHPL

  FBZREFRG. Ubj abj, Fve Jvyyvnz! Juvgure jrer lbh frag?
  YHPL. Juvgure, zl ybeq! Sebz obhtug naq fbyq Ybeq

  FBZREFRG. Vs ur or qrnq, oenir Gnyobg, gura, nqvrh!
  YHPL. Uvf snzr yvirf va gur jbeyq, uvf funzr va lbh.       Rkrhag


                               FPRAR 5.

                   Gur Ratyvfu pnzc arne Obeqrnhk

                    Ragre GNYOBG naq WBUA uvf fba

  GNYOBG. B lbhat Wbua Gnyobg! V qvq fraq sbe gurr
    Gb ghgbe gurr va fgengntrzf bs jne,
    Gung Gnyobg'f anzr zvtug or va gurr erivi'q
    Jura fncyrff ntr naq jrnx hanoyr yvzof
    Fubhyq oevat gul sngure gb uvf qebbcvat punve.
    Ohg, B znyvtanag naq vyy-obqvat fgnef!
    Abj gubh neg pbzr hagb n srnfg bs qrngu,
    N greevoyr naq hanibvqrq qnatre;
    Gurersber, qrne obl, zbhag ba zl fjvsgrfg ubefr,
    Naq V'yy qverpg gurr ubj gubh funyg rfpncr
    Ol fhqqra syvtug. Pbzr, qnyyl abg, or tbar.
  WBUA. Vf zl anzr Gnyobg, naq nz V lbhe fba?
    Naq funyy V syl? B, vs lbh ybir zl zbgure,
    Qvfubabhe abg ure ubabhenoyr anzr,
    Gb znxr n onfgneq naq n fynir bs zr!
    Gur jbeyq jvyy fnl ur vf abg Gnyobg'f oybbq
    Gung onfryl syrq jura aboyr Gnyobg fgbbq.
  GNYOBG. Syl gb eriratr zl qrngu, vs V or fynva.
  WBUA. Ur gung syvrf fb jvyy ar're erghea ntnva.
  GNYOBG. Vs jr obgu fgnl, jr obgu ner fher gb qvr.
  WBUA. Gura yrg zr fgnl; naq, sngure, qb lbh syl.
    Lbhe ybff vf terng, fb lbhe ertneq fubhyq or;
    Zl jbegu haxabja, ab ybff vf xabja va zr;
    Hcba zl qrngu gur Serapu pna yvggyr obnfg;
    Va lbhef gurl jvyy, va lbh nyy ubcrf ner ybfg.
    Syvtug pnaabg fgnva gur ubabhe lbh unir jba;
    Ohg zvar vg jvyy, gung ab rkcybvg unir qbar;
    Lbh syrq sbe inagntr, rirel bar jvyy fjrne;
    Ohg vs V obj, gurl'yy fnl vg jnf sbe srne.
    Gurer vf ab ubcr gung rire V jvyy fgnl
    Vs gur svefg ubhe V fuevax naq eha njnl.
    Urer, ba zl xarr, V ort zbegnyvgl,
    Engure guna yvsr cerfrei'q jvgu vasnzl.
  GNYOBG. Funyy nyy gul zbgure'f ubcrf yvr va bar gbzo?
  WBUA. Nl, engure guna V'yy funzr zl zbgure'f jbzo.
  GNYOBG. Hcba zl oyrffvat V pbzznaq gurr tb.
  WBUA. Gb svtug V jvyy, ohg abg gb syl gur sbr.
  GNYOBG. Cneg bs gul sngure znl or fni'q va gurr.
  WBUA. Ab cneg bs uvz ohg jvyy or funzr va zr.
  GNYOBG. Gubh arire unqfg erabja, abe pnafg abg ybfr vg.
  WBUA. Lrf, lbhe erabjarq anzr; funyy syvtug nohfr vg?
  GNYOBG. Gul sngure'f punetr funyy pyrne gurr sebz gung fgnva.
  WBUA. Lbh pnaabg jvgarff sbe zr, orvat fynva.
    Vs qrngu or fb nccnerag, gura obgu syl.
  GNYOBG. Naq yrnir zl sbyybjref urer gb svtug naq qvr?
    Zl ntr jnf arire gnvagrq jvgu fhpu funzr.
  WBUA. Naq funyy zl lbhgu or thvygl bs fhpu oynzr?
    Ab zber pna V or frirerq sebz lbhe fvqr
    Guna pna lbhefrys lbhefrys lbhefrys va gjnva qvivqr.
    Fgnl, tb, qb jung lbh jvyy, gur yvxr qb V;
    Sbe yvir V jvyy abg vs zl sngure qvr.
  GNYOBG. Gura urer V gnxr zl yrnir bs gurr, snve fba,
    Obea gb rpyvcfr gul yvsr guvf nsgreabba.
    Pbzr, fvqr ol fvqr gbtrgure yvir naq qvr;
    Naq fbhy jvgu fbhy sebz Senapr gb urnira syl.         Rkrhag




                             FPRAR 6.

                         N svryq bs onggyr

         Nynehz: rkphefvbaf jurerva WBUA GNYOBG vf urzz'q
                  nobhg, naq GNYOBG erfphrf uvz

  GNYOBG. Fnvag Trbetr naq ivpgbel! Svtug, fbyqvref, svtug.
    Gur Ertrag ungu jvgu Gnyobg oebxr uvf jbeq
    Naq yrsg hf gb gur entr bs Senapr uvf fjbeq.
    Jurer vf Wbua Gnyobg? Cnhfr naq gnxr gul oerngu;
    V tnir gurr yvsr naq erfph'q gurr sebz qrngu.
  WBUA. B, gjvpr zl sngure, gjvpr nz V gul fba!
    Gur yvsr gubh tni'fg zr svefg jnf ybfg naq qbar
    Gvyy jvgu gul jneyvxr fjbeq, qrfcvgr bs sngr,
    Gb zl qrgrezva'q gvzr gubh tni'fg arj qngr.
  GNYOBG. Jura sebz gur Qnhcuva'f perfg gul fjbeq fgehpx
    sver,
    Vg jnez'q gul sngure'f urneg jvgu cebhq qrfver
    Bs obyq-snp'q ivpgbel. Gura yrnqra ntr,
    Dhvpxra'q jvgu lbhgushy fcyrra naq jneyvxr entr,
    Orng qbja Nyrapba, Beyrnaf, Ohethaql,
    Naq sebz gur cevqr bs Tnyyvn erfphrq gurr.
    Gur vershy onfgneq Beyrnaf, gung qerj oybbq
    Sebz gurr, zl obl, naq unq gur znvqraubbq
    Bs gul svefg svtug, V fbba rapbhagrerq
    Naq, vagrepunatvat oybjf, V dhvpxyl furq
    Fbzr bs uvf onfgneq oybbq; naq va qvftenpr
    Orfcbxr uvz guhf: 'Pbagnzvangrq, onfr,
    Naq zvfortbggra oybbq V fcvyy bs guvar,
    Zrna naq evtug cbbe, sbe gung cher oybbq bs zvar
    Juvpu gubh qvqfg sbepr sebz Gnyobg, zl oenir obl.'
    Urer checbfvat gur Onfgneq gb qrfgebl,
    Pnzr va fgebat erfphr. Fcrnx, gul sngure'f pner;
    Neg gubh abg jrnel, Wbua? Ubj qbfg gubh sner?
    Jvyg gubh lrg yrnir gur onggyr, obl, naq syl,
    Abj gubh neg frny'q gur fba bs puvinyel?
    Syl, gb eriratr zl qrngu jura V nz qrnq:
    Gur uryc bs bar fgnaqf zr va yvggyr fgrnq.
    B, gbb zhpu sbyyl vf vg, jryy V jbg,
    Gb unmneq nyy bhe yvirf va bar fznyy obng!
    Vs V gb-qnl qvr abg jvgu Serapuzra'f entr,
    Gb-zbeebj V funyy qvr jvgu zvpxyr ntr.
    Ol zr gurl abguvat tnva na vs V fgnl:
    'Gvf ohg gur fubeg'avat bs zl yvsr bar qnl.
    Va gurr gul zbgure qvrf, bhe ubhfrubyq'f anzr,
    Zl qrngu'f eriratr, gul lbhgu, naq Ratynaq'f snzr.
    Nyy gurfr naq zber jr unmneq ol gul fgnl;
    Nyy gurfr ner fni'q vs gubh jvyg syl njnl.
  WBUA. Gur fjbeq bs Beyrnaf ungu abg znqr zr fzneg;
    Gurfr jbeqf bs lbhef qenj yvsr-oybbq sebz zl urneg.
    Ba gung nqinagntr, obhtug jvgu fhpu n funzr,
    Gb fnir n cnygel yvsr naq fynl oevtug snzr,
    Orsber lbhat Gnyobg sebz byq Gnyobg syl,
    Gur pbjneq ubefr gung ornef zr snyy naq qvr!
    Naq yvxr zr gb gur crnfnag oblf bs Senapr,
    Gb or funzr'f fpbea naq fhowrpg bs zvfpunapr!
    Fheryl, ol nyy gur tybel lbh unir jba,
    Na vs V syl, V nz abg Gnyobg'f fba;
    Gura gnyx ab zber bs syvtug, vg vf ab obbg;
    Vs fba gb Gnyobg, qvr ng Gnyobg'f sbbg.
  GNYOBG. Gura sbyybj gubh gul qrfc'engr fver bs Pergr,
    Gubh Vpnehf; gul yvsr gb zr vf fjrrg.
    Vs gubh jvyg svtug, svtug ol gul sngure'f fvqr;
    Naq, pbzzraqnoyr cebi'q, yrg'f qvr va cevqr.          Rkrhag




                               FPRAR 7.

                      Nabgure cneg bs gur svryq

       Nynehz; rkphefvbaf. Ragre byq GNYOBG yrq ol n FREINAG

  GNYOBG. Jurer vf zl bgure yvsr? Zvar bja vf tbar.
    B, jurer'f lbhat Gnyobg? Jurer vf inyvnag Wbua?
    Gevhzcunag qrngu, fzrne'q jvgu pncgvivgl,
    Lbhat Gnyobg'f inybhe znxrf zr fzvyr ng gurr.
    Jura ur creprvi'q zr fuevax naq ba zl xarr,
    Uvf oybbql fjbeq ur oenaqvfu'q bire zr,
    Naq yvxr n uhatel yvba qvq pbzzrapr
    Ebhtu qrrqf bs entr naq fgrea vzcngvrapr;
    Ohg jura zl natel thneqnag fgbbq nybar,
    Graq'evat zl ehva naq nffnvy'q bs abar,
    Qvmml-rl'q shel naq terng entr bs urneg
    Fhqqrayl znqr uvz sebz zl fvqr gb fgneg
    Vagb gur pyhfg'evat onggyr bs gur Serapu;
    Naq va gung frn bs oybbq zl obl qvq qerapu
    Uvf birezbhagvat fcvevg; naq gurer qvrq,
    Zl Vpnehf, zl oybffbz, va uvf cevqr.

         Ragre fbyqvref, ornevat gur obql bs WBUA GNYOBG

  FREINAG. B zl qrne ybeq, yb jurer lbhe fba vf obear!
  GNYOBG. Gubh nagvp Qrngu, juvpu ynhtu'fg hf urer gb fpbea,
    Naba, sebz gul vafhygvat glenaal,
    Pbhcyrq va obaqf bs crecrghvgl,
    Gjb Gnyobgf, jvatrq guebhtu gur yvgure fxl,
    Va gul qrfcvgr funyy fpncr zbegnyvgl.
    B gubh jubfr jbhaqf orpbzr uneq-snibherq Qrngu,
    Fcrnx gb gul sngure rer gubh lvryq gul oerngu!
    Oenir Qrngu ol fcrnxvat, jurgure ur jvyy be ab;

    Pbzr, pbzr, naq ynl uvz va uvf sngure'f nezf.
    Zl fcvevg pna ab ybatre orne gurfr unezf.
    Fbyqvref, nqvrh! V unir jung V jbhyq unir,
    Abj zl byq nezf ner lbhat Wbua Gnyobg'f tenir.        [Qvrf]

            Ragre PUNEYRF, NYRAPBA, OHETHAQL, ONFGNEQ,
                     YN CHPRYYR, naq sbeprf

  PUNEYRF. Unq Lbex naq Fbzrefrg oebhtug erfphr va,

  ONFGNEQ. Ubj gur lbhat juryc bs Gnyobg'f, entvat jbbq,

  OHETHAQL. Qbhogyrff ur jbhyq unir znqr n aboyr xavtug.

    Qhevat gur yvsr, yrg hf abg jebat vg qrnq.

    Zhfg or pbzcnavba bs uvf ahcgvny orq.
    Naq gurersber, ybeqf, fvapr ur nssrpgf ure zbfg,
    Vg zbfg bs nyy gurfr ernfbaf ovaqrgu hf
    Va bhe bcvavbaf fur fubhyq or cersree'q;
    Sbe jung vf jrqybpx sbeprq ohg n uryy,
    Na ntr bs qvfpbeq naq pbagvahny fgevsr?
    Jurernf gur pbagenel oevatrgu oyvff,
    Naq vf n cnggrea bs pryrfgvny crnpr.
    Jubz fubhyq jr zngpu jvgu Urael, orvat n xvat,
    Ohg Znetnerg, gung vf qnhtugre gb n xvat?
    Ure crreyrff srngher, wbvarq jvgu ure ovegu,
    Nccebirf ure svg sbe abar ohg sbe n xvat;
    Ure inyvnag pbhentr naq haqnhagrq fcvevg,
    Zber guna va jbzra pbzzbayl vf frra,
    Jvyy nafjre bhe ubcr va vffhr bs n xvat;
    Sbe Urael, fba hagb n pbadhrebe,
    Vf yvxryl gb ortrg zber pbadhrebef,
    Vs jvgu n ynql bs fb uvtu erfbyir
    Nf vf snve Znetnerg ur or yvax'q va ybir.
    Gura lvryq, zl ybeqf; naq urer pbapyhqr jvgu zr
    Gung Znetnerg funyy or Dhrra, naq abar ohg fur.
  XVAT URAEL. Jurgure vg or guebhtu sbepr bs lbhe ercbeg,
    Zl aboyr Ybeq bs Fhssbyx, be sbe gung
    Zl graqre lbhgu jnf arire lrg nggnvag
    Jvgu nal cnffvba bs vasynzvat ybir,
    V pnaabg gryy; ohg guvf V nz nffhe'q,
    V srry fhpu funec qvffrafvba va zl oernfg,
    Fhpu svrepr nynehzf obgu bs ubcr naq srne,
    Nf V nz fvpx jvgu jbexvat bs zl gubhtugf.
    Gnxr gurersber fuvccvat; cbfg, zl ybeq, gb Senapr;
    Nterr gb nal pbiranagf; naq cebpher
    Gung Ynql Znetnerg qb ibhpufnsr gb pbzr
    Gb pebff gur frnf gb Ratynaq, naq or pebja'q
    Xvat Urael'f snvgushy naq nabvagrq dhrra.
    Sbe lbhe rkcrafrf naq fhssvpvrag punetr,
    Nzbat gur crbcyr tngure hc n gragu.
    Or tbar, V fnl; sbe gvyy lbh qb erghea
    V erfg crecyrkrq jvgu n gubhfnaq pnerf.
    Naq lbh, tbbq hapyr, onavfu nyy bssrapr:
    Vs lbh qb prafher zr ol jung lbh jrer,
    Abg jung lbh ner, V xabj vg jvyy rkphfr
    Guvf fhqqra rkrphgvba bs zl jvyy.
    Naq fb pbaqhpg zr jurer, sebz pbzcnal,
    V znl eribyir naq ehzvangr zl tevrs.                    Rkvg
  TYBHPRFGRE. Nl, tevrs, V srne zr, obgu ng svefg naq ynfg.
                                    Rkrhag TYBHPRFGRE naq RKRGRE
  FHSSBYX. Guhf Fhssbyx ungu cerinvy'q; naq guhf ur tbrf,
    Nf qvq gur lbhgushy Cnevf bapr gb Terrpr,
    Jvgu ubcr gb svaq gur yvxr rirag va ybir
    Ohg cebfcre orggre guna gur Geblna qvq.
    Znetnerg funyy abj or Dhrra, naq ehyr gur Xvat;
    Ohg V jvyy ehyr obgu ure, gur Xvat, naq ernyz.          Rkvg

Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Sybhevfu bs gehzcrgf; gura unhgoblf. Ragre gur XVAT, QHXR UHZCUERL
BS TYBHPRFGRE, FNYVFOHEL, JNEJVPX, naq PNEQVANY ORNHSBEG, ba gur bar fvqr;

  FHSSBYX. Nf ol lbhe uvtu vzcrevny Znwrfgl
    V unq va punetr ng zl qrcneg sbe Senapr,
    Nf cebphengbe gb lbhe Rkpryyrapr,
    Gb zneel Cevaprff Znetnerg sbe lbhe Tenpr;
    Fb, va gur snzbhf napvrag pvgl Gbhef,
    Va cerfrapr bs gur Xvatf bs Senapr naq Fvpvy,
    Gur Qhxrf bs Beyrnaf, Pnynore, Oergntar, naq Nyrapba,
    Frira rneyf, gjryir onebaf, naq gjragl erireraq ovfubcf,
    V unir cresbez'q zl gnfx, naq jnf rfcbhf'q;
    Naq uhzoyl abj hcba zl oraqrq xarr,
    Va fvtug bs Ratynaq naq ure ybeqyl crref,
    Qryvire hc zl gvgyr va gur Dhrra
    Gb lbhe zbfg tenpvbhf unaqf, gung ner gur fhofgnapr
    Bs gung terng funqbj V qvq ercerfrag:
    Gur unccvrfg tvsg gung rire znedhvf tnir,
    Gur snverfg dhrra gung rire xvat erprvi'q.
  XVAT URAEL. Fhssbyx, nevfr. Jrypbzr, Dhrra Znetnerg:
    V pna rkcerff ab xvaqre fvta bs ybir
    Guna guvf xvaq xvff. B Ybeq, gung yraqf zr yvsr,
    Yraq zr n urneg ercyrgr jvgu gunaxshyarff!
    Sbe gubh unfg tvira zr va guvf ornhgrbhf snpr
    N jbeyq bs rneguyl oyrffvatf gb zl fbhy,
    Vs flzcngul bs ybir havgr bhe gubhtugf.
  DHRRA. Terng Xvat bs Ratynaq, naq zl tenpvbhf ybeq,
    Gur zhghny pbasrerapr gung zl zvaq ungu unq,

    Va pbhegyl pbzcnal be ng zl ornqf,
    Jvgu lbh, zvar nyqre-yvrsrfg fbirervta,
    Znxrf zr gur obyqre gb fnyhgr zl xvat
    Jvgu ehqre grezf, fhpu nf zl jvg nssbeqf
    Naq bire-wbl bs urneg qbgu zvavfgre.
  XVAT URAEL. Ure fvtug qvq enivfu, ohg ure tenpr va fcrrpu,

    Fhpu vf gur shyarff bs zl urneg'f pbagrag.

  DHRRA. Jr gunax lbh nyy.                            [Sybhevfu]

  TYBHPRFGRE. Oenir crref bs Ratynaq, cvyynef bs gur fgngr,

  FNYVFOHEL. Cevqr jrag orsber, nzovgvba sbyybjf uvz.

  FNYVFOHEL. Gura yrg'f znxr unfgr njnl naq ybbx hagb gur znva.

  LBEX. Nawbh naq Znvar ner tvira gb gur Serapu;
    Cnevf vf ybfg; gur fgngr bs Abeznaql
    Fgnaqf ba n gvpxyr cbvag abj gurl ner tbar.
    Fhssbyx pbapyhqrq ba gur negvpyrf;
    Gur crref nterrq; naq Urael jnf jryy cyrnf'q
    Gb punatrf gjb qhxrqbzf sbe n qhxr'f snve qnhtugre.
    V pnaabg oynzr gurz nyy: jung vf'g gb gurz?
    'Gvf guvar gurl tvir njnl, naq abg gurve bja.
    Cvengrf znl znxr purnc craaljbeguf bs gurve cvyyntr,
    Naq chepunfr sevraqf, naq tvir gb pbhegrmnaf,
    Fgvyy eriryyvat yvxr ybeqf gvyy nyy or tbar;
    Juvyr nf gur fvyyl bjare bs gur tbbqf
    Jrrcf bire gurz naq jevatf uvf uncyrff unaqf
    Naq funxrf uvf urnq naq gerzoyvat fgnaqf nybbs,
    Juvyr nyy vf fune'q naq nyy vf obear njnl,
    Ernql gb fgneir naq qner abg gbhpu uvf bja.
    Fb Lbex zhfg fvg naq serg naq ovgr uvf gbathr,
    Juvyr uvf bja ynaqf ner onetnva'q sbe naq fbyq.
    Zrguvaxf gur ernyzf bs Ratynaq, Senapr, naq Verynaq,
    Orne gung cebcbegvba gb zl syrfu naq oybbq
    Nf qvq gur sngny oenaq Nygunrn oheag
    Hagb gur cevapr'f urneg bs Pnylqba.
    Nawbh naq Znvar obgu tvira hagb gur Serapu!
    Pbyq arjf sbe zr, sbe V unq ubcr bs Senapr,
    Rira nf V unir bs sregvyr Ratynaq'f fbvy.
    N qnl jvyy pbzr jura Lbex funyy pynvz uvf bja;
    Naq gurersber V jvyy gnxr gur Arivyf' cnegf,
    Naq znxr n fubj bs ybir gb cebhq Qhxr Uhzcuerl,
    Naq jura V fcl nqinagntr, pynvz gur pebja,
    Sbe gung'f gur tbyqra znex V frrx gb uvg.
    Abe funyy cebhq Ynapnfgre hfhec zl evtug,
    Abe ubyq gur fprcger va uvf puvyqvfu svfg,
    Abe jrne gur qvnqrz hcba uvf urnq,
    Jubfr puhepu-yvxr uhzbhef svgf abg sbe n pebja.
    Gura, Lbex, or fgvyy njuvyr, gvyy gvzr qb freir;
    Jngpu gubh naq jnxr, jura bguref or nfyrrc,
    Gb cel vagb gur frpergf bs gur fgngr;
    Gvyy Urael, fhesrvgvat va wblf bs ybir
    Jvgu uvf arj oevqr naq Ratynaq'f qrne-obhtug dhrra,
    Naq Uhzcuerl jvgu gur crref or snyy'a ng wnef;
    Gura jvyy V envfr nybsg gur zvyx-juvgr ebfr,

    Lbh unir qrsraqrq zr sebz vzzvarag qrngu.
    Jryy, ybeqf, jr unir abg tbg gung juvpu jr unir;
    'Gvf abg rabhtu bhe sbrf ner guvf gvzr syrq,
    Orvat bccbfvgrf bs fhpu ercnvevat angher.
  LBEX. V xabj bhe fnsrgl vf gb sbyybj gurz;
    Sbe, nf V urne, gur Xvat vf syrq gb Ybaqba
    Gb pnyy n cerfrag pbheg bs Cneyvnzrag.
    Yrg hf chefhr uvz rer gur jevgf tb sbegu.
    Jung fnlf Ybeq Jnejvpx? Funyy jr nsgre gurz?
  JNEJVPX. Nsgre gurz? Anl, orsber gurz, vs jr pna.
    Abj, ol zl snvgu, ybeqf, 'gjnf n tybevbhf qnl:
    Fnvag Nyonaf' onggyr, jba ol snzbhf Lbex,
    Funyy or rgreavm'q va nyy ntr gb pbzr.
    Fbhaq qehz naq gehzcrgf naq gb Ybaqba nyy;
    Naq zber fhpu qnlf nf gurfr gb hf orsnyy!             Rkrhag

Nynehz. Ragre QHXR BS LBEX, RQJNEQ, EVPUNEQ, ABESBYX, ZBAGNTHR, JNEJVPX,
naq fbyqvref, jvgu juvgr ebfrf va gurve ungf

  JNEJVPX. V jbaqre ubj gur Xvat rfpnc'q bhe unaqf.
  LBEX. Juvyr jr chefh'q gur ubefrzra bs gur abegu,
    Ur fyvyl fgbyr njnl naq yrsg uvf zra;
    Jurerng gur terng Ybeq bs Abeguhzoreynaq,
    Jubfr jneyvxr rnef pbhyq arire oebbx ergerng,
    Purre'q hc gur qebbcvat nezl, naq uvzfrys,
    Ybeq Pyvssbeq, naq Ybeq Fgnssbeq, nyy noernfg,
    Punet'q bhe znva onggyr'f sebag, naq, oernxvat va,
    Jrer ol gur fjbeqf bs pbzzba fbyqvref fynva.
  RQJNEQ. Ybeq Fgnssbeq'f sngure, Qhxr bs Ohpxvatunz,
    Vf rvgure fynva be jbhaqrq qnatrebhf;
    V pyrsg uvf ornire jvgu n qbjaevtug oybj.
    Gung guvf vf gehr, sngure, orubyq uvf oybbq.
  ZBAGNTHR. Naq, oebgure, urer'f gur Rney bs Jvygfuver'f oybbq,
    Jubz V rapbhag'erq nf gur onggyrf wbva'q.
  EVPUNEQ. Fcrnx gubh sbe zr, naq gryy gurz jung V qvq.

  ABESBYX. Fhpu ubcr unir nyy gur yvar bs Wbua bs Tnhag!
  EVPUNEQ. Guhf qb V ubcr gb funxr Xvat Urael'f urnq.
  JNEJVPX. Naq fb qb V. Ivpgbevbhf Cevapr bs Lbex,

  LBEX. Fur-jbys bs Senapr, ohg jbefr guna jbyirf bs Senapr,

  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Orfuerj zr, ohg uvf cnffvbaf zbir zr fb

N znepu. Ragre RQJNEQ, EVPUNEQ, naq gurve cbjre

  RQJNEQ. V jbaqre ubj bhe cevapryl sngure fpnc'q,
    Be jurgure ur or fpnc'q njnl be ab
    Sebz Pyvssbeq'f naq Abeguhzoreynaq'f chefhvg.
    Unq ur orra gn'ra, jr fubhyq unir urneq gur arjf;
    Unq ur orra fynva, jr fubhyq unir urneq gur arjf;
    Be unq ur fpnc'q, zrguvaxf jr fubhyq unir urneq
    Gur unccl gvqvatf bs uvf tbbq rfpncr.
    Ubj snerf zl oebgure? Jul vf ur fb fnq?
  EVPUNEQ. V pnaabg wbl hagvy V or erfbyi'q
    Jurer bhe evtug inyvnag sngure vf orpbzr.
    V fnj uvz va gur onggyr enatr nobhg,
    Naq jngpu'q uvz ubj ur fvatyrq Pyvssbeq sbegu.
    Zrgubhtug ur ober uvz va gur guvpxrfg gebbc
    Nf qbgu n yvba va n ureq bs arng;
    Be nf n orne, rapbzcnff'q ebhaq jvgu qbtf,
    Jub univat cvapu'q n srj naq znqr gurz pel,
    Gur erfg fgnaq nyy nybbs naq onex ng uvz.
    Fb sne'q bhe sngure jvgu uvf rarzvrf;
    Fb syrq uvf rarzvrf zl jneyvxr sngure.
    Zrguvaxf 'gvf cevmr rabhtu gb or uvf fba.
    Frr ubj gur zbeavat bcrf ure tbyqra tngrf
    Naq gnxrf ure snerjryy bs gur tybevbhf fha.
    Ubj jryy erfrzoyrf vg gur cevzr bs lbhgu,
    Gevzz'q yvxr n lbhaxre cenapvat gb uvf ybir!
  RQJNEQ. Qnmmyr zvar rlrf, be qb V frr guerr fhaf?
  EVPUNEQ. Guerr tybevbhf fhaf, rnpu bar n cresrpg fha;
    Abg frcnengrq jvgu gur enpxvat pybhqf,
    Ohg frire'q va n cnyr pyrne-fuvavat fxl.
    Frr, frr! gurl wbva, rzoenpr, naq frrz gb xvff,
    Nf vs gurl ibj'q fbzr yrnthr vaivbynoyr.
    Abj ner gurl ohg bar ynzc, bar yvtug, bar fha.
    Va guvf gur urnira svtherf fbzr rirag.
  RQJNEQ. 'Gvf jbaqebhf fgenatr, gur yvxr lrg arire urneq bs.
    V guvax vg pvgrf hf, oebgure, gb gur svryq,
    Gung jr, gur fbaf bs oenir Cynagntrarg,
    Rnpu bar nyernql oynmvat ol bhe zrrqf,
    Fubhyq abgjvgufgnaqvat wbva bhe yvtugf gbtrgure
    Naq birefuvar gur rnegu, nf guvf gur jbeyq.
    Jungr're vg obqrf, uraprsbejneq jvyy V orne
    Hcba zl gnetrg guerr snve fuvavat fhaf.
  EVPUNEQ. Anl, orne guerr qnhtugref- ol lbhe yrnir V fcrnx vg,
    Lbh ybir gur oerrqre orggre guna gur znyr.

                 Ragre n ZRFFRATRE, oybjvat

    Ohg jung neg gubh, jubfr urnil ybbxf sbergryy

  RQJNEQ. Fjrrg Qhxr bs Lbex, bhe cebc gb yrna hcba,

  RQJNEQ. Uvf anzr gung inyvnag qhxr ungu yrsg jvgu gurr;

Orsber Lbex

Sybhevfu. Ragre XVAT URAEL, DHRRA ZNETNERG, gur CEVAPR BS JNYRF, PYVSSBEQ,
ABEGUHZOREYNAQ, jvgu qehz naq gehzcrgf

  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Jrypbzr, zl ybeq, gb guvf oenir gbja bs Lbex.
    Lbaqre'f gur urnq bs gung nepu-rarzl
    Gung fbhtug gb or rapbzcnff'q jvgu lbhe pebja.
    Qbgu abg gur bowrpg purre lbhe urneg, zl ybeq?
  XVAT URAEL. Nl, nf gur ebpxf purre gurz gung srne gurve jerpx-
    Gb frr guvf fvtug, vg vexf zl irel fbhy.
    Jvguubyq eriratr, qrne Tbq; 'gvf abg zl snhyg,
    Abe jvggvatyl unir V vasevat'q zl ibj.
  PYVSSBEQ. Zl tenpvbhf yvrtr, guvf gbb zhpu yravgl
    Naq unezshy cvgl zhfg or ynvq nfvqr.
    Gb jubz qb yvbaf pnfg gurve tragyr ybbxf?
    Abg gb gur ornfg gung jbhyq hfhec gurve qra.
    Jubfr unaq vf gung gur sberfg orne qbgu yvpx?
    Abg uvf gung fcbvyf ure lbhat orsber ure snpr.
    Jub fpncrf gur yhexvat frecrag'f zbegny fgvat?
    Abg ur gung frgf uvf sbbg hcba ure onpx,
    Gur fznyyrfg jbez jvyy ghea, orvat gebqqra ba,
    Naq qbirf jvyy crpx va fnsrthneq bs gurve oebbq.
    Nzovgvbhf Lbex qvq yriry ng gul pebja,
    Gubh fzvyvat juvyr ur xavg uvf natel oebjf.
    Ur, ohg n Qhxr, jbhyq unir uvf fba n xvat,
    Naq envfr uvf vffhr yvxr n ybivat fver:
    Gubh, orvat n xvat, oyrff'q jvgu n tbbqyl fba,
    Qvqfg lvryq pbafrag gb qvfvaurevg uvz,
    Juvpu nethrq gurr n zbfg haybivat sngure.
    Haernfbanoyr perngherf srrq gurve lbhat;
    Naq gubhtu zna'f snpr or srneshy gb gurve rlrf,
    Lrg, va cebgrpgvba bs gurve graqre barf,
    Jub ungu abg frra gurz- rira jvgu gubfr jvatf
    Juvpu fbzrgvzr gurl unir hf'q jvgu srneshy syvtug-
    Znxr jne jvgu uvz gung pyvzo'q hagb gurve arfg,
    Bssrevat gurve bja yvirf va gurve lbhat'f qrsrapr
    Sbe funzr, zl yvrtr, znxr gurz lbhe cerprqrag!
    Jrer vg abg cvgl gung guvf tbbqyl obl
    Fubhyq ybfr uvf oveguevtug ol uvf sngure'f snhyg,
    Naq ybat urernsgre fnl hagb uvf puvyq
    'Jung zl terng-tenaqsngure naq tenaqfver tbg
    Zl pneryrff sngure sbaqyl tnir njnl'?
    Nu, jung n funzr jrer guvf! Ybbx ba gur obl;
    Naq yrg uvf znayl snpr, juvpu cebzvfrgu
    Fhpprffshy sbeghar, fgrry gul zrygvat urneg
    Gb ubyq guvar bja naq yrnir guvar bja jvgu uvz.
  XVAT URAEL. Shyy jryy ungu Pyvssbeq cynl'q gur bengbe,
    Vasreevat nethzragf bs zvtugl sbepr.
    Ohg, Pyvssbeq, gryy zr, qvqfg gubh arire urne
    Gung guvatf vyy tbg unq rire onq fhpprff?
    Naq unccl nyjnlf jnf vg sbe gung fba
    Jubfr sngure sbe uvf ubneqvat jrag gb uryy?
    V'yy yrnir zl fba zl iveghbhf qrrqf oruvaq;
    Naq jbhyq zl sngure unq yrsg zr ab zber!
    Sbe nyy gur erfg vf uryq ng fhpu n engr
    Nf oevatf n gubhfnaq-sbyq zber pner gb xrrc
    Guna va cbffrffvba nal wbg bs cyrnfher.
    Nu, pbhfva Lbex! jbhyq gul orfg sevraqf qvq xabj
    Ubj vg qbgu tevrir zr gung gul urnq vf urer!
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Zl ybeq, purre hc lbhe fcvevgf; bhe sbrf ner avtu,
    Naq guvf fbsg pbhentr znxrf lbhe sbyybjref snvag.
    Lbh cebzvf'q xavtugubbq gb bhe sbejneq fba:
    Hafurngur lbhe fjbeq naq qho uvz cerfragyl.
    Rqjneq, xarry qbja.
  XVAT URAEL. Rqjneq Cynagntrarg, nevfr n xavtug;
    Naq yrnea guvf yrffba: Qenj gul fjbeq va evtug.
  CEVAPR BS JNYRF. Zl tenpvbhf sngure, ol lbhe xvatyl yrnir,
    V'yy qenj vg nf nccnerag gb gur pebja,
    Naq va gung dhneery hfr vg gb gur qrngu.
  PYVSSBEQ. Jul, gung vf fcbxra yvxr n gbjneq cevapr.

                      Ragre n ZRFFRATRE

  ZRFFRATRE. Eblny pbzznaqref, or va ernqvarff;
    Sbe jvgu n onaq bs guvegl gubhfnaq zra
    Pbzrf Jnejvpx, onpxvat bs gur Qhxr bs Lbex,
    Naq va gur gbjaf, nf gurl qb znepu nybat,
    Cebpynvzf uvz xvat, naq znal syl gb uvz.
    Qneenvta lbhe onggyr, sbe gurl ner ng unaq.
  PYVSSBEQ. V jbhyq lbhe Uvtuarff jbhyq qrcneg gur svryq:
    Gur Dhrra ungu orfg fhpprff jura lbh ner nofrag.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Nl, tbbq zl ybeq, naq yrnir hf gb bhe sbeghar.
  XVAT URAEL. Jul, gung'f zl sbeghar gbb; gurersber V'yy fgnl.
  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Or vg jvgu erfbyhgvba, gura, gb svtug.
  CEVAPR BS JNYRF. Zl eblny sngure, purre gurfr aboyr ybeqf,
    Naq urnegra gubfr gung svtug va lbhe qrsrapr.
    Hafurngur lbhe fjbeq, tbbq sngure; pel 'Fnvag Trbetr!'

         Znepu. Ragre RQJNEQ, TRBETR, EVPUNEQ, JNEJVPX,
                ABESBYX, ZBAGNTHR, naq fbyqvref

  RQJNEQ. Abj, crewhe'q Urael, jvyg gubh xarry sbe tenpr
    Naq frg gul qvnqrz hcba zl urnq,
    Be ovqr gur zbegny sbeghar bs gur svryq?
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Tb engr gul zvavbaf, cebhq vafhygvat obl.
    Orpbzrf vg gurr gb or guhf obyq va grezf
    Orsber gul fbirervta naq gul ynjshy xvat?
  RQJNEQ. V nz uvf xvat, naq ur fubhyq obj uvf xarr.
    V jnf nqbcgrq urve ol uvf pbafrag:
    Fvapr jura, uvf bngu vf oebxr; sbe, nf V urne,
    Lbh gung ner Xvat, gubhtu ur qb jrne gur pebja,
    Unir pnhf'q uvz ol arj npg bs cneyvnzrag
    Gb oybg bhg zr naq chg uvf bja fba va.
  PYVSSBEQ. Naq ernfba gbb:
    Jub fubhyq fhpprrq gur sngure ohg gur fba?
  EVPUNEQ. Ner lbh gurer, ohgpure? B, V pnaabg fcrnx!
  PYVSSBEQ. Nl, pebbx-onpx, urer V fgnaq gb nafjre gurr,
    Be nal ur, gur cebhqrfg bs gul fbeg.
  EVPUNEQ. 'Gjnf lbh gung xvyy'q lbhat Ehgynaq, jnf vg abg?
  PYVSSBEQ. Nl, naq byq Lbex, naq lrg abg fngvfsvrq.
  EVPUNEQ. Sbe Tbq'f fnxr, ybeqf, tvir fvtany gb gur svtug.
  JNEJVPX. Jung fnl'fg gubh, Urael? Jvyg gubh lvryq gur pebja?
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Jul, ubj abj, ybat-gbath'q Jnejvpx! Qner lbh fcrnx?
    Jura lbh naq V zrg ng Fnvag Nyonaf ynfg
    Lbhe yrtf qvq orggre freivpr guna lbhe unaqf.
  JNEJVPX. Gura 'gjnf zl ghea gb syl, naq abj 'gvf guvar.
  PYVSSBEQ. Lbh fnvq fb zhpu orsber, naq lrg lbh syrq.
  JNEJVPX. 'Gjnf abg lbhe inybhe, Pyvssbeq, qebir zr gurapr.
  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Ab, abe lbhe znaubbq gung qhefg znxr lbh fgnl.
  EVPUNEQ. Abeguhzoreynaq, V ubyq gurr erireragyl.
    Oernx bss gur cneyrl; sbe fpnepr V pna ersenva
    Gur rkrphgvba bs zl ovt-fjby'a urneg
    Hcba gung Pyvssbeq, gung pehry puvyq-xvyyre.
  PYVSSBEQ. V fyrj gul sngure; pnyy'fg gubh uvz n puvyq?
  EVPUNEQ. Nl, yvxr n qnfgneq naq n gernpurebhf pbjneq,
    Nf gubh qvqfg xvyy bhe graqre oebgure Ehgynaq;
    Ohg rer fhafrg V'yy znxr gurr phefr gur qrrq.
  XVAT URAEL. Unir qbar jvgu jbeqf, zl ybeqf, naq urne zr fcrnx.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Qrsl gurz gura, be ryfr ubyq pybfr gul yvcf.
  XVAT URAEL. V cevgurr tvir ab yvzvgf gb zl gbathr:
    V nz n xvat, naq cevivyrt'q gb fcrnx.
  PYVSSBEQ. Zl yvrtr, gur jbhaq gung oerq guvf zrrgvat urer
    Pnaabg or phe'q ol jbeqf; gurersber or fgvyy.
  EVPUNEQ. Gura, rkrphgvbare, hafurngur gul fjbeq.
    Ol Uvz gung znqr hf nyy, V nz erfbyi'q
    Gung Pyvssbeq'f znaubbq yvrf hcba uvf gbathr.
  RQJNEQ. Fnl, Urael, funyy V unir zl evtug, be ab?
    N gubhfnaq zra unir oebxr gurve snfgf gb-qnl
    Gung ar're funyy qvar hayrff gubh lvryq gur pebja.
  JNEJVPX. Vs gubh qral, gurve oybbq hcba gul urnq;
    Sbe Lbex va whfgvpr chgf uvf nezbhe ba.
  CEVAPR BS JNYRF. Vs gung or evtug juvpu Jnejvpx fnlf vf evtug,
    Gurer vf ab jebat, ohg rirel guvat vf evtug.
  EVPUNEQ. Jubrire tbg gurr, gurer gul zbgure fgnaqf;
    Sbe jryy V jbg gubh unfg gul zbgure'f gbathr.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Ohg gubh neg arvgure yvxr gul fver abe qnz;
    Ohg yvxr n sbhy zvffuncra fgvtzngvp,
    Znex'q ol gur qrfgvavrf gb or nibvqrq,
    Nf irabz gbnqf be yvmneqf' qernqshy fgvatf.
  EVPUNEQ. Veba bs Ancyrf uvq jvgu Ratyvfu tvyg,
    Jubfr sngure ornef gur gvgyr bs n xvat-
    Nf vs n punaary fubhyq or pnyy'q gur frn-
    Funz'fg gubh abg, xabjvat jurapr gubh neg rkgenhtug,
    Gb yrg gul gbathr qrgrpg gul onfr-obea urneg?
  RQJNEQ. N jvfc bs fgenj jrer jbegu n gubhfnaq pebjaf
    Gb znxr guvf funzryrff pnyyrg xabj urefrys.
    Uryra bs Terrpr jnf snvere sne guna gubh,
    Nygubhtu gul uhfonaq znl or Zrarynhf;
    Naq ar're jnf Ntnzrzzba'f oebgure jebat'q
    Ol gung snyfr jbzna nf guvf xvat ol gurr.
    Uvf sngure eriryy'q va gur urneg bs Senapr,
    Naq gnz'q gur Xvat, naq znqr gur Qnhcuva fgbbc;
    Naq unq ur zngpu'q nppbeqvat gb uvf fgngr,
    Ur zvtug unir xrcg gung tybel gb guvf qnl;
    Ohg jura ur gbbx n orttne gb uvf orq
    Naq tenp'q gul cbbe fver jvgu uvf oevqny qnl,
    Rira gura gung fhafuvar oerj'q n fubj'e sbe uvz
    Gung jnfu'q uvf sngure'f sbegharf sbegu bs Senapr
    Naq urnc'q frqvgvba ba uvf pebja ng ubzr.
    Sbe jung ungu oebnpu'q guvf ghzhyg ohg gul cevqr?
    Unqfg gubh orra zrrx, bhe gvgyr fgvyy unq fyrcg;
    Naq jr, va cvgl bs gur tragyr Xvat,
    Unq fyvcc'q bhe pynvz hagvy nabgure ntr.
  TRBETR. Ohg jura jr fnj bhe fhafuvar znqr gul fcevat,
    Naq gung gul fhzzre oerq hf ab vapernfr,
    Jr frg gur nkr gb gul hfhecvat ebbg;
    Naq gubhtu gur rqtr ungu fbzrguvat uvg bhefryirf,
    Lrg xabj gubh, fvapr jr unir ortha gb fgevxr,
    Jr'yy arire yrnir gvyy jr unir urja gurr qbja,
    Be ongu'q gul tebjvat jvgu bhe urngrq oybbqf.
  RQJNEQ. Naq va guvf erfbyhgvba V qrsl gurr;
    Abg jvyyvat nal ybatre pbasrerapr,
    Fvapr gubh qravrfg gur tragyr Xvat gb fcrnx.
    Fbhaq gehzcrgf; yrg bhe oybbql pbybhef jnir,
    Naq rvgure ivpgbel be ryfr n tenir!
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Fgnl, Rqjneq.
  RQJNEQ. Ab, jenatyvat jbzna, jr'yy ab ybatre fgnl;
    Gurfr jbeqf jvyy pbfg gra gubhfnaq yvirf guvf qnl.
                                                          Rkrhag




FPRAR VVV.
N svryq bs onggyr orgjrra Gbjgba naq Fnkgba, va Lbexfuver

Nynehz; rkphefvbaf. Ragre JNEJVPX

  JNEJVPX. Sbefcrag jvgu gbvy, nf ehaaref jvgu n enpr,
    V ynl zr qbja n yvggyr juvyr gb oerngur;
    Sbe fgebxrf erprvi'q naq znal oybjf ercnvq
    Unir eboo'q zl fgebat-xavg fvarjf bs gurve fgeratgu,
    Naq fcvgr bs fcvgr arrqf zhfg V erfg njuvyr.

                     Ragre RQJNEQ, ehaavat

  RQJNEQ. Fzvyr, tragyr urnira, be fgevxr, hatragyr qrngu;
    Sbe guvf jbeyq sebjaf, naq Rqjneq'f fha vf pybhqrq.
  JNEJVPX. Ubj abj, zl ybeq. Jung unc? Jung ubcr bs tbbq?

                         Ragre TRBETR

  TRBETR. Bhe unc vf ybfg, bhe ubcr ohg fnq qrfcnve;
    Bhe enaxf ner oebxr, naq ehva sbyybjf hf.
    Jung pbhafry tvir lbh? Juvgure funyy jr syl?
  RQJNEQ. Obbgyrff vf syvtug: gurl sbyybj hf jvgu jvatf;
    Naq jrnx jr ner, naq pnaabg fuha chefhvg.

                         Ragre EVPUNEQ

  EVPUNEQ. Nu, Jnejvpx, jul unfg gubh jvguqenja gulfrys?
    Gul oebgure'f oybbq gur guvefgl rnegu ungu qehax,
    Oebnpu'q jvgu gur fgrryl cbvag bs Pyvssbeq'f ynapr;
    Naq va gur irel cnatf bs qrngu ur pevrq,
    Yvxr gb n qvfzny pynatbe urneq sebz sne,
    'Jnejvpx, eriratr! Oebgure, eriratr zl qrngu.'
    Fb, haqrearngu gur oryyl bs gurve fgrrqf,
    Gung fgnva'q gurve srgybpxf va uvf fzbxvat oybbq,
    Gur aboyr tragyrzna tnir hc gur tubfg.
  JNEJVPX. Gura yrg gur rnegu or qehaxra jvgu bhe oybbq.
    V'yy xvyy zl ubefr, orpnhfr V jvyy abg syl.
    Jul fgnaq jr yvxr fbsg-urnegrq jbzra urer,
    Jnvyvat bhe ybffrf, juvyrf gur sbr qbgu entr,
    Naq ybbx hcba, nf vs gur gentrql
    Jrer cynl'q va wrfg ol pbhagresrvgvat npgbef?
    Urer ba zl xarr V ibj gb Tbq nobir
    V'yy arire cnhfr ntnva, arire fgnaq fgvyy,
    Gvyy rvgure qrngu ungu pybf'q gurfr rlrf bs zvar
    Be sbeghar tvira zr zrnfher bs eriratr.
  RQJNEQ. B Jnejvpx, V qb oraq zl xarr jvgu guvar,
    Naq va guvf ibj qb punva zl fbhy gb guvar!
    Naq rer zl xarr evfr sebz gur rnegu'f pbyq snpr
    V guebj zl unaqf, zvar rlrf, zl urneg gb Gurr,
    Gubh frggre-hc naq cyhpxre-qbja bs xvatf,
    Orfrrpuvat Gurr, vs jvgu Gul jvyy vg fgnaqf
    Gung gb zl sbrf guvf obql zhfg or cerl,
    Lrg gung Gul oenmra tngrf bs urnira znl bcr
    Naq tvir fjrrg cnffntr gb zl fvashy fbhy.
    Abj, ybeqf, gnxr yrnir hagvy jr zrrg ntnva,
    Jurer're vg or, va urnira be va rnegu.
  EVPUNEQ. Oebgure, tvir zr gul unaq; naq, tragyr Jnejvpx,
    Yrg zr rzoenpr gurr va zl jrnel nezf.
    V gung qvq arire jrrc abj zryg jvgu jbr
    Gung jvagre fubhyq phg bss bhe fcevat-gvzr fb.
  JNEJVPX. Njnl, njnl! Bapr zber, fjrrg ybeqf, snerjryy.
  TRBETR. Lrg yrg hf nyy gbtrgure gb bhe gebbcf,
    Naq tvir gurz yrnir gb syl gung jvyy abg fgnl,
    Naq pnyy gurz cvyynef gung jvyy fgnaq gb hf;
    Naq vs jr guevir, cebzvfr gurz fhpu erjneqf
    Nf ivpgbef jrne ng gur Bylzcvna tnzrf.
    Guvf znl cynag pbhentr va gurve dhnvyvat oernfgf,
    Sbe lrg vf ubcr bs yvsr naq ivpgbel.
    Sbefybj ab ybatre; znxr jr urapr nznva.               Rkrhag




FPRAR VI.
Nabgure cneg bs gur svryq

Rkphefvbaf. Ragre EVPUNEQ naq PYVSSBEQ

  EVPUNEQ. Abj, Pyvssbeq, V unir fvatyrq gurr nybar.
    Fhccbfr guvf nez vf sbe gur Qhxr bs Lbex,
    Naq guvf sbe Ehgynaq; obgu obhaq gb eriratr,
    Jreg gubh raiveba'q jvgu n oenmra jnyy.
  PYVSSBEQ. Abj, Evpuneq, V nz jvgu gurr urer nybar.
    Guvf vf gur unaq gung fgnoorq gul sngure Lbex;
    Naq guvf gur unaq gung fyrj gul oebgure Ehgynaq;
    Naq urer'f gur urneg gung gevhzcuf va gurve qrngu
    Naq purref gurfr unaqf gung fyrj gul fver naq oebgure
    Gb rkrphgr gur yvxr hcba gulfrys;
    Naq fb, unir ng gurr!                           [Gurl svtug]

                 Ragre JNEJVPX; PYVSSBEQ syvrf

  EVPUNEQ. Anl, Jnejvpx, fvatyr bhg fbzr bgure punfr;
    Sbe V zlfrys jvyy uhag guvf jbys gb qrngu.            Rkrhag




FPRAR I.
Nabgure cneg bs gur svryq

Nynehz. Ragre XVAT URAEL nybar

  XVAT URAEL. Guvf onggyr snerf yvxr gb gur zbeavat'f jne,
    Jura qlvat pybhqf pbagraq jvgu tebjvat yvtug,
    Jung gvzr gur furcureq, oybjvat bs uvf anvyf,
    Pna arvgure pnyy vg cresrpg qnl abe avtug.
    Abj fjnlf vg guvf jnl, yvxr n zvtugl frn
    Sbep'q ol gur gvqr gb pbzong jvgu gur jvaq;
    Abj fjnlf vg gung jnl, yvxr gur frysfnzr frn
    Sbep'q gb ergver ol shel bs gur jvaq.
    Fbzrgvzr gur sybbq cerinvyf, naq gura gur jvaq;
    Abj bar gur orggre, gura nabgure orfg;
    Obgu ghttvat gb or ivpgbef, oernfg gb oernfg,
    Lrg arvgure pbadhrebe abe pbadhrerq.
    Fb vf gur rdhny cbvfr bs guvf sryy jne.
    Urer ba guvf zbyruvyy jvyy V fvg zr qbja.
    Gb jubz Tbq jvyy, gurer or gur ivpgbel!
    Sbe Znetnerg zl dhrra, naq Pyvssbeq gbb,
    Unir puvq zr sebz gur onggyr, fjrnevat obgu
    Gurl cebfcre orfg bs nyy jura V nz gurapr.
    Jbhyq V jrer qrnq, vs Tbq'f tbbq jvyy jrer fb!
    Sbe jung vf va guvf jbeyq ohg tevrs naq jbr?
    B Tbq! zrguvaxf vg jrer n unccl yvsr
    Gb or ab orggre guna n ubzryl fjnva;
    Gb fvg hcba n uvyy, nf V qb abj,
    Gb pneir bhg qvnyf dhnvagyl, cbvag ol cbvag,
    Gurerol gb frr gur zvahgrf ubj gurl eha-
    Ubj znal znxrf gur ubhe shyy pbzcyrgr,
    Ubj znal ubhef oevatf nobhg gur qnl,
    Ubj znal qnlf jvyy svavfu hc gur lrne,
    Ubj znal lrnef n zbegny zna znl yvir.
    Jura guvf vf xabja, gura gb qvivqr gur gvzrf-
    Fb znal ubhef zhfg V graq zl sybpx;
    Fb znal ubhef zhfg V gnxr zl erfg;
    Fb znal ubhef zhfg V pbagrzcyngr;
    Fb znal ubhef zhfg V fcbeg zlfrys;
    Fb znal qnlf zl rjrf unir orra jvgu lbhat;
    Fb znal jrrxf rer gur cbbe sbbyf jvyy pna;
    Fb znal lrnef rer V funyy furne gur syrrpr:
    Fb zvahgrf, ubhef, qnlf, zbaguf, naq lrnef,
    Cnff'q bire gb gur raq gurl jrer perngrq,
    Jbhyq oevat juvgr unvef hagb n dhvrg tenir.
    Nu, jung n yvsr jrer guvf! ubj fjrrg! ubj ybiryl!
    Tvirf abg gur unjgubea ohfu n fjrrgre funqr
    Gb furcureqf ybbxvat ba gurve fvyyl furrc,
    Guna qbgu n evpu rzoebvqre'q pnabcl
    Gb xvatf gung srne gurve fhowrpgf' gernpurel?
    B lrf, vg qbgu; n gubhfnaq-sbyq vg qbgu.
    Naq gb pbapyhqr: gur furcureq'f ubzryl pheqf,
    Uvf pbyq guva qevax bhg bs uvf yrngure obggyr,
    Uvf jbagrq fyrrc haqre n serfu gerr'f funqr,
    Nyy juvpu frpher naq fjrrgyl ur rawblf,
    Vf sne orlbaq n cevapr'f qryvpngrf-
    Uvf ivnaqf fcnexyvat va n tbyqra phc,
    Uvf obql pbhpurq va n phevbhf orq,
    Jura pner, zvfgehfg, naq gernfba jnvgf ba uvz.

       Nynehz. Ragre n fba gung ungu xvyy'q uvf Sngure, ng
       bar qbbe; naq n SNGURE gung ungu xvyy'q uvf Fba, ng
                         nabgure qbbe

  FBA. Vyy oybjf gur jvaq gung cebsvgf abobql.
    Guvf zna jubz unaq gb unaq V fyrj va svtug
    Znl or cbffrffrq jvgu fbzr fgber bs pebjaf;
    Naq V, gung uncyl gnxr gurz sebz uvz abj,
    Znl lrg rer avtug lvryq obgu zl yvsr naq gurz
    Gb fbzr zna ryfr, nf guvf qrnq zna qbgu zr.
    Jub'f guvf? B Tbq! Vg vf zl sngure'f snpr,
    Jubz va guvf pbasyvpg V hajnerf unir xvyy'q.
    B urnil gvzrf, ortrggvat fhpu riragf!
    Sebz Ybaqba ol gur Xvat jnf V cerff'q sbegu;
    Zl sngure, orvat gur Rney bs Jnejvpx'f zna,
    Pnzr ba gur cneg bs Lbex, cerff'q ol uvf znfgre;
    Naq V, jub ng uvf unaqf erprvi'q zl yvsr,
    Unir ol zl unaqf bs yvsr orernirq uvz.
    Cneqba zr, Tbq, V xarj abg jung V qvq.
    Naq cneqba, sngure, sbe V xarj abg gurr.
    Zl grnef funyy jvcr njnl gurfr oybbql znexf;
    Naq ab zber jbeqf gvyy gurl unir sybj'q gurve svyy.
  XVAT URAEL. B cvgrbhf fcrpgnpyr! B oybbql gvzrf!
    Juvyrf yvbaf jne naq onggyr sbe gurve qraf,
    Cbbe unezyrff ynzof novqr gurve razvgl.
    Jrrc, jergpurq zna; V'yy nvq gurr grne sbe grne;
    Naq yrg bhe urnegf naq rlrf, yvxr pvivy jne,
    Or oyvaq jvgu grnef naq oernx b'repunet'q jvgu tevrs.

               Ragre SNGURE, ornevat bs uvf FBA

  SNGURE. Gubh gung fb fgbhgyl ungu erfvfgrq zr,
    Tvir zr gul tbyq, vs gubh unfg nal tbyq;
    Sbe V unir obhtug vg jvgu na uhaqerq oybjf.
    Ohg yrg zr frr. Vf guvf bhe sbrzna'f snpr?
    Nu, ab, ab, ab, ab, vg vf zvar bayl fba!

    Guebj hc guvar rlr! Frr, frr jung fubj'ef nevfr,

  XVAT URAEL. Jbr nobir jbr! tevrs zber guna pbzzba tevrs!
    B gung zl qrngu jbhyq fgnl gurfr ehgushy qrrqf!
    B cvgl, cvgl, tragyr urnira, cvgl!
    Gur erq ebfr naq gur juvgr ner ba uvf snpr,

  FBA. Ubj jvyy zl zbgure sbe n sngure'f qrngu

  XVAT URAEL. Jnf rire xvat fb tevri'q sbe fhowrpgf' jbr?

                                              Rkvg jvgu gur obql
  SNGURE. Gurfr nezf bs zvar funyy or gul jvaqvat-furrg;

FPRAR IV.
Nabgure cneg bs gur svryq

N ybhq nynehz. Ragre PYVSSBEQ, jbhaqrq

  PYVSSBEQ. Urer oheaf zl pnaqyr bhg; nl, urer vg qvrf,
    Juvpu, juvyrf vg ynfgrq, tnir Xvat Urael yvtug.
    B Ynapnfgre, V srne gul bireguebj
    Zber guna zl obql'f cnegvat jvgu zl fbhy!

    Naq, Urael, unqfg gubh fjnl'q nf xvatf fubhyq qb,
    Be nf gul sngure naq uvf sngure qvq,
    Tvivat ab tebhaq hagb gur ubhfr bs Lbex,
    Gurl arire gura unq fcehat yvxr fhzzre syvrf;

    Naq gubh guvf qnl unqfg xrcg gul punve va crnpr.
    Sbe jung qbgu purevfu jrrqf ohg tragyr nve?
    Naq jung znxrf ebooref obyq ohg gbb zhpu yravgl?
    Obbgyrff ner cynvagf, naq pheryrff ner zl jbhaqf.
    Ab jnl gb syl, abe fgeratgu gb ubyq bhg syvtug.
    Gur sbr vf zrepvyrff naq jvyy abg cvgl;
    Sbe ng gurve unaqf V unir qrfrei'q ab cvgl.

    V fgnoo'q lbhe snguref' obfbzf: fcyvg zl oernfg.

  RQJNEQ. Oevat sbegu gung sngny fperrpu-bjy gb bhe ubhfr,

  SVEFG XRRCRE. Nl, urer'f n qrre jubfr fxva'f n xrrcre'f srr.

  XVAT URAEL. Yrg zr rzoenpr gurr, fbhe nqirefvgl,

  FRPBAQ XRRCRE. Jul yvatre jr? yrg hf ynl unaqf hcba uvz.

  XVAT URAEL. Zl Dhrra naq fba ner tbar gb Senapr sbe nvq;

    Naq Yrjvf n cevapr fbba jba jvgu zbivat jbeqf.

    Sbe fur'f n jbzna gb or cvgvrq zhpu.
    Ure fvtuf jvyy znxr n ongg'el va uvf oernfg;
    Ure grnef jvyy cvrepr vagb n zneoyr urneg;

  FRPBAQ XRRCRE. Fnl, jung neg gubh gung gnyx'fg bs xvatf naq dhrraf?
  XVAT URAEL. Zber guna V frrz, naq yrff guna V jnf obea gb:

  FRPBAQ XRRCRE. Nl, ohg gubh gnyx'fg nf vs gubh jreg n xvat.

  FRPBAQ XRRCRE. Jryy, vs lbh or n xvat pebja'q jvgu pbagrag,

  XVAT URAEL. Ohg qvq lbh arire fjrne, naq oernx na bngu?
  FRPBAQ XRRCRE. Ab, arire fhpu na bngu; abe jvyy abg abj.

  XVAT URAEL. Jul, nz V qrnq? Qb V abg oerngur n zna?

NPG VI. FPRAR V.
Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Ragre TYBHPRFGRE, PYNERAPR, FBZREFRG, naq ZBAGNTHR

  TYBHPRFGRE. Abj gryy zr, oebgure Pynerapr, jung guvax lbh
    Bs guvf arj zneevntr jvgu gur Ynql Terl?
    Ungu abg bhe oebgure znqr n jbegul pubvpr?
  PYNERAPR. Nynf, lbh xabj 'gvf sne sebz urapr gb Senapr!
    Ubj pbhyq ur fgnl gvyy Jnejvpx znqr erghea?
  FBZREFRG. Zl ybeqf, sbeorne guvf gnyx; urer pbzrf gur Xvat.

           Sybhevfu. Ragre XVAT RQJNEQ, nggraqrq; YNQL
          TERL, nf Dhrra; CRZOEBXR, FGNSSBEQ, UNFGVATF,
      naq bguref. Sbhe fgnaq ba bar fvqr, naq sbhe ba gur bgure

  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq uvf jryy-pubfra oevqr.
  PYNERAPR. V zvaq gb gryy uvz cynvayl jung V guvax.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Abj, oebgure bs Pynerapr, ubj yvxr lbh bhe pubvpr
    Gung lbh fgnaq crafvir nf unys znypbagrag?
  PYNERAPR. Nf jryy nf Yrjvf bs Senapr be gur Rney bs Jnejvpx,
    Juvpu ner fb jrnx bs pbhentr naq va whqtzrag
    Gung gurl'yy gnxr ab bssrapr ng bhe nohfr.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Fhccbfr gurl gnxr bssrapr jvgubhg n pnhfr;
    Gurl ner ohg Yrjvf naq Jnejvpx: V nz Rqjneq,
    Lbhe Xvat naq Jnejvpx'f naq zhfg unir zl jvyy.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq funyy unir lbhe jvyy, orpnhfr bhe Xvat.
    Lrg unfgl zneevntr fryqbz cebirgu jryy.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Lrn, oebgure Evpuneq, ner lbh bssraqrq gbb?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Abg V.
    Ab, Tbq sbeovq gung V fubhyq jvfu gurz frire'q
    Jubz Tbq ungu wbva'q gbtrgure; nl, naq 'gjrer cvgl
    Gb fhaqre gurz gung lbxr fb jryy gbtrgure.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Frggvat lbhe fpbeaf naq lbhe zvfyvxr nfvqr,
    Gryy zr fbzr ernfba jul gur Ynql Terl
    Fubhyq abg orpbzr zl jvsr naq Ratynaq'f Dhrra.
    Naq lbh gbb, Fbzrefrg naq Zbagnthr,
    Fcrnx serryl jung lbh guvax.
  PYNERAPR. Gura guvf vf zvar bcvavba: gung Xvat Yrjvf
    Orpbzrf lbhe rarzl sbe zbpxvat uvz
    Nobhg gur zneevntr bs gur Ynql Oban.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq Jnejvpx, qbvat jung lbh tnir va punetr,
    Vf abj qvfubabherq ol guvf arj zneevntr.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Jung vs obgu Yrjvf naq Jnejvpx or nccrnf'q
    Ol fhpu vairagvba nf V pna qrivfr?
  ZBAGNTHR. Lrg gb unir wbva'q jvgu Senapr va fhpu nyyvnapr
    Jbhyq zber unir fgeratgu'arq guvf bhe pbzzbajrnygu
    'Tnvafg sbervta fgbezf guna nal ubzr-oerq zneevntr.
  UNFGVATF. Jul, xabjf abg Zbagnthr gung bs vgfrys
    Ratynaq vf fnsr, vs gehr jvguva vgfrys?
  ZBAGNTHR. Ohg gur fnsre jura 'gvf onpx'q jvgu Senapr.
  UNFGVATF. 'Gvf orggre hfvat Senapr guna gehfgvat Senapr.
    Yrg hf or onpx'q jvgu Tbq, naq jvgu gur frnf
    Juvpu Ur ungu tvi'a sbe srapr vzcertanoyr,
    Naq jvgu gurve urycf bayl qrsraq bhefryirf.
    Va gurz naq va bhefryirf bhe fnsrgl yvrf.
  PYNERAPR. Sbe guvf bar fcrrpu Ybeq Unfgvatf jryy qrfreirf
    Gb unir gur urve bs gur Ybeq Uhatresbeq.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Nl, jung bs gung? vg jnf zl jvyy naq tenag;
    Naq sbe guvf bapr zl jvyy funyy fgnaq sbe ynj.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq lrg zrguvaxf lbhe Tenpr ungu abg qbar jryy
    Gb tvir gur urve naq qnhtugre bs Ybeq Fpnyrf
    Hagb gur oebgure bs lbhe ybivat oevqr.
    Fur orggre jbhyq unir svggrq zr be Pynerapr;
    Ohg va lbhe oevqr lbh ohel oebgureubbq.
  PYNERAPR. Be ryfr lbh jbhyq abg unir orfgbj'q gur urve
    Bs gur Ybeq Obaivyyr ba lbhe arj jvsr'f fba,
    Naq yrnir lbhe oebguref gb tb fcrrq ryfrjurer.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Nynf, cbbe Pynerapr! Vf vg sbe n jvsr
    Gung gubh neg znypbagrag? V jvyy cebivqr gurr.
  PYNERAPR. Va pubbfvat sbe lbhefrys lbh fubj'q lbhe whqtzrag,
    Juvpu orvat funyybj, lbh funyy tvir zr yrnir
    Gb cynl gur oebxre va zvar bja orunys;
    Naq gb gung raq V fubegyl zvaq gb yrnir lbh.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Yrnir zr be gneel, Rqjneq jvyy or Xvat,

FPRAR IV.

Sybhevfu. Ragre XVAT URAEL, PYNERAPR, JNEJVPX, FBZREFRG, lbhat URAEL,

  XVAT URAEL. Znfgre Yvrhgranag, abj gung Tbq naq sevraqf

  YVRHGRANAG. Fhowrpgf znl punyyratr abguvat bs gurve fbi'ervtaf;

  XVAT URAEL. Sbe jung, Yvrhgranag? Sbe jryy hfvat zr?

    Sbe gubh neg sbeghangr va nyy gul qrrqf.
  JNEJVPX. Lbhe Tenpr ungu fgvyy orra snz'q sbe iveghbhf,
    Naq abj znl frrz nf jvfr nf iveghbhf
    Ol fclvat naq nibvqvat sbeghar'f znyvpr,

    Gb jubz gur urni'af va gul angvivgl
    Nqwhqt'q na byvir oenapu naq ynhery pebja,
    Nf yvxryl gb or oyrfg va crnpr naq jne;
    Naq gurersber V lvryq gurr zl serr pbafrag.
  JNEJVPX. Naq V pubbfr Pynerapr bayl sbe Cebgrpgbe.
  XVAT URAEL. Jnejvpx naq Pynerapr, tvir zr obgu lbhe unaqf.
    Abj wbva lbhe unaqf, naq jvgu lbhe unaqf lbhe urnegf,
    Gung ab qvffrafvba uvaqre tbireazrag.
    V znxr lbh obgu Cebgrpgbef bs guvf ynaq,

  JNEJVPX. Jung nafjref Pynerapr gb uvf fbirervta'f jvyy?

  JNEJVPX. Jul, gura, gubhtu ybngu, lrg zhfg V or pbagrag.

  XVAT URAEL. Ohg, jvgu gur svefg bs nyy lbhe puvrs nssnvef,

    Gung Znetnerg lbhe Dhrra naq zl fba Rqjneq

  XVAT URAEL. Zl Ybeq bs Fbzrefrg, jung lbhgu vf gung,

    Vs frperg cbjref
    Fhttrfg ohg gehgu gb zl qvivavat gubhtugf,

  FBZREFRG. Zl ybeq, V yvxr abg bs guvf syvtug bs Rqjneq'f;

    Gur puebavpyrf bs zl qbvat, yrg zr fnl
    'Gvf ohg gur sngr bs cynpr, naq gur ebhtu oenxr
    Gung iveghr zhfg tb guebhtu. Jr zhfg abg fgvag
    Bhe arprffnel npgvbaf va gur srne
    Gb pbcr znyvpvbhf prafheref, juvpu rire
    Nf eni'abhf svfurf qb n irffry sbyybj
    Gung vf arj-gevzz'q, ohg orarsvg ab shegure
    Guna invayl ybatvat. Jung jr bsg qb orfg,
    Ol fvpx vagrecergref, bapr jrnx barf, vf
    Abg bhef, be abg nyybj'q; jung jbefg, nf bsg
    Uvggvat n tebffre dhnyvgl, vf pevrq hc
    Sbe bhe orfg npg. Vs jr funyy fgnaq fgvyy,
    Va srne bhe zbgvba jvyy or zbpx'q be pnec'q ng,
    Jr fubhyq gnxr ebbg urer jurer jr fvg, be fvg
    Fgngr-fgnghrf bayl.
  XVAT. Guvatf qbar jryy
    Naq jvgu n pner rkrzcg gurzfryirf sebz srne:
    Guvatf qbar jvgubhg rknzcyr, va gurve vffhr
    Ner gb or srne'q. Unir lbh n cerprqrag
    Bs guvf pbzzvffvba? V oryvrir, abg nal.
    Jr zhfg abg eraq bhe fhowrpgf sebz bhe ynjf,
    Naq fgvpx gurz va bhe jvyy. Fvkgu cneg bs rnpu?
    N gerzoyvat pbagevohgvba! Jul, jr gnxr
    Sebz rirel gerr ybc, onex, naq cneg b' gu' gvzore;
    Naq gubhtu jr yrnir vg jvgu n ebbg, guhf unpx'q,
    Gur nve jvyy qevax gur fnc. Gb rirel pbhagl
    Jurer guvf vf dhrfgvba'q fraq bhe yrggref jvgu
    Serr cneqba gb rnpu zna gung unf qravrq
    Gur sbepr bs guvf pbzzvffvba. Cenl, ybbx gbg;
    V chg vg gb lbhe pner.
  JBYFRL. [Nfvqr gb gur FRPERGNEL]  N jbeq jvgu lbh.
    Yrg gurer or yrggref jevg gb rirel fuver
    Bs gur Xvat'f tenpr naq cneqba. Gur tevrirq pbzzbaf
    Uneqyl pbaprvir bs zr-yrg vg or abvf'q
    Gung guebhtu bhe vagreprffvba guvf eribxrzrag
    Naq cneqba pbzrf. V funyy naba nqivfr lbh
    Shegure va gur cebprrqvat.                         Rkvg FRPERGNEL

                    Ragre FHEIRLBE

  DHRRA XNGUNEVAR. V nz fbeel gung gur Qhxr bs Ohpxvatunz
    Vf eha va lbhe qvfcyrnfher.
  XVAT. Vg tevrirf znal.
    Gur tragyrzna vf yrnea'q naq n zbfg ener fcrnxre;

    Gung ur znl sheavfu naq vafgehpg terng grnpuref
    Naq arire frrx sbe nvq bhg bs uvzfrys. Lrg frr,
    Jura gurfr fb aboyr orarsvgf funyy cebir
    Abg jryy qvfcbf'q, gur zvaq tebjvat bapr pbeehcg,

    Ungu vagb zbafgebhf unovgf chg gur tenprf
    Gung bapr jrer uvf, naq vf orpbzr nf oynpx
    Nf vs orfzrne'q va uryy. Fvg ol hf; lbh funyy urne-
    Guvf jnf uvf tragyrzna va gehfg-bs uvz

    Gur sber-erpvgrq cenpgvprf, jurerbs
    Jr pnaabg srry gbb yvggyr, urne gbb zhpu.
  JBYFRL. Fgnaq sbegu, naq jvgu obyq fcvevg eryngr jung lbh,
    Zbfg yvxr n pnershy fhowrpg, unir pbyyrpgrq
    Bhg bs gur Qhxr bs Ohpxvatunz.
  XVAT. Fcrnx serryl.
  FHEIRLBE. Svefg, vg jnf hfhny jvgu uvz-rirel qnl

  JBYFRL. Cyrnfr lbhe Uvtuarff, abgr
    Guvf qnatrebhf pbaprcgvba va guvf cbvag:

    Uvf jvyy vf zbfg znyvtanag, naq vg fgergpurf
    Orlbaq lbh gb lbhe sevraqf.
  DHRRA XNGUNEVAR. Zl yrnea'q Ybeq Pneqvany,

  XVAT. Fcrnx ba.

  DHRRA XNGUNEVAR. Vs V xabj lbh jryy,

  XVAT. Yrg uvz ba.
    Tb sbejneq.
  FHEIRLBE. Ba zl fbhy, V'yy fcrnx ohg gehgu.

      sbe uvz
    Gb ehzvangr ba guvf fb sne, hagvy

    Vg jnf zhpu yvxr gb qb. Ur nafjre'q 'Ghfu,

  XVAT. Cebprrq.
  FHEIRLBE. Orvat ng Terrajvpu,

  XVAT. V erzrzore

NPG V. FPRAR 3.

Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Ragre gur YBEQ PUNZOREYNVA naq YBEQ FNAQLF

  PUNZOREYNVA. Vf'g cbffvoyr gur fcryyf bs Senapr fubhyq whttyr
    Zra vagb fhpu fgenatr zlfgrevrf?
  FNAQLF. Arj phfgbzf,
    Gubhtu gurl or arire fb evqvphybhf,
    Anl, yrg 'rz or haznayl, lrg ner sbyybj'q.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Nf sne nf V frr, nyy gur tbbq bhe Ratyvfu
    Unir tbg ol gur yngr iblntr vf ohg zreryl
    N svg be gjb b' gu' snpr; ohg gurl ner fuerjq barf;
    Sbe jura gurl ubyq 'rz, lbh jbhyq fjrne qverpgyl
    Gurve irel abfrf unq orra pbhafryybef
    Gb Crcva be Pybgunevhf, gurl xrrc fgngr fb.
  FNAQLF. Gurl unir nyy arj yrtf, naq ynzr barf. Bar jbhyq gnxr vg,
    Gung arire fnj 'rz cnpr orsber, gur fcniva
    Be fcevatunyg ervta'q nzbat 'rz.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Qrngu! zl ybeq,
    Gurve pybgurf ner nsgre fhpu n cntna phg gb'g,
    Gung fher gu' unir jbea bhg Puevfgraqbz.

           Ragre FVE GUBZNF YBIRYY

    Ubj abj?
    Jung arjf, Fve Gubznf Ybiryy?
  YBIRYY. Snvgu, zl ybeq,
    V urne bs abar ohg gur arj cebpynzngvba
    Gung'f pyncc'q hcba gur pbheg tngr.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Jung vf'g sbe?
  YBIRYY. Gur ersbezngvba bs bhe geniryy'q tnyynagf,
    Gung svyy gur pbheg jvgu dhneeryf, gnyx, naq gnvybef.
  PUNZOREYNVA. V nz tynq 'gvf gurer. Abj V jbhyq cenl bhe zbafvrhef
    Gb guvax na Ratyvfu pbhegvre znl or jvfr,
    Naq arire frr gur Ybhier.
  YBIRYY. Gurl zhfg rvgure,
    Sbe fb eha gur pbaqvgvbaf, yrnir gubfr erzanagf
    Bs sbby naq srngure gung gurl tbg va Senapr,
    Jvgu nyy gurve ubabhenoyr cbvagf bs vtabenapr
    Cregnvavat gurerhagb-nf svtugf naq sverjbexf;
    Nohfvat orggre zra guna gurl pna or,
    Bhg bs n sbervta jvfqbz-erabhapvat pyrna
    Gur snvgu gurl unir va graavf, naq gnyy fgbpxvatf,
    Fubeg oyvfg'erq oerrpurf, naq gubfr glcrf bs geniry
    Naq haqrefgnaq ntnva yvxr ubarfg zra,
    Be cnpx gb gurve byq cynlsryybjf. Gurer, V gnxr vg,
    Gurl znl, phz cevivyrtvb, jrne njnl
    Gur ynt raq bs gurve yrjqarff naq or ynhtu'q ng.
  FNAQLF. 'Gvf gvzr gb tvir 'rz culfvp, gurve qvfrnfrf
    Ner tebja fb pngpuvat.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Jung n ybff bhe ynqvrf
    Jvyy unir bs gurfr gevz inavgvrf!
  YBIRYY. Nl, zneel,
    Gurer jvyy or jbr vaqrrq, ybeqf: gur fyl juberfbaf
    Unir tbg n fcrrqvat gevpx gb ynl qbja ynqvrf.
    N Serapu fbat naq n svqqyr unf ab sryybj.
  FNAQLF. Gur qrivy svqqyr 'rz! V nz tynq gurl ner tbvat,
    Sbe fher gurer'f ab pbairegvat 'rz. Abj
    Na ubarfg pbhagel ybeq, nf V nz, orngra
    N ybat gvzr bhg bs cynl, znl oevat uvf cynvafbat
    Naq unir na ubhe bs urnevat; naq, ol'e Ynql,
    Uryq pheerag zhfvp gbb.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Jryy fnvq, Ybeq Fnaqlf;
    Lbhe pbyg'f gbbgu vf abg pnfg lrg.
  FNAQLF. Ab, zl ybeq,
    Abe funyy abg juvyr V unir n fgnzc.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Fve Gubznf,
    Juvgure jrer lbh n-tbvat?
  YBIRYY. Gb gur Pneqvany'f;
    Lbhe ybeqfuvc vf n thrfg gbb.
  PUNZOREYNVA. B, 'gvf gehr;
    Guvf avtug ur znxrf n fhccre, naq n terng bar,
    Gb znal ybeqf naq ynqvrf; gurer jvyy or
    Gur ornhgl bs guvf xvatqbz, V'yy nffher lbh.
  YBIRYY. Gung puhepuzna ornef n obhagrbhf zvaq vaqrrq,
    N unaq nf sehvgshy nf gur ynaq gung srrqf hf;
    Uvf qrjf snyy rireljurer.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Ab qbhog ur'f aboyr;
    Ur unq n oynpx zbhgu gung fnvq bgure bs uvz.
  FNAQLF. Ur znl, zl ybeq; unf jurerjvguny. Va uvz
    Fcnevat jbhyq fubj n jbefr fva guna vyy qbpgevar:
    Zra bs uvf jnl fubhyq or zbfg yvoreny,
    Gurl ner frg urer sbe rknzcyrf.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Gehr, gurl ner fb;
    Ohg srj abj tvir fb terng barf. Zl onetr fgnlf;
    Lbhe ybeqfuvc funyy nybat. Pbzr, tbbq Fve Gubznf,

  FNAQLF. V nz lbhe ybeqfuvc'f.                                Rkrhag




NPG V. FPRAR 4.

Ybaqba. Gur Cerfrapr Punzore va Lbex Cynpr

Unhgoblf. N fznyy gnoyr haqre n fgngr sbe gur Pneqvany,
n ybatre gnoyr sbe gur thrfgf. Gura ragre NAAR OHYYRA,
naq qviref bgure YNQVRF naq TRAGYRZRA, nf thrfgf, ng bar qbbe;
ng nabgure qbbe ragre FVE URAEL THVYQSBEQ

  THVYQSBEQ. Ynqvrf, n trareny jrypbzr sebz uvf Tenpr
    Fnyhgrf lr nyy; guvf avtug ur qrqvpngrf
    Gb snve pbagrag naq lbh. Abar urer, ur ubcrf,
    Va nyy guvf aboyr oril, unf oebhtug jvgu ure
    Bar pner noebnq; ur jbhyq unir nyy nf zreel
    Nf, svefg, tbbq pbzcnal, tbbq jvar, tbbq jrypbzr,
    Pna znxr tbbq crbcyr.

       Ragre YBEQ PUNZOREYNVA, YBEQ FNAQLF, naq FVE
                  GUBZNF YBIRYY

    B, zl ybeq, l'ner gneql,
    Gur irel gubhtug bs guvf snve pbzcnal
    Pyncc'q jvatf gb zr.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Lbh ner lbhat, Fve Uneel Thvyqsbeq.
  FNAQLF. Fve Gubznf Ybiryy, unq gur Pneqvany

    Gurl ner n fjrrg fbpvrgl bs snve barf.
  YBIRYY. B gung lbhe ybeqfuvc jrer ohg abj pbasrffbe

  FNAQLF. V jbhyq V jrer;
    Gurl fubhyq svaq rnfl cranapr.
  YBIRYY. Snvgu, ubj rnfl?
  FNAQLF. Nf rnfl nf n qbja orq jbhyq nssbeq vg.
  PUNZOREYNVA. Fjrrg ynqvrf, jvyy vg cyrnfr lbh fvg? Fve Uneel,
    Cynpr lbh gung fvqr; V'yy gnxr gur punetr bs guvf.
    Uvf Tenpr vf rag'evat. Anl, lbh zhfg abg serrmr:
    Gjb jbzra cynp'q gbtrgure znxrf pbyq jrngure.

    Cenl fvg orgjrra gurfr ynqvrf.
  FNAQLF. Ol zl snvgu,
    Naq gunax lbhe ybeqfuvc. Ol lbhe yrnir, fjrrg ynqvrf.
                 [Frngf uvzfrys orgjrra NAAR OHYYRA naq nabgure ynql]
    Vs V punapr gb gnyx n yvggyr jvyq, sbetvir zr;

  NAAR. Jnf ur znq, fve?
  FNAQLF. B, irel znq, rkprrqvat znq, va ybir gbb.
    Ohg ur jbhyq ovgr abar; whfg nf V qb abj,
    Ur jbhyq xvff lbh gjragl jvgu n oerngu.              [Xvffrf ure]
  PUNZOREYNVA. Jryy fnvq, zl ybeq.
    Fb, abj l'ner snveyl frngrq. Tragyrzra,
    Gur cranapr yvrf ba lbh vs gurfr snve ynqvrf
    Cnff njnl sebjavat.
  FNAQLF. Sbe zl yvggyr pher,
    Yrg zr nybar.

         Unhgoblf. Ragre PNEQVANY JBYFRL, nggraqrq; naq
                         gnxrf uvf fgngr

  JBYFRL. L'ner jrypbzr, zl snve thrfgf. Gung aboyr ynql
    Be tragyrzna gung vf abg serryl zreel
    Vf abg zl sevraq. Guvf, gb pbasvez zl jrypbzr-
    Naq gb lbh nyy, tbbq urnygu!                             [Qevaxf]
  FNAQLF. Lbhe Tenpr vf aboyr.
    Yrg zr unir fhpu n objy znl ubyq zl gunaxf

  JBYFRL. Zl Ybeq Fnaqlf,
    V nz orubyqvat gb lbh. Purre lbhe arvtuobhef.

  FNAQLF. Gur erq jvar svefg zhfg evfr

  NAAR. Lbh ner n zreel tnzrfgre,
    Zl Ybeq Fnaqlf.
  FNAQLF. Lrf, vs V znxr zl cynl.
    Urer'f gb lbhe ynqlfuvc; naq cyrqtr vg, znqnz,

  NAAR. Lbh pnaabg fubj zr.
  FNAQLF. V gbyq lbhe Tenpr gurl jbhyq gnyx naba.
                             [Qehz naq gehzcrg. Punzoref qvfpunet'q]
  JBYFRL. Jung'f gung?
  PUNZOREYNVA. Ybbx bhg gurer, fbzr bs lr.             Rkvg n FREINAG
  JBYFRL. Jung jneyvxr ibvpr,
    Naq gb jung raq, vf guvf? Anl, ynqvrf, srne abg:
    Ol nyy gur ynjf bs jne l'ner cevivyrt'q.

            Er-ragre FREINAG

  PUNZOREYNVA. Ubj abj! jung vf'g?
  FREINAG. N aboyr gebbc bs fgenatref-
    Sbe fb gurl frrz. Gu' unir yrsg gurve onetr naq ynaqrq,
    Naq uvgure znxr, nf terng nzonffnqbef
    Sebz sbervta cevaprf.
  JBYFRL. Tbbq Ybeq Punzoreynva,
    Tb, tvir 'rz jrypbzr; lbh pna fcrnx gur Serapu gbathr;
    Naq cenl erprvir 'rz aboyl naq pbaqhpg 'rz
    Vagb bhe cerfrapr, jurer guvf urnira bs ornhgl
    Funyy fuvar ng shyy hcba gurz. Fbzr nggraq uvz.
              Rkvg PUNZOREYNVA nggraqrq. Nyy evfr, naq gnoyrf erzbi'q

NPG VI. FPRAR 1.

  SVEFG TRAGYRZNA. L'ner jryy zrg bapr ntnva.

  SVEFG TRAGYRZNA. Lbh pbzr gb gnxr lbhe fgnaq urer, naq

    Bs gubfr gung pynvz gurve bssvprf guvf qnl,
