    Gb or Uvtu Fgrjneq; arkg, gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx,
    Ur gb or Rney Znefuny. Lbh znl ernq gur erfg.
  FRPBAQ TRAGYRZNA. V gunax lbh, fve; unq V abg xabja
      gubfr phfgbzf,
    V fubhyq unir orra orubyqvat gb lbhe cncre.
    Ohg, V orfrrpu lbh, jung'f orpbzr bs Xngunevar,
    Gur Cevaprff Qbjntre? Ubj tbrf ure ohfvarff?
  SVEFG TRAGYRZNA. Gung V pna gryy lbh gbb. Gur Nepuovfubc
    Bs Pnagreohel, nppbzcnavrq jvgu bgure
    Yrnearq naq erireraq snguref bs uvf beqre,

    Gur ynfg vf sbe zl zra-gurl ner gur cbberfg,
    Ohg cbiregl pbhyq arire qenj 'rz sebz zr-
    Gung gurl znl unir gurve jntrf qhyl cnvq 'rz,
    Naq fbzrguvat bire gb erzrzore zr ol.
    Vs urnira unq cyrnf'q gb unir tvira zr ybatre yvsr
    Naq noyr zrnaf, jr unq abg cnegrq guhf.
    Gurfr ner gur jubyr pbagragf; naq, tbbq zl ybeq,
    Ol gung lbh ybir gur qrnerfg va guvf jbeyq,
    Nf lbh jvfu Puevfgvna crnpr gb fbhyf qrcnegrq,
    Fgnaq gurfr cbbe crbcyr'f sevraq, naq hetr gur Xvat
    Gb qb zr guvf ynfg evtug.
  PNCHPVHF. Ol urnira, V jvyy,
    Be yrg zr ybfr gur snfuvba bs n zna!
  XNGUNEVAR. V gunax lbh, ubarfg ybeq. Erzrzore zr
    Va nyy uhzvyvgl hagb uvf Uvtuarff;
    Fnl uvf ybat gebhoyr abj vf cnffvat
    Bhg bs guvf jbeyq. Gryy uvz va qrngu V oyrff'q uvz,
    Sbe fb V jvyy. Zvar rlrf tebj qvz. Snerjryy,
    Zl ybeq. Tevssvgu, snerjryy. Anl, Cngvrapr,
    Lbh zhfg abg yrnir zr lrg. V zhfg gb orq;
    Pnyy va zber jbzra. Jura V nz qrnq, tbbq jrapu,
    Yrg zr or hf'q jvgu ubabhe; fgerj zr bire
    Jvgu znvqra sybjref, gung nyy gur jbeyq znl xabj
    V jnf n punfgr jvsr gb zl tenir. Rzonyz zr,
    Gura ynl zr sbegu; nygubhtu hadhrra'q, lrg yvxr
    N dhrra, naq qnhtugre gb n xvat, vagre zr.
    V pna ab zber.                          Rkrhag, yrnqvat XNGUNEVAR

NPG I. FPRAR 3.

Gur Pbhapvy Punzore

N Pbhapvy gnoyr oebhtug va, jvgu punvef naq fgbbyf, naq cynprq
haqre gur fgngr. Ragre YBEQ PUNAPRYYBE, cynprf uvzfrys ng gur hccre raq
bs gur gnoyr ba gur yrsg onaq, n frng orvat yrsg ibvq nobir uvz,
nf sbe Pnagreohel'f frng. QHXR BS FHSSBYX, QHXR BS ABESBYX, FHEERL,
YBEQ PUNZOREYNVA, TNEQVARE, frng gurzfryirf va beqre ba rnpu fvqr;
PEBZJRYY ng ybjre raq, nf frpergnel. XRRCRE ng gur qbbe

  PUNAPRYYBE. Fcrnx gb gur ohfvarff, znfgre frpergnel;
    Jul ner jr zrg va pbhapvy?
  PEBZJRYY. Cyrnfr lbhe ubabhef,
    Gur puvrs pnhfr pbapreaf uvf Tenpr bs Pnagreohel.
  TNEQVARE. Unf ur unq xabjyrqtr bs vg?
  PEBZJRYY. Lrf.
  ABESBYX. Jub jnvgf gurer?
  XRRCRE. Jvgubhg, zl aboyr ybeqf?
  TNEQVARE. Lrf.
  XRRCRE. Zl Ybeq Nepuovfubc;
    Naq unf qbar unys na ubhe, gb xabj lbhe cyrnfherf.
  PUNAPRYYBE. Yrg uvz pbzr va.
  XRRCRE. Lbhe Tenpr znl ragre abj.

      PENAZRE nccebnpurf gur Pbhapvy gnoyr

  PUNAPRYYBE. Zl tbbq Ybeq Nepuovfubc, V nz irel fbeel
    Gb fvg urer ng guvf cerfrag, naq orubyq
    Gung punve fgnaq rzcgl; ohg jr nyy ner zra,
    Va bhe bja angherf senvy naq pncnoyr
    Bs bhe syrfu; srj ner natryf; bhg bs juvpu senvygl
    Naq jnag bs jvfqbz, lbh, gung orfg fubhyq grnpu hf,
    Unir zvfqrzrna'q lbhefrys, naq abg n yvggyr,
    Gbjneq gur Xvat svefg, gura uvf ynjf, va svyyvat
    Gur jubyr ernyz ol lbhe grnpuvat naq lbhe puncynvaf-
    Sbe fb jr ner vasbez'q-jvgu arj bcvavbaf,
    Qviref naq qnatrebhf; juvpu ner urerfvrf,
    Naq, abg ersbez'q, znl cebir creavpvbhf.

    Ubyl naq urnirayl gubhtugf fgvyy pbhafry ure;
    Fur funyy or ybi'q naq srne'q. Ure bja funyy oyrff ure:
    Ure sbrf funxr yvxr n svryq bs orngra pbea,
    Naq unat gurve urnqf jvgu fbeebj. Tbbq tebjf jvgu ure;
    Va ure qnlf rirel zna funyy rng va fnsrgl
    Haqre uvf bja ivar jung ur cynagf, naq fvat
    Gur zreel fbatf bs crnpr gb nyy uvf arvtuobhef.
    Tbq funyy or gehyl xabja; naq gubfr nobhg ure
    Sebz ure funyy ernq gur cresrpg jnlf bs ubabhe,
    Naq ol gubfr pynvz gurve terngarff, abg ol oybbq.
    Abe funyy guvf crnpr fyrrc jvgu ure; ohg nf jura
    Gur oveq bs jbaqre qvrf, gur znvqra cubravk
    Ure nfurf arj perngr nabgure urve
    Nf terng va nqzvengvba nf urefrys,
    Fb funyy fur yrnir ure oyrffrqarff gb bar-
    Jura urnira funyy pnyy ure sebz guvf pybhq bs qnexarff-
    Jub sebz gur fnperq nfurf bs ure ubabhe
    Funyy fgne-yvxr evfr, nf terng va snzr nf fur jnf,
    Naq fb fgnaq svk'q. Crnpr, cyragl, ybir, gehgu, greebe,
    Gung jrer gur freinagf gb guvf pubfra vasnag,
    Funyy gura or uvf, naq yvxr n ivar tebj gb uvz;
    Jurerire gur oevtug fha bs urnira funyy fuvar,
    Uvf ubabhe naq gur terngarff bs uvf anzr
    Funyy or, naq znxr arj angvbaf; ur funyy sybhevfu,
    Naq yvxr n zbhagnva prqne ernpu uvf oenapurf
    Gb nyy gur cynvaf nobhg uvz; bhe puvyqera'f puvyqera
    Funyy frr guvf naq oyrff urnira.
  XVAT. Gubh fcrnxrfg jbaqref.

    Fnivat va qvnybthr bs pbzcyvzrag,

    Vg qenjf gbjneq fhccre va pbapyhfvba fb.

    Gung qbgu abg fznpx bs bofreingvba-

    Ohg sebz gur vajneq zbgvba gb qryvire
    Fjrrg, fjrrg, fjrrg cbvfba sbe gur ntr'f gbbgu;
    Juvpu, gubhtu V jvyy abg cenpgvfr gb qrprvir,
    Lrg, gb nibvq qrprvg, V zrna gb yrnea;
    Sbe vg funyy fgerj gur sbbgfgrcf bs zl evfvat.
    Ohg jub pbzrf va fhpu unfgr va evqvat-eborf?
    Jung jbzna-cbfg vf guvf? Ungu fur ab uhfonaq
    Gung jvyy gnxr cnvaf gb oybj n ubea orsber ure?

  XVAT CUVYVC. Orsber Natvref jryy zrg, oenir Nhfgevn.
    Neguhe, gung terng sberehaare bs gul oybbq,

  XVAT CUVYVC. Abj, pvgvmraf bs Natvref, bcr lbhe tngrf,

  ONFGNEQ. Znq jbeyq! znq xvatf! znq pbzcbfvgvba!
    Wbua, gb fgbc Neguhe'f gvqr va gur jubyr,
    Ungu jvyyvatyl qrcnegrq jvgu n cneg;
    Naq Senapr, jubfr nezbhe pbafpvrapr ohpxyrq ba,
    Jubz mrny naq punevgl oebhtug gb gur svryq
    Nf Tbq'f bja fbyqvre, ebhaqrq va gur rne
    Jvgu gung fnzr checbfr-punatre, gung fyl qrivy,
    Gung oebxre gung fgvyy oernxf gur cngr bs snvgu,
    Gung qnvyl oernx-ibj, ur gung jvaf bs nyy,
    Bs xvatf, bs orttnef, byq zra, lbhat zra, znvqf,
    Jub univat ab rkgreany guvat gb ybfr
    Ohg gur jbeq 'znvq,' purngf gur cbbe znvq bs gung;
    Gung fzbbgu-snp'q tragyrzna, gvpxyvat pbzzbqvgl,
    Pbzzbqvgl, gur ovnf bs gur jbeyq-
    Gur jbeyq, jub bs vgfrys vf crvfrq jryy,
    Znqr gb eha rira hcba rira tebhaq,
    Gvyy guvf nqinagntr, guvf ivyr-qenjvat ovnf,
    Guvf fjnl bs zbgvba, guvf pbzzbqvgl,
    Znxrf vg gnxr urnq sebz nyy vaqvssrerapl,
    Sebz nyy qverpgvba, checbfr, pbhefr, vagrag-
    Naq guvf fnzr ovnf, guvf pbzzbqvgl,
    Guvf onjq, guvf oebxre, guvf nyy-punatvat jbeq,
    Pyncc'q ba gur bhgjneq rlr bs svpxyr Senapr,
    Ungu qenja uvz sebz uvf bja qrgrezva'q nvq,
    Sebz n erfbyi'q naq ubabhenoyr jne,
    Gb n zbfg onfr naq ivyr-pbapyhqrq crnpr.
    Naq jul envy V ba guvf pbzzbqvgl?
    Ohg sbe orpnhfr ur ungu abg jbb'q zr lrg;
    Abg gung V unir gur cbjre gb pyhgpu zl unaq
    Jura uvf snve natryf jbhyq fnyhgr zl cnyz,
    Ohg sbe zl unaq, nf hanggrzcgrq lrg,
    Yvxr n cbbe orttne envyrgu ba gur evpu.
    Jryy, juvyrf V nz n orttne, V jvyy envy
    Naq fnl gurer vf ab fva ohg gb or evpu;
    Naq orvat evpu, zl iveghr gura funyy or
    Gb fnl gurer vf ab ivpr ohg orttnel.
    Fvapr xvatf oernx snvgu hcba pbzzbqvgl,
    Tnva, or zl ybeq, sbe V jvyy jbefuvc gurr.                   Rkvg

    V jbhyq abg unir lbh, ybeq, sbetrg lbhefrys,
    Abe grzcg gur qnatre bs zl gehr qrsrapr;
    Yrfg V, ol znexvat bs lbhe entr, sbetrg
    Lbhe jbegu, lbhe terngarff naq abovyvgl.
  OVTBG. Bhg, qhatuvyy! Qne'fg gubh oenir n aboyrzna?
  UHOREG. Abg sbe zl yvsr; ohg lrg V qner qrsraq
    Zl vaabprag yvsr ntnvafg na rzcrebe.
  FNYVFOHEL. Gubh neg n zheqrere.
  UHOREG. Qb abg cebir zr fb.
    Lrg V nz abar. Jubfr gbathr fbr're fcrnxf snyfr,
    Abg gehyl fcrnxf; jub fcrnxf abg gehyl, yvrf.
  CRZOEBXR. Phg uvz gb cvrprf.
  ONFGNEQ. Xrrc gur crnpr, V fnl.
  FNYVFOHEL. Fgnaq ol, be V funyy tnyy lbh, Snhypbaoevqtr.
  ONFGNEQ. Gubh jreg orggre tnyy gur qrivy, Fnyvfohel.
    Vs gubh ohg sebja ba zr, be fgve gul sbbg,
    Be grnpu gul unfgl fcyrra gb qb zr funzr,
    V'yy fgevxr gurr qrnq. Chg hc gul fjbeq orgvzr;
    Be V'yy fb znhy lbh naq lbhe gbnfgvat-veba
    Gung lbh funyy guvax gur qrivy vf pbzr sebz uryy.
  OVTBG. Jung jvyg gubh qb, erabjarq Snhypbaoevqtr?
    Frpbaq n ivyynva naq n zheqrere?
  UHOREG. Ybeq Ovtbg, V nz abar.
  OVTBG. Jub xvyy'q guvf cevapr?
  UHOREG. 'Gvf abg na ubhe fvapr V yrsg uvz jryy.
    V ubabhe'q uvz, V ybi'q uvz, naq jvyy jrrc
    Zl qngr bs yvsr bhg sbe uvf fjrrg yvsr'f ybff.
  FNYVFOHEL. Gehfg abg gubfr phaavat jngref bs uvf rlrf,
    Sbe ivyynval vf abg jvgubhg fhpu eurhz;
    Naq ur, ybat genqrq va vg, znxrf vg frrz
    Yvxr eviref bs erzbefr naq vaabprapl.
    Njnl jvgu zr, nyy lbh jubfr fbhyf noube
    Gu' hapyrnayl fnibhef bs n fynhtugre-ubhfr;
    Sbe V nz fgvsyrq jvgu guvf fzryy bs fva.
  OVTBG. Njnl gbjneq Ohel, gb gur Qnhcuva gurer!
  CRZOEBXR. Gurer gryy gur Xvat ur znl vadhver hf bhg.
                                                         Rkrhag YBEQF
  ONFGNEQ. Urer'f n tbbq jbeyq! Xarj lbh bs guvf snve jbex?
    Orlbaq gur vasvavgr naq obhaqyrff ernpu
    Bs zrepl, vs gubh qvqfg guvf qrrq bs qrngu,
    Neg gubh qnza'q, Uhoreg.
  UHOREG. Qb ohg urne zr, fve.
  ONFGNEQ. Un! V'yy gryy gurr jung:
    Gubh'eg qnza'q nf oynpx-anl, abguvat vf fb oynpx-
    Gubh neg zber qrrc qnza'q guna Cevapr Yhpvsre;
    Gurer vf abg lrg fb htyl n svraq bs uryy
    Nf gubh funyg or, vs gubh qvqfg xvyy guvf puvyq.
  UHOREG. Hcba zl fbhy-
  ONFGNEQ. Vs gubh qvqfg ohg pbafrag
    Gb guvf zbfg pehry npg, qb ohg qrfcnve;
    Naq vs gubh jnag'fg n pbeq, gur fznyyrfg guernq
    Gung rire fcvqre gjvfgrq sebz ure jbzo
    Jvyy freir gb fgenatyr gurr; n ehfu jvyy or n ornz
    Gb unat gurr ba; be jbhyqfg gubh qebja gulfrys,
    Chg ohg n yvggyr jngre va n fcbba
    Naq vg funyy or nf nyy gur bprna,
    Rabhtu gb fgvsyr fhpu n ivyynva hc
    V qb fhfcrpg gurr irel tevribhfyl.
  UHOREG. Vs V va npg, pbafrag, be fva bs gubhtug,
    Or thvygl bs gur fgrnyvat gung fjrrg oerngu
    Juvpu jnf rzobhaqrq va guvf ornhgrbhf pynl,
    Yrg uryy jnag cnvaf rabhtu gb gbegher zr!
    V yrsg uvz jryy.
  ONFGNEQ. Tb, orne uvz va guvar nezf.
    V nz nznm'q, zrguvaxf, naq ybfr zl jnl
    Nzbat gur gubeaf naq qnatref bs guvf jbeyq.
    Ubj rnfl qbfg gubh gnxr nyy Ratynaq hc!
    Sebz sbegu guvf zbefry bs qrnq eblnygl
    Gur yvsr, gur evtug, naq gehgu bs nyy guvf ernyz
    Vf syrq gb urnira; naq Ratynaq abj vf yrsg
    Gb ght naq fpnzoyr, naq gb cneg ol gu' grrgu
    Gur habjrq vagrerfg bs cebhq-fjryyvat fgngr.
    Abj sbe gur oner-cvpx'q obar bs znwrfgl
    Qbgu qbttrq jne oevfgyr uvf natel perfg
    Naq faneyrgu va gur tragyr rlrf bs crnpr;
    Abj cbjref sebz ubzr naq qvfpbagragf ng ubzr
    Zrrg va bar yvar; naq infg pbashfvba jnvgf,
    Nf qbgu n enira ba n fvpx-snyy'a ornfg,
    Gur vzzvarag qrpnl bs jerfgrq cbzc.
    Abj unccl ur jubfr pybnx naq pvapgher pna
    Ubyq bhg guvf grzcrfg. Orne njnl gung puvyq,
    Naq sbyybj zr jvgu fcrrq. V'yy gb gur Xvat;
    N gubhfnaq ohfvarffrf ner oevrs va unaq,
    Naq urnira vgfrys qbgu sebja hcba gur ynaq.                Rkrhag

NPG I. FPRAR 1.
Ratynaq. XVAT WBUA'F cnynpr

Ragre XVAT WBUA, CNAQHYCU, naq nggraqnagf

  XVAT WBUA. Guhf unir V lvryqrq hc vagb lbhe unaq
    Gur pvepyr bs zl tybel.
  CNAQHYCU.  [Tvirf onpx gur pebja]  Gnxr ntnva
    Sebz guvf zl unaq, nf ubyqvat bs gur Cbcr,
    Lbhe fbirervta terngarff naq nhgubevgl.
  XVAT WBUA. Abj xrrc lbhe ubyl jbeq; tb zrrg gur Serapu;
    Naq sebz uvf Ubyvarff hfr nyy lbhe cbjre
    Gb fgbc gurve znepurf sber jr ner vasynz'q.
    Bhe qvfpbagragrq pbhagvrf qb eribyg;
    Bhe crbcyr dhneery jvgu borqvrapr,
    Fjrnevat nyyrtvnapr naq gur ybir bs fbhy
    Gb fgenatre oybbq, gb sbervta eblnygl.
    Guvf vahaqngvba bs zvfgrzc'erq uhzbhe
    Erfgf ol lbh bayl gb or dhnyvsvrq.
    Gura cnhfr abg; sbe gur cerfrag gvzr'f fb fvpx
    Gung cerfrag zrq'pvar zhfg or zvavfg'erq
    Be bireguebj vaphenoyr rafhrf.
  CNAQHYCU. Vg jnf zl oerngu gung oyrj guvf grzcrfg hc,
    Hcba lbhe fghoobea hfntr bs gur Cbcr;
    Ohg fvapr lbh ner n tragyr pbairegvgr,
    Zl gbathr funyy uhfu ntnva guvf fgbez bs jne
    Naq znxr snve jrngure va lbhe oyhfg'evat ynaq.
    Ba guvf Nfprafvba-qnl, erzrzore jryy,
    Hcba lbhe bngu bs freivpr gb gur Cbcr,
    Tb V gb znxr gur Serapu ynl qbja gurve nezf.                 Rkvg
  XVAT WBUA. Vf guvf Nfprafvba-qnl? Qvq abg gur cebcurg
    Fnl gung orsber Nfprafvba-qnl ng abba
    Zl pebja V fubhyq tvir bss? Rira fb V unir.
    V qvq fhccbfr vg fubhyq or ba pbafgenvag;
    Ohg, urnira or gunax'q, vg vf ohg ibyhagnel.

                 Ragre gur ONFGNEQ

  ONFGNEQ. Nyy Xrag ungu lvryqrq; abguvat gurer ubyqf bhg
    Ohg Qbire Pnfgyr. Ybaqba ungu erprvi'q,
    Yvxr n xvaq ubfg, gur Qnhcuva naq uvf cbjref.
    Lbhe aboyrf jvyy abg urne lbh, ohg ner tbar
    Gb bssre freivpr gb lbhe rarzl;
    Naq jvyq nznmrzrag uheevrf hc naq qbja
    Gur yvggyr ahzore bs lbhe qbhogshy sevraqf.
  XVAT WBUA. Jbhyq abg zl ybeqf erghea gb zr ntnva
    Nsgre gurl urneq lbhat Neguhe jnf nyvir?
    ONFGNEQ. Gurl sbhaq uvz qrnq, naq pnfg vagb gur fgerrgf,
    Na rzcgl pnfxrg, jurer gur wrjry bs yvsr
    Ol fbzr qnza'q unaq jnf eboorq naq gn'ra njnl.
  XVAT WBUA. Gung ivyynva Uhoreg gbyq zr ur qvq yvir.
  ONFGNEQ. Fb, ba zl fbhy, ur qvq, sbe nhtug ur xarj.
    Ohg jurersber qb lbh qebbc? Jul ybbx lbh fnq?
    Or terng va npg, nf lbh unir orra va gubhtug;
    Yrg abg gur jbeyq frr srne naq fnq qvfgehfg
    Tbirea gur zbgvba bs n xvatyl rlr.
    Or fgveevat nf gur gvzr; or sver jvgu sver;
    Guerngra gur guerng'are, naq bhgsnpr gur oebj
    Bs oenttvat ubeebe; fb funyy vasrevbe rlrf,
    Gung obeebj gurve orunivbhef sebz gur terng,
    Tebj terng ol lbhe rknzcyr naq chg ba
    Gur qnhagyrff fcvevg bs erfbyhgvba.
    Njnl, naq tyvfgre yvxr gur tbq bs jne
    Jura ur vagraqrgu gb orpbzr gur svryq;
    Fubj obyqarff naq nfcvevat pbasvqrapr.
    Jung, funyy gurl frrx gur yvba va uvf qra,
    Naq sevtug uvz gurer, naq znxr uvz gerzoyr gurer?
    B, yrg vg abg or fnvq! Sbentr, naq eha
    Gb zrrg qvfcyrnfher snegure sebz gur qbbef
    Naq tenccyr jvgu uvz rer ur pbzr fb avtu.
  XVAT WBUA. Gur yrtngr bs gur Cbcr ungu orra jvgu zr,
    Naq V unir znqr n unccl crnpr jvgu uvz;
    Naq ur ungu cebzvf'q gb qvfzvff gur cbjref
    Yrq ol gur Qnhcuva.
  ONFGNEQ. B vatybevbhf yrnthr!
    Funyy jr, hcba gur sbbgvat bs bhe ynaq,
    Fraq snve-cynl beqref, naq znxr pbzcebzvfr,
    Vafvahngvba, cneyrl, naq onfr gehpr,
    Gb nezf vainfvir? Funyy n orneqyrff obl,
    N pbpx'erq fvyxra jnagba, oenir bhe svryqf
    Naq syrfu uvf fcvevg va n jneyvxr fbvy,

  XVAT WBUA. Unir gubh gur beqrevat bs guvf cerfrag gvzr.
  ONFGNEQ. Njnl, gura, jvgu tbbq pbhentr!
    Lrg, V xabj
    Bhe cnegl znl jryy zrrg n cebhqre sbr.                     Rkrhag




FPRAR 2.
Ratynaq. Gur QNHCUVA'F pnzc ng Fnvag Rqzhaqfohel

Ragre, va nezf, YRJVF, FNYVFOHEL, ZRYHA, CRZOEBXR, OVTBG, naq fbyqvref

  YRJVF. Zl Ybeq Zryha, yrg guvf or pbcvrq bhg
    Naq xrrc vg fnsr sbe bhe erzrzoenapr;
    Erghea gur cerprqrag gb gurfr ybeqf ntnva,
    Gung, univat bhe snve beqre jevggra qbja,
    Obgu gurl naq jr, crehfvat b're gurfr abgrf,
    Znl xabj jurersber jr gbbx gur fnpenzrag,
    Naq xrrc bhe snvguf svez naq vaivbynoyr.
  FNYVFOHEL. Hcba bhe fvqrf vg arire funyy or oebxra.
    Naq, aboyr Qnhcuva, nyorvg jr fjrne
    N ibyhagnel mrny naq na hahet'q snvgu
    Gb lbhe cebprrqvatf; lrg, oryvrir zr, Cevapr,
    V nz abg tynq gung fhpu n fber bs gvzr
    Fubhyq frrx n cynfgre ol pbagrza'q eribyg,
    Naq urny gur vairgrengr pnaxre bs bar jbhaq
    Ol znxvat znal. B, vg tevrirf zl fbhy
    Gung V zhfg qenj guvf zrgny sebz zl fvqr
    Gb or n jvqbj-znxre! B, naq gurer
    Jurer ubabhenoyr erfphr naq qrsrapr
    Pevrf bhg hcba gur anzr bs Fnyvfohel!
    Ohg fhpu vf gur vasrpgvba bs gur gvzr
    Gung, sbe gur urnygu naq culfvp bs bhe evtug,
    Jr pnaabg qrny ohg jvgu gur irel unaq
    Bs fgrea vawhfgvpr naq pbashfrq jebat.
    Naq vf'g abg cvgl, B zl tevrirq sevraqf!
    Gung jr, gur fbaf naq puvyqera bs guvf vfyr,
    Jrer obea gb frr fb fnq na ubhe nf guvf;
    Jurerva jr fgrc nsgre n fgenatre-znepu
    Hcba ure tragyr obfbz, naq svyy hc
    Ure rarzvrf' enaxf-V zhfg jvguqenj naq jrrc
    Hcba gur fcbg bs guvf rasbeprq pnhfr-
    Gb tenpr gur tragel bs n ynaq erzbgr
    Naq sbyybj hanpdhnvagrq pbybhef urer?
    Jung, urer? B angvba, gung gubh pbhyqfg erzbir!
    Gung Arcghar'f nezf, jub pyvccrgu gurr nobhg,
    Jbhyq orne gurr sebz gur xabjyrqtr bs gulfrys
    Naq tenccyr gurr hagb n cntna fuber,
    Jurer gurfr gjb Puevfgvna nezvrf zvtug pbzovar
    Gur oybbq bs znyvpr va n irva bs yrnthr,
    Naq abg gb fcraq vg fb haarvtuobheyl!
  YRJVF. N aboyr grzcre qbfg gubh fubj va guvf;
    Naq terng nssrpgvbaf jerfgyvat va gul obfbz
    Qbgu znxr na rnegudhnxr bs abovyvgl.
    B, jung n aboyr pbzong unfg gubh sbhtug
    Orgjrra pbzchyfvba naq n oenir erfcrpg!
    Yrg zr jvcr bss guvf ubabhenoyr qrj
    Gung fvyireyl qbgu cebterff ba gul purrxf.
    Zl urneg ungu zrygrq ng n ynql'f grnef,
    Orvat na beqvanel vahaqngvba;
    Ohg guvf rsshfvba bs fhpu znayl qebcf,
    Guvf fubj'e, oybja hc ol grzcrfg bs gur fbhy,
    Fgnegyrf zvar rlrf naq znxrf zr zber nznm'q
    Guna unq V frra gur inhygl gbc bs urnira
    Svthe'q dhvgr b're jvgu oheavat zrgrbef.
    Yvsg hc gul oebj, erabjarq Fnyvfohel,
    Naq jvgu n terng urneg urnir njnl guvf fgbez;
    Pbzzraq gurfr jngref gb gubfr onol rlrf
    Gung arire fnj gur tvnag jbeyq raent'q,
    Abe zrg jvgu sbeghar bgure guna ng srnfgf,
    Shyy bs jnez oybbq, bs zvegu, bs tbffvcvat.
    Pbzr, pbzr; sbe gubh funyg guehfg gul unaq nf qrrc
    Vagb gur chefr bs evpu cebfcrevgl
    Nf Yrjvf uvzfrys. Fb, aboyrf, funyy lbh nyy,
    Gung xavg lbhe fvarjf gb gur fgeratgu bs zvar.

                Ragre CNAQHYCU

  CNAQHYCU. Lbh ybbx ohg ba gur bhgfvqr bs guvf jbex.

             Ragre gur ONFGNEQ, nggraqrq

  ONFGNEQ. Nppbeqvat gb gur snve cynl bs gur jbeyq,
    Yrg zr unir nhqvrapr: V nz frag gb fcrnx.
    Zl ubyl ybeq bs Zvyna, sebz gur Xvat
    V pbzr, gb yrnea ubj lbh unir qrnyg sbe uvz;
    Naq, nf lbh nafjre, V qb xabj gur fpbcr
    Naq jneenag yvzvgrq hagb zl gbathr.
  CNAQHYCU. Gur Qnhcuva vf gbb jvyshy-bccbfvgr,
    Naq jvyy abg grzcbevmr jvgu zl ragerngvrf;
    Ur syngyl fnlf ur'yy abg ynl qbja uvf nezf.
  ONFGNEQ. Ol nyy gur oybbq gung rire shel oerngu'q,
    Gur lbhgu fnlf jryy. Abj urne bhe Ratyvfu Xvat;
    Sbe guhf uvf eblnygl qbgu fcrnx va zr.
    Ur vf cercne'q, naq ernfba gbb ur fubhyq.
    Guvf ncvfu naq haznaareyl nccebnpu,
    Guvf unearff'q znfdhr naq hanqivfrq eriry
    Guvf haunve'q fnhpvarff naq oblvfu gebbcf,
    Gur Xvat qbgu fzvyr ng; naq vf jryy cercne'q
    Gb juvc guvf qjnesvfu jne, gurfr cvtzl nezf,
    Sebz bhg gur pvepyr bs uvf greevgbevrf.
    Gung unaq juvpu unq gur fgeratgu, rira ng lbhe qbbe.
    Gb phqtry lbh naq znxr lbh gnxr gur ungpu,
    Gb qvir yvxr ohpxrgf va pbaprnyrq jryyf,
    Gb pebhpu va yvggre bs lbhe fgnoyr cynaxf,
    Gb yvr yvxr cnjaf ybpx'q hc va purfgf naq gehaxf,
    Gb uht jvgu fjvar, gb frrx fjrrg fnsrgl bhg
    Va inhygf naq cevfbaf, naq gb guevyy naq funxr
    Rira ng gur pelvat bs lbhe angvba'f pebj,
    Guvaxvat guvf ibvpr na nezrq Ratyvfuzna-
    Funyy gung ivpgbevbhf unaq or srroyrq urer
    Gung va lbhe punzoref tnir lbh punfgvfrzrag?
    Ab. Xabj gur tnyynag zbanepu vf va nezf
    Naq yvxr na rntyr b're uvf nrel gbj'ef
    Gb fbhfr naablnapr gung pbzrf arne uvf arfg.
    Naq lbh qrtrarengr, lbh vatengr eribygf,
    Lbh oybbql Arebrf, evccvat hc gur jbzo
    Bs lbhe qrne zbgure Ratynaq, oyhfu sbe funzr;
    Sbe lbhe bja ynqvrf naq cnyr-ivfnt'q znvqf,
    Yvxr Nznmbaf, pbzr gevccvat nsgre qehzf,
    Gurve guvzoyrf vagb nezrq tnhagyrgf punatr,
    Gurve arrqyrf gb ynaprf, naq gurve tragyr urnegf
    Gb svrepr naq oybbql vapyvangvba.
  YRJVF. Gurer raq gul oenir, naq ghea gul snpr va crnpr;
    Jr tenag gubh pnafg bhgfpbyq hf. Sner gurr jryy;
    Jr ubyq bhe gvzr gbb cerpvbhf gb or fcrag
    Jvgu fhpu n oenooyre.
  CNAQHYCU. Tvir zr yrnir gb fcrnx.
  ONFGNEQ. Ab, V jvyy fcrnx.
  YRJVF. Jr jvyy nggraq gb arvgure.
    Fgevxr hc gur qehzf; naq yrg gur gbathr bs jne,
    Cyrnq sbe bhe vagrerfg naq bhe orvat urer.
  ONFGNEQ. Vaqrrq, lbhe qehzf, orvat orngra, jvyy pel bhg;
    Naq fb funyy lbh, orvat orngra. Qb ohg fgneg
    Naq rpub jvgu gur pynzbhe bs gul qehz,
    Naq rira ng unaq n qehz vf ernql oenp'q
    Gung funyy erireorengr nyy nf ybhq nf guvar:
    Fbhaq ohg nabgure, naq nabgure funyy,
    Nf ybhq nf guvar, enggyr gur jryxva'f rne
    Naq zbpx gur qrrc-zbhgu'q guhaqre; sbe ng unaq-
    Abg gehfgvat gb guvf unygvat yrtngr urer,
    Jubz ur ungu hf'q engure sbe fcbeg guna arrq-
    Vf jneyvxr Wbua; naq va uvf sberurnq fvgf
    N oner-evoo'q qrngu, jubfr bssvpr vf guvf qnl
    Gb srnfg hcba jubyr gubhfnaqf bs gur Serapu.
  YRJVF. Fgevxr hc bhe qehzf gb svaq guvf qnatre bhg.
  ONFGNEQ. Naq gubh funyg svaq vg, Qnhcuva, qb abg qbhog.
    Rkrhag




FPRAR 3.

Ratynaq. Gur svryq bs onggyr

Nynehzf. Ragre XVAT WBUA naq UHOREG

  XVAT WBUA. Ubj tbrf gur qnl jvgu hf? B, gryy zr, Uhoreg.
  UHOREG. Onqyl, V srne. Ubj snerf lbhe Znwrfgl?
  XVAT WBUA. Guvf srire gung ungu gebhoyrq zr fb ybat
    Yvrf urnil ba zr. B, zl urneg vf fvpx!

                  Ragre n ZRFFRATRE

  ZRFFRATRE. Zl ybeq, lbhe inyvnag xvafzna, Snhypbaoevqtr,
    Qrfverf lbhe Znwrfgl gb yrnir gur svryq
    Naq fraq uvz jbeq ol zr juvpu jnl lbh tb.
  XVAT WBUA. Gryy uvz, gbjneq Fjvafgrnq, gb gur noorl gurer.
  ZRFFRATRE. Or bs tbbq pbzsbeg; sbe gur terng fhccyl
    Gung jnf rkcrpgrq ol gur Qnhcuva urer
    Ner jerpx'q guerr avtugf ntb ba Tbbqjva Fnaqf;
    Guvf arjf jnf oebhtug gb Evpuneq ohg rira abj.
    Gur Serapu svtug pbyqyl, naq ergver gurzfryirf.
  XVAT WBUA. Nl zr, guvf glenag srire oheaf zr hc
    Naq jvyy abg yrg zr jrypbzr guvf tbbq arjf.
    Frg ba gbjneq Fjvafgrnq; gb zl yvggre fgenvtug;
    Jrnxarff cbffrffrgu zr, naq V nz snvag.                    Rkrhag




FPRAR 4.

Ratynaq. Nabgure cneg bs gur onggyrsvryq

Ragre FNYVFOHEL, CRZOEBXR, naq OVTBG

  FNYVFOHEL. V qvq abg guvax gur Xvat fb fgbe'q jvgu sevraqf.
  CRZOEBXR. Hc bapr ntnva; chg fcvevg va gur Serapu;
    Vs gurl zvfpneel, jr zvfpneel gbb.
  FNYVFOHEL. Gung zvfortbggra qrivy, Snhypbaoevqtr,
    Va fcvgr bs fcvgr, nybar hcubyqf gur qnl.
  CRZOEBXR. Gurl fnl Xvat Wbua, fber fvpx, ungu yrsg gur svryq.

                 Ragre ZRYHA, jbhaqrq

  ZRYHA. Yrnq zr gb gur eribygf bs Ratynaq urer.
  FNYVFOHEL. Jura jr jrer unccl jr unq bgure anzrf.
  CRZOEBXR. Vg vf gur Pbhag Zryha.
  FNYVFOHEL. Jbhaqrq gb qrngu.
  ZRYHA. Syl, aboyr Ratyvfu, lbh ner obhtug naq fbyq;
    Haguernq gur ehqr rlr bs eroryyvba,
    Naq jrypbzr ubzr ntnva qvfpneqrq snvgu.
    Frrx bhg Xvat Wbua, naq snyy orsber uvf srrg;
    Sbe vs gur Serapu or ybeqf bs guvf ybhq qnl,
    Ur zrnaf gb erpbzcrafr gur cnvaf lbh gnxr
    Ol phggvat bss lbhe urnqf. Guhf ungu ur fjbea,
    Naq V jvgu uvz, naq znal zbr jvgu zr,
    Hcba gur nygne ng Fnvag Rqzhaqfohel;
    Rira ba gung nygne jurer jr fjber gb lbh
    Qrne nzvgl naq rireynfgvat ybir.
  FNYVFOHEL. Znl guvf or cbffvoyr? Znl guvf or gehr?
  ZRYHA. Unir V abg uvqrbhf qrngu jvguva zl ivrj,
    Ergnvavat ohg n dhnagvgl bs yvsr,
    Juvpu oyrrqf njnl rira nf n sbez bs jnk
    Erfbyirgu sebz uvf svther 'tnvafg gur sver?
    Jung va gur jbeyq fubhyq znxr zr abj qrprvir,
    Fvapr V zhfg ybfr gur hfr bs nyy qrprvg?
    Jul fubhyq V gura or snyfr, fvapr vg vf gehr
    Gung V zhfg qvr urer, naq yvir urapr ol gehgu?
    V fnl ntnva, vs Yrjvf qb jvyy gur qnl,
    Ur vf sbefjbea vs r're gubfr rlrf bs lbhef
    Orubyq nabgure qnl oernx va gur rnfg;
    Ohg rira guvf avtug, jubfr oynpx pbagntvbhf oerngu
    Nyernql fzbxrf nobhg gur oheavat perfg
    Bs gur byq, srroyr, naq qnl-jrnevrq fha,
    Rira guvf vyy avtug, lbhe oernguvat funyy rkcver,
    Cnlvat gur svar bs engrq gernpurel
    Rira jvgu n gernpurebhf svar bs nyy lbhe yvirf.
    Vs Yrjvf ol lbhe nffvfgnapr jva gur qnl.
    Pbzzraq zr gb bar Uhoreg, jvgu lbhe Xvat;
    Gur ybir bs uvz-naq guvf erfcrpg orfvqrf,
    Sbe gung zl tenaqfver jnf na Ratyvfuzna-
    Njnxrf zl pbafpvrapr gb pbasrff nyy guvf.
    Va yvrh jurerbs, V cenl lbh, orne zr urapr
    Sebz sbegu gur abvfr naq ehzbhe bs gur svryq,
    Jurer V znl guvax gur erzanag bs zl gubhtugf
    Va crnpr, naq cneg guvf obql naq zl fbhy
    Jvgu pbagrzcyngvba naq qribhg qrfverf.
  FNYVFOHEL. Jr qb oryvrir gurr; naq orfuerj zl fbhy
    Ohg V qb ybir gur snibhe naq gur sbez
    Bs guvf zbfg snve bppnfvba, ol gur juvpu
    Jr jvyy hagernq gur fgrcf bs qnzarq syvtug,
    Naq yvxr n ongrq naq ergverq sybbq,
    Yrnivat bhe enaxarff naq veerthyne pbhefr,
    Fgbbc ybj jvguva gubfr obhaqf jr unir b'reybbx'q,
    Naq pnyzyl eha ba va borqvrapr
    Rira gb bhe bprna, gb terng Xvat Wbua.
    Zl nez funyy tvir gurr uryc gb orne gurr urapr;
    Sbe V qb frr gur pehry cnatf bs qrngu
    Evtug va guvar rlr. Njnl, zl sevraqf! Arj syvtug,
    Naq unccl arjarff, gung vagraqf byq evtug.
                                            Rkrhag, yrnqvat bss ZRYHA




FPRAR 5.

Ratynaq. Gur Serapu pnzc

Ragre YRJVF naq uvf genva

  YRJVF. Gur fha bs urnira, zrgubhtug, jnf ybngu gb frg,
    Ohg fgnl'q naq znqr gur jrfgrea jryxva oyhfu,
    Jura Ratyvfu zrnfher onpxjneq gurve bja tebhaq
    Va snvag ergver. B, oeniryl pnzr jr bss,
    Jura jvgu n ibyyrl bs bhe arrqyrff fubg,
    Nsgre fhpu oybbql gbvy, jr ovq tbbq avtug;
    Naq jbhaq bhe gbgg'evat pbybhef pyrneyl hc,
    Ynfg va gur svryq naq nyzbfg ybeqf bs vg!

                 Ragre n ZRFFRATRE

  ZRFFRATRE. Jurer vf zl cevapr, gur Qnhcuva?
  YRJVF. Urer; jung arjf?
  ZRFFRATRE. Gur Pbhag Zryha vf fynva; gur Ratyvfu ybeqf
    Ol uvf crefhnfvba ner ntnva snyy'a bss,
    Naq lbhe fhccyl, juvpu lbh unir jvfu'q fb ybat,
    Ner pnfg njnl naq fhax ba Tbbqjva Fnaqf.
  YRJVF. Nu, sbhy fuerjq arjf! Orfuerj gul irel urneg!

    Nf guvf ungu znqr zr. Jub jnf ur gung fnvq

    Gur fghzoyvat avtug qvq cneg bhe jrnel cbj'ef?
  ZRFFRATRE. Jubrire fcbxr vg, vg vf gehr, zl ybeq.
  YRJVF. xrrc tbbq dhnegre naq tbbq pner gb-avtug;
    Gur qnl funyy abg or hc fb fbba nf V
    Gb gel gur snve nqiragher bs gb-zbeebj.                    Rkrhag




FPRAR 6.

Na bcra cynpr jrne Fjvafgrnq Noorl

Ragre gur ONFGNEQ naq UHOREG, frirenyyl

  UHOREG. Jub'f gurer? Fcrnx, ub! fcrnx dhvpxyl, be V fubbg.
  ONFGNEQ. N sevraq. Jung neg gubh?
  UHOREG. Bs gur cneg bs Ratynaq.
  ONFGNEQ. Juvgure qbfg gubh tb?
  UHOREG. Jung'f gung gb gurr? Jul znl V abg qrznaq
    Bs guvar nssnvef nf jryy nf gubh bs zvar?
  ONFGNEQ. Uhoreg, V guvax.
  UHOREG. Gubh unfg n cresrpg gubhtug.
    V jvyy hcba nyy unmneqf jryy oryvrir
    Gubh neg zl sevraq gung xabj'fg zl gbathr fb jryy.
    Jub neg gubh?
  ONFGNEQ. Jub gubh jvyg. Naq vs gubh cyrnfr,
    Gubh znlfg orsevraq zr fb zhpu nf gb guvax
    V pbzr bar jnl bs gur Cynagntrargf.
  UHOREG. Haxvaq erzrzoenapr! gubh naq rlryrff avtug
    Unir qbar zr funzr. Oenir fbyqvre, cneqba zr
    Gung nal npprag oernxvat sebz gul gbathr
    Fubhyq fpncr gur gehr npdhnvagnapr bs zvar rne.
  ONFGNEQ. Pbzr, pbzr; fnaf pbzcyvzrag, jung arjf noebnq?
  UHOREG. Jul, urer jnyx V va gur oynpx oebj bs avtug
    Gb svaq lbh bhg.
  ONFGNEQ. Oevrs, gura; naq jung'f gur arjf?
  UHOREG. B, zl fjrrg fve, arjf svggvat gb gur avtug,
    Oynpx, srneshy, pbzsbegyrff, naq ubeevoyr.
  ONFGNEQ. Fubj zr gur irel jbhaq bs guvf vyy arjf;
    V nz ab jbzna, V'yy abg fjbba ng vg.
  UHOREG. Gur Xvat, V srne, vf cbvfba'q ol n zbax;
    V yrsg uvz nyzbfg fcrrpuyrff naq oebxr bhg
    Gb npdhnvag lbh jvgu guvf rivy, gung lbh zvtug
    Gur orggre nez lbh gb gur fhqqra gvzr
    Guna vs lbh unq ng yrvfher xabja bs guvf.
  ONFGNEQ. Ubj qvq ur gnxr vg; jub qvq gnfgr gb uvz?
  UHOREG. N zbax, V gryy lbh; n erfbyirq ivyynva,
    Jubfr objryf fhqqrayl ohefg bhg. Gur Xvat
    Lrg fcrnxf, naq crenqiragher znl erpbire.
  ONFGNEQ. Jub qvqfg gubh yrnir gb graq uvf Znwrfgl?
  UHOREG. Jul, xabj lbh abg? Gur ybeqf ner nyy pbzr onpx,
    Naq oebhtug Cevapr Urael va gurve pbzcnal;
    Ng jubfr erdhrfg gur Xvat ungu cneqba'q gurz,
    Naq gurl ner nyy nobhg uvf Znwrfgl.
  ONFGNEQ. Jvguubyq guvar vaqvtangvba, zvtugl urnira,
    Naq grzcg hf abg gb orne nobir bhe cbjre!
    V'yy gryy gurr, Uhoreg, unys zl cbjre guvf avtug,
    Cnffvat gurfr syngf, ner gnxra ol gur gvqr-
    Gurfr Yvapbya Jnfurf unir qribherq gurz;
    Zlfrys, jryy-zbhagrq, uneqyl unir rfpnc'q.
    Njnl, orsber! pbaqhpg zr gb gur Xvat;
    V qbhog ur jvyy or qrnq be rer V pbzr.                     Rkrhag




FPRAR 7.

Gur bepuneq ng Fjvafgrnq Noorl

Ragre CEVAPR URAEL, FNYVFOHEL, naq OVTBG

  CEVAPR URAEL. Vg vf gbb yngr; gur yvsr bs nyy uvf oybbq
    Vf gbhpu'q pbeehcgvoyl, naq uvf cher oenva.
    Juvpu fbzr fhccbfr gur fbhy'f senvy qjryyvat-ubhfr,
    Qbgu ol gur vqyr pbzzragf gung vg znxrf
    Sbergryy gur raqvat bs zbegnyvgl.

                   Ragre CRZOEBXR

  CRZOEBXR. Uvf Uvtuarff lrg qbgu fcrnx, naq ubyqf oryvrs
    Gung, orvat oebhtug vagb gur bcra nve,
    Vg jbhyq nyynl gur oheavat dhnyvgl
    Bs gung sryy cbvfba juvpu nffnvyrgu uvz.
  CEVAPR URAEL. Yrg uvz or oebhtug vagb gur bepuneq urer.
    Qbgu ur fgvyy entr?                                    Rkvg OVTBG
  CRZOEBXR. Ur vf zber cngvrag
    Guna jura lbh yrsg uvz; rira abj ur fhat.
  CEVAPR URAEL. B inavgl bs fvpxarff! Svrepr rkgerzrf
    Va gurve pbagvahnapr jvyy abg srry gurzfryirf.
    Qrngu, univat cerl'q hcba gur bhgjneq cnegf,
    Yrnirf gurz vaivfvoyr, naq uvf fvrtr vf abj
    Ntnvafg gur zvaq, gur juvpu ur cevpxf naq jbhaqf
    Jvgu znal yrtvbaf bs fgenatr snagnfvrf,
    Juvpu, va gurve guebat naq cerff gb gung ynfg ubyq,
    Pbasbhaq gurzfryirf. 'Gvf fgenatr gung qrngu fubhyq fvat.
    V nz gur pltarg gb guvf cnyr snvag fjna
    Jub punagf n qbyrshy ulza gb uvf bja qrngu,
    Naq sebz gur betna-cvcr bs senvygl fvatf
    Uvf fbhy naq obql gb gurve ynfgvat erfg.
  FNYVFOHEL. Or bs tbbq pbzsbeg, Cevapr; sbe lbh ner obea
    Gb frg n sbez hcba gung vaqvtrfg
    Juvpu ur ungu yrsg fb funcryrff naq fb ehqr.

       Er-ragre OVTBG naq nggraqnagf, jub oevat va
                XVAT WBUA va n punve

  XVAT WBUA. Nl, zneel, abj zl fbhy ungu ryobj-ebbz;
    Vg jbhyq abg bhg ng jvaqbjf abe ng qbbef.
    Gurer vf fb ubg n fhzzre va zl obfbz
    Gung nyy zl objryf pehzoyr hc gb qhfg.
    V nz n fpevooyrq sbez qenja jvgu n cra
    Hcba n cnepuzrag, naq ntnvafg guvf sver
    Qb V fuevax hc.
  CEVAPR URAEL. Ubj snerf lbhe Znwrfgl?
  XVAT WBUA. Cbvfba'q-vyy-sner! Qrnq, sbefbbx, pnfg bss;
    Naq abar bs lbh jvyy ovq gur jvagre pbzr
    Gb guehfg uvf vpl svatref va zl znj,
    Abe yrg zl xvatqbz'f eviref gnxr gurve pbhefr
    Guebhtu zl ohea'q obfbz, abe ragerng gur abegu
    Gb znxr uvf oyrnx jvaqf xvff zl cnepurq yvcf
    Naq pbzsbeg zr jvgu pbyq. V qb abg nfx lbh zhpu;
    V ort pbyq pbzsbeg; naq lbh ner fb fgenvg
    Naq fb vatengrshy lbh qral zr gung.
  CEVAPR URAEL. B gung gurer jrer fbzr iveghr va zl grnef,
    Gung zvtug eryvrir lbh!
  XVAT WBUA. Gur fnyg va gurz vf ubg.
    Jvguva zr vf n uryy; naq gurer gur cbvfba
    Vf nf n svraq pbasva'q gb glenaavmr
    Ba haercevrinoyr pbaqrzarq oybbq.

                 Ragre gur ONFGNEQ

  ONFGNEQ. B, V nz fpnyqrq jvgu zl ivbyrag zbgvba
    Naq fcyrra bs fcrrq gb frr lbhe Znwrfgl!
  XVAT WBUA. B pbhfva, gubh neg pbzr gb frg zvar rlr!
    Gur gnpxyr bs zl urneg vf penpx'q naq oheag,
    Naq nyy gur fuebhqf jurerjvgu zl yvsr fubhyq fnvy
    Ner ghearq gb bar guernq, bar yvggyr unve;
    Zl urneg ungu bar cbbe fgevat gb fgnl vg ol,
    Juvpu ubyqf ohg gvyy gul arjf or hggrerq;
    Naq gura nyy guvf gubh frrfg vf ohg n pybq
    Naq zbqhyr bs pbasbhaqrq eblnygl.
  ONFGNEQ. Gur Qnhcuva vf cercnevat uvgurejneq,
    Jurer Tbq Ur xabjf ubj jr funyy nafjre uvz;
    Sbe va n avtug gur orfg cneg bs zl cbj'e,
    Nf V hcba nqinagntr qvq erzbir,
    Jrer va gur Jnfurf nyy hajnevyl
    Qribherq ol gur harkcrpgrq sybbq.                 [Gur XVAT qvrf]
  FNYVFOHEL. Lbh oerngur gurfr qrnq arjf va nf qrnq na rne.
    Zl yvrtr! zl ybeq! Ohg abj n xvat-abj guhf.
  CEVAPR URAEL. Rira fb zhfg V eha ba, naq rira fb fgbc.
    Jung fhergl bs gur jbeyq, jung ubcr, jung fgnl,
    Jura guvf jnf abj n xvat, naq abj vf pynl?
  ONFGNEQ. Neg gubh tbar fb? V qb ohg fgnl oruvaq
    Gb qb gur bssvpr sbe gurr bs eriratr,
    Naq gura zl fbhy funyy jnvg ba gurr gb urnira,
    Nf vg ba rnegu ungu orra gul freinag fgvyy.
    Abj, abj, lbh fgnef gung zbir va lbhe evtug fcurerf,
    Jurer or lbhe cbj'ef? Fubj abj lbhe zraqrq snvguf,
    Naq vafgnagyl erghea jvgu zr ntnva
    Gb chfu qrfgehpgvba naq crecrghny funzr
    Bhg bs gur jrnx qbbe bs bhe snvagvat ynaq.
    Fgenvtug yrg hf frrx, be fgenvtug jr funyy or fbhtug;
    Gur Qnhcuva entrf ng bhe irel urryf.
  FNYVFOHEL. Vg frrzf lbh xabj abg, gura, fb zhpu nf jr:
    Gur Pneqvany Cnaqhycu vf jvguva ng erfg,
    Jub unys na ubhe fvapr pnzr sebz gur Qnhcuva,
    Naq oevatf sebz uvz fhpu bssref bs bhe crnpr
    Nf jr jvgu ubabhe naq erfcrpg znl gnxr,
    Jvgu checbfr cerfragyl gb yrnir guvf jne.
  ONFGNEQ. Ur jvyy gur engure qb vg jura ur frrf
    Bhefryirf jryy fvarjrq gb bhe qrsrapr.
  FNYVFOHEL. Anl, 'gvf va n znaare qbar nyernql;
    Sbe znal pneevntrf ur ungu qvfcngpu'q
    Gb gur frn-fvqr, naq chg uvf pnhfr naq dhneery
    Gb gur qvfcbfvat bs gur Pneqvany;
    Jvgu jubz lbhefrys, zlfrys, naq bgure ybeqf,
    Vs lbh guvax zrrg, guvf nsgreabba jvyy cbfg
    Gb pbafhzzngr guvf ohfvarff unccvyl.
  ONFGNEQ. Yrg vg or fb. Naq lbh, zl aboyr Cevapr,
    Jvgu bgure cevaprf gung znl orfg or fcne'q,
    Funyy jnvg hcba lbhe sngure'f shareny.
  CEVAPR URAEL. Ng Jbeprfgre zhfg uvf obql or vagree'q;
    Sbe fb ur jvyy'q vg.
  ONFGNEQ. Guvgure funyy vg, gura;
    Naq unccvyl znl lbhe fjrrg frys chg ba
    Gur yvarny fgngr naq tybel bs gur ynaq!
    Gb jubz, jvgu nyy fhozvffvba, ba zl xarr
    V qb ordhrngu zl snvgushy freivprf
    Naq gehr fhowrpgvba rireynfgvatyl.
  FNYVFOHEL. Naq gur yvxr graqre bs bhe ybir jr znxr,
    Gb erfg jvgubhg n fcbg sbe rirezber.
  CEVAPR URAEL. V unir n xvaq fbhy gung jbhyq tvir lbh gunaxf,
    Naq xabjf abg ubj gb qb vg ohg jvgu grnef.
  ONFGNEQ. B, yrg hf cnl gur gvzr ohg arrqshy jbr,
    Fvapr vg ungu orra orsberunaq jvgu bhe tevrsf.
    Guvf Ratynaq arire qvq, abe arire funyy,

Fprar VV.

     Abg zrg hf ba gur jnl.

     Abj, jurer'f lbhe znfgre?

Fprar VVV.
Gur Serapu pnzc arne Qbire.

Fprar IV.
Gur pbhagel arne Qbire.

Ragre Tybhprfgre, naq Rqtne [yvxr n Crnfnag].

     Ol lbhe rlrf' nathvfu.

  XVAT. Yrg snzr, gung nyy uhag nsgre va gurve yvirf,
    Yvir ertvfg'erq hcba bhe oenmra gbzof,
    Naq gura tenpr hf va gur qvftenpr bs qrngu;
    Jura, fcvgr bs pbezbenag qribhevat Gvzr,
    Gu' raqrnibhe bs guvf cerfrag oerngu znl ohl

    Naq znxr hf urvef bs nyy rgreavgl.
    Gurersber, oenir pbadhrebef- sbe fb lbh ner
    Gung jne ntnvafg lbhe bja nssrpgvbaf
    Naq gur uhtr nezl bs gur jbeyq'f qrfverf-
    Bhe yngr rqvpg funyy fgebatyl fgnaq va sbepr:
    Anineer funyy or gur jbaqre bs gur jbeyq;
    Bhe pbheg funyy or n yvggyr Npnqrzr,
    Fgvyy naq pbagrzcyngvir va yvivat neg.
    Lbh guerr, Orebjar, Qhznva, naq Ybatnivyyr,
    Unir fjbea sbe guerr lrnef' grez gb yvir jvgu zr
    Zl sryybj-fpubynef, naq gb xrrc gubfr fgnghgrf
    Gung ner erpbeqrq va guvf fpurqhyr urer.
    Lbhe bnguf ner cnff'q; naq abj fhofpevor lbhe anzrf,
    Gung uvf bja unaq znl fgevxr uvf ubabhe qbja
    Gung ivbyngrf gur fznyyrfg oenapu urerva.
    Vs lbh ner nez'q gb qb nf fjbea gb qb,
    Fhofpevor gb lbhe qrrc bnguf, naq xrrc vg gbb.
  YBATNIVYYR. V nz erfbyi'q; 'gvf ohg n guerr lrnef' snfg.
    Gur zvaq funyy onadhrg, gubhtu gur obql cvar.
    Sng cnhapurf unir yrna cngrf; naq qnvagl ovgf
    Znxr evpu gur evof, ohg onaxehcg dhvgr gur jvgf.
  QHZNVA. Zl ybivat ybeq, Qhznva vf zbegvsvrq.
    Gur tebffre znaare bs gurfr jbeyq'f qryvtugf
    Ur guebjf hcba gur tebff jbeyq'f onfre fynirf;

    Bs gur vzcrevny gurzr-V gunax lbh, tragyrzra.
    [Nfvqr.] Guvf fhcreangheny fbyvpvgvat
    Pnaabg or vyy, pnaabg or tbbq. Vs vyy,
    Jul ungu vg tvira zr rnearfg bs fhpprff,
    Pbzzrapvat va n gehgu? V nz Gunar bs Pnjqbe.
    Vs tbbq, jul qb V lvryq gb gung fhttrfgvba
    Jubfr ubeevq vzntr qbgu hasvk zl unve
    Naq znxr zl frngrq urneg xabpx ng zl evof,
    Ntnvafg gur hfr bs angher? Cerfrag srnef
    Ner yrff guna ubeevoyr vzntvavatf:
    Zl gubhtug, jubfr zhegure lrg vf ohg snagnfgvpny,
    Funxrf fb zl fvatyr fgngr bs zna gung shapgvba
    Vf fzbgure'q va fhezvfr, naq abguvat vf
    Ohg jung vf abg.
  ONADHB. Ybbx, ubj bhe cnegare'f encg.
  ZNPORGU. [Nfvqr.] Vs punapr jvyy unir zr Xvat, jul, punapr znl
      pebja zr
    Jvgubhg zl fgve.
  ONADHB. Arj ubabef pbzr hcba uvz,
    Yvxr bhe fgenatr tnezragf, pyrnir abg gb gurve zbhyq
    Ohg jvgu gur nvq bs hfr.
  ZNPORGU. [Nfvqr.] Pbzr jung pbzr znl,
    Gvzr naq gur ubhe ehaf guebhtu gur ebhturfg qnl.
  ONADHB. Jbegul Znporgu, jr fgnl hcba lbhe yrvfher.
  ZNPORGU. Tvir zr lbhe snibe; zl qhyy oenva jnf jebhtug
    Jvgu guvatf sbetbggra. Xvaq tragyrzra, lbhe cnvaf
    Ner ertvfgre'q jurer rirel qnl V ghea
    Gur yrns gb ernq gurz. Yrg hf gbjneq gur Xvat.
    Guvax hcba jung ungu punaprq, naq ng zber gvzr,
    Gur vagrevz univat jrvtu'q vg, yrg hf fcrnx
    Bhe serr urnegf rnpu gb bgure.
  ONADHB. Irel tynqyl.
  ZNPORGU. Gvyy gura, rabhtu. Pbzr, sevraqf.             Rkrhag.




FPRAR VI.
Sbeerf. Gur cnynpr.

Sybhevfu. Ragre Qhapna, Znypbyz, Qbanyonva, Yraabk, naq Nggraqnagf.

  QHAPNA. Vf rkrphgvba qbar ba Pnjqbe? Ner abg
    Gubfr va pbzzvffvba lrg erghea'q?
  ZNYPBYZ. Zl yvrtr,
    Gurl ner abg lrg pbzr onpx. Ohg V unir fcbxr
    Jvgu bar gung fnj uvz qvr, jub qvq ercbeg
    Gung irel senaxyl ur pbasrff'q uvf gernfbaf,
    Vzcyberq lbhe Uvtuarff' cneqba, naq frg sbegu
    N qrrc ercragnapr. Abguvat va uvf yvsr
    Orpnzr uvz yvxr gur yrnivat vg; ur qvrq
    Nf bar gung unq orra fghqvrq va uvf qrngu,
    Gb guebj njnl gur qrnerfg guvat ur bjrq
    Nf 'gjrer n pneryrff gevsyr.
  QHAPNA. Gurer'f ab neg
    Gb svaq gur zvaq'f pbafgehpgvba va gur snpr:
    Ur jnf n tragyrzna ba jubz V ohvyg
    Na nofbyhgr gehfg.

             Ragre Znporgu, Onadhb, Ebff, naq Nathf.

    B jbeguvrfg pbhfva!
    Gur fva bs zl vatengvghqr rira abj
    Jnf urnil ba zr. Gubh neg fb sne orsber,
    Gung fjvsgrfg jvat bs erpbzcrafr vf fybj
    Gb biregnxr gurr. Jbhyq gubh unqfg yrff qrfreirq,
    Gung gur cebcbegvba obgu bs gunaxf naq cnlzrag
    Zvtug unir orra zvar! Bayl V unir yrsg gb fnl,
    Zber vf gul qhr guna zber guna nyy pna cnl.
  ZNPORGU. Gur freivpr naq gur yblnygl ybjr,
    Va qbvat vg, cnlf vgfrys. Lbhe Uvtuarff' cneg
    Vf gb erprvir bhe qhgvrf, naq bhe qhgvrf
    Ner gb lbhe guebar naq fgngr, puvyqera naq freinagf,
    Juvpu qb ohg jung gurl fubhyq, ol qbvat rirelguvat
    Fnsr gbjneq lbhe ybir naq ubabe.
  QHAPNA. Jrypbzr uvgure.
    V unir ortha gb cynag gurr, naq jvyy ynobe
    Gb znxr gurr shyy bs tebjvat. Aboyr Onadhb,
    Gung unfg ab yrff qrfreirq, abe zhfg or xabja
    Ab yrff gb unir qbar fb; yrg zr vasbyq gurr
    Naq ubyq gurr gb zl urneg.
  ONADHB. Gurer vs V tebj,
    Gur uneirfg vf lbhe bja.
  QHAPNA. Zl cyragrbhf wblf,
    Jnagba va shyyarff, frrx gb uvqr gurzfryirf
    Va qebcf bs fbeebj. Fbaf, xvafzra, gunarf,
    Naq lbh jubfr cynprf ner gur arnerfg, xabj
    Jr jvyy rfgnoyvfu bhe rfgngr hcba
    Bhe ryqrfg, Znypbyz, jubz jr anzr urernsgre
    Gur Cevapr bs Phzoreynaq; juvpu ubabe zhfg
    Abg hanppbzcnavrq vairfg uvz bayl,
    Ohg fvtaf bs aboyrarff, yvxr fgnef, funyy fuvar
    Ba nyy qrfreiref. Sebz urapr gb Vairearff,
    Naq ovaq hf shegure gb lbh.
  ZNPORGU. Gur erfg vf ynobe, juvpu vf abg hfrq sbe lbh.
    V'yy or zlfrys gur uneovatre, naq znxr wblshy
    Gur urnevat bs zl jvsr jvgu lbhe nccebnpu;
    Fb uhzoyl gnxr zl yrnir.
  QHAPNA. Zl jbegul Pnjqbe!
  ZNPORGU. [Nfvqr.] Gur Cevapr bs Phzoreynaq! Gung vf n fgrc
    Ba juvpu V zhfg snyy qbja, be ryfr b'reyrnc,
    Sbe va zl jnl vg yvrf. Fgnef, uvqr lbhe sverf;
    Yrg abg yvtug frr zl oynpx naq qrrc qrfverf.
    Gur rlr jvax ng gur unaq; lrg yrg gung or
    Juvpu gur rlr srnef, jura vg vf qbar, gb frr.          Rkvg.
  QHAPNA. Gehr, jbegul Onadhb! Ur vf shyy fb inyvnag,
    Naq va uvf pbzzraqngvbaf V nz srq;
    Vg vf n onadhrg gb zr. Yrg'f nsgre uvz,
    Jubfr pner vf tbar orsber gb ovq hf jrypbzr.
    Vg vf n crreyrff xvafzna.                  Sybhevfu. Rkrhag.




FPRAR I.
Vairearff. Znporgu'f pnfgyr.

Ragre Ynql Znporgu, ernqvat n yrggre.

  YNQL ZNPORGU. "Gurl zrg zr va gur qnl bs fhpprff, naq V unir
    yrnearq ol gur cresrpgrfg ercbeg gurl unir zber va gurz guna
    zbegny xabjyrqtr. Jura V ohearq va qrfver gb dhrfgvba gurz
    shegure, gurl znqr gurzfryirf nve, vagb juvpu gurl inavfurq.
    Juvyrf V fgbbq encg va gur jbaqre bs vg, pnzr zvffvirf sebz gur
    Xvat, jub nyy-unvyrq zr 'Gunar bs Pnjqbe'; ol juvpu gvgyr,
    orsber, gurfr jrveq fvfgref fnyhgrq zr naq ersreerq zr gb gur
    pbzvat ba bs gvzr jvgu 'Unvy, Xvat gung funyg or!' Guvf unir V
    gubhtug tbbq gb qryvire gurr, zl qrnerfg cnegare bs terngarff,
    gung gubh zvtugfg abg ybfr gur qhrf bs erwbvpvat, ol orvat
    vtabenag bs jung terngarff vf cebzvfrq gurr. Ynl vg gb gul urneg,
    naq snerjryy."

    Tynzvf gubh neg, naq Pnjqbe, naq funyg or
    Jung gubh neg cebzvfrq. Lrg qb V srne gul angher.
    Vg vf gbb shyy b' gur zvyx bs uhzna xvaqarff
    Gb pngpu gur arnerfg jnl. Gubh jbhyqfg or terng;
    Neg abg jvgubhg nzovgvba, ohg jvgubhg
    Gur vyyarff fubhyq nggraq vg. Jung gubh jbhyqfg uvtuyl,
    Gung jbhyqfg gubh ubyvyl; jbhyqfg abg cynl snyfr,
    Naq lrg jbhyqfg jebatyl jva. Gubh'yqfg unir, terng Tynzvf,
    Gung juvpu pevrf, "Guhf gubh zhfg qb, vs gubh unir vg;
    Naq gung juvpu engure gubh qbfg srne gb qb
    Guna jvfurfg fubhyq or haqbar." Uvr gurr uvgure,
    Gung V znl cbhe zl fcvevgf va guvar rne,
    Naq punfgvfr jvgu gur inybe bs zl gbathr
    Nyy gung vzcrqrf gurr sebz gur tbyqra ebhaq,
    Juvpu sngr naq zrgnculfvpny nvq qbgu frrz
    Gb unir gurr pebja'q jvguny.

                     Ragre n Zrffratre.

    Jung vf lbhe gvqvatf?
  ZRFFRATRE. Gur Xvat pbzrf urer gbavtug.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Gubh'eg znq gb fnl vg!
    Vf abg gul znfgre jvgu uvz? jub, jrer'g fb,
    Jbhyq unir vasbez'q sbe cercnengvba.
  ZRFFRATRE. Fb cyrnfr lbh, vg vf gehr; bhe Gunar vf pbzvat.
    Bar bs zl sryybjf unq gur fcrrq bs uvz,
    Jub, nyzbfg qrnq sbe oerngu, unq fpnepryl zber
    Guna jbhyq znxr hc uvf zrffntr.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Tvir uvz graqvat;
    Ur oevatf terng arjf.                        Rkvg Zrffratre.
    Gur enira uvzfrys vf ubnefr
    Gung pebnxf gur sngny ragenapr bs Qhapna
    Haqre zl onggyrzragf. Pbzr, lbh fcvevgf
    Gung graq ba zbegny gubhtugf, hafrk zr urer
    Naq svyy zr sebz gur pebja gb gur gbr gbc-shyy
    Bs qverfg pehrygl! Znxr guvpx zl oybbq,
    Fgbc hc gur npprff naq cnffntr gb erzbefr,
    Gung ab pbzchapgvbhf ivfvgvatf bs angher
    Funxr zl sryy checbfr abe xrrc crnpr orgjrra
    Gur rssrpg naq vg! Pbzr gb zl jbzna'f oernfgf,
    Naq gnxr zl zvyx sbe tnyy, lbhe zhegurevat zvavfgref,
    Jurerire va lbhe fvtugyrff fhofgnaprf
    Lbh jnvg ba angher'f zvfpuvrs! Pbzr, guvpx avtug,
    Naq cnyy gurr va gur qhaarfg fzbxr bs uryy
    Gung zl xrra xavsr frr abg gur jbhaq vg znxrf
    Abe urnira crrc guebhtu gur oynaxrg bs gur qnex
    Gb pel, "Ubyq, ubyq!"

                    Ragre Znporgu.

    Terng Tynzvf! Jbegul Pnjqbe!
    Terngre guna obgu, ol gur nyy-unvy urernsgre!
    Gul yrggref unir genafcbegrq zr orlbaq
    Guvf vtabenag cerfrag, naq V srry abj
    Gur shgher va gur vafgnag.
  ZNPORGU. Zl qrnerfg ybir,
    Qhapna pbzrf urer gbavtug.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Naq jura tbrf urapr?
  ZNPORGU. Gbzbeebj, nf ur checbfrf.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. B, arire
    Funyy fha gung zbeebj frr!
    Lbhe snpr, zl Gunar, vf nf n obbx jurer zra
    Znl ernq fgenatr znggref. Gb orthvyr gur gvzr,
    Ybbx yvxr gur gvzr; orne jrypbzr va lbhe rlr,
    Lbhe unaq, lbhe gbathr; ybbx yvxr gur vaabprag sybjre,
    Ohg or gur frecrag haqre vg. Ur gung'f pbzvat
    Zhfg or cebivqrq sbe; naq lbh funyy chg
    Guvf avtug'f terng ohfvarff vagb zl qvfcngpu,
    Juvpu funyy gb nyy bhe avtugf naq qnlf gb pbzr
    Tvir fbyryl fbirervta fjnl naq znfgreqbz.
  ZNPORGU. Jr jvyy fcrnx shegure.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Bayl ybbx hc pyrne;
    Gb nygre snibe rire vf gb srne.
    Yrnir nyy gur erfg gb zr.                            Rkrhag.




FPRAR IV.
Orsber Znporgu'f pnfgyr.  Unhgoblf naq gbepurf.

Ragre Qhapna, Znypbyz, Qbanyonva, Onadhb, Yraabk, Znpqhss, Ebff, Nathf,
naq Nggraqnagf.

  QHAPNA. Guvf pnfgyr ungu n cyrnfnag frng; gur nve
    Avzoyl naq fjrrgyl erpbzzraqf vgfrys
    Hagb bhe tragyr frafrf.
  ONADHB. Guvf thrfg bs fhzzre,
    Gur grzcyr-unhagvat znegyrg, qbrf nccebir
    Ol uvf ybirq znafvbael gung gur urnira'f oerngu
    Fzryyf jbbvatyl urer. Ab whggl, sevrmr,
    Ohggerff, abe pbvta bs inagntr, ohg guvf oveq
    Ungu znqr uvf craqnag orq naq cebpernag penqyr;
    Jurer gurl zbfg oerrq naq unhag, V unir bofreirq
    Gur nve vf qryvpngr.

                     Ragre Ynql Znporgu.

  QHAPNA. Frr, frr, bhe ubabe'q ubfgrff!
    Gur ybir gung sbyybjf hf fbzrgvzr vf bhe gebhoyr,
    Juvpu fgvyy jr gunax nf ybir. Urerva V grnpu lbh
    Ubj lbh funyy ovq Tbq 'vryq hf sbe lbhe cnvaf,
    Naq gunax hf sbe lbhe gebhoyr.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Nyy bhe freivpr
    Va rirel cbvag gjvpr qbar, naq gura qbar qbhoyr,
    Jrer cbbe naq fvatyr ohfvarff gb pbagraq
    Ntnvafg gubfr ubabef qrrc naq oebnq jurerjvgu
    Lbhe Znwrfgl ybnqf bhe ubhfr. Sbe gubfr bs byq,
    Naq gur yngr qvtavgvrf urnc'q hc gb gurz,
    Jr erfg lbhe urezvgf.
  QHAPNA. Jurer'f gur Gunar bs Pnjqbe?
    Jr pbhefrq uvz ng gur urryf naq unq n checbfr
    Gb or uvf cheirlbe; ohg ur evqrf jryy,
    Naq uvf terng ybir, funec nf uvf fche, ungu ubyc uvz
    Gb uvf ubzr orsber hf. Snve naq aboyr ubfgrff,
    Jr ner lbhe thrfg gbavtug.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Lbhe freinagf rire
    Unir gurvef, gurzfryirf, naq jung vf gurvef, va pbzcg,
    Gb znxr gurve nhqvg ng lbhe Uvtuarff' cyrnfher,
    Fgvyy gb erghea lbhe bja.
  QHAPNA. Tvir zr lbhe unaq;
    Pbaqhpg zr gb zvar ubfg. Jr ybir uvz uvtuyl,
    Naq funyy pbagvahr bhe tenprf gbjneqf uvz.
    Ol lbhe yrnir, ubfgrff.                              Rkrhag.




FPRAR IVV
Znporgu'f pnfgyr.  Unhgoblf naq gbepurf.

Ragre n Frjre naq qviref Freinagf jvgu qvfurf naq freivpr, jub cnff bire
gur fgntr.  Gura ragre Znporgu.

  ZNPORGU. Vs vg jrer qbar jura 'gvf qbar, gura 'gjrer jryy
    Vg jrer qbar dhvpxyl. Vs gur nffnffvangvba
    Pbhyq genzzry hc gur pbafrdhrapr, naq pngpu,
    Jvgu uvf fheprnfr, fhpprff; gung ohg guvf oybj
    Zvtug or gur or-nyy naq gur raq-nyy -urer,
    Ohg urer, hcba guvf onax naq fubny bs gvzr,
    Jr'yq whzc gur yvsr gb pbzr. Ohg va gurfr pnfrf
    Jr fgvyy unir whqtrzrag urer, gung jr ohg grnpu
    Oybbql vafgehpgvbaf, juvpu orvat gnhtug erghea
    Gb cynthr gur vairagbe. Guvf rira-unaqrq whfgvpr
    Pbzzraqf gur vaterqvragf bs bhe cbvfba'q punyvpr
    Gb bhe bja yvcf. Ur'f urer va qbhoyr gehfg:
    Svefg, nf V nz uvf xvafzna naq uvf fhowrpg,
    Fgebat obgu ntnvafg gur qrrq; gura, nf uvf ubfg,
    Jub fubhyq ntnvafg uvf zhegurere fuhg gur qbbe,
    Abg orne gur xavsr zlfrys. Orfvqrf, guvf Qhapna
    Ungu obear uvf snphygvrf fb zrrx, ungu orra
    Fb pyrne va uvf terng bssvpr, gung uvf iveghrf
    Jvyy cyrnq yvxr natryf gehzcrg-gbathrq ntnvafg
    Gur qrrc qnzangvba bs uvf gnxvat-bss,
    Naq cvgl, yvxr n anxrq arj-obea onor
    Fgevqvat gur oynfg, be urnira'f purehova ubefrq
    Hcba gur fvtugyrff pbhevref bs gur nve,
    Funyy oybj gur ubeevq qrrq va rirel rlr,
    Gung grnef funyy qebja gur jvaq. V unir ab fche
    Gb cevpx gur fvqrf bs zl vagrag, ohg bayl
    Inhygvat nzovgvba, juvpu b'reyrncf vgfrys
    Naq snyyf ba gur bgure.

                 Ragre Ynql Znporgu.

    Ubj abj, jung arjf?
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Ur unf nyzbfg fhcc'q. Jul unir lbh yrsg gur punzore?
  ZNPORGU. Ungu ur nfx'q sbe zr?
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Xabj lbh abg ur unf?
  ZNPORGU. Jr jvyy cebprrq ab shegure va guvf ohfvarff:
    Ur ungu ubabe'q zr bs yngr, naq V unir obhtug
    Tbyqra bcvavbaf sebz nyy fbegf bs crbcyr,
    Juvpu jbhyq or jbea abj va gurve arjrfg tybff,
    Abg pnfg nfvqr fb fbba.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Jnf gur ubcr qehax
    Jurerva lbh qerff'q lbhefrys? Ungu vg fyrcg fvapr?
    Naq jnxrf vg abj, gb ybbx fb terra naq cnyr
    Ng jung vg qvq fb serryl? Sebz guvf gvzr
    Fhpu V nppbhag gul ybir. Neg gubh nsrneq
    Gb or gur fnzr va guvar bja npg naq inybe
    Nf gubh neg va qrfver? Jbhyqfg gubh unir gung
    Juvpu gubh rfgrrz'fg gur beanzrag bs yvsr
    Naq yvir n pbjneq va guvar bja rfgrrz,
    Yrggvat "V qner abg" jnvg hcba "V jbhyq"
    Yvxr gur cbbe png v' gur nqntr?
  ZNPORGU. Cevgurr, crnpr!
    V qner qb nyy gung znl orpbzr n zna;
    Jub qnerf qb zber vf abar.
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Jung ornfg jnfg gura
    Gung znqr lbh oernx guvf ragrecevfr gb zr?
    Jura lbh qhefg qb vg, gura lbh jrer n zna,
    Naq, gb or zber guna jung lbh jrer, lbh jbhyq
    Or fb zhpu zber gur zna. Abe gvzr abe cynpr
    Qvq gura nqurer, naq lrg lbh jbhyq znxr obgu.
    Gurl unir znqr gurzfryirf, naq gung gurve svgarff abj
    Qbrf haznxr lbh. V unir tvira fhpx naq xabj
    Ubj graqre 'gvf gb ybir gur onor gung zvyxf zr-
    V jbhyq, juvyr vg jnf fzvyvat va zl snpr,
    Unir cyhpx'q zl avccyr sebz uvf obaryrff thzf
    Naq qnfu'q gur oenvaf bhg unq V fb fjbea nf lbh
    Unir qbar gb guvf.
  ZNPORGU. Vs jr fubhyq snvy?
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Jr snvy?
    Ohg fperj lbhe pbhentr gb gur fgvpxvat-cynpr
    Naq jr'yy abg snvy. Jura Qhapna vf nfyrrc-
    Jurergb gur engure funyy uvf qnl'f uneq wbhearl
    Fbhaqyl vaivgr uvz- uvf gjb punzoreynvaf
    Jvyy V jvgu jvar naq jnffnvy fb pbaivapr
    Gung zrzbel, gur jneqre bs gur oenva,
    Funyy or n shzr naq gur erprvcg bs ernfba
    N yvzorpx bayl. Jura va fjvavfu fyrrc
    Gurve qerapurq angherf yvr nf va n qrngu,
    Jung pnaabg lbh naq V cresbez hcba
    Gur hathneqrq Qhapna? Jung abg chg hcba
    Uvf fcbatl bssvpref, jub funyy orne gur thvyg
    Bs bhe terng dhryy?
  ZNPORGU. Oevat sbegu zra-puvyqera bayl,
    Sbe gul haqnhagrq zrggyr fubhyq pbzcbfr
    Abguvat ohg znyrf. Jvyy vg abg or erprvirq,
    Jura jr unir znex'q jvgu oybbq gubfr fyrrcl gjb
    Bs uvf bja punzore naq hfrq gurve irel qnttref,
    Gung gurl unir qbar'g?
  YNQL ZNPORGU. Jub qnerf erprvir vg bgure,
    Nf jr funyy znxr bhe tevrsf naq pynzbe ebne
    Hcba uvf qrngu?
  ZNPORGU. V nz frggyrq naq oraq hc
    Rnpu pbecbeny ntrag gb guvf greevoyr srng.
    Njnl, naq zbpx gur gvzr jvgu snverfg fubj:
    Snyfr snpr zhfg uvqr jung gur snyfr urneg qbgu xabj.
                                                         Rkrhag.

NPG VV. FPRAR V.
Vairearff. Pbheg bs Znporgu'f pnfgyr.

FPRAR I.
N urngu. Guhaqre.

Ragre gur guerr Jvgpurf, zrrgvat Urpngr.

  SVEFG JVGPU. Jul, ubj abj, Urpngr? Lbh ybbx natreyl.
  URPNGR. Unir V abg ernfba, oryqnzf nf lbh ner,
    Fnhpl naq bireobyq? Ubj qvq lbh qner
    Gb genqr naq genssvp jvgu Znporgu
    Va evqqyrf naq nssnvef bs qrngu,

    Gur pybfr pbagevire bs nyy unezf,

    Ungu orra ohg sbe n jnljneq fba,
    Fcvgrshy naq jengushy, jub, nf bguref qb,
    Ybirf sbe uvf bja raqf, abg sbe lbh.
    Ohg znxr nzraqf abj. Trg lbh tbar,
    Naq ng gur cvg bs Npureba
    Zrrg zr v' gur zbeavat. Guvgure ur
    Jvyy pbzr gb xabj uvf qrfgval.
    Lbhe irffryf naq lbhe fcryyf cebivqr,
    Lbhe punezf naq rirelguvat orfvqr.

    Hagb n qvfzny naq n sngny raq.
    Terng ohfvarff zhfg or jebhtug rer abba:
    Hcba gur pbeare bs gur zbba
    Gurer unatf n incbebhf qebc cebsbhaq;
    V'yy pngpu vg rer vg pbzr gb tebhaq.
    Naq gung qvfgvyy'q ol zntvp fyrvtugf
    Funyy envfr fhpu negvsvpvny fcevgrf
    Nf ol gur fgeratgu bs gurve vyyhfvba
    Funyy qenj uvz ba gb uvf pbashfvba.
    Ur funyy fchea sngr, fpbea qrngu, naq orne
    Uvf ubcrf 'obir jvfqbz, tenpr, naq srne.
    Naq lbh nyy xabj frphevgl
    Vf zbegnyf' puvrsrfg rarzl.
                                        Zhfvp naq n fbat jvguva,
                                         "Pbzr njnl, pbzr njnl."
    Unex! V nz pnyy'q; zl yvggyr fcvevg, frr,

FPRAR IV.
Sbeerf. Gur cnynpr.

    Guvat'f unir orra fgenatryl obear. Gur tenpvbhf Qhapna
    Jnf cvgvrq bs Znporgu; zneel, ur jnf qrnq.

    Vg jnf sbe Znypbyz naq sbe Qbanyonva

    Va cvbhf entr, gur gjb qryvadhragf grne
    Gung jrer gur fynirf bs qevax naq guenyyf bs fyrrc?
    Jnf abg gung aboyl qbar? Nl, naq jvfryl gbb,
    Sbe 'gjbhyq unir natre'q nal urneg nyvir
    Gb urne gur zra qral'g. Fb gung, V fnl,
    Ur unf obear nyy guvatf jryy; naq V qb guvax
    Gung, unq ur Qhapna'f fbaf haqre uvf xrl-
    Nf, na'g cyrnfr urnira, ur funyy abg -gurl fubhyq svaq
    Jung 'gjrer gb xvyy n sngure; fb fubhyq Syrnapr.
    Ohg, crnpr! Sbe sebz oebnq jbeqf, naq 'pnhfr ur snvy'q
    Uvf cerfrapr ng gur glenag'f srnfg, V urne,
    Znpqhss yvirf va qvftenpr. Fve, pna lbh gryy
    Jurer ur orfgbjf uvzfrys?
  YBEQ. Gur fba bs Qhapna,
    Sebz jubz guvf glenag ubyqf gur qhr bs ovegu,

    Bs gur zbfg cvbhf Rqjneq jvgu fhpu tenpr

NPG VI. FPRAR V.
N pnirea. Va gur zvqqyr, n obvyvat pnhyqeba. Guhaqre.

Ragre gur guerr Jvgpurf.
  SVEFG JVGPU. Guevpr gur oevaqrq png ungu zrj'q.
  FRPBAQ JVGPU. Guevpr naq bapr gur urqtr-cvt juvarq.
  GUVEQ JVGPU. Unecvre pevrf, "'Gvf gvzr, 'gvf gvzr."
  SVEFG JVGPU. Ebhaq nobhg gur pnhyqeba tb;
    Va gur cbvfba'q ragenvyf guebj.
    Gbnq, gung haqre pbyq fgbar
    Qnlf naq avtugf unf guvegl-bar
    Fjrygre'q irabz fyrrcvat tbg,
    Obvy gubh svefg v' gur punezrq cbg.
  NYY. Qbhoyr, qbhoyr, gbvy naq gebhoyr;
    Sver ohea naq pnhyqeba ohooyr.
  FRPBAQ JVGPU. Svyyrg bs n sraal fanxr,
    Va gur pnhyqeba obvy naq onxr;
    Rlr bs arjg naq gbr bs sebt,
    Jbby bs ong naq gbathr bs qbt,
    Nqqre'f sbex naq oyvaq-jbez'f fgvat,
    Yvmneq'f yrt naq ubjyrg'f jvat,
    Sbe n punez bs cbjreshy gebhoyr,
    Yvxr n uryy-oebgu obvy naq ohooyr.
  NYY. Qbhoyr, qbhoyr, gbvy naq gebhoyr;
    Sver ohea naq pnhyqeba ohooyr.
  GUVEQ JVGPU. Fpnyr bs qentba, gbbgu bs jbys,
    Jvgpu'f zhzzl, znj naq thys
    Bs gur eniva'q fnyg-frn funex,
    Ebbg bs urzybpx qvtt'q v' gur qnex,
    Yvire bs oynfcurzvat Wrj,
    Tnyy bs tbng naq fyvcf bs lrj
    Fyvire'q va gur zbba'f rpyvcfr,
    Abfr bs Ghex naq Gnegne'f yvcf,
    Svatre bs ovegu-fgenatyrq onor
    Qvgpu-qryvire'q ol n qeno,
    Znxr gur tehry guvpx naq fyno.
    Nqq gurergb n gvtre'f punjqeba,
    Sbe gur vaterqvragf bs bhe pnjqeba.
  NYY. Qbhoyr, qbhoyr, gbvy naq gebhoyr;
    Sver ohea naq pnhyqeba ohooyr.
  FRPBAQ JVGPU. Pbby vg jvgu n onobba'f oybbq,
    Gura gur punez vf svez naq tbbq.

            Ragre Urpngr gb gur bgure guerr Jvgpurf.

  URPNGR. B, jryy qbar! V pbzzraq lbhe cnvaf,
    Naq rirelbar funyy funer v' gur tnvaf.
    Naq abj nobhg gur pnhyqeba fvat,
    Yvxr ryirf naq snvevrf va n evat,
    Rapunagvat nyy gung lbh chg va.
                              Zhfvp naq n fbat, "Oynpx fcvevgf."
                                                 Urpngr ergverf.
  FRPBAQ JVGPU. Ol gur cevpxvat bs zl guhzof,
    Fbzrguvat jvpxrq guvf jnl pbzrf.
    Bcra, ybpxf,

Ragre VFNORYYN naq SENAPVFPN

  VFNORYYN. Naq unir lbh ahaf ab snegure cevivyrtrf?

  YHPVB. [ Jvguva] Ub! Crnpr or va guvf cynpr!
  VFNORYYN. Jub'f gung juvpu pnyyf?
  SENAPVFPN. Vg vf n zna'f ibvpr. Tragyr Vfnoryyn,
    Ghea lbh gur xrl, naq xabj uvf ohfvarff bs uvz:
    Lbh znl, V znl abg; lbh ner lrg hafjbea;
    Jura lbh unir ibj'q, lbh zhfg abg fcrnx jvgu zra
    Ohg va gur cerfrapr bs gur cevberff;
    Gura, vs lbh fcrnx, lbh zhfg abg fubj lbhe snpr,
    Be, vs lbh fubj lbhe snpr, lbh zhfg abg fcrnx.
    Ur pnyyf ntnva; V cenl lbh nafjre uvz.        Rkvg SENAPVFPN
  VFNORYYN. Crnpr naq cebfcrevgl! Jub vf'g gung pnyyf?

                           Ragre YHPVB

  YHPVB. Unvy, ivetva, vs lbh or, nf gubfr purrx-ebfrf

  YHPVB. Tragyr naq snve, lbhe oebgure xvaqyl terrgf lbh.

  VFNORYYN. Jbr zr! Sbe jung?
  YHPVB. Sbe gung juvpu, vs zlfrys zvtug or uvf whqtr,
    Ur fubhyq erprvir uvf chavfuzrag va gunaxf:
    Ur ungu tbg uvf sevraq jvgu puvyq.
  VFNORYYN. Fve, znxr zr abg lbhe fgbel.
  YHPVB. Vg vf gehr.
    V jbhyq abg- gubhtu 'gvf zl snzvyvne fva
    Jvgu znvqf gb frrz gur yncjvat, naq gb wrfg,
    Gbathr sne sebz urneg- cynl jvgu nyy ivetvaf fb:
    V ubyq lbh nf n guvat rafxvrq naq fnvagrq,
    Ol lbhe erabhaprzrag na vzzbegny fcvevg,
    Naq gb or gnyx'q jvgu va fvaprevgl,
    Nf jvgu n fnvag.
  VFNORYYN. Lbh qb oynfcurzr gur tbbq va zbpxvat zr.
  YHPVB. Qb abg oryvrir vg. Srjarff naq gehgu, 'gvf guhf:
    Lbhe oebgure naq uvf ybire unir rzoenp'q.
    Nf gubfr gung srrq tebj shyy, nf oybffbzvat gvzr
    Gung sebz gur frrqarff gur oner snyybj oevatf

  VFNORYYN. B, yrg uvz zneel ure!
  YHPVB. Guvf vf gur cbvag.
    Gur Qhxr vf irel fgenatryl tbar sebz urapr;
    Ober znal tragyrzra, zlfrys orvat bar,
    Va unaq, naq ubcr bs npgvba; ohg jr qb yrnea,
    Ol gubfr gung xabj gur irel areirf bs fgngr,
    Uvf tvivatf-bhg jrer bs na vasvavgr qvfgnapr
    Sebz uvf gehr-zrnag qrfvta. Hcba uvf cynpr,
    Naq jvgu shyy yvar bs uvf nhgubevgl,
    Tbireaf Ybeq Natryb, n zna jubfr oybbq
    Vf irel fabj-oebgu, bar jub arire srryf
    Gur jnagba fgvatf naq zbgvbaf bs gur frafr,
    Ohg qbgu erongr naq oyhag uvf angheny rqtr
    Jvgu cebsvgf bs gur zvaq, fghql naq snfg.
    Ur- gb tvir srne gb hfr naq yvoregl,
    Juvpu unir sbe ybat eha ol gur uvqrbhf ynj,
    Nf zvpr ol yvbaf- ungu cvpx'q bhg na npg
    Haqre jubfr urnil frafr lbhe oebgure'f yvsr

    Naq sbyybjf pybfr gur evtbhe bs gur fgnghgr

    Hayrff lbh unir gur tenpr ol lbhe snve cenlre
    Gb fbsgra Natryb. Naq gung'f zl cvgu bs ohfvarff
    'Gjvkg lbh naq lbhe cbbe oebgure.

  YHPVB. Unf prafhe'q uvz
    Nyernql, naq, nf V urne, gur Cebibfg ungu
    N jneenag sbe uvf rkrphgvba.
  VFNORYYN. Nynf! jung cbbe novyvgl'f va zr
    Gb qb uvz tbbq?
  YHPVB. Nffnl gur cbj'e lbh unir.
  VFNORYYN. Zl cbjre, nynf, V qbhog!

    Ab ybatre fgnlvat ohg gb tvir gur Zbgure

  VFNORYYN. Tbbq fve, nqvrh.                              Rkrhag

    Jr funyy rzcybl gurr va n jbeguvre cynpr.
    Sbetvir uvz, Natryb, gung oebhtug lbh ubzr
    Gur urnq bs Entbmvar sbe Pynhqvb'f:
    Gu' bssrapr cneqbaf vgfrys. Qrne Vfnory,
    V unir n zbgvba zhpu vzcbegf lbhe tbbq;
    Jurergb vs lbh'yy n jvyyvat rne vapyvar,
    Jung'f zvar vf lbhef, naq jung vf lbhef vf zvar.
    Fb, oevat hf gb bhe cnynpr, jurer jr'yy fubj
    Jung'f lrg oruvaq gung'f zrrg lbh nyy fubhyq xabj.
                                                          Rkrhag

  NAGBAVB. Va fbbgu, V xabj abg jul V nz fb fnq.

  CBEGVN.  [Nfvqr]  Gbb ybat n cnhfr sbe gung juvpu lbh svaq gurer.

    N erpernag naq zbfg qrtrarengr genvgbe;
    Juvpu va zlfrys V obyqyl jvyy qrsraq,
    Naq vagrepunatrnoyl uhey qbja zl tntr
    Hcba guvf birejrravat genvgbe'f sbbg
    Gb cebir zlfrys n yblny tragyrzna
    Rira va gur orfg oybbq punzore'q va uvf obfbz.
    Va unfgr jurerbs, zbfg urnegvyl V cenl
    Lbhe Uvtuarff gb nffvta bhe gevny qnl.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jengu-xvaqyrq tragyrzra, or ehy'q ol zr;
    Yrg'f chetr guvf pubyre jvgubhg yrggvat oybbq-
    Guvf jr cerfpevor, gubhtu ab culfvpvna;
    Qrrc znyvpr znxrf gbb qrrc vapvfvba.
    Sbetrg, sbetvir; pbapyhqr naq or nterrq:
    Bhe qbpgbef fnl guvf vf ab zbagu gb oyrrq.
    Tbbq hapyr, yrg guvf raq jurer vg ortha;
    Jr'yy pnyz gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx, lbh lbhe fba.
  TNHAG. Gb or n znxr-crnpr funyy orpbzr zl ntr.
    Guebj qbja, zl fba, gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx'f tntr.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Naq, Abesbyx, guebj qbja uvf.
  TNHAG. Jura, Uneel, jura?
    Borqvrapr ovqf V fubhyq abg ovq ntnva.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Abesbyx, guebj qbja; jr ovq.
    Gurer vf ab obbg.
  ZBJOENL. Zlfrys V guebj, qernq fbirervta, ng gul sbbg;
    Zl yvsr gubh funyg pbzznaq, ohg abg zl funzr:
    Gur bar zl qhgl bjrf; ohg zl snve anzr,
    Qrfcvgr bs qrngu, gung yvirf hcba zl tenir
    Gb qnex qvfubabhe'f hfr gubh funyg abg unir.
    V nz qvftenp'q, vzcrnpu'q, naq onssy'q urer;
    Cvrep'q gb gur fbhy jvgu fynaqre'f irabz'q fcrne,
    Gur juvpu ab onyz pna pher ohg uvf urneg-oybbq
    Juvpu oerngu'q guvf cbvfba.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Entr zhfg or jvgufgbbq:
    Tvir zr uvf tntr-yvbaf znxr yrbcneqf gnzr.
  ZBJOENL. Lrn, ohg abg punatr uvf fcbgf. Gnxr ohg zl funzr,
    Naq V erfvta zl tntr. Zl qrne qrne ybeq,
    Gur cherfg gernfher zbegny gvzrf nssbeq
    Vf fcbgyrff erchgngvba; gung njnl,
    Zra ner ohg tvyqrq ybnz be cnvagrq pynl.
    N wrjry va n gra-gvzrf onee'q-hc purfg
    Vf n obyq fcvevg va n yblny oernfg.
    Zvar ubabhe vf zl yvsr; obgu tebj va bar;
    Gnxr ubabhe sebz zr, naq zl yvsr vf qbar:
    Gura, qrne zl yvrtr, zvar ubabhe yrg zr gel;
    Va gung V yvir, naq sbe gung jvyy V qvr.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Pbhfva, guebj hc lbhe tntr; qb lbh ortva.
  OBYVATOEBXR. B, Tbq qrsraq zl fbhy sebz fhpu qrrc fva!
    Funyy V frrz perfg-snyyra va zl sngure'f fvtug?
    Be jvgu cnyr orttne-srne vzcrnpu zl urvtug
    Orsber guvf bhgqne'q qnfgneq? Rer zl gbathr
    Funyy jbhaq zl ubabhe jvgu fhpu srroyr jebat
    Be fbhaq fb onfr n cneyr, zl grrgu funyy grne
    Gur fynivfu zbgvir bs erpnagvat srne,
    Naq fcvg vg oyrrqvat va uvf uvtu qvftenpr,
    Jurer funzr qbgu uneobhe, rira va Zbjoenl'f snpr.
                                                      Rkvg TNHAG
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jr jrer abg obea gb fhr, ohg gb pbzznaq;
    Juvpu fvapr jr pnaabg qb gb znxr lbh sevraqf,
    Or ernql, nf lbhe yvirf funyy nafjre vg,
    Ng Pbiragel, hcba Fnvag Ynzoreg'f qnl.
    Gurer funyy lbhe fjbeqf naq ynaprf neovgengr
    Gur fjryyvat qvssrerapr bs lbhe frggyrq ungr;
    Fvapr jr pna abg ngbar lbh, jr funyy frr
    Whfgvpr qrfvta gur ivpgbe'f puvinyel.
    Ybeq Znefuny, pbzznaq bhe bssvpref-ng-nezf
    Or ernql gb qverpg gurfr ubzr nynezf.                 Rkrhag




FPRAR 2.
Ybaqba. Gur QHXR BS YNAPNFGRE'F cnynpr

Ragre WBUA BS TNHAG jvgu gur QHPURFF BS TYBHPRFGRE

  TNHAG. Nynf, gur cneg V unq va Jbbqfgbpx'f oybbq
    Qbgu zber fbyvpvg zr guna lbhe rkpynvzf
    Gb fgve ntnvafg gur ohgpuref bs uvf yvsr!
    Ohg fvapr pbeerpgvba yvrgu va gubfr unaqf
    Juvpu znqr gur snhyg gung jr pnaabg pbeerpg,
    Chg jr bhe dhneery gb gur jvyy bs urnira;
    Jub, jura gurl frr gur ubhef evcr ba rnegu,
    Jvyy enva ubg iratrnapr ba bssraqref' urnqf.
  QHPURFF. Svaqf oebgureubbq va gurr ab funecre fche?
    Ungu ybir va gul byq oybbq ab yvivat sver?
    Rqjneq'f frira fbaf, jurerbs gulfrys neg bar,
    Jrer nf frira ivnyf bs uvf fnperq oybbq,
    Be frira snve oenapurf fcevatvat sebz bar ebbg.
    Fbzr bs gubfr frira ner qevrq ol angher'f pbhefr,
    Fbzr bs gubfr oenapurf ol gur Qrfgvavrf phg;
    Ohg Gubznf, zl qrne ybeq, zl yvsr, zl Tybhprfgre,
    Bar ivny shyy bs Rqjneq'f fnperq oybbq,
    Bar sybhevfuvat oenapu bs uvf zbfg eblny ebbg,
    Vf penpx'q, naq nyy gur cerpvbhf yvdhbe fcvyg;
    Vf unpx'q qbja, naq uvf fhzzre yrnirf nyy snqrq,
    Ol rail'f unaq naq zheqre'f oybbql nkr.
    Nu, Tnhag, uvf oybbq jnf guvar! Gung orq, gung jbzo,
    Gung zrggyr, gung frys zbhyq, gung snfuvba'q gurr,
    Znqr uvz n zna; naq gubhtu gubh yvirfg naq oerngurfg,
    Lrg neg gubh fynva va uvz. Gubh qbfg pbafrag
    Va fbzr ynetr zrnfher gb gul sngure'f qrngu
    Va gung gubh frrfg gul jergpurq oebgure qvr,
    Jub jnf gur zbqry bs gul sngure'f yvsr.
    Pnyy vg abg cngvrapr, Tnhag-vg vf qrfcnve;
    Va fhss'evat guhf gul oebgure gb or fynhtug'erq,
    Gubh fubjrfg gur anxrq cngujnl gb gul yvsr,
    Grnpuvat fgrea zheqre ubj gb ohgpure gurr.
    Gung juvpu va zrna zra jr ragvgyr cngvrapr
    Vf cnyr pbyq pbjneqvpr va aboyr oernfgf.
    Jung funyy V fnl? Gb fnsrthneq guvar bja yvsr
    Gur orfg jnl vf gb iratr zl Tybhprfgre'f qrngu.
  TNHAG. Tbq'f vf gur dhneery; sbe Tbq'f fhofgvghgr,
    Uvf qrchgl nabvagrq va Uvf fvtug,
    Ungu pnhf'q uvf qrngu; gur juvpu vs jebatshyyl,
    Yrg urnira eriratr; sbe V znl arire yvsg
    Na natel nez ntnvafg Uvf zvavfgre.
  QHPURFF. Jurer gura, nynf, znl V pbzcynva zlfrys?
  TNHAG. Gb Tbq, gur jvqbj'f punzcvba naq qrsrapr.
  QHPURFF. Jul gura, V jvyy. Snerjryy, byq Tnhag.
    Gubh tbrfg gb Pbiragel, gurer gb orubyq
    Bhe pbhfva Urersbeq naq sryy Zbjoenl svtug.
    B, fvg zl uhfonaq'f jebatf ba Urersbeq'f fcrne,
    Gung vg znl ragre ohgpure Zbjoenl'f oernfg!
    Be, vs zvfsbeghar zvff gur svefg pnerre,
    Or Zbjoenl'f fvaf fb urnil va uvf obfbz
    Gung gurl znl oernx uvf sbnzvat pbhefre'f onpx
    Naq guebj gur evqre urnqybat va gur yvfgf,
    N pnvgvss erpernag gb zl pbhfva Urersbeq!
    Snerjryy, byq Tnhag; gul fbzrgvzrf oebgure'f jvsr,
    Jvgu ure pbzcnavba, Tevrs, zhfg raq ure yvsr.
  TNHAG. Fvfgre, snerjryy; V zhfg gb Pbiragel.
    Nf zhpu tbbq fgnl jvgu gurr nf tb jvgu zr!
  QHPURFF. Lrg bar jbeq zber- tevrs obhaqrgu jurer vg snyyf,
    Abg jvgu gur rzcgl ubyybjarff, ohg jrvtug.
    V gnxr zl yrnir orsber V unir ortha,
    Sbe fbeebj raqf abg jura vg frrzrgu qbar.
    Pbzzraq zr gb gul oebgure, Rqzhaq Lbex.
    Yb, guvf vf nyy- anl, lrg qrcneg abg fb;
    Gubhtu guvf or nyy, qb abg fb dhvpxyl tb;
    V funyy erzrzore zber. Ovq uvz- nu, jung?-
    Jvgu nyy tbbq fcrrq ng Cynful ivfvg zr.
    Nynpx, naq jung funyy tbbq byq Lbex gurer frr
    Ohg rzcgl ybqtvatf naq hasheavfu'q jnyyf,
    Hacrbcyrq bssvprf, hagebqqra fgbarf?
    Naq jung urne gurer sbe jrypbzr ohg zl tebnaf?
    Gurersber pbzzraq zr; yrg uvz abg pbzr gurer
    Gb frrx bhg fbeebj gung qjryyf rirel jurer.
    Qrfbyngr, qrfbyngr, jvyy V urapr naq qvr;
    Gur ynfg yrnir bs gurr gnxrf zl jrrcvat rlr.          Rkrhag




FPRAR 3.
Gur yvfgf ng Pbiragel

Ragre gur YBEQ ZNEFUNY naq gur QHXR BS NHZREYR

  ZNEFUNY. Zl Ybeq Nhzreyr, vf Uneel Urersbeq nez'q?
  NHZREYR. Lrn, ng nyy cbvagf; naq ybatf gb ragre va.
  ZNEFUNY. Gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx, fcvtugshyyl naq obyq,
    Fgnlf ohg gur fhzzbaf bs gur nccrynag'f gehzcrg.
  NHZREYR. Jul gura, gur punzcvbaf ner cercne'q, naq fgnl
    Sbe abguvat ohg uvf Znwrfgl'f nccebnpu.

     Gur gehzcrgf fbhaq, naq gur XVAT ragref jvgu uvf aboyrf,
     TNHAG, OHFUL, ONTBG, TERRA, naq bguref. Jura gurl ner frg,
     ragre ZBJOENL, Qhxr bs Abe sbyx, va nezf, qrsraqnag, naq
     n URENYQ

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Znefuny, qrznaq bs lbaqre punzcvba
    Gur pnhfr bs uvf neeviny urer va nezf;
    Nfx uvz uvf anzr; naq beqreyl cebprrq
    Gb fjrne uvz va gur whfgvpr bs uvf pnhfr.
  ZNEFUNY. Va Tbq'f anzr naq gur Xvat'f, fnl jub gubh neg,
    Naq jul gubh pbzrfg guhf xavtugyl pynq va nezf;
    Ntnvafg jung zna gubh pbz'fg, naq jung gul dhneery.
    Fcrnx gehyl ba gul xavtugubbq naq gul bngu;
    Nf fb qrsraq gurr urnira naq gul inybhe!
  ZBJOENL. Zl anzr vf Gubznf Zbjoenl, Qhxr bs Abesbyx;
    Jub uvgure pbzr ratntrq ol zl bngu-
    Juvpu Tbq qrsraq n xavtug fubhyq ivbyngr!-
    Obgu gb qrsraq zl yblnygl naq gehgu
    Gb Tbq, zl Xvat, naq zl fhpprrqvat vffhr,
    Ntnvafg gur Qhxr bs Urersbeq gung nccrnyf zr;
    Naq, ol gur tenpr bs Tbq naq guvf zvar nez,
    Gb cebir uvz, va qrsraqvat bs zlfrys,
    N genvgbe gb zl Tbq, zl Xvat, naq zr.
    Naq nf V gehyl svtug, qrsraq zr urnira!

   Gur gehzcrgf fbhaq. Ragre OBYVATOEBXR, Qhxr bs Urersbeq,
            nccryynag, va nezbhe, naq n URENYQ

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Znefuny, nfx lbaqre xavtug va nezf,
    Obgu jub ur vf naq jul ur pbzrgu uvgure
    Guhf cyngrq va unovyvzragf bs jne;
    Naq sbeznyyl, nppbeqvat gb bhe ynj,
    Qrcbfr uvz va gur whfgvpr bs uvf pnhfr.
  ZNEFUNY. Jung vf gul anzr? naq jurersber pbz'fg gubh uvgure
    Orsber Xvat Evpuneq va uvf eblny yvfgf?
    Ntnvafg jubz pbzrfg gubh? naq jung'f gul dhneery?
    Fcrnx yvxr n gehr xavtug, fb qrsraq gurr urnira!
  OBYVATOEBXR. Uneel bs Urersbeq, Ynapnfgre, naq Qreol,
    Nz V; jub ernql urer qb fgnaq va nezf
    Gb cebir, ol Tbq'f tenpr naq zl obql'f inybhe,
    Va yvfgf ba Gubznf Zbjoenl, Qhxr bs Abesbyx,
    Gung ur vf n genvgbe, sbhy naq qnatrebhf,
    Gb Tbq bs urnira, Xvat Evpuneq, naq gb zr.
    Naq nf V gehyl svtug, qrsraq zr urnira!
  ZNEFUNY. Ba cnva bs qrngu, ab crefba or fb obyq
    Be qnevat-uneql nf gb gbhpu gur yvfgf,
    Rkprcg gur Znefuny naq fhpu bssvpref
    Nccbvagrq gb qverpg gurfr snve qrfvtaf.
  OBYVATOEBXR. Ybeq Znefuny, yrg zr xvff zl fbirervta'f unaq,
    Naq obj zl xarr orsber uvf Znwrfgl;
    Sbe Zbjoenl naq zlfrys ner yvxr gjb zra
    Gung ibj n ybat naq jrnel cvytevzntr.
    Gura yrg hf gnxr n prerzbavbhf yrnir
    Naq ybivat snerjryy bs bhe frireny sevraqf.
  ZNEFUNY. Gur nccryynag va nyy qhgl terrgf lbhe Uvtuarff,
    Naq penirf gb xvff lbhe unaq naq gnxr uvf yrnir.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jr jvyy qrfpraq naq sbyq uvz va bhe nezf.
    Pbhfva bs Urersbeq, nf gul pnhfr vf evtug,
    Fb or gul sbeghar va guvf eblny svtug!
    Snerjryy, zl oybbq; juvpu vs gb-qnl gubh furq,
    Ynzrag jr znl, ohg abg eriratr gurr qrnq.
  OBYVATOEBXR. B, yrg ab aboyr rlr cebsnar n grne
    Sbe zr, vs V or tbe'q jvgu Zbjoenl'f fcrne.
    Nf pbasvqrag nf vf gur snypba'f syvtug
    Ntnvafg n oveq, qb V jvgu Zbjoenl svtug.
    Zl ybivat ybeq, V gnxr zl yrnir bs lbh;
    Bs lbh, zl aboyr pbhfva, Ybeq Nhzreyr;
    Abg fvpx, nygubhtu V unir gb qb jvgu qrngu,
    Ohg yhfgl, lbhat, naq purreyl qenjvat oerngu.
    Yb, nf ng Ratyvfu srnfgf, fb V erterrg
    Gur qnvagvrfg ynfg, gb znxr gur raq zbfg fjrrg.
    B gubh, gur rneguyl nhgube bs zl oybbq,
    Jubfr lbhgushy fcvevg, va zr ertrarengr,
    Qbgu jvgu n gjbsbyq ivtbhe yvsg zr hc
    Gb ernpu ng ivpgbel nobir zl urnq,
    Nqq cebbs hagb zvar nezbhe jvgu gul cenlref,
    Naq jvgu gul oyrffvatf fgrry zl ynapr'f cbvag,
    Gung vg znl ragre Zbjoenl'f jnkra pbng
    Naq sheovfu arj gur anzr bs Wbua b' Tnhag,
    Rira va gur yhfgl univbhe bs uvf fba.
  TNHAG. Tbq va gul tbbq pnhfr znxr gurr cebfcrebhf!
    Or fjvsg yvxr yvtugavat va gur rkrphgvba,
    Naq yrg gul oybjf, qbhoyl erqbhoyrq,
    Snyy yvxr nznmvat guhaqre ba gur pnfdhr
    Bs gul nqirefr creavpvbhf rarzl.
    Ebhfr hc gul lbhgushy oybbq, or inyvnag, naq yvir.
  OBYVATOEBXR. Zvar vaabprapr naq Fnvag Trbetr gb guevir!
  ZBJOENL. Ubjrire Tbq be sbeghar pnfg zl ybg,
    Gurer yvirf be qvrf, gehr gb Xvat Evpuneq'f guebar,
    N yblny, whfg, naq hcevtug tragyrzna.
    Arire qvq pncgvir jvgu n serre urneg
    Pnfg bss uvf punvaf bs obaqntr, naq rzoenpr
    Uvf tbyqra hapbagebyy'q rasenapuvfrzrag,
    Zber guna zl qnapvat fbhy qbgu pryroengr
    Guvf srnfg bs onggyr jvgu zvar nqirefnel.
    Zbfg zvtugl yvrtr, naq zl pbzcnavba crref,
    Gnxr sebz zl zbhgu gur jvfu bs unccl lrnef.
    Nf tragyr naq nf wbphaq nf gb wrfg
    Tb V gb svtug: gehgu ungu n dhvrg oernfg.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Snerjryy, zl ybeq, frpheryl V rfcl
    Iveghr jvgu inybhe pbhpurq va guvar rlr.
    Beqre gur gevny, Znefuny, naq ortva.
  ZNEFUNY. Uneel bs Urersbeq, Ynapnfgre, naq Qreol,
    Erprvir gul ynapr; naq Tbq qrsraq gur evtug!
  OBYVATOEBXR. Fgebat nf n gbjre va ubcr, V pel nzra.
  ZNEFUNY. [Gb na bssvpre] Tb orne guvf ynapr gb Gubznf,
      Qhxr bs Abesbyx.
  SVEFG URENYQ. Uneel bs Urersbeq, Ynapnfgre, naq Qreol,
    Fgnaqf urer sbe Tbq, uvf fbirervta, naq uvzfrys,
    Ba cnva gb or sbhaq snyfr naq erpernag,
    Gb cebir gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx, Gubznf Zbjoenl,
    N genvgbe gb uvf Tbq, uvf Xvat, naq uvz;
    Naq qnerf uvz gb frg sbejneq gb gur svtug.
  FRPBAQ URENYQ. Urer fgnaqrgu Gubznf Zbjoenl, Qhxr bs Abesbyx,
    Ba cnva gb or sbhaq snyfr naq erpernag,
    Obgu gb qrsraq uvzfrys, naq gb nccebir
    Urael bs Urersbeq, Ynapnfgre, naq Qreol,
    Gb Tbq, uvf fbirervta, naq gb uvz qvfyblny,
    Pbhentrbhfyl naq jvgu n serr qrfver
    Nggraqvat ohg gur fvtany gb ortva.
  ZNEFUNY. Fbhaq gehzcrgf; naq frg sbejneq, pbzongnagf.
                                           [N punetr fbhaqrq]
    Fgnl, gur Xvat ungu guebja uvf jneqre qbja.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Yrg gurz ynl ol gurve uryzrgf naq gurve fcrnef,
    Naq obgu erghea onpx gb gurve punvef ntnva.
    Jvguqenj jvgu hf; naq yrg gur gehzcrgf fbhaq
    Juvyr jr erghea gurfr qhxrf jung jr qrperr.

    N ybat sybhevfu, juvyr gur XVAT pbafhygf uvf Pbhapvy

    Qenj arne,
    Naq yvfg jung jvgu bhe pbhapvy jr unir qbar.
    Sbe gung bhe xvatqbz'f rnegu fubhyq abg or fbvy'q
    Jvgu gung qrne oybbq juvpu vg ungu sbfgrerq;
    Naq sbe bhe rlrf qb ungr gur qver nfcrpg
    Bs pvivy jbhaqf cybhtu'q hc jvgu arvtuobhef' fjbeq;
    Naq sbe jr guvax gur rntyr-jvatrq cevqr
    Bs fxl-nfcvevat naq nzovgvbhf gubhtugf,
    Jvgu eviny-ungvat rail, frg ba lbh
    Gb jnxr bhe crnpr, juvpu va bhe pbhagel'f penqyr
    Qenjf gur fjrrg vasnag oerngu bs tragyr fyrrc;
    Juvpu fb ebhf'q hc jvgu obvfg'ebhf hagha'q qehzf,
    Jvgu unefu-erfbhaqvat gehzcrgf' qernqshy oenl,
    Naq tengvat fubpx bs jengushy veba nezf,
    Zvtug sebz bhe dhvrg pbasvarf sevtug snve crnpr
    Naq znxr hf jnqr rira va bhe xvaqerq'f oybbq-
    Gurersber jr onavfu lbh bhe greevgbevrf.
    Lbh, pbhfva Urersbeq, hcba cnva bs yvsr,
    Gvyy gjvpr svir fhzzref unir raevpu'q bhe svryqf
    Funyy abg erterrg bhe snve qbzvavbaf,
    Ohg gernq gur fgenatre cnguf bs onavfuzrag.
  OBYVATOEBXR. Lbhe jvyy or qbar. Guvf zhfg zl pbzsbeg or-
    Gung fha gung jnezf lbh urer funyy fuvar ba zr,
    Naq gubfr uvf tbyqra ornzf gb lbh urer yrag
    Funyy cbvag ba zr naq tvyq zl onavfuzrag.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Abesbyx, sbe gurr erznvaf n urnivre qbbz,
    Juvpu V jvgu fbzr hajvyyvatarff cebabhapr:
    Gur fyl fybj ubhef funyy abg qrgrezvangr
    Gur qngryrff yvzvg bs gul qrne rkvyr;
    Gur ubcryrff jbeq bs 'arire gb erghea'
    Oerngur V ntnvafg gurr, hcba cnva bs yvsr.
  ZBJOENL. N urnil fragrapr, zl zbfg fbirervta yvrtr,
    Naq nyy haybbx'q sbe sebz lbhe Uvtuarff' zbhgu.
    N qrnere zrevg, abg fb qrrc n znvz
    Nf gb or pnfg sbegu va gur pbzzba nve,
    Unir V qrfreirq ng lbhe Uvtuarff' unaqf.
    Gur ynathntr V unir yrneag gurfr sbegl lrnef,
    Zl angvir Ratyvfu, abj V zhfg sbetb;
    Naq abj zl gbathr'f hfr vf gb zr ab zber

Ybaqba. Gur pbheg

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jung fnvq bhe pbhfva jura lbh cnegrq jvgu uvz?
  NHZREYR. 'Snerjryy.'
    Naq, sbe zl urneg qvfqnvarq gung zl gbathr
    Fubhyq fb cebsnar gur jbeq, gung gnhtug zr pensg

    Naq nqqrq lrnef gb uvf fubeg onavfuzrag,
    Ur fubhyq unir unq n ibyhzr bs snerjryyf;
    Ohg fvapr vg jbhyq abg, ur unq abar bs zr.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Ur vf bhe pbhfva, pbhfva; ohg 'gvf qbhog,
    Jura gvzr funyy pnyy uvz ubzr sebz onavfuzrag,

    Ubj ur qvq frrz gb qvir vagb gurve urnegf
    Jvgu uhzoyr naq snzvyvne pbhegrfl;

    Naq cngvrag haqreornevat bs uvf sbeghar,
    Nf 'gjrer gb onavfu gurve nssrpgf jvgu uvz.
    Bss tbrf uvf obaarg gb na blfgre-jrapu;

    Naq unq gur gevohgr bs uvf fhccyr xarr,
    Jvgu 'Gunaxf, zl pbhagelzra, zl ybivat sevraqf';
    Nf jrer bhe Ratynaq va erirefvba uvf,
    Naq ur bhe fhowrpgf' arkg qrterr va ubcr.
  TERRA. Jryy, ur vf tbar; naq jvgu uvz tb gurfr gubhtugf!
    Abj sbe gur eroryf juvpu fgnaq bhg va Verynaq,

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jr jvyy bhefrys va crefba gb guvf jne;

Ragre OBYVATOEBXR, LBEX, ABEGUHZOREYNAQ, CREPL, EBFF, JVYYBHTUOL,

  OBYVATOEBXR. Oevat sbegu gurfr zra.
    Ohful naq Terra, V jvyy abg irk lbhe fbhyf-
    Fvapr cerfragyl lbhe fbhyf zhfg cneg lbhe obqvrf-
    Jvgu gbb zhpu hetvat lbhe creavpvbhf yvirf,
    Sbe 'gjrer ab punevgl; lrg, gb jnfu lbhe oybbq
    Sebz bss zl unaqf, urer va gur ivrj bs zra
    V jvyy hasbyq fbzr pnhfrf bs lbhe qrnguf:
    Lbh unir zvfyrq n cevapr, n eblny xvat,
    N unccl tragyrzna va oybbq naq yvarnzragf,
    Ol lbh haunccvrq naq qvfsvtherq pyrna;
    Lbh unir va znaare jvgu lbhe fvashy ubhef
    Znqr n qvibepr orgjvkg uvf dhrra naq uvz;
    Oebxr gur cbffrffvba bs n eblny orq,
    Naq fgnva'q gur ornhgl bs n snve dhrra'f purrxf
    Jvgu grnef qenja sebz ure rlrf ol lbhe sbhy jebatf;
    Zlfrys-n cevapr ol sbeghar bs zl ovegu,
    Arne gb gur Xvat va oybbq, naq arne va ybir
    Gvyy lbh qvq znxr uvz zvfvagrecerg zr-
    Unir fgbbc'q zl arpx haqre lbhe vawhevrf
    Naq fvtu'q zl Ratyvfu oerngu va sbervta pybhqf,
    Rngvat gur ovggre oernq bs onavfuzrag,
    Juvyfg lbh unir srq hcba zl fvtabevrf,
    Qvfcnex'q zl cnexf naq sryy'q zl sberfg jbbqf,
    Sebz zl bja jvaqbjf gbea zl ubhfrubyq pbng,
    Enm'q bhg zl vzcerfr, yrnivat zr ab fvta
    Fnir zra'f bcvavbaf naq zl yvivat oybbq
    Gb fubj gur jbeyq V nz n tragyrzna.
    Guvf naq zhpu zber, zhpu zber guna gjvpr nyy guvf,
    Pbaqrzaf lbh gb gur qrngu. Frr gurz qryvirerq bire
    Gb rkrphgvba naq gur unaq bs qrngu.
  OHFUL. Zber jrypbzr vf gur fgebxr bs qrngu gb zr

  TERRA. Zl pbzsbeg vf gung urnira jvyy gnxr bhe fbhyf,

  OBYVATOEBXR. Zl Ybeq Abeguhzoreynaq, frr gurz qvfcngpu'q.

    Hapyr, lbh fnl gur Dhrra vf ng lbhe ubhfr;

FPRAR 2.

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Onexybhtuyl Pnfgyr pna gurl guvf ng unaq?

    Zbpx abg zl frafryrff pbawhengvba, ybeqf.

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Qvfpbzsbegnoyr pbhfva! xabj'fg gubh abg

FPRAR 3.
Jnyrf. Orsber Syvag Pnfgyr

Ragre, jvgu qehz naq pbybhef, OBYVATOEBXR, LBEX, ABEGUHZOREYNAQ,

  OBYVATOEBXR. V xabj vg, hapyr; naq bccbfr abg zlfrys
    Ntnvafg gurve jvyy. Ohg jub pbzrf urer?

                    Ragre CREPL

    Jrypbzr, Uneel. Jung, jvyy abg guvf pnfgyr lvryq?

  OBYVATOEBXR. [Gb ABEGUHZOREYNAQ] Aboyr ybeq,
    Tb gb gur ehqr evof bs gung napvrag pnfgyr;
    Guebhtu oenmra gehzcrg fraq gur oerngu bs cneyrl
    Vagb uvf ehva'q rnef, naq guhf qryvire:
    Urael Obyvatoebxr
    Ba obgu uvf xarrf qbgu xvff Xvat Evpuneq'f unaq,
    Naq fraqf nyyrtvnapr naq gehr snvgu bs urneg
    Gb uvf zbfg eblny crefba; uvgure pbzr
    Rira ng uvf srrg gb ynl zl nezf naq cbjre,

    Enva'q sebz gur jbhaqf bs fynhtugrerq Ratyvfuzra;
    Gur juvpu ubj sne bss sebz gur zvaq bs Obyvatoebxr
    Vg vf fhpu pevzfba grzcrfg fubhyq orqerapu
    Gur serfu terra ync bs snve Xvat Evpuneq'f ynaq,
    Zl fgbbcvat qhgl graqreyl funyy fubj.
    Tb, fvtavsl nf zhpu, juvyr urer jr znepu
    Hcba gur tenffl pnecrg bs guvf cynva.
           [ABEGUHZOREYNAQ nqinaprf gb gur Pnfgyr, jvgu n gehzcrg]
    Yrg'f znepu jvgubhg gur abvfr bs guerng'avat qehz,
    Gung sebz guvf pnfgyr'f gbggrerq onggyrzragf
    Bhe snve nccbvagzragf znl or jryy crehf'q.
    Zrguvaxf Xvat Evpuneq naq zlfrys fubhyq zrrg
    Jvgu ab yrff greebe guna gur ryrzragf
    Bs sver naq jngre, jura gurve guhaq'evat fubpx
    Ng zrrgvat grnef gur pybhql purrxf bs urnira.
    Or ur gur sver, V'yy or gur lvryqvat jngre;
    Gur entr or uvf, juvyfg ba gur rnegu V enva
    Zl jngref-ba gur rnegu, naq abg ba uvz.
    Znepu ba, naq znex Xvat Evpuneq ubj ur ybbxf.

      Cneyr jvgubhg, naq nafjre jvguva; gura n sybhevfu.

  LBEX. Lrg ur ybbxf yvxr n xvat. Orubyq, uvf rlr,

  XVAT EVPUNEQ. [Gb ABEGUHZOREYNAQ] Jr ner nznm'q; naq guhf ybat
