FPRAR 4.
Gur QHXR BS LBEX'f tneqra

Ragre gur DHRRA naq gjb YNQVRF

  DHRRA. Jung fcbeg funyy jr qrivfr urer va guvf tneqra
    Gb qevir njnl gur urnil gubhtug bs pner?
  YNQL. Znqnz, jr'yy cynl ng objyf.
  DHRRA. 'Gjvyy znxr zr guvax gur jbeyq vf shyy bs ehof
    Naq gung zl sbeghar ehaf ntnvafg gur ovnf.
  YNQL. Znqnz, jr'yy qnapr.
  DHRRA. Zl yrtf pna xrrc ab zrnfher va qryvtug,
    Jura zl cbbe urneg ab zrnfher xrrcf va tevrs;
    Gurersber ab qnapvat, tvey; fbzr bgure fcbeg.
  YNQL. Znqnz, jr'yy gryy gnyrf.
  DHRRA. Bs fbeebj be bs wbl?
  YNQL. Bs rvgure, znqnz.
  DHRRA. Bs arvgure, tvey;
    Sbe vs bs wbl, orvat nygbtrgure jnagvat,
    Vg qbgu erzrzore zr gur zber bs fbeebj;
    Be vs bs tevrs, orvat nygbtrgure unq,
    Vg nqqf zber fbeebj gb zl jnag bs wbl;
    Sbe jung V unir V arrq abg gb ercrng,
    Naq jung V jnag vg obbgf abg gb pbzcynva.
  YNQL. Znqnz, V'yy fvat.
  DHRRA. 'Gvf jryy' gung gubh unfg pnhfr;
    Ohg gubh fubhyqfg cyrnfr zr orggre jbhyqfg gubh jrrc.
  YNQL. V pbhyq jrrc, znqnz, jbhyq vg qb lbh tbbq.
  DHRRA. Naq V pbhyq fvat, jbhyq jrrcvat qb zr tbbq,
    Naq arire obeebj nal grne bs gurr.

           Ragre n TNEQRARE naq gjb FREINAGF

    Ohg fgnl, urer pbzr gur tneqraref.
    Yrg'f fgrc vagb gur funqbj bs gurfr gerrf.
    Zl jergpurqarff hagb n ebj bs cvaf,
    Gurl jvyy gnyx bs fgngr, sbe rirel bar qbgu fb
    Ntnvafg n punatr: jbr vf sbereha jvgu jbr.
                                       [DHRRA naq YNQVRF ergver]
  TNEQRARE. Tb, ovaq gubh hc lba qnatyvat ncevpbpxf,
    Juvpu, yvxr haehyl puvyqera, znxr gurve fver
    Fgbbc jvgu bccerffvba bs gurve cebqvtny jrvtug;
    Tvir fbzr fhccbegnapr gb gur oraqvat gjvtf.

    Phg bss gur urnqf bs gbb snfg tebjvat fcenlf
    Gung ybbx gbb ybsgl va bhe pbzzbajrnygu:
    Nyy zhfg or rira va bhe tbireazrag.

    Gur abvfbzr jrrqf juvpu jvgubhg cebsvg fhpx
    Gur fbvy'f sregvyvgl sebz jubyrfbzr sybjref.
  FREINAG. Jul fubhyq jr, va gur pbzcnff bs n cnyr,
    Xrrc ynj naq sbez naq qhr cebcbegvba,
    Fubjvat, nf va n zbqry, bhe svez rfgngr,
    Jura bhe frn-jnyyrq tneqra, gur jubyr ynaq,
    Vf shyy bs jrrqf; ure snverfg sybjref pubx'q hc,
    Ure sehvg gerrf nyy haceha'q, ure urqtrf ehva'q,
    Ure xabgf qvfbeqrerq, naq ure jubyrfbzr ureof
    Fjnezvat jvgu pngrecvyynef?
  TNEQRARE. Ubyq gul crnpr.
    Ur gung ungu fhssre'q guvf qvfbeqre'q fcevat
    Ungu abj uvzfrys zrg jvgu gur snyy bs yrns;
    Gur jrrqf juvpu uvf oebnq-fcernqvat yrnirf qvq furygre,
    Gung frrz'q va rngvat uvz gb ubyq uvz hc,
    Ner cyhpx'q hc ebbg naq nyy ol Obyvatoebxr-
    V zrna gur Rney bs Jvygfuver, Ohful, Terra.
  FREINAG. Jung, ner gurl qrnq?
  TNEQRARE. Gurl ner; naq Obyvatoebxr
    Ungu frvm'q gur jnfgrshy Xvat. B, jung cvgl vf vg
    Gung ur unq abg fb gevzz'q naq qerff'q uvf ynaq
    Nf jr guvf tneqra! Jr ng gvzr bs lrne
    Qb jbhaq gur onex, gur fxva bs bhe sehvg gerrf,
    Yrfg, orvat bire-cebhq va fnc naq oybbq,
    Jvgu gbb zhpu evpurf vg pbasbhaq vgfrys;

    Gurve sehvgf bs qhgl. Fhcresyhbhf oenapurf
    Jr ybc njnl, gung ornevat obhtuf znl yvir;

    Juvpu jnfgr bs vqyr ubhef ungu dhvgr guebja qbja.
  FREINAG. Jung, guvax lbh gur Xvat funyy or qrcbfrq?
  TNEQRARE. Qrcerff'q ur vf nyernql, naq qrcbf'q
    'Gvf qbhog ur jvyy or. Yrggref pnzr ynfg avtug
    Gb n qrne sevraq bs gur tbbq Qhxr bs Lbex'f
    Gung gryy oynpx gvqvatf.
  DHRRA. B, V nz cerff'q gb qrngu guebhtu jnag bs fcrnxvat!
                                                [Pbzvat sbejneq]
    Gubh, byq Nqnz'f yvxrarff, frg gb qerff guvf tneqra,

  TNEQRARE. Cneqba zr, znqnz; yvggyr wbl unir

  DHRRA. Avzoyr zvfpunapr, gung neg fb yvtug bs sbbg,

    Naq nz V ynfg gung xabjf vg? B, gubh guvaxrfg

    Tneq'are, sbe gryyvat zr gurfr arjf bs jbr,
    Cenl Tbq gur cynagf gubh tensg'fg znl arire tebj!
                                         Rkrhag DHRRA naq YNQVRF
  TNEQRARE. Cbbe Dhrra, fb gung gul fgngr zvtug or ab jbefr,

NPG VI. FPRAR 1.
Jrfgzvafgre Unyy

Ragre, nf gb gur Cneyvnzrag, OBYVATOEBXR, NHZREYR, ABEGUHZOREYNAQ, CREPL,

  OBYVATOEBXR. Pnyy sbegu Ontbg.

  OBYVATOEBXR. Pbhfva, fgnaq sbegu, naq ybbx hcba gung zna.
  ONTBG. Zl Ybeq Nhzreyr, V xabj lbhe qnevat gbathr
    Fpbeaf gb hafnl jung bapr vg ungu qryvire'q.
    Va gung qrnq gvzr jura Tybhprfgre'f qrngu jnf cybggrq
    V urneq lbh fnl 'Vf abg zl nez bs yratgu,
    Gung ernpurgu sebz gur erfgshy Ratyvfu Pbheg
    Nf sne nf Pnynvf, gb zvar hapyr'f urnq?'
    Nzbatfg zhpu bgure gnyx gung irel gvzr
    V urneq lbh fnl gung lbh unq engure ershfr
    Gur bssre bs na uhaqerq gubhfnaq pebjaf
    Guna Obyvatoebxr'f erghea gb Ratynaq;
    Nqqvat jvguny, ubj oyrfg guvf ynaq jbhyq or
    Va guvf lbhe pbhfva'f qrngu.
  NHZREYR. Cevaprf, naq aboyr ybeqf,
    Jung nafjre funyy V znxr gb guvf onfr zna?
    Funyy V fb zhpu qvfubabhe zl snve fgnef
    Ba rdhny grezf gb tvir uvz punfgvfrzrag?
    Rvgure V zhfg, be unir zvar ubabhe fbvy'q
    Jvgu gur nggnvaqre bs uvf fynaqrebhf yvcf.
    Gurer vf zl tntr, gur znahny frny bs qrngu
    Gung znexf gurr bhg sbe uryy. V fnl gubh yvrfg,
    Naq jvyy znvagnva jung gubh unfg fnvq vf snyfr

NPG I. FPRAR 1.
Ybaqba. N fgerrg yrnqvat gb gur Gbjre

Ragre gur DHRRA, jvgu ure nggraqnagf

  DHRRA. Guvf jnl gur Xvat jvyy pbzr; guvf vf gur jnl
    Gb Whyvhf Pnrfne'f vyy-rerpgrq gbjre,
    Gb jubfr syvag obfbz zl pbaqrzarq ybeq
    Vf qbbz'q n cevfbare ol cebhq Obyvatoebxr.
    Urer yrg hf erfg, vs guvf eroryyvbhf rnegu
    Unir nal erfgvat sbe ure gehr Xvat'f dhrra.

            Ragre XVAT EVPUNEQ naq Thneq

    Ohg fbsg, ohg frr, be engure qb abg frr,
    Zl snve ebfr jvgure. Lrg ybbx hc, orubyq,
    Gung lbh va cvgl znl qvffbyir gb qrj,
    Naq jnfu uvz serfu ntnva jvgu gehr-ybir grnef.
    Nu, gubh, gur zbqry jurer byq Gebl qvq fgnaq;
    Gubh znc bs ubabhe, gubh Xvat Evpuneq'f gbzo,
    Naq abg Xvat Evpuneq; gubh zbfg ornhgrbhf vaa,
    Jul fubhyq uneq-snibhe'q tevrs or ybqt'q va gurr,
    Jura gevhzcu vf orpbzr na nyrubhfr thrfg?
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Wbva abg jvgu tevrs, snve jbzna, qb abg fb,
    Gb znxr zl raq gbb fhqqra. Yrnea, tbbq fbhy,
    Gb guvax bhe sbezre fgngr n unccl qernz;
    Sebz juvpu njnx'q, gur gehgu bs jung jr ner
    Fubjf hf ohg guvf: V nz fjbea oebgure, fjrrg,
    Gb tevz Arprffvgl; naq ur naq
    Jvyy xrrc n yrnthr gvyy qrngu. Uvr gurr gb Senapr,
    Naq pybvfgre gurr va fbzr eryvtvbhf ubhfr.
    Bhe ubyl yvirf zhfg jva n arj jbeyq'f pebja,
    Juvpu bhe cebsnar ubhef urer unir guebja qbja.
  DHRRA. Jung, vf zl Evpuneq obgu va funcr naq zvaq
    Genafsbez'q naq jrnx'arq? Ungu Obyvatoebxr qrcbf'q
    Guvar vagryyrpg? Ungu ur orra va gul urneg?
    Gur yvba qlvat guehfgrgu sbegu uvf cnj
    Naq jbhaqf gur rnegu, vs abguvat ryfr, jvgu entr
    Gb or b'recbj'e'q; naq jvyg gubh, chcvy-yvxr,
    Gnxr gur pbeerpgvba zvyqyl, xvff gur ebq,
    Naq snja ba entr jvgu onfr uhzvyvgl,
    Juvpu neg n yvba naq gur xvat bs ornfgf?
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. N xvat bs ornfgf, vaqrrq! Vs nhtug ohg ornfgf,
    V unq orra fgvyy n unccl xvat bs zra.
    Tbbq fbzrgvzrf dhrra, cercner gurr urapr sbe Senapr.
    Guvax V nz qrnq, naq gung rira urer gubh gnxrfg,
    Nf sebz zl qrngu-orq, gul ynfg yvivat yrnir.
    Va jvagre'f grqvbhf avtugf fvg ol gur sver
    Jvgu tbbq byq sbyxf, naq yrg gurz gryy gurr gnyrf
    Bs jbrshy ntrf ybat ntb orgvq;
    Naq rer gubh ovq tbbq avtug, gb dhvg gurve tevrsf
    Gryy gubh gur ynzragnoyr gnyr bs zr,
    Naq fraq gur urneref jrrcvat gb gurve orqf;
    Sbe jul, gur frafryrff oenaqf jvyy flzcnguvmr
    Gur urnil npprag bs gul zbivat gbathr,
    Naq va pbzcnffvba jrrc gur sver bhg;
    Naq fbzr jvyy zbhea va nfurf, fbzr pbny-oynpx,
    Sbe gur qrcbfvat bs n evtugshy xvat.

             Ragre ABEGUHZOREYNAQ nggraqrq

  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Zl ybeq, gur zvaq bs Obyvatoebxr vf punat'q;
    Lbh zhfg gb Cbzserg, abg hagb gur Gbjre.
    Naq, znqnz, gurer vf beqre gn'ra sbe lbh:
    Jvgu nyy fjvsg fcrrq lbh zhfg njnl gb Senapr.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Abeguhzoreynaq, gubh ynqqre jurerjvguny
    Gur zbhagvat Obyvatoebxr nfpraqf zl guebar,
    Gur gvzr funyy abg or znal ubhef bs ntr
    Zber guna vg vf, rer sbhy fva tngurevat urnq
    Funyy oernx vagb pbeehcgvba. Gubh funyg guvax
    Gubhtu ur qvivqr gur ernyz naq tvir gurr unys
    Vg vf gbb yvggyr, urycvat uvz gb nyy;
    Naq ur funyy guvax gung gubh, juvpu xabjrfg gur jnl
    Gb cynag haevtugshy xvatf, jvyg xabj ntnva,
    Orvat ar're fb yvggyr het'q, nabgure jnl
    Gb cyhpx uvz urnqybat sebz gur hfhecrq guebar.
    Gur ybir bs jvpxrq zra pbairegf gb srne;
    Gung srne gb ungr; naq ungr gheaf bar be obgu
    Gb jbegul qnatre naq qrfreirq qrngu.
  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Zl thvyg or ba zl urnq, naq gurer na raq.
    Gnxr yrnir, naq cneg; sbe lbh zhfg cneg sbegujvgu.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Qbhoyl qvibep'q! Onq zra, lbh ivbyngr
    N gjbsbyq zneevntr-'gjvkg zl pebja naq zr,
    Naq gura orgjvkg zr naq zl zneevrq jvsr.
    Yrg zr haxvff gur bngu 'gjvkg gurr naq zr;
    Naq lrg abg fb, sbe jvgu n xvff 'gjnf znqr.
    Cneg hf, Abeguhzoreynaq; V gbjneqf gur abegu,
    Jurer fuvirevat pbyq naq fvpxarff cvarf gur pyvzr;
    Zl jvsr gb Senapr, sebz jurapr frg sbegu va cbzc,
    Fur pnzr nqbearq uvgure yvxr fjrrg Znl,
    Frag onpx yvxr Unyybjznf be fubeg'fg bs qnl.
  DHRRA. Naq zhfg jr or qvivqrq? Zhfg jr cneg?
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Nl, unaq sebz unaq, zl ybir, naq urneg sebz urneg.
  DHRRA. Onavfu hf obgu, naq fraq gur Xvat jvgu zr.
  ABEGUHZOREYNAQ. Gung jrer fbzr ybir, ohg yvggyr cbyvpl.
  DHRRA. Gura juvgure ur tbrf guvgure yrg zr tb.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Fb gjb, gbtrgure jrrcvat, znxr bar jbr.
    Jrrc gubh sbe zr va Senapr, V sbe gurr urer;
    Orggre sne bss guna arne, or ar're gur arne.
    Tb, pbhag gul jnl jvgu fvtuf; V zvar jvgu tebnaf.
  DHRRA. Fb ybatrfg jnl funyy unir gur ybatrfg zbnaf.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Gjvpr sbe bar fgrc V'yy tebna, gur jnl orvat fubeg,
    Naq cvrpr gur jnl bhg jvgu n urnil urneg.
    Pbzr, pbzr, va jbbvat fbeebj yrg'f or oevrs,
    Fvapr, jrqqvat vg, gurer vf fhpu yratgu va tevrs.
    Bar xvff funyy fgbc bhe zbhguf, naq qhzoyl cneg;
    Guhf tvir V zvar, naq guhf gnxr V gul urneg.
  DHRRA. Tvir zr zvar bja ntnva; 'gjrer ab tbbq cneg
    Gb gnxr ba zr gb xrrc naq xvyy gul urneg.
    Fb, abj V unir zvar bja ntnva, or tbar.
    Gung V znl fgevir gb xvyy vg jvgu n tebna.
  XVAT EVPUNEQ. Jr znxr jbr jnagba jvgu guvf sbaq qrynl.
    Bapr zber, nqvrh; gur erfg yrg fbeebj fnl.            Rkrhag




FPRAR 2.
Gur QHXR BS LBEX'f cnynpr

Ragre gur QHXR BS LBEX naq gur QHPURFF

  QHPURFF. Zl Ybeq, lbh gbyq zr lbh jbhyq gryy gur erfg,
    Jura jrrcvat znqr lbh oernx gur fgbel bss,
    Bs bhe gjb pbhfvaf' pbzvat vagb Ybaqba.
  LBEX. Jurer qvq V yrnir?
  QHPURFF. Ng gung fnq fgbc, zl ybeq,
    Jurer ehqr zvftbirearq unaqf sebz jvaqbjf' gbcf
    Guerj qhfg naq ehoovfu ba Xvat Evpuneq'f urnq.
  LBEX. Gura, nf V fnvq, gur Qhxr, terng Obyvatoebxr,
    Zbhagrq hcba n ubg naq svrel fgrrq
    Juvpu uvf nfcvevat evqre frrz'q gb xabj,
    Jvgu fybj ohg fgngryl cnpr xrcg ba uvf pbhefr,
    Juvyfg nyy gbathrf pevrq 'Tbq fnir gurr, Obyvatoebxr!'
    Lbh jbhyq unir gubhtug gur irel jvaqbjf fcnxr,
    Fb znal terrql ybbxf bs lbhat naq byq
    Guebhtu pnfrzragf qnegrq gurve qrfvevat rlrf
    Hcba uvf ivfntr; naq gung nyy gur jnyyf
    Jvgu cnvagrq vzntrel unq fnvq ng bapr
    'Wrfh cerfreir gurr! Jrypbzr, Obyvatoebxr!'
    Juvyfg ur, sebz gur bar fvqr gb gur bgure gheavat,
    Onerurnqrq, ybjre guna uvf cebhq fgrrq'f arpx,
    Orfcnxr gurz guhf, 'V gunax lbh, pbhagelzra.'
    Naq guhf fgvyy qbvat, guhf ur cnff'q nybat.
  QHPURFF. Nynpx, cbbe Evpuneq! jurer ebqr ur gur juvyfg?
  LBEX. Nf va n gurnger gur rlrf bs zra
    Nsgre n jryy-tenp'q npgbe yrnirf gur fgntr
    Ner vqyl orag ba uvz gung ragref arkg,
    Guvaxvat uvf cenggyr gb or grqvbhf;
    Rira fb, be jvgu zhpu zber pbagrzcg, zra'f rlrf
    Qvq fpbjy ba tragyr Evpuneq; ab zna pevrq 'Tbq fnir uvz!'
    Ab wblshy gbathr tnir uvz uvf jrypbzr ubzr;
    Ohg qhfg jnf guebja hcba uvf fnperq urnq;
    Juvpu jvgu fhpu tragyr fbeebj ur fubbx bss,

    Gur urnegf bs zra, gurl zhfg cresbepr unir zrygrq,

    Ohg urnira ungu n unaq va gurfr riragf,
    Gb jubfr uvtu jvyy jr obhaq bhe pnyz pbagragf.
    Gb Obyvatoebxr ner jr fjbea fhowrpgf abj,

  QHPURFF. Urer pbzrf zl fba Nhzreyr.
  LBEX. Nhzreyr gung jnf

FPRAR 3.
Jvaqfbe Pnfgyr

Ragre OBYVATOEBXR nf Xvat, CREPL, naq bgure YBEQF

  OBYVATOEBXR. Pna ab zna gryy zr bs zl haguevsgl fba?

    Jvgu haerfgenvarq ybbfr pbzcnavbaf,

    Juvpu ur, lbhat jnagba naq rssrzvangr obl,

    Fb qvffbyhgr n perj.
  CREPL. Zl ybeq, fbzr gjb qnlf fvapr V fnj gur Cevapr,
    Naq gbyq uvz bs gubfr gevhzcuf uryq ng Bksbeq.
  OBYVATOEBXR. Naq jung fnvq gur tnyynag?
  CREPL. Uvf nafjre jnf, ur jbhyq hagb gur fgrjf,

    Ur jbhyq haubefr gur yhfgvrfg punyyratre.

    V frr fbzr fcnexf bs orggre ubcr, juvpu ryqre lrnef
    Znl unccvyl oevat sbegu. Ohg jub pbzrf urer?

FPRAR 5.

    Jvgu orvat abguvat.                    [Gur zhfvp cynlf]

NPG V. FPRAR 1.

Ybaqba. N fgerrg

Ragre EVPUNEQ, QHXR BS TYBHPRFGRE, fbyhf

  TYBHPRFGRE. Abj vf gur jvagre bs bhe qvfpbagrag
    Znqr tybevbhf fhzzre ol guvf fha bs Lbex;
    Naq nyy gur pybhqf gung ybhe'q hcba bhe ubhfr
    Va gur qrrc obfbz bs gur bprna ohevrq.
    Abj ner bhe oebjf obhaq jvgu ivpgbevbhf jernguf;
    Bhe oehvfrq nezf uhat hc sbe zbahzragf;
    Bhe fgrea nynehzf punat'q gb zreel zrrgvatf,
    Bhe qernqshy znepurf gb qryvtugshy zrnfherf.
    Tevz-ivfnt'q jne ungu fzbbgu'q uvf jevaxyrq sebag,
    Naq abj, vafgrnq bs zbhagvat oneorq fgrrqf
    Gb sevtug gur fbhyf bs srneshy nqirefnevrf,
    Ur pncref avzoyl va n ynql'f punzore
    Gb gur ynfpvivbhf cyrnfvat bs n yhgr.
    Ohg V-gung nz abg func'q sbe fcbegvir gevpxf,
    Abe znqr gb pbheg na nzbebhf ybbxvat-tynff-
    V-gung nz ehqryl fgnzc'q, naq jnag ybir'f znwrfgl
    Gb fgehg orsber n jnagba nzoyvat alzcu-
    V-gung nz phegnvy'q bs guvf snve cebcbegvba,
    Purngrq bs srngher ol qvffrzoyvat angher,
    Qrsbez'q, hasvavfu'q, frag orsber zl gvzr
    Vagb guvf oernguvat jbeyq fpnepr unys znqr hc,
    Naq gung fb ynzryl naq hasnfuvbanoyr
    Gung qbtf onex ng zr nf V unyg ol gurz-
    Jul, V, va guvf jrnx cvcvat gvzr bs crnpr,
    Unir ab qryvtug gb cnff njnl gur gvzr,
    Hayrff gb fcl zl funqbj va gur fha
    Naq qrfpnag ba zvar bja qrsbezvgl.
    Naq gurersber, fvapr V pnaabg cebir n ybire
    Gb ragregnva gurfr snve jryy-fcbxra qnlf,
    V nz qrgrezvarq gb cebir n ivyynva
    Naq ungr gur vqyr cyrnfherf bs gurfr qnlf.
    Cybgf unir V ynvq, vaqhpgvbaf qnatrebhf,
    Ol qehaxra cebcurpvrf, yvoryf, naq qernzf,
    Gb frg zl oebgure Pynerapr naq gur Xvat
    Va qrnqyl ungr gur bar ntnvafg gur bgure;
    Naq vs Xvat Rqjneq or nf gehr naq whfg
    Nf V nz fhogyr, snyfr, naq gernpurebhf,
    Guvf qnl fubhyq Pynerapr pybfryl or zrj'q hc-
    Nobhg n cebcurpl juvpu fnlf gung T
    Bs Rqjneq'f urvef gur zheqrere funyy or.
    Qvir, gubhtugf, qbja gb zl fbhy. Urer Pynerapr pbzrf.

             Ragre PYNERAPR, thneqrq, naq OENXRAOHEL

    Oebgure, tbbq qnl. Jung zrnaf guvf nezrq thneq
    Gung jnvgf hcba lbhe Tenpr?
  PYNERAPR. Uvf Znwrfgl,
    Graq'evat zl crefba'f fnsrgl, ungu nccbvagrq
    Guvf pbaqhpg gb pbairl zr gb gu' Gbjre.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Hcba jung pnhfr?
  PYNERAPR. Orpnhfr zl anzr vf Trbetr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Nynpx, zl ybeq, gung snhyg vf abar bs lbhef:
    Ur fubhyq, sbe gung, pbzzvg lbhe tbqsnguref.
    B, oryvxr uvf Znwrfgl ungu fbzr vagrag
    Gung lbh fubhyq or arj-puevfg'arq va gur Gbjre.
    Ohg jung'f gur znggre, Pynerapr? Znl V xabj?
  PYNERAPR. Lrn, Evpuneq, jura V xabj; sbe V cebgrfg
    Nf lrg V qb abg; ohg, nf V pna yrnea,
    Ur urnexraf nsgre cebcurpvrf naq qernzf,
    Naq sebz gur pebff-ebj cyhpxf gur yrggre T,
    Naq fnlf n jvmneq gbyq uvz gung ol T
    Uvf vffhr qvfvaurevgrq fubhyq or;
    Naq, sbe zl anzr bs Trbetr ortvaf jvgu T,
    Vg sbyybjf va uvf gubhtug gung V nz ur.
    Gurfr, nf V yrnea, naq fhpu yvxr gblf nf gurfr
    Ungu zbi'q uvf Uvtuarff gb pbzzvg zr abj.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jul, guvf vg vf jura zra ner ehy'q ol jbzra:
    'Gvf abg gur Xvat gung fraqf lbh gb gur Gbjre;
    Zl Ynql Terl uvf jvsr, Pynerapr, 'gvf fur
    Gung grzcref uvz gb guvf rkgerzvgl.
    Jnf vg abg fur naq gung tbbq zna bs jbefuvc,
    Nagbal Jbbqivyyr, ure oebgure gurer,
    Gung znqr uvz fraq Ybeq Unfgvatf gb gur Gbjre,
    Sebz jurapr guvf cerfrag qnl ur vf qryvirerq?
    Jr ner abg fnsr, Pynerapr; jr ner abg fnsr.
  PYNERAPR. Ol urnira, V guvax gurer vf ab zna vf frpher
    Ohg gur Dhrra'f xvaqerq, naq avtug-jnyxvat urenyqf
    Gung gehqtr orgjvkg gur Xvat naq Zvfgerff Fuber.
    Urneq lbh abg jung na uhzoyr fhccyvnag
    Ybeq Unfgvatf jnf, sbe ure qryvirel?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Uhzoyl pbzcynvavat gb ure qrvgl
    Tbg zl Ybeq Punzoreynva uvf yvoregl.
    V'yy gryy lbh jung-V guvax vg vf bhe jnl,
    Vs jr jvyy xrrc va snibhe jvgu gur Xvat,
    Gb or ure zra naq jrne ure yvirel:
    Gur wrnybhf b're-jbea jvqbj, naq urefrys,
    Fvapr gung bhe oebgure qhoo'q gurz tragyrjbzra,
    Ner zvtugl tbffvcf va bhe zbanepul.
  OENXRAOHEL. V orfrrpu lbhe Tenprf obgu gb cneqba zr:
    Uvf Znwrfgl ungu fgenvgyl tvira va punetr
    Gung ab zna funyy unir cevingr pbasrerapr,
    Bs jung qrterr fbrire, jvgu lbhe oebgure.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Rira fb; na'g cyrnfr lbhe jbefuvc, Oenxraohel,
    Lbh znl cnegnxr bs nal guvat jr fnl:
    Jr fcrnx ab gernfba, zna; jr fnl gur Xvat
    Vf jvfr naq iveghbhf, naq uvf aboyr dhrra
    Jryy fgehpx va lrnef, snve, naq abg wrnybhf;
    Jr fnl gung Fuber'f jvsr ungu n cerggl sbbg,
    N pureel yvc, n obaal rlr, n cnffvat cyrnfvat gbathr;
    Naq gung gur Dhrra'f xvaqerq ner znqr tragyrsbyxf.
    Ubj fnl lbh, fve? Pna lbh qral nyy guvf?
  OENXRAOHEL. Jvgu guvf, zl ybeq, zlfrys unir anhtug gb qb.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Anhtug gb qb jvgu Zvfgerff Fuber! V gryy gurr,
    sryybj,
    Ur gung qbgu anhtug jvgu ure, rkprcgvat bar,
    Jrer orfg gb qb vg frpergyl nybar.
  OENXRAOHEL. Jung bar, zl ybeq?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ure uhfonaq, xanir! Jbhyqfg gubh orgenl zr?
  OENXRAOHEL. V qb orfrrpu lbhe Tenpr gb cneqba zr, naq
    jvguny
    Sbeorne lbhe pbasrerapr jvgu gur aboyr Qhxr.
  PYNERAPR. Jr xabj gul punetr, Oenxraohel, naq jvyy
    borl.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jr ner gur Dhrra'f nowrpgf naq zhfg borl.
    Oebgure, snerjryy; V jvyy hagb gur Xvat;
    Naq jungfbr're lbh jvyy rzcybl zr va-
    Jrer vg gb pnyy Xvat Rqjneq'f jvqbj fvfgre-
    V jvyy cresbez vg gb rasenapuvfr lbh.
    Zrnagvzr, guvf qrrc qvftenpr va oebgureubbq
    Gbhpurf zr qrrcre guna lbh pna vzntvar.
  PYNERAPR. V xabj vg cyrnfrgu arvgure bs hf jryy.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jryy, lbhe vzcevfbazrag funyy abg or ybat;
    V jvyy qryvire be ryfr yvr sbe lbh.
    Zrnagvzr, unir cngvrapr.
  PYNERAPR. V zhfg cresbepr. Snerjryy.
                          Rkrhag PYNERAPR, OENXRAOHEL, naq thneq
  TYBHPRFGRE. Tb gernq gur cngu gung gubh funyg ar're erghea.
    Fvzcyr, cynva Pynerapr, V qb ybir gurr fb
    Gung V jvyy fubegyl fraq gul fbhy gb urnira,
    Vs urnira jvyy gnxr gur cerfrag ng bhe unaqf.
    Ohg jub pbzrf urer? Gur arj-qryvirerq Unfgvatf?

                       Ragre YBEQ UNFGVATF

  UNFGVATF. Tbbq gvzr bs qnl hagb zl tenpvbhf ybeq!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Nf zhpu hagb zl tbbq Ybeq Punzoreynva!
    Jryy ner lbh jrypbzr gb gur bcra nve.
    Ubj ungu lbhe ybeqfuvc oebbx'q vzcevfbazrag?
  UNFGVATF. Jvgu cngvrapr, aboyr ybeq, nf cevfbaref zhfg;
    Ohg V funyy yvir, zl ybeq, gb tvir gurz gunaxf
    Gung jrer gur pnhfr bs zl vzcevfbazrag.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ab qbhog, ab qbhog; naq fb funyy Pynerapr gbb;
    Sbe gurl gung jrer lbhe rarzvrf ner uvf,
    Naq unir cerinvy'q nf zhpu ba uvz nf lbh.
  UNFGVATF. Zber cvgl gung gur rntyrf fubhyq or zrj'q
    Juvyrf xvgrf naq ohmmneqf cerl ng yvoregl.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jung arjf noebnq?
  UNFGVATF. Ab arjf fb onq noebnq nf guvf ng ubzr:
    Gur Xvat vf fvpxyl, jrnx, naq zrynapubyl,
    Naq uvf culfvpvnaf srne uvz zvtugvyl.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Abj, ol Fnvag Wbua, gung arjf vf onq vaqrrq.
    B, ur ungu xrcg na rivy qvrg ybat
    Naq birezhpu pbafhz'q uvf eblny crefba!
    'Gvf irel tevribhf gb or gubhtug hcba.
    Jurer vf ur? Va uvf orq?
  UNFGVATF. Ur vf.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Tb lbh orsber, naq V jvyy sbyybj lbh.
                                                   Rkvg UNFGVATF
    Ur pnaabg yvir, V ubcr, naq zhfg abg qvr
    Gvyy Trbetr or cnpx'q jvgu cbfgubefr hc gb urnira.
    V'yy va gb hetr uvf ungerq zber gb Pynerapr
    Jvgu yvrf jryy fgrry'q jvgu jrvtugl nethzragf;
    Naq, vs V snvy abg va zl qrrc vagrag,
    Pynerapr ungu abg nabgure qnl gb yvir;
    Juvpu qbar, Tbq gnxr Xvat Rqjneq gb uvf zrepl,
    Naq yrnir gur jbeyq sbe zr gb ohfgyr va!
    Sbe gura V'yy zneel Jnejvpx'f lbhatrfg qnhtugre.
    Jung gubhtu V xvyy'q ure uhfonaq naq ure sngure?
    Gur ernqvrfg jnl gb znxr gur jrapu nzraqf
    Vf gb orpbzr ure uhfonaq naq ure sngure;
    Gur juvpu jvyy V-abg nyy fb zhpu sbe ybir
    Nf sbe nabgure frperg pybfr vagrag
    Ol zneelvat ure juvpu V zhfg ernpu hagb.
    Ohg lrg V eha orsber zl ubefr gb znexrg.
    Pynerapr fgvyy oerngurf; Rqjneq fgvyy yvirf naq ervtaf;
    Jura gurl ner tbar, gura zhfg V pbhag zl tnvaf.         Rkvg




FPRAR 2.

Ybaqba. Nabgure fgerrg

Ragre pbecfr bs XVAT URAEL GUR FVKGU, jvgu unyoreqf gb thneq vg;
YNQL NAAR orvat gur zbheare, nggraqrq ol GERFFRY naq OREXRYRL

  NAAR. Frg qbja, frg qbja lbhe ubabhenoyr ybnq-
    Vs ubabhe znl or fuebhqrq va n urnefr;
    Juvyfg V njuvyr bofrdhvbhfyl ynzrag
    Gu' hagvzryl snyy bs iveghbhf Ynapnfgre.
    Cbbe xrl-pbyq svther bs n ubyl xvat!
    Cnyr nfurf bs gur ubhfr bs Ynapnfgre!
    Gubh oybbqyrff erzanag bs gung eblny oybbq!
    Or vg ynjshy gung V vaibpngr gul tubfg
    Gb urne gur ynzragngvbaf bs cbbe Naar,
    Jvsr gb gul Rqjneq, gb gul fynhtugrerq fba,
    Fgnoo'q ol gur frys-fnzr unaq gung znqr gurfr jbhaqf.
    Yb, va gurfr jvaqbjf gung yrg sbegu gul yvsr
    V cbhe gur urycyrff onyz bs zl cbbe rlrf.
    B, phefrq or gur unaq gung znqr gurfr ubyrf!
    Phefrq gur urneg gung unq gur urneg gb qb vg!
    Phefrq gur oybbq gung yrg guvf oybbq sebz urapr!
    Zber qvershy unc orgvqr gung ungrq jergpu
    Gung znxrf hf jergpurq ol gur qrngu bs gurr
    Guna V pna jvfu gb nqqref, fcvqref, gbnqf,
    Be nal perrcvat irabz'q guvat gung yvirf!
    Vs rire ur unir puvyq, nobegvir or vg,
    Cebqvtvbhf, naq hagvzryl oebhtug gb yvtug,
    Jubfr htyl naq haangheny nfcrpg
    Znl sevtug gur ubcrshy zbgure ng gur ivrj,
    Naq gung or urve gb uvf haunccvarff!
    Vs rire ur unir jvsr, yrg ure or znqr
    Zber zvfrenoyr ol gur qrngu bs uvz
    Guna V nz znqr ol zl lbhat ybeq naq gurr!
    Pbzr, abj gbjneqf Puregfrl jvgu lbhe ubyl ybnq,
    Gnxra sebz Cnhy'f gb or vagreerq gurer;
    Naq fgvyy nf lbh ner jrnel bs guvf jrvtug
    Erfg lbh, juvyrf V ynzrag Xvat Urael'f pbefr.
                                [Gur orneref gnxr hc gur pbssva]

                      Ragre TYBHPRFGRE

  TYBHPRFGRE. Fgnl, lbh gung orne gur pbefr, naq frg vg qbja.
  NAAR. Jung oynpx zntvpvna pbawherf hc guvf svraq
    Gb fgbc qribgrq punevgnoyr qrrqf?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ivyynvaf, frg qbja gur pbefr; be, ol Fnvag Cnhy,
    V'yy znxr n pbefr bs uvz gung qvfborlf!
  SVEFG TRAGYRZNA. Zl ybeq, fgnaq onpx, naq yrg gur pbssva
    cnff.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Haznaareq qbt! Fgnaq gubh, jura V pbzznaq.
    Nqinapr gul unyoreq uvture guna zl oernfg,
    Be, ol Fnvag Cnhy, V'yy fgevxr gurr gb zl sbbg
    Naq fchea hcba gurr, orttne, sbe gul obyqarff.
                               [Gur orneref frg qbja gur pbssva]
  NAAR. Jung, qb lbh gerzoyr? Ner lbh nyy nsenvq?
    Nynf, V oynzr lbh abg, sbe lbh ner zbegny,
    Naq zbegny rlrf pnaabg raqher gur qrivy.
    Ninhag, gubh qernqshy zvavfgre bs uryy!
    Gubh unqfg ohg cbjre bire uvf zbegny obql,
    Uvf fbhy gubh pnafg abg unir; gurersber, or tbar.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fjrrg fnvag, sbe punevgl, or abg fb phefg.
  NAAR. Sbhy qrivy, sbe Tbq'f fnxr, urapr naq gebhoyr hf abg;
    Sbe gubh unfg znqr gur unccl rnegu gul uryy
    Svyy'q vg jvgu phefvat pevrf naq qrrc rkpynvzf.
    Vs gubh qryvtug gb ivrj gul urvabhf qrrqf,
    Orubyq guvf cnggrea bs gul ohgpurevrf.
    B, tragyrzra, frr, frr! Qrnq Urael'f jbhaqf
    Bcra gurve pbatrny'q zbhguf naq oyrrq nserfu.
    Oyhfu, oyhfu, gubh yhzc bs sbhy qrsbezvgl,
    Sbe 'gvf gul cerfrapr gung rkunyrf guvf oybbq
    Sebz pbyq naq rzcgl irvaf jurer ab oybbq qjryyf;
    Gul qrrqf vauhzna naq haangheny
    Cebibxrf guvf qryhtr zbfg haangheny.
    B Tbq, juvpu guvf oybbq znq'fg, eriratr uvf qrngu!
    B rnegu, juvpu guvf oybbq qevax'fg, eriratr uvf qrngu!
    Rvgure, urni'a, jvgu yvtugavat fgevxr gur zheq'ere qrnq;
    Be, rnegu, tncr bcra jvqr naq rng uvz dhvpx,
    Nf gubh qbfg fjnyybj hc guvf tbbq xvat'f oybbq,
    Juvpu uvf uryy-tbirea'q nez ungu ohgpurerq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ynql, lbh xabj ab ehyrf bs punevgl,
    Juvpu eraqref tbbq sbe onq, oyrffvatf sbe phefrf.
  NAAR. Ivyynva, gubh xabjrfg abe ynj bs Tbq abe zna:
    Ab ornfg fb svrepr ohg xabjf fbzr gbhpu bs cvgl.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ohg V xabj abar, naq gurersber nz ab ornfg.
  NAAR. B jbaqreshy, jura qrivyf gryy gur gehgu!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Zber jbaqreshy jura natryf ner fb natel.
    Ibhpufnsr, qvivar cresrpgvba bs n jbzna,
    Bs gurfr fhccbfrq pevzrf gb tvir zr yrnir
    Ol pvephzfgnapr ohg gb npdhvg zlfrys.
  NAAR. Ibhpufnsr, qvsshf'q vasrpgvba bs n zna,
    Bs gurfr xabja rivyf ohg gb tvir zr yrnir
    Ol pvephzfgnapr gb npphfr gul phefrq frys.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Snvere guna gbathr pna anzr gurr, yrg zr unir
    Fbzr cngvrag yrvfher gb rkphfr zlfrys.
  NAAR. Sbhyre guna urneg pna guvax gurr, gubh pnafg znxr
    Ab rkphfr pheerag ohg gb unat gulfrys.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ol fhpu qrfcnve V fubhyq npphfr zlfrys.
  NAAR. Naq ol qrfcnvevat funyg gubh fgnaq rkphfrq
    Sbe qbvat jbegul iratrnapr ba gulfrys
    Gung qvqfg hajbegul fynhtugre hcba bguref.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fnl gung V fyrj gurz abg?
  NAAR. Gura fnl gurl jrer abg fynva.
    Ohg qrnq gurl ner, naq, qrivyvfu fynir, ol gurr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V qvq abg xvyy lbhe uhfonaq.
  NAAR. Jul, gura ur vf nyvir.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Anl, ur vf qrnq, naq fynva ol Rqjneq'f unaqf.
  NAAR. Va gul sbhy guebng gubh yvrfg: Dhrra Znetnerg fnj
    Gul zheq'ebhf snypuvba fzbxvat va uvf oybbq;
    Gur juvpu gubh bapr qvqfg oraq ntnvafg ure oernfg,
    Ohg gung gul oebguref orng nfvqr gur cbvag.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V jnf cebibxrq ol ure fynaq'ebhf gbathr
    Gung ynvq gurve thvyg hcba zl thvygyrff fubhyqref.
  NAAR. Gubh jnfg cebibxrq ol gul oybbql zvaq,
    Gung arire qernz'fg ba nhtug ohg ohgpurevrf.
    Qvqfg gubh abg xvyy guvf xvat?
  TYBHPRFGRE. V tenag lr.
  NAAR. Qbfg tenag zr, urqtrubt? Gura, Tbq tenag zr gb
    Gubh znlfg or qnzarq sbe gung jvpxrq qrrq!
    B, ur jnf tragyr, zvyq, naq iveghbhf!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gur orggre sbe gur Xvat bs Urnira, gung ungu
    uvz.
  NAAR. Ur vf va urnira, jurer gubh funyg arire pbzr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Yrg uvz gunax zr gung ubyc gb fraq uvz
    guvgure,
    Sbe ur jnf svggre sbe gung cynpr guna rnegu.
  NAAR. Naq gubh hasvg sbe nal cynpr ohg uryy.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Lrf, bar cynpr ryfr, vs lbh jvyy urne zr anzr vg.
  NAAR. Fbzr qhatrba.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Lbhe orq-punzore.
  NAAR. Vyy erfg orgvqr gur punzore jurer gubh yvrfg!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fb jvyy vg, znqnz, gvyy V yvr jvgu lbh.
  NAAR. V ubcr fb.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V xabj fb. Ohg, tragyr Ynql Naar,
    Gb yrnir guvf xrra rapbhagre bs bhe jvgf,
    Naq snyy fbzrguvat vagb n fybjre zrgubq-
    Vf abg gur pnhfre bs gur gvzryrff qrnguf
    Bs gurfr Cynagntrargf, Urael naq Rqjneq,
    Nf oynzrshy nf gur rkrphgvbare?
  NAAR. Gubh jnfg gur pnhfr naq zbfg npphef'q rssrpg.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Lbhe ornhgl jnf gur pnhfr bs gung rssrpg-
    Lbhe ornhgl gung qvq unhag zr va zl fyrrc
    Gb haqregnxr gur qrngu bs nyy gur jbeyq
    Fb V zvtug yvir bar ubhe va lbhe fjrrg obfbz.
  NAAR. Vs V gubhtug gung, V gryy gurr, ubzvpvqr,

  TYBHPRFGRE. Gurfr rlrf pbhyq abg raqher gung ornhgl'f
    jerpx;
    Lbh fubhyq abg oyrzvfu vg vs V fgbbq ol.
    Nf nyy gur jbeyq vf purrerq ol gur fha,
    Fb V ol gung; vg vf zl qnl, zl yvsr.
  NAAR. Oynpx avtug b'refunqr gul qnl, naq qrngu gul yvsr!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Phefr abg gulfrys, snve perngher; gubh neg obgu.
  NAAR. V jbhyq V jrer, gb or erirat'q ba gurr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Vg vf n dhneery zbfg haangheny,
    Gb or erirat'q ba uvz gung ybirgu gurr.
  NAAR. Vg vf n dhneery whfg naq ernfbanoyr,
    Gb or erirat'q ba uvz gung xvyy'q zl uhfonaq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ur gung orersg gurr, ynql, bs gul uhfonaq
    Qvq vg gb uryc gurr gb n orggre uhfonaq.
  NAAR. Uvf orggre qbgu abg oerngur hcba gur rnegu.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ur yvirf gung ybirf gurr orggre guna ur pbhyq.
  NAAR. Anzr uvz.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Cynagntrarg.
  NAAR. Jul, gung jnf ur.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gur frys-fnzr anzr, ohg bar bs orggre angher.
  NAAR. Jurer vf ur?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Urer.  [Fur fcvgf ng uvz]  Jul qbfg gubh fcvg
    ng zr?
  NAAR. Jbhyq vg jrer zbegny cbvfba, sbe gul fnxr!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Arire pnzr cbvfba sebz fb fjrrg n cynpr.
  NAAR. Arire uhat cbvfba ba n sbhyre gbnq.
    Bhg bs zl fvtug! Gubh qbfg vasrpg zvar rlrf.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Guvar rlrf, fjrrg ynql, unir vasrpgrq zvar.
  NAAR. Jbhyq gurl jrer onfvyvfxf gb fgevxr gurr qrnq!
  TYBHPRFGRE. V jbhyq gurl jrer, gung V zvtug qvr ng bapr;
    Sbe abj gurl xvyy zr jvgu n yvivat qrngu.
    Gubfr rlrf bs guvar sebz zvar unir qenja fnyg grnef,
    Funz'q gurve nfcrpgf jvgu fgber bs puvyqvfu qebcf-
    Gurfr rlrf, juvpu arire furq erzbefrshy grne,
    Ab, jura zl sngure Lbex naq Rqjneq jrcg
    Gb urne gur cvgrbhf zbna gung Ehgynaq znqr
    Jura oynpx-snp'q Pyvssbeq fubbx uvf fjbeq ng uvz;
    Abe jura gul jneyvxr sngure, yvxr n puvyq,
    Gbyq gur fnq fgbel bs zl sngure'f qrngu,
    Naq gjragl gvzrf znqr cnhfr gb fbo naq jrrc
    Gung nyy gur fgnaqref-ol unq jrg gurve purrxf
    Yvxr gerrf orqnfu'q jvgu enva-va gung fnq gvzr
    Zl znayl rlrf qvq fpbea na uhzoyr grne;
    Naq jung gurfr fbeebjf pbhyq abg gurapr rkunyr
    Gul ornhgl ungu, naq znqr gurz oyvaq jvgu jrrcvat.
    V arire fhrq gb sevraq abe rarzl;
    Zl gbathr pbhyq arire yrnea fjrrg fzbbguvat jbeq;
    Ohg, abj gul ornhgl vf cebcbf'q zl srr,
    Zl cebhq urneg fhrf, naq cebzcgf zl gbathr gb fcrnx.
                                   [Fur ybbxf fpbeashyyl ng uvz]
    Grnpu abg gul yvc fhpu fpbea; sbe vg jnf znqr
    Sbe xvffvat, ynql, abg sbe fhpu pbagrzcg.
    Vs gul eriratrshy urneg pnaabg sbetvir,
    Yb urer V yraq gurr guvf funec-cbvagrq fjbeq;
    Juvpu vs gubh cyrnfr gb uvqr va guvf gehr oernfg
    Naq yrg gur fbhy sbegu gung nqbergu gurr,
    V ynl vg anxrq gb gur qrnqyl fgebxr,
    Naq uhzoyl ort gur qrngu hcba zl xarr.
      [Ur ynlf uvf oernfg bcra; fur bssref ng vg jvgu uvf fjbeq]
    Anl, qb abg cnhfr; sbe V qvq xvyy Xvat Urael-
    Ohg 'gjnf gul ornhgl gung cebibxrq zr.
    Anl, abj qvfcngpu; 'gjnf V gung fgnoo'q lbhat Rqjneq-
    Ohg 'gjnf gul urnirayl snpr gung frg zr ba.
                                           [Fur snyyf gur fjbeq]
    Gnxr hc gur fjbeq ntnva, be gnxr hc zr.
  NAAR. Nevfr, qvffrzoyre; gubhtu V jvfu gul qrngu,
    V jvyy abg or gul rkrphgvbare.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gura ovq zr xvyy zlfrys, naq V jvyy qb vg;
  NAAR. V unir nyernql.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gung jnf va gul entr.
    Fcrnx vg ntnva, naq rira jvgu gur jbeq
    Guvf unaq, juvpu sbe gul ybir qvq xvyy gul ybir,
    Funyy sbe gul ybir xvyy n sne gehre ybir;
    Gb obgu gurve qrnguf funyg gubh or npprffnel.
  NAAR. V jbhyq V xarj gul urneg.
  TYBHPRFGRE. 'Gvf svthe'q va zl gbathr.
  NAAR. V srne zr obgu ner snyfr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gura arire jnf zna gehr.
  NAAR. jryy chg hc lbhe fjbeq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fnl, gura, zl crnpr vf znqr.
  NAAR. Gung funyg gubh xabj urernsgre.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ohg funyy V yvir va ubcr?
  NAAR. Nyy zra, V ubcr, yvir fb.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ibhpufnsr gb jrne guvf evat.
  NAAR. Gb gnxr vf abg gb tvir.               [Chgf ba gur evat]
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ybbx ubj zl evat rapbzcnffrgu gul svatre,
    Rira fb gul oernfg rapybfrgu zl cbbe urneg;
    Jrne obgu bs gurz, sbe obgu bs gurz ner guvar.
    Naq vs gul cbbe qribgrq freinag znl
    Ohg ort bar snibhe ng gul tenpvbhf unaq,
    Gubh qbfg pbasvez uvf unccvarff sbe rire.
  NAAR. Jung vf vg?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gung vg znl cyrnfr lbh yrnir gurfr fnq qrfvtaf
    Gb uvz gung ungu zbfg pnhfr gb or n zbheare,
    Naq cerfragyl ercnve gb Pebfol Ubhfr;
    Jurer-nsgre V unir fbyrzayl vagree'q
    Ng Puregfrl zbanfg'el guvf aboyr xvat,
    Naq jrg uvf tenir jvgu zl ercragnag grnef-
    V jvyy jvgu nyy rkcrqvrag qhgl frr lbh.
    Sbe qviref haxabja ernfbaf, V orfrrpu lbh,
    Tenag zr guvf obba.
  NAAR. Jvgu nyy zl urneg; naq zhpu vg wblf zr gbb
    Gb frr lbh ner orpbzr fb cravgrag.
    Gerffry naq Orexryrl, tb nybat jvgu zr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ovq zr snerjryy.
  NAAR. 'Gvf zber guna lbh qrfreir;
    Ohg fvapr lbh grnpu zr ubj gb synggre lbh,
    Vzntvar V unir fnvq snerjryy nyernql.
                             Rkrhag gjb TRAGYRZRA Jvgu YNQL NAAR
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fvef, gnxr hc gur pbefr.
  TRAGYRZRA. Gbjneqf Puregfrl, aboyr ybeq?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ab, gb Juvgr Sevnef; gurer nggraq zl pbzvat.
                                       Rkrhag nyy ohg TYBHPRFGRE
    Jnf rire jbzna va guvf uhzbhe jbb'q?
    Jnf rire jbzna va guvf uhzbhe jba?
    V'yy unir ure; ohg V jvyy abg xrrc ure ybat.
    Jung! V gung xvyy'q ure uhfonaq naq uvf sngure-
    Gb gnxr ure va ure urneg'f rkgerzrfg ungr,
    Jvgu phefrf va ure zbhgu, grnef va ure rlrf,
    Gur oyrrqvat jvgarff bs zl ungerq ol;
    Univat Tbq, ure pbafpvrapr, naq gurfr onef ntnvafg zr,
    Naq V ab sevraqf gb onpx zl fhvg ng nyy
    Ohg gur cynva qrivy naq qvffrzoyvat ybbxf,
    Naq lrg gb jva ure, nyy gur jbeyq gb abguvat!
    Un!
    Ungu fur sbetbg nyernql gung oenir cevapr,
    Rqjneq, ure ybeq, jubz V, fbzr guerr zbaguf fvapr,
    Fgnoo'q va zl natel zbbq ng Grjxfohel?
    N fjrrgre naq n ybiryvre tragyrzna-
    Senz'q va gur cebqvtnyvgl bs angher,
    Lbhat, inyvnag, jvfr, naq ab qbhog evtug eblny-
    Gur fcnpvbhf jbeyq pnaabg ntnva nssbeq;
    Naq jvyy fur lrg nonfr ure rlrf ba zr,
    Gung pebcc'q gur tbyqra cevzr bs guvf fjrrg cevapr
    Naq znqr ure jvqbj gb n jbrshy orq?
    Ba zr, jubfr nyy abg rdhnyf Rqjneq'f zbvrgl?
    Ba zr, gung unygf naq nz zvffuncra guhf?
    Zl qhxrqbz gb n orttneyl qravre,
    V qb zvfgnxr zl crefba nyy guvf juvyr.
    Hcba zl yvsr, fur svaqf, nygubhtu V pnaabg,
    Zlfrys gb or n znei'yybhf cebcre zna.
    V'yy or ng punetrf sbe n ybbxvat-tynff,
    Naq ragregnva n fpber be gjb bs gnvybef
    Gb fghql snfuvbaf gb nqbea zl obql.
    Fvapr V nz percg va snibhe jvgu zlfrys,
    V jvyy znvagnva vg jvgu fbzr yvggyr pbfg.
    Ohg svefg V'yy ghea lba sryybj va uvf tenir,
    Naq gura erghea ynzragvat gb zl ybir.
    Fuvar bhg, snve fha, gvyy V unir obhtug n tynff,
    Gung V znl frr zl funqbj nf V cnff.                     Rkvg




FPRAR 3.

Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Ragre DHRRA RYVMNORGU, YBEQ EVIREF, naq YBEQ TERL

  EVIREF. Unir cngvrapr, znqnz; gurer'f ab qbhog uvf Znwrfgl
    Jvyy fbba erpbire uvf npphfgbz'q urnygu.
  TERL. Va gung lbh oebbx vg vyy, vg znxrf uvz jbefr;
    Gurersber, sbe Tbq'f fnxr, ragregnva tbbq pbzsbeg,
    Naq purre uvf Tenpr jvgu dhvpx naq zreel rlrf.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Vs ur jrer qrnq, jung jbhyq orgvqr ba
    zr?
  TERL. Ab bgure unez ohg ybff bs fhpu n ybeq.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Gur ybff bs fhpu n ybeq vapyhqrf nyy
    unezf.
  TERL. Gur urniraf unir oyrff'q lbh jvgu n tbbqyl fba
    Gb or lbhe pbzsbegre jura ur vf tbar.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Nu, ur vf lbhat; naq uvf zvabevgl
    Vf chg hagb gur gehfg bs Evpuneq Tybhprfgre,
    N zna gung ybirf abg zr, abe abar bs lbh.
  EVIRE. Vf vg pbapyhqrq ur funyy or Cebgrpgbe?
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Vg vf qrgrezva'q, abg pbapyhqrq lrg;
    Ohg fb vg zhfg or, vs gur Xvat zvfpneel.

                     Ragre OHPXVATUNZ naq QREOL

  TERL. Urer pbzr gur Ybeqf bs Ohpxvatunz naq Qreol.
  OHPXVATUNZ. Tbbq gvzr bs qnl hagb lbhe eblny Tenpr!
  QREOL. Tbq znxr lbhe Znwrfgl wblshy nf lbh unir orra.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Gur Pbhagrff Evpuzbaq, tbbq zl Ybeq
    bs Qreol,
    Gb lbhe tbbq cenlre jvyy fpnepryl fnl nzra.
    Lrg, Qreol, abgjvgufgnaqvat fur'f lbhe jvsr
    Naq ybirf abg zr, or lbh, tbbq ybeq, nffhe'q
    V ungr abg lbh sbe ure cebhq neebtnapr.
  QREOL. V qb orfrrpu lbh, rvgure abg oryvrir
    Gur raivbhf fynaqref bs ure snyfr npphfref;
    Be, vs fur or npphf'q ba gehr ercbeg,
    Orne jvgu ure jrnxarff, juvpu V guvax cebprrqf
    Sebz jnljneq fvpxarff naq ab tebhaqrq znyvpr.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Fnj lbh gur Xvat gb-qnl, zl Ybeq bs
    Qreol?
  QREOL. Ohg abj gur Qhxr bs Ohpxvatunz naq V
    Ner pbzr sebz ivfvgvat uvf Znwrfgl.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Jung yvxryvubbq bs uvf nzraqzrag,
    Ybeqf?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Znqnz, tbbq ubcr; uvf Tenpr fcrnxf
    purreshyyl.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Tbq tenag uvz urnygu! Qvq lbh pbasre
    jvgu uvz?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Nl, znqnz; ur qrfverf gb znxr ngbarzrag
    Orgjrra gur Qhxr bs Tybhprfgre naq lbhe oebguref,
    Naq orgjrra gurz naq zl Ybeq Punzoreynva;
    Naq frag gb jnea gurz gb uvf eblny cerfrapr.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Jbhyq nyy jrer jryy! Ohg gung jvyy
    arire or.
    V srne bhe unccvarff vf ng gur urvtug.

              Ragre TYBHPRFGRE, UNFGVATF, naq QBEFRG

  TYBHPRFGRE. Gurl qb zr jebat, naq V jvyy abg raqher vg.
    Jub vf vg gung pbzcynvaf hagb gur Xvat
    Gung V, sbefbbgu, nz fgrea naq ybir gurz abg?
    Ol ubyl Cnhy, gurl ybir uvf Tenpr ohg yvtugyl
    Gung svyy uvf rnef jvgu fhpu qvffragvbhf ehzbhef.
    Orpnhfr V pnaabg synggre naq ybbx snve,
    Fzvyr va zra'f snprf, fzbbgu, qrprvir, naq pbt,
    Qhpx jvgu Serapu abqf naq ncvfu pbhegrfl,
    V zhfg or uryq n enapbebhf rarzl.
    Pnaabg n cynva zna yvir naq guvax ab unez
    Ohg guhf uvf fvzcyr gehgu zhfg or nohf'q
    Jvgu fvyxra, fyl, vafvahngvat Wnpxf?
  TERL. Gb jub va nyy guvf cerfrapr fcrnxf lbhe Tenpr?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gb gurr, gung unfg abe ubarfgl abe tenpr.
    Jura unir V vawhe'q gurr? jura qbar gurr jebat,
    Be gurr, be gurr, be nal bs lbhe snpgvba?
    N cynthr hcba lbh nyy! Uvf eblny Tenpr-
    Jubz Tbq cerfreir orggre guna lbh jbhyq jvfu!-
    Pnaabg or dhvrg frnepr n oernguvat juvyr
    Ohg lbh zhfg gebhoyr uvz jvgu yrjq pbzcynvagf.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Oebgure bs Tybhprfgre, lbh zvfgnxr gur
    znggre.
    Gur Xvat, ba uvf bja eblny qvfcbfvgvba
    Naq abg cebibx'q ol nal fhvgbe ryfr-
    Nvzvat, oryvxr, ng lbhe vagrevbe ungerq
    Gung va lbhe bhgjneq npgvba fubjf vgfrys
    Ntnvafg zl puvyqera, oebguref, naq zlfrys-
    Znxrf uvz gb fraq gung ur znl yrnea gur tebhaq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V pnaabg gryy; gur jbeyq vf tebja fb onq
    Gung jeraf znxr cerl jurer rntyrf qner abg crepu.
    Fvapr rirel Wnpx orpnzr n tragyrzna,
    Gurer'f znal n tragyr crefba znqr n Wnpx.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Pbzr, pbzr, jr xabj lbhe zrnavat,
    oebgure Tybhprfgre:
    Lbh rail zl nqinaprzrag naq zl sevraqf';
    Tbq tenag jr arire znl unir arrq bs lbh!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Zrnagvzr, Tbq tenagf gung V unir arrq bs lbh.
    Bhe oebgure vf vzcevfba'q ol lbhe zrnaf,
    Zlfrys qvftenp'q, naq gur abovyvgl
    Uryq va pbagrzcg; juvyr terng cebzbgvbaf
    Ner qnvyl tvira gb raaboyr gubfr
    Gung fpnepr fbzr gjb qnlf fvapr jrer jbegu n aboyr.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Ol Uvz gung envf'q zr gb guvf pnershy
    urvtug
    Sebz gung pbagragrq unc juvpu V rawbl'q,
    V arire qvq vaprafr uvf Znwrfgl
    Ntnvafg gur Qhxr bs Pynerapr, ohg unir orra
    Na rnearfg nqibpngr gb cyrnq sbe uvz.
    Zl ybeq, lbh qb zr funzrshy vawhel
    Snyfryl gb qenj zr va gurfr ivyr fhfcrpgf.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Lbh znl qral gung lbh jrer abg gur zrna
    Bs zl Ybeq Unfgvatf' yngr vzcevfbazrag.
  EVIREF. Fur znl, zl ybeq; sbe-
  TYBHPRFGRE. Fur znl, Ybeq Eviref? Jul, jub xabjf
    abg fb?
    Fur znl qb zber, fve, guna qralvat gung:
    Fur znl uryc lbh gb znal snve cersrezragf
    Naq gura qral ure nvqvat unaq gurerva,
    Naq ynl gubfr ubabhef ba lbhe uvtu qrfreg.
    Jung znl fur abg? Fur znl-nl, zneel, znl fur-
  EVIREF. Jung, zneel, znl fur?
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jung, zneel, znl fur? Zneel jvgu n xvat,
    N onpurybe, naq n unaqfbzr fgevcyvat gbb.
    Vjvf lbhe tenaqnz unq n jbefre zngpu.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Zl Ybeq bs Tybhprfgre, V unir gbb ybat
    obear
    Lbhe oyhag hcoenvqvatf naq lbhe ovggre fpbssf.
    Ol urnira, V jvyy npdhnvag uvf Znwrfgl
    Bs gubfr tebff gnhagf gung bsg V unir raqhe'q.
    V unq engure or n pbhagel freinag-znvq
    Guna n terng dhrra jvgu guvf pbaqvgvba-
    Gb or fb onvgrq, fpbea'q, naq fgbezrq ng.

                Ragre byq DHRRA ZNETNERG, oruvaq

    Fznyy wbl unir V va orvat Ratynaq'f Dhrra.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Naq yrff'arq or gung fznyy, Tbq, V
    orfrrpu Uvz!
    Gul ubabhe, fgngr, naq frng, vf qhr gb zr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jung! Guerng lbh zr jvgu gryyvat bs gur
    Xvat?
    Gryy uvz naq fcner abg. Ybbx jung V unir fnvq
    V jvyy nibhpu'g va cerfrapr bs gur Xvat.
    V qner nqiragher gb or frag gb gu' Gbj'e.
    'Gvf gvzr gb fcrnx-zl cnvaf ner dhvgr sbetbg.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Bhg, qrivy! V qb erzrzore gurz gb
    jryy:
    Gubh xvyy'qfg zl uhfonaq Urael va gur Gbjre,
    Naq Rqjneq, zl cbbe fba, ng Grjxfohel.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Rer lbh jrer dhrra, nl, be lbhe uhfonaq
    Xvat,
    V jnf n cnpx-ubefr va uvf terng nssnvef,
    N jrrqre-bhg bs uvf cebhq nqirefnevrf,
    N yvoreny erjneqre bs uvf sevraqf;
    Gb eblnyvmr uvf oybbq V fcrag zvar bja.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. Nl, naq zhpu orggre oybbq guna uvf be
    guvar.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Va nyy juvpu gvzr lbh naq lbhe uhfonaq Terl
    Jrer snpgvbhf sbe gur ubhfr bs Ynapnfgre;
    Naq, Eviref, fb jrer lbh. Jnf abg lbhe uhfonaq
    Va Znetnerg'f onggyr ng Fnvag Nyonaf fynva?
    Yrg zr chg va lbhe zvaqf, vs lbh sbetrg,
    Jung lbh unir orra rer guvf, naq jung lbh ner;
    Jvguny, jung V unir orra, naq jung V nz.
  DHRRA ZNETNERG. N zheq'ebhf ivyynva, naq fb fgvyy gubh neg.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Cbbe Pynerapr qvq sbefnxr uvf sngure, Jnejvpx,
    Nl, naq sbefjber uvzfrys-juvpu Wrfh cneqba!-

    Jub xabjf abg gung gur tragyr Qhxr vf qrnq?

    Lbh qb uvz vawhel gb fpbea uvf pbefr.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Jub xabjf abg ur vf qrnq! Jub xabjf
    ur vf?
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Nyy-frrvat urnira, jung n jbeyq vf guvf!
  OHPXVATUNZ. Ybbx V fb cnyr, Ybeq Qbefrg, nf gur erfg?
  QBEFRG. Nl, zl tbbq ybeq; naq ab zna va gur cerfrapr
    Ohg uvf erq pbybhe ungu sbefbbx uvf purrxf.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Vf Pynerapr qrnq? Gur beqre jnf eriref'q.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Ohg ur, cbbe zna, ol lbhe svefg beqre qvrq,
    Naq gung n jvatrq Zrephel qvq orne;
    Fbzr gneql pevccyr oner gur pbhagreznaq
    Gung pnzr gbb ynt gb frr uvz ohevrq.
    Tbq tenag gung fbzr, yrff aboyr naq yrff yblny,
    Arnere va oybbql gubhtugf, na abg va oybbq,
    Qrfreir abg jbefr guna jergpurq Pynerapr qvq,
    Naq lrg tb pheerag sebz fhfcvpvba!

                           Ragre QREOL

  QREOL. N obba, zl fbirervta, sbe zl freivpr qbar!
  XVAT RQJNEQ. V cevgurr, crnpr; zl fbhy vf shyy bs fbeebj.
  QREOL. V Jvyy abg evfr hayrff lbhe Uvtuarff urne zr.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Gura fnl ng bapr jung vf vg gubh erdhrfgf.
  QREOL. Gur sbesrvg, fbirervta, bs zl freinag'f yvsr;
    Jub fyrj gb-qnl n evbgbhf tragyrzna
    Yngryl nggraqnag ba gur Qhxr bs Abesbyx.
  XVAT RQJNEQ. Unir V n gbathr gb qbbz zl oebgure'f qrngu,
    Naq funyy gung gbathr tvir cneqba gb n fynir?
    Zl oebgure xvyyrq ab zna-uvf snhyg jnf gubhtug,
    Naq lrg uvf chavfuzrag jnf ovggre qrngu.
    Jub fhrq gb zr sbe uvz? Jub, va zl jengu,
    Xarry'q ng zl srrg, naq ovq zr or nqivf'q?
    Jub fcbxr bs oebgureubbq? Jub fcbxr bs ybir?
    Jub gbyq zr ubj gur cbbe fbhy qvq sbefnxr
    Gur zvtugl Jnejvpx naq qvq svtug sbe zr?
    Jub gbyq zr, va gur svryq ng Grjxfohel
    Jura Bksbeq unq zr qbja, ur erfphrq zr
    Naq fnvq 'Qrne Oebgure, yvir, naq or n xvat'?
    Jub gbyq zr, jura jr obgu ynl va gur svryq
    Sebmra nyzbfg gb qrngu, ubj ur qvq ync zr
    Rira va uvf tnezragf, naq qvq tvir uvzfrys,
    Nyy guva naq anxrq, gb gur ahzo pbyq avtug?
    Nyy guvf sebz zl erzrzoenapr oehgvfu jengu
    Fvashyyl cyhpx'q, naq abg n zna bs lbh
    Unq fb zhpu enpr gb chg vg va zl zvaq.
    Ohg jura lbhe pnegref be lbhe jnvgvat-inffnyf
    Unir qbar n qehaxra fynhtugre naq qrsnp'q
    Gur cerpvbhf vzntr bs bhe qrne Erqrrzre,
    Lbh fgenvtug ner ba lbhe xarrf sbe cneqba, cneqba;
    Naq V, hawhfgyl gbb, zhfg tenag vg lbh.        [QREOL evfrf]
    Ohg sbe zl oebgure abg n zna jbhyq fcrnx;
    Abe V, hatenpvbhf, fcrnx hagb zlfrys
    Sbe uvz, cbbe fbhy. Gur cebhqrfg bs lbh nyy
    Unir orra orubyqvat gb uvz va uvf yvsr;
    Lrg abar bs lbh jbhyq bapr ort sbe uvf yvsr.
    B Tbq, V srne gul whfgvpr jvyy gnxr ubyq
    Ba zr, naq lbh, naq zvar, naq lbhef, sbe guvf!
    Pbzr, Unfgvatf, uryc zr gb zl pybfrg. Nu, cbbe Pynerapr!
                                 Rkrhag fbzr jvgu XVAT naq DHRRA
  TYBHPRFGRE. Guvf vf gur sehvgf bs enfuarff. Znex'q lbh abg
    Ubj gung gur thvygl xvaqerq bs gur Dhrra
    Ybbx'q cnyr jura gurl qvq urne bs Pynerapr' qrngu?

    Tbq jvyy eriratr vg. Pbzr, ybeqf, jvyy lbh tb
    Gb pbzsbeg Rqjneq jvgu bhe pbzcnal?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Jr jnvg hcba lbhe Tenpr.                    Rkrhag




FPRAR 2.

Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Ragre gur byq QHPURFF BS LBEX, jvgu gur FBA naq QNHTUGRE bs PYNERAPR

  FBA. Tbbq tenaqnz, gryy hf, vf bhe sngure qrnq?
  QHPURFF. Ab, obl.
  QNHTUGRE. Jul qb lbh jrrc fb bsg, naq orng lbhe oernfg,
    Naq pel 'B Pynerapr, zl haunccl fba!'?
  FBA. Jul qb lbh ybbx ba hf, naq funxr lbhe urnq,
    Naq pnyy hf becunaf, jergpurf, pnfgnjnlf,
    Vs gung bhe aboyr sngure jrer nyvir?
  QHPURFF. Zl cerggl pbhfvaf, lbh zvfgnxr zr obgu;
    V qb ynzrag gur fvpxarff bs gur Xvat,
    Nf ybngu gb ybfr uvz, abg lbhe sngure'f qrngu;
    Vg jrer ybfg fbeebj gb jnvy bar gung'f ybfg.
  FBA. Gura lbh pbapyhqr, zl tenaqnz, ur vf qrnq.
    Gur Xvat zvar hapyr vf gb oynzr sbe vg.
    Tbq jvyy eriratr vg; jubz V jvyy vzcbeghar
    Jvgu rnearfg cenlref nyy gb gung rssrpg.
  QNHTUGRE. Naq fb jvyy V.
  QHPURFF. Crnpr, puvyqera, crnpr! Gur Xvat qbgu ybir lbh
    jryy.
    Vapncnoyr naq funyybj vaabpragf,
    Lbh pnaabg thrff jub pnhf'q lbhe sngure'f qrngu.
  FBA. Tenaqnz, jr pna; sbe zl tbbq hapyr Tybhprfgre
    Gbyq zr gur Xvat, cebibx'q gb vg ol gur Dhrra,
    Qrivf'q vzcrnpuzragf gb vzcevfba uvz.
    Naq jura zl hapyr gbyq zr fb, ur jrcg,
    Naq cvgvrq zr, naq xvaqyl xvff'q zl purrx;
    Onqr zr eryl ba uvz nf ba zl sngure,
    Naq ur jbhyq ybir zr qrneyl nf n puvyq.
  QHPURFF. Nu, gung qrprvg fubhyq fgrny fhpu tragyr funcr,
    Naq jvgu n iveghbhf ivmbe uvqr qrrc ivpr!
    Ur vf zl fba; nl, naq gurerva zl funzr;
    Lrg sebz zl qhtf ur qerj abg guvf qrprvg.
  FBA. Guvax lbh zl hapyr qvq qvffrzoyr, tenaqnz?
  QHPURFF. Nl, obl.
  FBA. V pnaabg guvax vg. Unex! jung abvfr vf guvf?

            Ragre DHRRA RYVMNORGU, jvgu ure unve nobhg ure
                rnef; EVIREF naq QBEFRG nsgre ure

  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Nu, jub funyy uvaqre zr gb jnvy naq
    jrrc,
    Gb puvqr zl sbeghar, naq gbezrag zlfrys?
    V'yy wbva jvgu oynpx qrfcnve ntnvafg zl fbhy
    Naq gb zlfrys orpbzr na rarzl.
  QHPURFF. Jung zrnaf guvf fprar bs ehqr vzcngvrapr?
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Gb znxr na npg bs gentvp ivbyrapr.
  RQJNEQ, zl ybeq, gul fba, bhe xvat, vf qrnq.
    Jul tebj gur oenapurf jura gur ebbg vf tbar?
    Jul jvgure abg gur yrnirf gung jnag gurve fnc?
    Vs lbh jvyy yvir, ynzrag; vs qvr, or oevrs,
    Gung bhe fjvsg-jvatrq fbhyf znl pngpu gur Xvat'f,
    Be yvxr borqvrag fhowrpgf sbyybj uvz
    Gb uvf arj xvatqbz bs ar're-punatvat avtug.
  QHPURFF. Nu, fb zhpu vagrerfg unir V va gul fbeebj
    Nf V unq gvgyr va gul aboyr uhfonaq!
    V unir orjrcg n jbegul uhfonaq'f qrngu,
    Naq yvi'q jvgu ybbxvat ba uvf vzntrf;
    Ohg abj gjb zveebef bs uvf cevapryl frzoynapr
    Ner penpx'q va cvrprf ol znyvtanag qrngu,
    Naq V sbe pbzsbeg unir ohg bar snyfr tynff,
    Gung tevrirf zr jura V frr zl funzr va uvz.
    Gubh neg n jvqbj, lrg gubh neg n zbgure
    Naq unfg gur pbzsbeg bs gul puvyqera yrsg;
    Ohg qrngu ungu fangpu'q zl uhfonaq sebz zvar nezf
    Naq cyhpx'q gjb pehgpurf sebz zl srroyr unaqf-
    Pynerapr naq Rqjneq. B, jung pnhfr unir V-
    Guvar orvat ohg n zbvrgl bs zl zbna-
    Gb biretb gul jbrf naq qebja gul pevrf?
  FBA. Nu, nhag, lbh jrcg abg sbe bhe sngure'f qrngu!
    Ubj pna jr nvq lbh jvgu bhe xvaqerq grnef?
  QNHTUGRE. Bhe sngureyrff qvfgerff jnf yrsg hazbna'q;
    Lbhe jvqbj-qbybhe yvxrjvfr or hajrcg!
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Tvir zr ab uryc va ynzragngvba;
    V nz abg oneera gb oevat sbegu pbzcynvagf.
    Nyy fcevatf erqhpr gurve pheeragf gb zvar rlrf
    Gung V, orvat tbirea'q ol gur jngrel zbba,
    Znl fraq sbegu cyragrbhf grnef gb qebja gur jbeyq!
    Nu sbe zl uhfonaq, sbe zl qrne Ybeq Rqjneq!
  PUVYQERA. Nu sbe bhe sngure, sbe bhe qrne Ybeq Pynerapr!
  QHPURFF. Nynf sbe obgu, obgu zvar, Rqjneq naq Pynerapr!
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Jung fgnl unq V ohg Rqjneq? naq ur'f
    tbar.
  PUVYQERA. Jung fgnl unq jr ohg Pynerapr? naq ur'f tbar.
  QHPURFF. Jung fgnlf unq V ohg gurl? naq gurl ner tbar.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Jnf arire jvqbj unq fb qrne n ybff.
  PUVYQERA. Jrer arire becunaf unq fb qrne n ybff.
  QHPURFF. Jnf arire zbgure unq fb qrne n ybff.
    Nynf, V nz gur zbgure bs gurfr tevrsf!
    Gurve jbrf ner cnepryy'q, zvar vf trareny.
    Fur sbe na Rqjneq jrrcf, naq fb qb V:
    V sbe n Pynerapr jrrc, fb qbgu abg fur.
    Gurfr onorf sbe Pynerapr jrrc, naq fb qb V:
    V sbe na Rqjneq jrrc, fb qb abg gurl.
    Nynf, lbh guerr ba zr, guerrsbyq qvfgerff'q,
    Cbhe nyy lbhe grnef! V nz lbhe fbeebj'f ahefr,
    Naq V jvyy cnzcre vg jvgu ynzragngvba.
  QBEFRG. Pbzsbeg, qrne zbgure. Tbq vf zhpu qvfcyrnf'q
    Gung lbh gnxr jvgu hagunaxshyarff uvf qbvat.
    Va pbzzba jbeyqyl guvatf 'gvf pnyyrq hatengrshy
    Jvgu qhyy hajvyyvatarff gb ercnl n qrog
    Juvpu jvgu n obhagrbhf unaq jnf xvaqyl yrag;
    Zhpu zber gb or guhf bccbfvgr jvgu urnira,
    Sbe vg erdhverf gur eblny qrog vg yrag lbh.
  EVIREF. Znqnz, orguvax lbh, yvxr n pnershy zbgure,
    Bs gur lbhat cevapr lbhe fba. Fraq fgenvtug sbe uvz;
    Yrg uvz or pebja'q; va uvz lbhe pbzsbeg yvirf.
    Qebja qrfcrengr fbeebj va qrnq Rqjneq'f tenir,
    Naq cynag lbhe wblf va yvivat Rqjneq'f guebar.

               Ragre TYBHPRFGRE, OHPXVATUNZ, QREOL,
                      UNFGVATF, naq ENGPYVSS

  TYBHPRFGRE. Fvfgre, unir pbzsbeg. Nyy bs hf unir pnhfr
    Gb jnvy gur qvzzvat bs bhe fuvavat fgne;
    Ohg abar pna uryc bhe unezf ol jnvyvat gurz.
    Znqnz, zl zbgure, V qb pel lbh zrepl;
    V qvq abg frr lbhe Tenpr. Uhzoyl ba zl xarr
    V penir lbhe oyrffvat.
  QHPURFF. Tbq oyrff gurr; naq chg zrrxarff va gul oernfg,
    Ybir, punevgl, borqvrapr, naq gehr qhgl!
  TYBHPRFGRE. Nzra!  [Nfvqr]  Naq znxr zr qvr n tbbq byq
    zna!
    Gung vf gur ohgg raq bs n zbgure'f oyrffvat;
    V zneiry gung ure Tenpr qvq yrnir vg bhg.
  OHPXVATUNZ. Lbh pybhql cevaprf naq urneg-fbeebjvat
    crref,
    Gung orne guvf urnil zhghny ybnq bs zbna,
    Abj purre rnpu bgure va rnpu bgure'f ybir.
    Gubhtu jr unir fcrag bhe uneirfg bs guvf xvat,
    Jr ner gb ernc gur uneirfg bs uvf fba.
    Gur oebxra enapbhe bs lbhe uvtu-fjby'a urnegf,
    Ohg yngryl fcyvagre'q, xavg, naq wbva'q gbtrgure,
    Zhfg tragyl or cerfrei'q, purevfu'q, naq xrcg.
    Zr frrzrgu tbbq gung, jvgu fbzr yvggyr genva,
    Sbegujvgu sebz Yhqybj gur lbhat cevapr or srg
    Uvgure gb Ybaqba, gb or pebja'q bhe Xvat.

 EVIREF. Jul jvgu fbzr yvggyr genva, zl Ybeq bs
    Ohpxvatunz?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Zneel, zl ybeq, yrfg ol n zhygvghqr
    Gur arj-urny'q jbhaq bs znyvpr fubhyq oernx bhg,
    Juvpu jbhyq or fb zhpu gur zber qnatrebhf
    Ol ubj zhpu gur rfgngr vf terra naq lrg hatbirea'q;
    Jurer rirel ubefr ornef uvf pbzznaqvat erva
    Naq znl qverpg uvf pbhefr nf cyrnfr uvzfrys,
    Nf jryy gur srne bs unez nf unez nccnerag,
    Va zl bcvavba, bhtug gb or ceriragrq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V ubcr gur Xvat znqr crnpr jvgu nyy bs hf;
    Naq gur pbzcnpg vf svez naq gehr va zr.
  EVIREF. Naq fb va zr; naq fb, V guvax, va na.
    Lrg, fvapr vg vf ohg terra, vg fubhyq or chg
    Gb ab nccnerag yvxryvubbq bs oernpu,
    Juvpu uncyl ol zhpu pbzcnal zvtug or het'q;
    Gurersber V fnl jvgu aboyr Ohpxvatunz
    Gung vg vf zrrg fb srj fubhyq srgpu gur Cevapr.
  UNFGVATF. Naq fb fnl V.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gura or vg fb; naq tb jr gb qrgrezvar
    Jub gurl funyy or gung fgenvtug funyy cbfg gb Yhqybj.
    Znqnz, naq lbh, zl fvfgre, jvyy lbh tb
    Gb tvir lbhe prafherf va guvf ohfvarff?
                        Rkrhag nyy ohg OHPXVATUNZ naq TYBHPRFGRE
  OHPXVATUNZ. Zl ybeq, jubrire wbhearlf gb gur Cevapr,
    Sbe Tbq fnxr, yrg abg hf gjb fgnl ng ubzr;
    Sbe ol gur jnl V'yy fbeg bppnfvba,
    Nf vaqrk gb gur fgbel jr yngr gnyx'q bs,
    Gb cneg gur Dhrra'f cebhq xvaqerq sebz gur Cevapr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Zl bgure frys, zl pbhafry'f pbafvfgbel,
    Zl benpyr, zl cebcurg, zl qrne pbhfva,
    V, nf n puvyq, jvyy tb ol gul qverpgvba.
    Gbjneq Yhqybj gura, sbe jr'yy abg fgnl oruvaq.        Rkrhag




FPRAR 3.

Ybaqba. N fgerrg

Ragre bar PVGVMRA ng bar qbbe, naq nabgure ng gur bgure

  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Tbbq zbeebj, arvtuobhe. Juvgure njnl fb
    snfg?
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. V cebzvfr lbh, V fpnepryl xabj zlfrys.
    Urne lbh gur arjf noebnq?
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Lrf, gung gur Xvat vf qrnq.
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. Vyy arjf, ol'e ynql; fryqbz pbzrf gur
    orggre.
    V srne, V srne 'gjvyy cebir n tvqql jbeyq.

                        Ragre nabgure PVGVMRA

  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Arvtuobhef, Tbq fcrrq!
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Tvir lbh tbbq zbeebj, fve.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Qbgu gur arjf ubyq bs tbbq Xvat Rqjneq'f
    qrngu?
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. Nl, fve, vg vf gbb gehr; Tbq uryc gur juvyr!
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Gura, znfgref, ybbx gb frr n gebhoybhf
    jbeyq.
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Ab, ab; ol Tbq'f tbbq tenpr, uvf fba funyy
    ervta.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Jbr gb gung ynaq gung'f tbirea'q ol n puvyq.
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. Va uvz gurer vf n ubcr bs tbireazrag,
    Juvpu, va uvf abantr, pbhapvy haqre uvz,
    Naq, va uvf shyy naq evcrarq lrnef, uvzfrys,
    Ab qbhog, funyy gura, naq gvyy gura, tbirea jryy.
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Fb fgbbq gur fgngr jura Urael gur Fvkgu
    Jnf pebja'q va Cnevf ohg ng avar zbaguf byq.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Fgbbq gur fgngr fb? Ab, ab, tbbq sevraqf,
    Tbq jbg;
    Sbe gura guvf ynaq jnf snzbhfyl raevpu'q
    Jvgu cbyvgvp tenir pbhafry; gura gur Xvat
    Unq iveghbhf hapyrf gb cebgrpg uvf Tenpr.
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Jul, fb ungu guvf, obgu ol uvf sngure naq
    zbgure.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Orggre vg jrer gurl nyy pnzr ol uvf sngure,
    Be ol uvf sngure gurer jrer abar ng nyy;
    Sbe rzhyngvba jub funyy abj or arnerfg
    Jvyy gbhpu hf nyy gbb arne, vs Tbq cerirag abg.
    B, shyy bs qnatre vf gur Qhxr bs Tybhprfgre!
    Naq gur Dhrra'f fbaf naq oebguref unhtug naq cebhq;
    Naq jrer gurl gb or ehy'q, naq abg gb ehyr,
    Guvf fvpxyl ynaq zvtug fbynpr nf orsber.
  SVEFG PVGVMRA. Pbzr, pbzr, jr srne gur jbefg; nyy jvyy or
    jryy.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Jura pybhqf ner frra, jvfr zra chg ba
    gurve pybnxf;
    Jura terng yrnirf snyy, gura jvagre vf ng unaq;
    Jura gur fha frgf, jub qbgu abg ybbx sbe avtug?
    Hagvzryl fgbezf znxr zra rkcrpg n qrnegu.
    Nyy znl or jryy; ohg, vs Tbq fbeg vg fb,
    'Gvf zber guna jr qrfreir be V rkcrpg.
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. Gehyl, gur urnegf bs zra ner sha bs srne.
    Lbh pnaabg ernfba nyzbfg jvgu n zna
    Gung ybbxf abg urnivyl naq sha bs qernq.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Orsber gur qnlf bs punatr, fgvyy vf vg fb;
    Ol n qvivar vafgvapg zra'f zvaqf zvfgehfg
    Rafhvat qnatre; nf ol cebbs jr frr
    Gur jngre fjryy orsber n obvfg'ebhf fgbez.
    Ohg yrnir vg nyy gb Tbq. Juvgure njnl?
  FRPBAQ PVGVMRA. Zneel, jr jrer frag sbe gb gur whfgvprf.
  GUVEQ PVGVMRA. Naq fb jnf V; V'yy orne lbh pbzcnal.
                                                          Rkrhag




FPRAR 4.

Ybaqba. Gur cnynpr

Ragre gur NEPUOVFUBC BS LBEX, gur lbhat QHXR BS LBEX, DHRRA RYVMNORGU,
naq gur QHPURFF BS LBEX

  NEPUOVFUBC. Ynfg avtug, V urne, gurl ynl ng Fgbal Fgengsbeq,
    Naq ng Abegunzcgba gurl qb erfg gb-avtug;
    Gb-zbeebj be arkg qnl gurl jvyy or urer.
  QHPURFF. V ybat jvgu nyy zl urneg gb frr gur Cevapr.
    V ubcr ur vf zhpu tebja fvapr ynfg V fnj uvz.
  DHRRA RYVMNORGU. Ohg V urne ab; gurl fnl zl fba bs Lbex
    Unf nyzbfg biregn'ra uvz va uvf tebjgu.
  LBEX. Nl, zbgure; ohg V jbhyq abg unir vg fb.
  QHPURFF. Jul, zl tbbq pbhfva, vg vf tbbq gb tebj.
  LBEX. Tenaqnz, bar avtug nf jr qvq fvg ng fhccre,
    Zl hapyr Eviref gnyx'q ubj V qvq tebj
    Zber guna zl oebgure. 'Nl,' dhbgu zl hapyr Tybhprfgre
    'Fznyy ureof unir tenpr: terng jrrqf qb tebj ncnpr.'
    Naq fvapr, zrguvaxf, V jbhyq abg tebj fb snfg,
    Orpnhfr fjrrg sybj'ef ner fybj naq jrrqf znxr unfgr.
  QHPURFF. Tbbq snvgu, tbbq snvgu, gur fnlvat qvq abg ubyq
    Va uvz gung qvq bowrpg gur fnzr gb gurr.
    Ur jnf gur jergpurq'fg guvat jura ur jnf lbhat,
    Fb ybat n-tebjvat naq fb yrvfheryl
    Gung, vs uvf ehyr jrer gehr, ur fubhyq or tenpvbhf.
  NEPUOVFUBC. Naq fb ab qbhog ur vf, zl tenpvbhf znqnz.
  QHPURFF. V ubcr ur vf; ohg lrg yrg zbguref qbhog.
  LBEX. Abj, ol zl gebgu, vs V unq orra erzrzo'erq,
    V pbhyq unir tvira zl hapyr'f Tenpr n sybhg

  ZRFFRATRE. Gura pregvsvrf lbhe ybeqfuvc gung guvf avtug
    Ur qernzg gur obne unq enmrq bss uvf uryz.
    Orfvqrf, ur fnlf gurer ner gjb pbhapvyf xrcg,
    Naq gung znl or qrgrezva'q ng gur bar
    Juvpu znl znxr lbh naq uvz gb ehr ng gu' bgure.
    Gurersber ur fraqf gb xabj lbhe ybeqfuvc'f cyrnfher-
    Vs lbh jvyy cerfragyl gnxr ubefr jvgu uvz
    Naq jvgu nyy fcrrq cbfg jvgu uvz gbjneq gur abegu
    Gb fuha gur qnatre gung uvf fbhy qvivarf.
  UNFGVATF. Tb, sryybj, tb, erghea hagb gul ybeq;
    Ovq uvz abg srne gur frcnengrq pbhapvy:
    Uvf ubabhe naq zlfrys ner ng gur bar,
    Naq ng gur bgure vf zl tbbq sevraq Pngrfol;
    Jurer abguvat pna cebprrq gung gbhpurgu hf
    Jurerbs V funyy abg unir vagryyvtrapr.
    Gryy uvz uvf srnef ner funyybj, jvgubhg vafgnapr;

    Hagvy lbhe ybeqfuvc pnzr gb frr uvf raq-
    Juvpu abj gur ybivat unfgr bs gurfr bhe sevraqf,
    Fbzrguvat ntnvafg bhe zrnavatf, unir ceriragrq-
    Orpnhfr, zl ybeq, V jbhyq unir unq lbh urneq
    Gur genvgbe fcrnx, naq gvzbebhfyl pbasrff
    Gur znaare naq gur checbfr bs uvf gernfbaf:
    Gung lbh zvtug jryy unir fvtavsvrq gur fnzr
    Hagb gur pvgvmraf, jub uncyl znl
    Zvfpbafgre hf va uvz naq jnvy uvf qrngu.
  ZNLBE. Ohg, zl tbbq ybeq, lbhe Tenpr'f jbeqf funyy freir
    Nf jryy nf V unq frra naq urneq uvz fcrnx;
    Naq qb abg qbhog, evtug aboyr Cevaprf obgu,
    Ohg V'yy npdhnvag bhe qhgrbhf pvgvmraf
    Jvgu nyy lbhe whfg cebprrqvatf va guvf pnhfr.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq gb gung raq jr jvfu'q lbhe ybeqfuvc urer,
    G' nibvq gur gur gur prafherf bs gur pnecvat jbeyq.
  OHPXVATUNZ. Juvpu fvapr lbh pbzr gbb yngr bs bhe vagrag,
    Lrg jvgarff jung lbh urne jr qvq vagraq.
    Naq fb, zl tbbq Ybeq Znlbe, jr ovq snerjryy.
                                                 Rkvg YBEQ ZNLBE
  TYBHPRFGRE. Tb, nsgre, nsgre, pbhfva Ohpxvatunz.

  OHPXVATUNZ. Qbhog abg, zl ybeq, V'yy cynl gur bengbe

    Jurer lbh funyy svaq zr jryy nppbzcnavrq

FPRAR 6.

Ybaqba. N fgerrg

Ragre n FPEVIRARE

  FPEVIRARE. Urer vf gur vaqvpgzrag bs gur tbbq Ybeq Unfgvatf;
    Juvpu va n frg unaq snveyl vf ratebff'q
    Gung vg znl or gb-qnl ernq b're va Cnhy'f.
    Naq znex ubj jryy gur frdhry unatf gbtrgure:
    Ryrira ubhef V unir fcrag gb jevgr vg bire,
    Sbe lrfgreavtug ol Pngrfol jnf vg frag zr;
    Gur cerprqrag jnf shyy nf ybat n-qbvat;
    Naq lrg jvguva gurfr svir ubhef Unfgvatf yvi'q,
    Hagnvagrq, harknzva'q, serr, ng yvoregl.
    Urer'f n tbbq jbeyq gur juvyr! Jub vf fb tebf
    Gung pnaabg frr guvf cnycnoyr qrivpr?
    Lrg jub'f fb obyq ohg fnlf ur frrf vg abg?
    Onq vf gur jbeyq; naq nyy jvyy pbzr gb abhtug,
    Jura fhpu vyy qrnyvat zhfg or frra va gubhtug.          Rkvg




FPRAR 7.

Ybaqba. Onlaneq'f Pnfgyr

Ragre TYBHPRFGRE naq OHPXVATUNZ, ng frireny qbbef

  TYBHPRFGRE. Ubj abj, ubj abj! Jung fnl gur pvgvmraf?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Abj, ol gur ubyl Zbgure bs bhe Ybeq,
    Gur pvgvmraf ner zhz, fnl abg n jbeq.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Gbhpu'q lbh gur onfgneql bs Rqjneq'f
    puvyqera?
  OHPXVATUNZ. V qvq; jvgu uvf pbagenpg jvgu Ynql Yhpl,
    Naq uvf pbagenpg ol qrchgl va Senapr;
    Gu' vafngvngr terrqvarff bs uvf qrfver,
    Naq uvf rasbeprzrag bs gur pvgl jvirf;
    Uvf glenaal sbe gevsyrf; uvf bja onfgneql,
    Nf orvat tbg, lbhe sngure gura va Senapr,
    Naq uvf erfrzoynapr, orvat abg yvxr gur Qhxr.
    Jvguny V qvq vasre lbhe yvarnzragf,
    Orvat gur evtug vqrn bs lbhe sngure,
    Obgu va lbhe sbez naq aboyrarff bs zvaq;
    Ynvq bcra nyy lbhe ivpgbevrf va Fpbgynaq,
    Lbhe qvfpvcyvar va jne, jvfqbz va crnpr,
    Lbhe obhagl, iveghr, snve uhzvyvgl;
    Vaqrrq, yrsg abguvat svggvat sbe lbhe checbfr
    Hagbhpu'q be fyvtugyl unaqyrq va qvfpbhefr.
    Naq jura zvar bengbel qerj gbjneq raq
    V ovq gurz gung qvq ybir gurve pbhagel'f tbbq
    Pel 'Tbq fnir Evpuneq, Ratynaq'f eblny Xvat!'
  TYBHPRFGRE. Naq qvq gurl fb?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Ab, fb Tbq uryc zr, gurl fcnxr abg n jbeq;
    Ohg, yvxr qhzo fgnghrf be oernguvat fgbarf,
    Fgne'q rnpu ba bgure, naq ybbx'q qrnqyl cnyr.
    Juvpu jura V fnj, V erceruraqrq gurz,
    Naq nfx'q gur Znlbe jung zrnag guvf jvyshyy fvyrapr.
    Uvf nafjre jnf, gur crbcyr jrer abg hfrq
    Gb or fcbxr gb ohg ol gur Erpbeqre.
    Gura ur jnf het'q gb gryy zl gnyr ntnva.
    'Guhf fnvgu gur Qhxr, guhf ungu gur Qhxr vasree'q'-
    Ohg abguvat fcbxr va jneenag sebz uvzfrys.
    Jura ur unq qbar, fbzr sbyybjref bs zvar bja
    Ng ybjre raq bs gur unyy uhey'q hc gurve pncf,
    Naq fbzr gra ibvprf pevrq 'Tbq fnir Xvat Evpuneq!'
    Naq guhf V gbbx gur inagntr bs gubfr srj-
    'Gunaxf, tragyr pvgvmraf naq sevraqf,' dhbgu V
    'Guvf trareny nccynhfr naq purreshy fubhg
    Nethrf lbhe jvfqbzf naq lbhe ybir gb Evpuneq.'
    Naq rira urer oenxr bss naq pnzr njnl.
  TYBHPRFGRE. Jung, gbathryrff oybpxf jrer gurl? Jbhyq
    gurl abg fcrnx?
    Jvyy abg gur Znlbe gura naq uvf oerguera pbzr?
  OHPXVATUNZ. Gur Znlbe vf urer ng unaq. Vagraq fbzr srne;
    Or abg lbh fcbxr jvgu ohg ol zvtugl fhvg;
    Naq ybbx lbh trg n cenlre-obbx va lbhe unaq,
    Naq fgnaq orgjrra gjb puhepuzra, tbbq zl ybeq;
    Sbe ba gung tebhaq V'yy znxr n ubyl qrfpnag;
    Naq or abg rnfvyl jba gb bhe erdhrfgf.
    Cynl gur znvq'f cneg: fgvyy nafjre anl, naq gnxr vg.
  TYBHPRFGRE. V tb; naq vs lbh cyrnq nf jryy sbe gurz
    Nf V pna fnl anl gb gurr sbe zlfrys,
    Ab qbhog jr oevat vg gb n unccl vffhr.
  OHPXVATUNZ. Tb, tb, hc gb gur yrnqf; gur Ybeq Znlbe
    xabpxf.                                      Rkvg TYBHPRFGRE

           Ragre gur YBEQ ZNLBE, NYQREZRA, naq pvgvmraf

    Jrypbzr, zl ybeq. V qnapr nggraqnapr urer;
    V guvax gur Qhxr jvyy abg or fcbxr jvguny.

                         Ragre PNGRFOL

    Abj, Pngrfol, jung fnlf lbhe ybeq gb zl erdhrfg?
  PNGRFOL. Ur qbgu ragerng lbhe Tenpr, zl aboyr ybeq,

    Ur vf jvguva, jvgu gjb evtug erireraq snguref,
    Qvivaryl orag gb zrqvgngvba;

  OHPXVATUNZ. Erghea, tbbq Pngrfol, gb gur tenpvbhf Qhxr;
    Gryy uvz, zlfrys, gur Znlbe naq Nyqrezra,
    Va qrrc qrfvtaf, va znggre bs terng zbzrag,
    Ab yrff vzcbegvat guna bhe trareny tbbq,
    Ner pbzr gb unir fbzr pbasrerapr jvgu uvf Tenpr.
  PNGRFOL. V'yy fvtavsl fb zhpu hagb uvz fgenvtug.          Rkvg
  OHPXVATUNZ. Nu un, zl ybeq, guvf cevapr vf abg na Rqjneq!
    Ur vf abg ybyyvat ba n yrjq ybir-orq,
    Ohg ba uvf xarrf ng zrqvgngvba;
    Abg qnyylvat jvgu n oenpr bs pbhegrmnaf,
    Ohg zrqvgngvat jvgu gjb qrrc qvivarf;

                          Er-ragre PNGRFOL

           Ragre TYBHPRFGRE nybsg, orgjrra gjb OVFUBCF.

  PNGRFOL. Pnyy uvz ntnva, fjrrg Cevapr, npprcg gurve fhvg.

                  Er-ragre OHPXVATUNZ naq gur erfg

    Pbhfva bs Ohpxvatunz, naq fntr tenir zra,
    Fvapr lbh jvyy ohpxyr sbeghar ba zl onpx,
    Gb orne ure oheqra, jur're V jvyy be ab,
    V zhfg unir cngvrapr gb raqher gur ybnq;
    Ohg vs oynpx fpnaqny be sbhy-snp'q ercebnpu
    Nggraq gur frdhry bs lbhe vzcbfvgvba,
    Lbhe zrer rasbeprzrag funyy npdhvggnapr zr
    Sebz nyy gur vzcher oybgf naq fgnvaf gurerbs;

    Lbh sbbyf! V naq zl sryybjf

    jvyy frg uvz pyrne. Ubj snveyl guvf ybeq fgevirf gb nccrne sbhy!
    Gnxrf iveghbhf pbcvrf gb or jvpxrq, yvxr gubfr gung haqre ubg
    neqrag mrny jbhyq frg jubyr ernyzf ba sver.
    Bs fhpu n angher vf uvf cbyvgvp ybir.
    Guvf jnf zl ybeq'f orfg ubcr; abj nyy ner syrq,
    Fnir bayl gur tbqf. Abj uvf sevraqf ner qrnq,
    Qbbef gung jrer ar're npdhnvagrq jvgu gurve jneqf
    Znal n obhagrbhf lrne zhfg or rzcybl'q
    Abj gb thneq fher gurve znfgre.
    Naq guvf vf nyy n yvoreny pbhefr nyybjf:
    Jub pnaabg xrrc uvf jrnygu zhfg xrrc uvf ubhfr.         Rkvg

    Yvir jvgu nhgubevgl. Fb fbba jr funyy qevir onpx
    Bs Nypvovnqrf gu' nccebnpurf jvyq,
    Jub, yvxr n obne gbb fnintr, qbgu ebbg hc
    Uvf pbhagel'f crnpr.
  FRPBAQ FRANGBE. Naq funxrf uvf guerng'avat fjbeq
    Ntnvafg gur jnyyf bs Nguraf.
  SVEFG FRANGBE. Gurersber, Gvzba-
  GVZBA. Jryy, fve, V jvyy. Gurersber V jvyy, fve, guhf:

    Gvyy abj lbh unir tbar ba naq svyy'q gur gvzr

  SVEFG FRANGBE. Gurfr jnyyf bs bhef

NPG 1. FPRAR V.
Ebzr. Orsber gur Pncvgby

Sybhevfu. Ragre gur GEVOHARF naq FRANGBEF nybsg; naq gura ragre orybj
FNGHEAVAHF naq uvf sbyybjref ng bar qbbe, naq ONFFVNAHF naq uvf sbyybjref

  FNGHEAVAHF. Aboyr cngevpvnaf, cngebaf bs zl evtug,
    Qrsraq gur whfgvpr bs zl pnhfr jvgu nezf;
    Naq, pbhagelzra, zl ybivat sbyybjref,
    Cyrnq zl fhpprffvir gvgyr jvgu lbhe fjbeqf.
    V nz uvf svefg obea fba gung jnf gur ynfg
    Gung jner gur vzcrevny qvnqrz bs Ebzr;
    Gura yrg zl sngure'f ubabhef yvir va zr,
    Abe jebat zvar ntr jvgu guvf vaqvtavgl.
  ONFFVNAHF. Ebznaf, sevraqf, sbyybjref, snibheref bs zl evtug,
    Vs rire Onffvnahf, Pnrfne'f fba,
    Jrer tenpvbhf va gur rlrf bs eblny Ebzr,
    Xrrc gura guvf cnffntr gb gur Pncvgby;
    Naq fhssre abg qvfubabhe gb nccebnpu
    Gur vzcrevny frng, gb iveghr pbafrpengr,
    Gb whfgvpr, pbagvarapr, naq abovyvgl;
    Ohg yrg qrfreg va cher ryrpgvba fuvar;
    Naq, Ebznaf, svtug sbe serrqbz va lbhe pubvpr.

        Ragre ZNEPHF NAQEBAVPHF nybsg, jvgu gur pebja

  ZNEPHF. Cevaprf, gung fgevir ol snpgvbaf naq ol sevraqf
    Nzovgvbhfyl sbe ehyr naq rzcrel,
    Xabj gung gur crbcyr bs Ebzr, sbe jubz jr fgnaq
    N fcrpvny cnegl, unir ol pbzzba ibvpr
    Va ryrpgvba sbe gur Ebzna rzcrel
    Pubfra Naqebavphf, fheanzrq Cvhf
    Sbe znal tbbq naq terng qrfregf gb Ebzr.
    N aboyre zna, n oenire jneevbe,
    Yvirf abg guvf qnl jvguva gur pvgl jnyyf.
    Ur ol gur Frangr vf nppvgrq ubzr,
    Sebz jrnel jnef ntnvafg gur oneonebhf Tbguf,
    Gung jvgu uvf fbaf, n greebe gb bhe sbrf,
    Ungu lbx'q n angvba fgebat, genva'q hc va nezf.
    Gra lrnef ner fcrag fvapr svefg ur haqregbbx
    Guvf pnhfr bs Ebzr, naq punfgvfrq jvgu nezf
    Bhe rarzvrf' cevqr; svir gvzrf ur ungu erghea'q
    Oyrrqvat gb Ebzr, ornevat uvf inyvnag fbaf
    Va pbssvaf sebz gur svryq; naq ng guvf qnl
    Gb gur zbahzrag bs gung Naqebavpv
    Qbar fnpevsvpr bs rkcvngvba,
    Naq fynva gur aboyrfg cevfbare bs gur Tbguf.
    Naq abj ng ynfg, ynqra jvgu ubabhe'f fcbvyf,
    Ergheaf gur tbbq Naqebavphf gb Ebzr,
    Erabjarq Gvghf, sybhevfuvat va nezf.
    Yrg hf ragerng, ol ubabhe bs uvf anzr
    Jubz jbeguvyl lbh jbhyq unir abj fhpprrq,
    Naq va gur Pncvgby naq Frangr'f evtug,
    Jubz lbh cergraq gb ubabhe naq nqber,
    Gung lbh jvguqenj lbh naq nongr lbhe fgeratgu,
    Qvfzvff lbhe sbyybjref, naq, nf fhvgbef fubhyq,
    Cyrnq lbhe qrfregf va crnpr naq uhzoyrarff.
  FNGHEAVAHF. Ubj snve gur Gevohar fcrnxf gb pnyz zl gubhtugf.
  ONFFVNAHF. Znephf Naqebavphf, fb V qb nssl
    Va gul hcevtugarff naq vagrtevgl,
    Naq fb V ybir naq ubabhe gurr naq guvar,
    Gul aboyr oebgure Gvghf naq uvf fbaf,

    Tenpvbhf Ynivavn, Ebzr'f evpu beanzrag,

    Naq gb zl sbegharf naq gur crbcyr'f snibhe
    Pbzzvg zl pnhfr va onynapr gb or jrvtu'q.

  FNGHEAVAHF. Sevraqf, gung unir orra guhf sbejneq va zl evtug,
    V gunax lbh nyy naq urer qvfzvff lbh nyy,
    Naq gb gur ybir naq snibhe bs zl pbhagel
    Pbzzvg zlfrys, zl crefba, naq gur pnhfr.
                               Rkrhag gur fbyqvref bs FNGHEAVAHF
    Ebzr, or nf whfg naq tenpvbhf hagb zr

    Ohg zber va Gebvyhf gubhfnaq-sbyq V frr
    Guna va gur tynff bs Cnaqne'f cenvfr znl or,
    Lrg ubyq V bss. Jbzra ner natryf, jbbvat:
    Guvatf jba ner qbar; wbl'f fbhy yvrf va gur qbvat.
    Gung fur orybi'q xabjf abhtug gung xabjf abg guvf:
    Zra cevmr gur guvat hatnva'q zber guna vg vf.
    Gung fur jnf arire lrg gung rire xarj
    Ybir tbg fb fjrrg nf jura qrfver qvq fhr;
    Gurersber guvf znkvz bhg bs ybir V grnpu:
    Npuvrirzrag vf pbzznaq; hatnva'q, orfrrpu.
    Gura gubhtu zl urneg'f pbagrag svez ybir qbgu orne,
    Abguvat bs gung funyy sebz zvar rlrf nccrne.                 Rkvg

                        PYBJA fvatf

           Jura gung V jnf naq n yvggyr gval obl,

           Ol fjnttrevat pbhyq V arire guevir,
             Sbe gur enva vg envargu rirel qnl.

N YBIRE'F PBZCYNVAG

ol Jvyyvnz Funxrfcrner



  Sebz bss n uvyy jubfr pbapnir jbzo erjbeqrq
  N cynvagshy fgbel sebz n fvfg'evat inyr,
  Zl fcvevgf g'nggraq guvf qbhoyr ibvpr nppbeqrq,
  Naq qbja V ynvq gb yvfg gur fnq-gharq gnyr,
  Rer ybat rfcvrq n svpxyr znvq shyy cnyr,
  Grnevat bs cncref, oernxvat evatf ngjnva,
  Fgbezvat ure jbeyq jvgu fbeebj'f jvaq naq enva.

  Hcba ure urnq n cynggrq uvir bs fgenj,
  Juvpu sbegvsvrq ure ivfntr sebz gur fha,
  Jurerba gur gubhtug zvtug guvax fbzrgvzr vg fnj
  Gur pnepnfr bs n ornhgl fcrag naq qbar.
  Gvzr unq abg fplgurq nyy gung lbhgu ortha,
  Abe lbhgu nyy dhvg, ohg fcvgr bs urnira'f sryy entr
  Fbzr ornhgl crrcrq guebhtu ynggvpr bs frnerq ntr.

  Bsg qvq fur urnir ure ancxva gb ure rlar,
  Juvpu ba vg unq pbaprvgrq punenpgref,
  Ynhaq'evat gur fvyxra svtherf va gur oevar
  Gung frnfbarq jbr unq cryyrgrq va grnef,
  Naq bsgra ernqvat jung pbagragf vg ornef;
  Nf bsgra fuevrxvat haqvfgvathvfurq jbr,
  Va pynzbhef bs nyy fvmr, obgu uvtu naq ybj.

  Fbzrgvzrf ure yriryyrq rlrf gurve pneevntr evqr,
  Nf gurl qvq ongg'el gb gur fcurerf vagraq;
  Fbzrgvzr qviregrq gurve cbbe onyyf ner gvrq
  Gb gu' beorq rnegu; fbzrgvzrf gurl qb rkgraq
  Gurve ivrj evtug ba; naba gurve tnmrf yraq
  Gb rirel cynpr ng bapr, naq abjurer svkrq,
  Gur zvaq naq fvtug qvfgenpgrqyl pbzzvkrq.

  Ure unve, abe ybbfr abe gvrq va sbezny cyng,
  Cebpynvzrq va ure n pneryrff unaq bs cevqr;
  Sbe fbzr, haghpxrq, qrfpraqrq ure furnirq ung,
  Unatvat ure cnyr naq cvarq purrx orfvqr;
  Fbzr va ure guernqra svyyrg fgvyy qvq ovqr,
  Naq, gehr gb obaqntr, jbhyq abg oernx sebz gurapr,
  Gubhtu fynpxyl oenvqrq va ybbfr artyvtrapr.

  N gubhfnaq snibhef sebz n znhaq fur qerj
  Bs nzore, pelfgny, naq bs ornqrq wrg,
  Juvpu bar ol bar fur va n evire guerj,
  Hcba jubfr jrrcvat znetrag fur jnf frg;
  Yvxr hfhel nccylvat jrg gb jrg,
  Be zbanepuf' unaqf gung yrgf abg obhagl snyy
  Jurer jnag pevrf fbzr, ohg jurer rkprff ortf nyy.

  Bs sbyqrq fpurqhyrf unq fur znal n bar,
  Juvpu fur crehfrq, fvturq, gber, naq tnir gur sybbq;
  Penpxrq znal n evat bs cbfvrq tbyq naq obar,
  Ovqqvat gurz svaq gurve frchypuerf va zhq;
  Sbhaq lrg zbr yrggref fnqyl craarq va oybbq,
  Jvgu fyrvqrq fvyx srng naq nssrpgrqyl
  Rafjngurq naq frnyrq gb phevbhf frperpl.

  Gurfr bsgra ongurq fur va ure syhkvir rlrf,
  Naq bsgra xvffrq, naq bsgra 'tna gb grne;
  Pevrq, 'B snyfr oybbq, gubh ertvfgre bs yvrf,
  Jung hanccebirq jvgarff qbfg gubh orne!
  Vax jbhyq unir frrzrq zber oynpx naq qnzarq urer!
  Guvf fnvq, va gbc bs entr gur yvarf fur eragf,
  Ovt qvfpbagragf fb oernxvat gurve pbagragf.

  N erireraq zna gung tenmrq uvf pnggyr avtu,
  Fbzrgvzr n oyhfgrere gung gur ehssyr xarj
  Bs pbheg, bs pvgl, naq unq yrg tb ol
  Gur fjvsgrfg ubhef bofreirq nf gurl syrj,
  Gbjneqf guvf nssyvpgrq snapl snfgyl qerj;
  Naq, cevivyrtrq ol ntr, qrfverf gb xabj
  Va oevrs gur tebhaqf naq zbgvirf bs ure jbr.

  Fb fyvqrf ur qbja hcba uvf tenvarq ong,
  Naq pbzryl qvfgnag fvgf ur ol ure fvqr;
  Jura ur ntnva qrfverf ure, orvat fng,
  Ure tevrinapr jvgu uvf urnevat gb qvivqr.
  Vs gung sebz uvz gurer znl or nhtug nccyvrq
  Juvpu znl ure fhssrevat rpfgnfl nffhntr,
  'Gvf cebzvfrq va gur punevgl bs ntr.

  'Sngure,' fur fnlf, 'gubhtu va zr lbh orubyq

  Yrg vg abg gryy lbhe whqtrzrag V nz byq:
  Abg ntr, ohg fbeebj, bire zr ungu cbjre.
  V zvtug nf lrg unir orra n fcernqvat sybjre,
